With that level of strength, Yi Yun could have easily killed him. That was the case even with the blanketing of the Luo King's psyche forces.

"My own strength far exceeds your imagination. Not only so, I have the Blood King backing me. I can protect you.

"If you are willing, I can sign a contract with you. As long as you serve me for ten years, you will be given freedom!"

At Yi Yun's level, he no longer needed the black Sea Serpent to aid him in battle. To put it frankly, the Sea Serpent was too weak!

However, having the Sea Serpent in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins saved him a lot of trouble. It was enough to shock and awe others! After all, even Rain Numinous's realm was only a quasi-Fey Thearch.

To subdue a quasi-Fey Thearch as his bodyguard, he could also smack Jiang Yuchan and the Luo King's face. This was very helpful for Jiang Xiaorou's fight for the throne.

The Sea Serpent growled softly. Its will was contained within the growl as it reached into Yi Yun's ears.

He knew that the Sea Serpent had agreed.

Yi Yun smiled. The enticement of freedom was not something the Sea Serpent could refuse.

He flicked his finger as an even more blinding bolt of Heretical God Lightning flew into the Sea Serpent's body.

This lightning contained the Heavenly Dao laws!

Although he could violently destroy the Luo King's seal inside the Sea Serpent's body, he did not do so. Instead, he abided by the laws and slowly unlocked it!

As such, it would not make Yi Yun appear too much of a freak.

A few seconds later, the seal within the Sea Serpent was completely removed!

To remove the seal using such means only proved that Yi Yun knew of a particular mystic technique and not that he possessed strength that matched a Fey Thearch. This was equivalent to how array grandmasters might be invincible when it came to arrays, but their actual combat strength was nothing much.

Even so, the Sea Serpent was completely astounded. He never expected Yi Yun to remove it as he said. A shackle that had bound it for hundreds of thousands of years had been removed just like that!

It was too excited. All it needed to do after this was be loyal to Yi Yun for ten years and it was free!

It still had a very long lifespan. Given time, it could even improve and become a Fey Thearch!

"You'll recognize me as master for ten years from today! You are to do whatever I tell you to do, but don't worry. I will definitely not send you to your death."

"Roar!" the Sea Serpent roared, expressing its acknowledgment.

And at that moment in time, they were still fighting, but they were acting after all. No matter how good their acting was, it was different from a real battle.

The surrounding experts soon noticed it.

"Darn it, what is that swine doing?" Jiang Yuchan raged. The Luo King's suppression had already been pushed to its limits. Yi Yun was clearly affected and the Sea Serpent should have released all of its lifeblood powers to crush Yi Yun. Yet, it did not do so. The battle appeared to be carried out perfunctorily, so how could Jiang Yuchan not be angry?

"Swine! If you do not heavily injure Lin Yun in the thirty seconds, I'll lock you up with the Dragon Lock for three years after this battle! Then, I'll extract your heart's blood to refine as medicine!" Jiang Yuchan warned. Three years under the Dragon Lock would definitely weaken the Sea Serpent. Extracting its heart's blood would only injure it even more greatly.

Upon hearing Jiang Yuchan's voice transmission, the Sea Serpent turned its head suddenly and looked at Jiang Yuchan. Its eyes flashed with hatred!

"Oh? You swine! What do you think you are doing?" Jiang Yuchan glared angrily, his eyes filled with coldness.

At the same time, Yi Yun's voice sounded in the Sea Serpent's ears. "Join hands with me and charge out the arena's array formation!"

Yi Yun alone was enough to crack the array!

However, there was the Fey Thearch's suppression and he did not wish to appear too startling. Joining hands with the Sea Serpent would be interesting enough.

"Attack!"

Yi Yun gave the order as the Sea Serpent let out an enraged roar. It instantly ignited all the lifeblood powers that erupted from consuming the Explosive Blood Fey Pill.

"Boom!"

The Sea Serpent crashed into the arena's array like a plummeting star, causing the entire arena to quake. The array cracked, producing cracks that resembled a spider's web!

And Yi Yun followed closely behind and slashed out with Mirage Snow. All his energy was gathered at one point as he struck the spot where the Sea Serpent had collided.

He cracked the entirety with one point!

Besides, the entirety of the array had already been shattered by the Sea Serpent to begin with!

"Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!"

The entire array shattered like glass being struck by a hammer. The Sea Serpent and Yi Yun charged out of the confines!

Chapter 1644: Brutal Beating

"What!?"

Everyone present was alarmed. They never expected such a turn of events.

Yi Yun had actually charged out of the arena together with the black Sea Serpent! Why was this happening!? And the direction in which they were charging was actually… Jiang Yuchan's direction!

Jiang Yuchan was considered half an owner of the Fey Blood Plains. As a Fey beast reared by the Fey Blood Plains, how could the black Sea Serpent attack its master!?

"Courting death!" Jiang Yuchan's heart turned anxious with rage. He had no idea what had happened, but he was certain that it was all because of Yi Yun.

Beside him, Jiang Yuebai had already taken a step forward to shield Jiang Yuchan. As a trusted aide of the Luo King, he naturally had to protect the young successor.

"The black Sea Serpent's seal has been removed!"

Jiang Yuebai also had the right to trigger the seal, but when he activated the seal, he realized that it was already gone from the Sea Serpent's body.

Was it removed by Lin Yun?

Jiang Yuebai did not have the luxury of time to think. The Sea Serpent had already roared and reached out its dragon claws to swipe at Jiang Yuebai.

In terms of grade, Jiang Yuebai was also at the quasi-Fey Thearch cultivation level. He was the strongest expert on Jiang Yuchan's lineup, making him equal to the Sea Serpent!

And now, the Explosive Blood Fey Pill's powers in the black Sea Serpent's body had yet been fully consumed. Its combat powers were still at their peak!

Jiang Yuebai roared as well, causing his star-patterned robe to blast apart. His muscles bulged as a Heaven Fey totem phantom appeared behind him!

The Heaven Fey totem was a heptagon star, and the six corners were separately Extreme Yang Illumination, Extreme Yin Nether Glow, as well as the azure dragon, vermilion bird, white tiger, and black turtle.

Jiang Yuebai only lit up the white tiger's corner!

Even so, the moment the Heaven Fey totem appeared, it augmented Jiang Yuebai with immense strength.

"Boom!"

Jiang Yuebai threw out a punch at the Sea Serpent's claw, sweeping up a potent blast that caused the surrounding mercenaries to retreat.

Jiang Yuebai had managed to withstand the black Sea Serpent's blow alone! Furthermore, the Sea Serpent was burning its lifeblood powers!

But the black Sea Serpent had Yi Yun on its side!

Yi Yun had already appeared in front of Jiang Yuebai like Death!

He held Mirage Snow and the sword was crackling and burning with lightning and fire!

"Protect the Successor!"

The mercenaries shouted as they lunged towards Jiang Yuchan, but at that instant, Yi Yun had activated his domain!

"Scram!"

Yi Yun berated them as powerful Primordial Chaos and Destructive powers poured out like a flood breaching its banks. The ten plus mercenaries had their protective lifebloods completely explode. Even their weapons cracked from the shock.

At that instance, they felt as though they had stepped into a Shura sea of blood. Their lifeblood seemed to be drawn away without them being able to do a thing.

"Bam! Bam! Bam!" The ten plus mercenaries failed to withstand the might as they knelt down right there and then. The weaker ones had their kneecaps crushed as they spat out blood!

The mercenaries were instantly washed away as Yi Yun's sword went straight for Jiang Yuchan's chest!

Jiang Yuchan was astounded. He never expected Yi Yun to be that bold. Was he planning on assassinating him? Was he sick of living?

"Do you really think you are invincible!?" Jiang Yuchan roared angrily as he bit the tip of his tongue and spewed out a mouthful of blood essence.

He knew Yi Yun was powerful, so he immediately burned his blood essence!

At the same time, a Heaven Fey totem appeared behind Jiang Yuchan!

The potent lifeblood forces interwove to form a protective net to withstand Yi Yun's strike. At the same time, he opened his mouth, spitting out a green talisman charm.

The green talisman charm was naturally created through a great deal of effort by the Luo King. It was meant to protect his life.

He knew very well that by stalling for time, the Luo King would arrive and Yi Yun would have to pay a terrible price for his transgression.

However, before the talisman charm could be activated, Yi Yun's sword had already stabbed into his protective lifeblood. The lifeblood powers he had always been proud of were penetrated by Mirage Snow as though they were paper!

In his alarm, Jiang Yuchan retreated rapidly! But at that moment, the ice-cold sword tip had proceeded straight for him. The lightning and fire on the sword tip formed a tiny purple and black sword that stabbed right into Jiang Yuchan's chest.

"Bam!"

Jiang Yuchan was thrown out as the color in his face drained. The two tiny swords had stabbed two holes in him!

At that moment, the talisman he had spat out had only just flown out. Before it could even ignite, it was beckoned by Yi Yun and snatched.

The next moment, Yi Yun appeared in front of Jiang Yuchan and stepped on his chest.

"Puah!"

Jiang Yuchan spat out a mouthful of blood as he flew out like a ball, slamming into the spectator stands and shattering them in the process.

Boom!

Rubble collapsed as Jiang Yuchan stood up among the debris. His face was covered in blood and his heart was filled with horror.

He did not realize how terrifying Yi Yun was until he fought him. Only in that clash did he realize how big a gap there was between him and Yi Yun!

He could not even withstand a single strike!

In his anxiety, he was afraid that he could not last until the Luo King arrived to kill Yi Yun!

Furthermore, he could sense that the energies of the two fire and lightning swords had flown into his chest and remained lurking in his body. Although the two energies were not causing him any damage, their potential for damage was worrying.

The spectators exclaimed inwardly as they saw Jiang Yuchan being brutally beaten up by Yi Yun. They never expected the match to end up like that.

They could forget the fact that Yi Yun had captured the past two Fey beasts alive, but even the strongest quasi-Fey Thearch Fey beast had been incited to defect by him.

"Yun-er!"

Jiang Xiaorou flew from her seat and towards Yi Yun.

At that moment, a powerful suppression fell from the sky. A cold voice resounded above the Fey Blood Plains.

"Nice! Very nice indeed! Am I, Jiang Luo, old already? Just with that bit of talent, you wish to wreak havoc in my Fey Blood Plains?"

The moment the suppression arrived, the spectators immediately felt all their lifeblood repressed. Even their hearts did not seem to be beating.

Although they could hear his voice, they could not see his body.

However, they knew that the Luo King had come!

The Luo King was here!

Jiang Yuchan was immediately delighted. "Grandfather, save me!"

Yi Yun remained stoic as he waved his hand. A Fey beast bag appeared as he stored away the black Sea Serpent.

The Sea Serpent did not resist either. It was extremely afraid with the Luo King present. It was a good feeling having freedom, but once it let its guard down, it could be captured by the Luo King again. It did not dare imagine the consequences of that scenario.

"So it's Senior Luo King."

Yi Yun smiled as he cupped his hands into the air.

The Luo King did not show himself. He had only projected his aura to stun the entire area. As for Yi Yun, he had immediately found the Luo King's location!

The direction in which he cupped his hands was where the Luo King was.

At that moment, the void that Yi Yun was facing warped a little. A middle-aged man in a purple-golden dragon robe appeared out of thin air.

He was tall in build with deep facial features. His eyes were especially long and his nose especially high. His nose tip was curved, covering nearly the entirety of his philtrum. This made him look extremely odd and gave one an everlasting impression.

"Interesting. You actually managed to spot my location."

The Luo King said it calmly, but his heart was somewhat alarmed. The young man's nomological attainments were truly terrifying.

Chapter 1645: Fey Thearchs' Staredown

No one expected that Yi Yun would stir the Luo King into action after engaging in merely three rounds of combat. A figure like the Luo King was given high recognition even before the Ruins Emperor.

Against the Luo King, everyone felt a sense of trepidation. They looked at Yi Yun, but realized that he did not appear flustered at all. Even if he was putting on a front, it was already quite impressive.

"To battle in the beast colosseum, you must sign the life-and-death waiver. You must abide by the rules no matter how many Fey beasts you kill, but why did you attack my grandson?"

The Luo King's voice was aggressive.

Yi Yun sneered and said, "Your grandson wished for my death in my battle with the beast, but you don't permit me to counterattack? As a high and mighty Fey Thearch, you have even tampered with the protective array formation, going as far as to sever your psyche force to inject it into the array. When you encounter undefeatable opponents, you trigger the severed psyche force to harm the gladiator. This sure is a brilliant plan!"

Yi Yun's words shocked everyone!

Many people were watching the fight as entertainment, but they had no idea of the exact details. Now that Yi Yun had made an exposé, they learned that the Luo King had severed a portion of his psyche force to harm geniuses in battle.

Although the Fey Blood Plains' battle rules were self-determined and never claimed to avoid such acts, it was still quite a loathsome piece of news. What was the meaning of this? In order to ensure his interests in the Fey Blood Plains, the Fey Thearch would personally enter the battle with his psyche force to harm the battling genius?

This was way too sensational. Furthermore, it was obvious that anyone who was targeted in such a manner was killed to ensure the confidentiality of the matter. The spectators would only believe that the gladiator had died due to their ineptitude, but they had no idea that it was a result of the Luo King's severed psyche force.

Instantly, the spectators present were enraged. They were so interested in the battle colosseum mainly because a number of them had participated in it before.

Now, it appeared that their survival was not because they were too powerful, but it was the complete opposite—they were too weak and unqualified.

The Luo King narrowed his eyes as he glared at Yi Yun. Ever since Yi Yun escaped despite Jiang Yuchan's triggering of his severed psyche force, the situation had already gone out of control.

Yi Yun was completely disparaging him due to his backing from the Blood King.

At the end of the day, it was because Yi Yun had removed the seal in the black Sea Serpent's body, allowing for it to mutiny.

The Luo King was stumped. The seal he had planted involved ancient mystic arts. The restraints the mystic art provided was something even the Blood King could not remove. How did Yi Yun manage to do it?

"Blood King, since you are here, there's no need to hide. Come on out!"

The Luo King suddenly spoke. He had appeared only to protect Jiang Yuchan. After all, he was forced to do so since Yi Yun's attack had nearly killed Jiang Yuchan.

As for suppressing Yi Yun, that was impossible. This was because the moment he appeared, the Blood King, who had a vendetta against him, would definitely appear.

This resulted in a stalemate between the two Fey Thearchs. The ones to truly determine victory were the juniors.

But against a freak of nature like Yi Yun, which junior was his match?

"Hahaha! Luo King, how have you been?"

A dragged out laughter was heard as the space behind Yi Yun warped. A man dressed in blood-colored robes appeared out of thin air. His hair flared in the air and his eyes were deep like the abyss. It was as though he could suck the souls of others into them.

Just looking at the Blood King made others feel like they had arrived in a bloody pool in hell. There were the appalling sounds of slaughtering all around and they seemed to see countless roaring Fey beasts. There was bodies of people engaging in massacres with blood-stained weapons as far as the eyes could see!

Blood King!

Everyone held their breaths for he was a lot mightier when it came to his stance.

The Luo King was stable and distant, like a lofty mountain.

As for the Blood King, he was filled with a decimation aura. Facing him felt like one was facing devils from an abyss. It left people stifled.

Two Fey Thearchs!

In the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins, these Fey Thearchs stood high above others. Commoners seldom saw them, but there were two appearing at one go!

"Luo King, what's the matter? The juniors are just sparring, but it actually pushed you into action. Is your grandson that useless? He has a quasi-Fey Thearch, Jiang Yuebai, to protect him, as well as a quasi-Fey Thearch Fey beast to summon. He even has a severed psyche force you left him and an intrinsic talisman charm. For him to be reduced to such a pathetic state by Lin Yun despite having so many good things that you needed to rush here to save his life must have been hard on you."

The Blood King did not hold back on his sarcasm. This was how the Fey handled things. For humans, even when important figures faced each other, their words would be somewhat measured, but the Blood King did not have such scruples. He was verbally smacking faces!

And he said whatever dealt the maximum impact.

He had a grudge with the Luo King to begin with. Now, Yi Yun had disgraced the Luo King so thoroughly that it was equivalent to tearing his face off and trampling it on the ground. He was in such a good mood that he yearned to cheer on Yi Yun.

Upon hearing the Blood King's words, Jiang Yuchan was so depressed that he wanted to die.

The result of the situation today was all because he had lost to Yi Yun. Furthermore, he had lost terribly; thus causing the Luo King to be in such a passive predicament.

The Luo King looked at the Blood King, but he did not retort. Anything he said would appear pointless and weak. He said, "Blood King, I heard that you have always wished to battle me?"

The Luo King's words stunned everyone present.

A battle among Fey Thearchs!?

In the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins, battles between Fey Thearchs were very rare. However, they still occurred. After all, the Fey were a combative race. Any disagreements that could not be resolved, ones that the Ruins Emperor could not mediate, would result in a battle among Fey Thearchs!

The typical Fey Thearch cherished their lives, so they did not easily engage in battle. After all, winning the battle required them to pay quite a considerable price. And any loss would be worse. Not only would they lose their reputation, they would also lose actual interests.

The Luo King had no intention to fight the Blood King originally, but he had been disgraced today. If he did not counterattack, he would become the laughing stock of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins.

A battle among Fey Thearchs was sufficient to divert the attention of the entire city.

Besides, the Blood King was a newly ascended Fey Thearch. He was at his prime and his strength improved rapidly. He also was at odds against him in every aspect. If he could heavily damage the Blood King during this period of growth, he could curtail his momentum and completely solidify his advantage.

Instantly, the Blood King and Luo King sent their lifeblood churning. They faced each other in a stalemate as the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi in the Fey Blood Plains split into two because of their appearance! If one went from the region where the Blood King was standing in to the Luo King's region, they would have the sensation of walking from one world to another.

This was the power of a Fey Thearch. Once they released their auras, they could form a world in and of itself.

The battle that was about to erupt between two Fey Thearchs stirred the zeal and ardor in everyone. This was a rare scene that left them thrilled. They no longer even cared that they had lost huge amounts of Chaos Crystal because of Yi Yun's victory.

Chapter 1646: Princess Chang

With nothing to lose, the crowd watched with anticipation as the two Fey Thearchs prepared to do battle.

At that moment, be it Jiang Xiaorou or Jiang Yuchan, their breathing had stagnated as they turned nervous. This battle was of paramount importance!

Defeat would mean the loss of certain interests. For example, the Blood King might end up losing the Treasure Fey Pagoda.

The Luo King could lose the Fey Blood Plains or the Nine Tribulations Veranda.

Yi Yun narrowed his eyes. In terms of strength, the Blood King was likely the Luo King's superior; after all, he cultivated in the Indestructible Killing Dao. There was nearly no genius in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins who chose this path, much less cultivated it to perfection.

However, under the circumstances that their strength was nearly equal during a bout between Fey Thearchs, it did not necessarily mean that the stronger side would win. Certain ancient disk arrays, artifacts, talisman charms, and pills could reverse the situation.

The Luo King who had been a Fey Thearch a lot longer exceeded the Blood King in these aspects. Furthermore, the Luo King had a wide net of friends. If they really prepared for battle, the Luo King could definitely buy even more heaven-defying tools.

But at this moment, high above the Fey Blood Plains, a jadeite cruiser slowly floated in. A graceful figure slowly fleeted from it.

The figure was dressed in feathered clothes and her body was immersed in a blurry blue halo, making it impossible to discern her face.

But even so, the hundreds of thousands of warriors present tried their best to widen their eyes, hoping to identify her. In fact, they had already guessed who she was since the jadeite cruiser had already hinted at her identity—

Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' Princess Chang, the younger sister of the ruling Ruins Emperor!

She was deemed as the number one beauty in all of Heaven Fey City.

However, few people had ever seen her face. As the cultivation technique she cultivated in was unique, her entire body was immersed in blue light. Even a Fey Thearch found it very difficult to see through the blue halo. This was also why everyone was trying their best to see through the blue halo for a glimpse of her actual looks in the flesh.

However, when they stared for too long, their eyes felt a stabbing pain as they nearly lost their minds.

"Even Her Highness Princess Chang has been stirred!"

People were alarmed, but it was within reason. The Luo King and Blood King had appeared in person after all. Besides, both of them had a vendetta with one another. Once the situation escalated, the two would have a fight that could reduce the Heaven Fey City to ruins.

"Luo King, Blood King, this is a result of the younger generation. It pertains to the contest for title of crown designate, so it's best you do not involve yourselves in it!" Princess Chang said in an indescribably pleasant tone, her voice clear and distant.

The Fey never had any scruples about mentioning the imperial power struggles since the throne of the Ruins Emperor was won through bloodshed.

The Luo King gave Princess Chang a glance. Many of the time, the Ruins Emperor did not make an appearance. Princess Chang would appear on his behalf, indicating his stance on the matter. After all, although there were many princes and princesses in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins, few of them were true siblings.

Princess Chang and the Ruins Emperor shared the same father but different mothers. Therefore, they were naturally close with one another.

With Princess Chang having affirmed her stance, the Luo King did not say anything further.

Besides, victory was not certain for him. He had mentioned battling the Blood King only to save his reputation.

"A battle between juniors can simply be left to juniors…"

As Princess Chang was speaking—

"Puah!"

Jiang Yuchan spewed out a mouthful of blood as he tumbled down the spectator stands.

"Oh?"

The Luo King was astounded as he quickly teleported over. He grabbed Jiang Yuchan and was shaken when he probed his body.

Inside Jiang Yuchan's body, interspersed within his meridians, flesh, and blood were fine threads. These threads were like nets that were embedded deep in his flesh and bones. Apart from that, there were tiny beads which hung on the lightning threads like cherries. Every bead contained potent forces that would blast Jiang Yuchan's body to smithereens the moment it exploded.

"This is… Lightning and Fire?"

The Luo King's brows twitched. The threads were lightning threads while the cherry-like objects were Fire pearls!

When he turned his gaze to Jiang Yuchan's Fey core, he drew a gasp.

The surface of Jiang Yuchan's Fey core was also covered in a layer of purple lightning threads. A portion of these lightning threads had even entered deep into Jiang Yuchan's Fey core!

He attempted to strip the lightning threads, but any motion caused the color in Jiang Yuchan's face to drain and his body to tremble. Even his Fey core appeared to be on the brink of cracking together with the lightning threads.

The Luo King turned his head at Yi Yun. "You!?"

The lightning net and fire pearls was clearly Yi Yun's work. Yi Yun was the only one who had attacked Jiang Yuchan.

Lightning could be used in a myriad of ways. Warriors who were skilled in lightning laws could even weave lightning threads into cloths and wear them.

And after Yi Yun gained the Heavenly Dao fragment and mastered the Heavenly Dao laws, his means were already completely incomparable to the typical warrior's.

This lightning net combined with fire pearls had Jiang Yuchan's life in its grasp!

Back when Yi Yun stabbed Jiang Yuchan, he did not cause any substantial damage to him since his real intention was to plant the lightning net and fire pearls in him.

Upon seeing the Luo King looking at him angrily, Yi Yun said calmly, "Jiang Yuchan wanted to use a Godly Monarch's psyche force to kill me. I naturally had to counterattack with full force. This Lightning Fire Sword is my killer move. Now that there's some remnant fire and lightning in Jiang Yuchan's body, I will need to pay a tremendous price if I'm to treat him. I think it's best left to you, Luo King. Such a trivial matter should be nothing to you."

After saying so, Yi Yun threw up his hands, completely ignoring the look on Luo King's face.

The surrounding crowd shuddered when they saw this. Yi Yun was completely offending the Luo King!

Even with the Blood King supporting him, offending a Fey Thearch was never a wise choice. The Blood King could not protect him all the time. Wouldn't the Luo King spare no cost to kill Yi Yun when the opportunity arose?

"Fine, well done!"

The Luo King fumed. He pressed one hand on Jiang Yuchan's head as his lifeblood powers surged into Jiang Yuchan's body.

Then, he extracted the lightning and fire bit by bit.

But at that moment, Jiang Yuchan let out a tragic cry like a pig about to be slaughtered.

His body convulsed as blood flowed out of his seven orifices. His expression was as pale as a sheet.

"Grand… Grandpa…"

Jiang Yuchan was in extreme pain. He was a highly refined person to begin with. As such, he would never show such a pathetic side to him in public unless he he absolutely could not handle the pain.

What Yi Yun had left in him was too vicious!

The lightning threads reached deep into his intrinsic bloodline and right into his bone marrow. With the Luo King extracting them, he felt as though his bone marrow was being extracted. The pain was obvious!

Seeing Jiang Yuchan struggling continuously, the Luo King's expression turned nasty.

He realized that he had no way of removing the lightning threads and fire beads.

It had nothing to do with how powerful the lightning threads and fire beads were; they were just too intertwined with Jiang Yuchan like viruses or germs that had invaded one's body. Although those could be killed with boiling water, doing so would kill the patient as well. Therefore, many illnesses were incurable once one was inflicted with them.

The present Jiang Yuchan was in such a situation.

Even with all his powers, the Luo King was helpless!

The Luo King stood up and looked at Yi Yun once again. His gaze made him look like an ancient Fey beast that was about to devour Yi Yun.

However, Yi Yun thought nothing of it. He was still having a merry chat with Jiang Xiaorou while ignoring the Luo King completely.

"Luo King." Jiang Yuebai was somewhat worried. "His Highness…"

At that moment, Jiang Yuchan was still in pain. What Yi Yun had planted in him was not immediately fatal, but it tormented him. Jiang Yuebai had watched Jiang Yuchan grow up, so his heart pained for him.

At that moment, everyone could tell that the Luo King did not have the means to extricate Jiang Yuchan from his pain. If he did, he would have done so a long time ago.

This left everyone alarmed. Yi Yun actually had such means!?

They recalled that the seal which the Luo King had planted in the black Sea Serpent was also removed by Yi Yun.

As such, the talent Yi Yun had in the aspect of planting and removing seals was above the Luo King's!

"Do you think you can act this fearlessly because the Blood King is protecting you?" The Luo King's Yuan Qi voice transmission sounded in Yi Yun's ears.

Yi Yun looked at the Luo King and said with a smile, "Senior Luo King, what are you saying? As a junior, I can't seem to understand you."

Yi Yun had directly voiced out the Luo King's sending of a voice transmission.

The Luo King had not said it publicly for fear of affecting his reputation, but Yi Yun had deliberately smacked him right in the face.

Luo King was raging mad. He had appeared today in the hope of taking back the black Sea Serpent, but he never expected to not only fail, but even see Jiang Yuchan at Yi Yun's mercy!

"Luo King, don't tell me you wish for me to treat Jiang Yuchan? I did mention that I attacked him because he wanted me dead. All I could do was counterattack. As for his injuries, I will require a tremendous price to save him. So it's best you do it yourself."

Yi Yun repeated his words, but when they landed in the Luo King's ears, they were filled with sarcasm.

High in the sky, Princess Chang frowned as well. She had appeared to stop the fight between the Blood King and the Luo King. She had given sufficient reason for them to do so—conflict between juniors naturally had to be resolved among themselves. It was only right.

However, she never expected Yi Yun to be so insidious. He had taken the black Sea Serpent and ignoring the figurative smack in the face, he had trounced Jiang Yuchan. Not only that, he had even left contingencies in his body.

He had really gone too far. Even if Jiang Yuchan had been in the wrong, he did not deserve to be put in such a tragic state!

Therefore, without the Luo King making a request, Princess Chang looked at the Blood King. Her intentions were obvious; she wanted the Blood King to get Yi Yun to save Jiang Yuchan.

However, the Blood Jade feigned ignorance by completely ignoring Princess Chang. He was a ruthless person to begin with and one that was protective of his brethren. He did not care about reputation as well. Jiang Yuchan had intended to kill Yi Yun, so how was it possible for him to get Yi Yun to help him?

Princess Chang was exasperated. What was Yi Yun planning to do? Didn't he know anything about making compromises after gaining an advantage? Did he really want to kill Jiang Yuchan?

Although Princess Chang was already biased towards Jiang Yuchan, her stature did not permit her to make the request.

She moved lightly towards Jiang Yuchan, grudgingly thinking to herself how useless the Luo King was. All he did was focus on cultivating his lifeblood and dabbled little in the mystic arts. If not, would he have failed to resolve a mere junior's seal?

Chapter 1647: Tremendous Price

In fact, most Fey warriors focused on cultivating their lifeblood. Just like Heaven Earth Yuan Qi were related to laws, lifeblood powers were related to the body. Lifeblood could both nourish a body and be released as an attack.

The Fey cultivated in their lifeblood and had the advantage of their bloodlines. This was not something humans could compare with. Furthermore, the Fey also endorsed tough combat styles.

Most Fey warriors were unwilling to cultivate in mystic arts or array formations. It was the same with the Luo King.

He was a genius when it came to the aspect of bloodline in his youth, so his lifeblood powers left others in the dust. But his mystic arts were much inferior to others.

This was also the reason why Princess Chang was unhappy with Luo King.

Although Princess Chang did not say it out loud, Luo King could sense her attitude and guess at what she was thinking.

At that moment, he did not say a word. All he did was take a step back and give her his spot.

Princess Chang waved her hand gently as a faint blue halo enveloped Jiang Yuchan.

Princess Chang's senses quickly probed Jiang Yuchan's body through the blue halo. Then, her expression somewhat stiffened. Of course, no one could tell since her body was covered in a halo.

She was surprised to discover that there was an extremely complex power contained within the lightning and fire that Yi Yun had released. It seemed to possess an undying strength that made the lightning and fire constantly renew itself. That prevented it from being frittered away.

Also present was a terrifying Major Destruction force. Just simple contact with it would trigger an explosion that would destroy Jiang Yuchan's body!

To extract the lightning and fire, brute strength was nearly impossible unless one could resolve the laws governing the fire and lightning.

"Your Highness, are you also at a loss?" the Luo King said with a voice transmission.

He was truly astounded at the moment. He had always been lacking when it came to the mystic arts, but Princess Chang was one of the better ones among the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' Fey Thearchs. She was about equal to some human Godly Monarchs.

If Princess Chang was helpless, that would imply that Yi Yun was terrifying.

"I'd like to help, but I'm unable to do so." Princess Chang felt depressed as well. She had disdained the Luo King just moments ago, but now she realized she was not any better.

She looked up and stared deeply at Yi Yun. She realized she had underestimated the young man!

Not only was he strong, his nomological insight was peerless. In time to come, he would likely become a peerless Godly Monarch.

She could not treat such a person as an ordinary junior.

"Is your name Lin Yun?" asked Princess Chang.

"Yes. Greetings, Princess Chang." Yi Yun cupped his hands.

"I mentioned that conflict between juniors should be resolved by them. Jiang Yuchan had offended you, so he deserves being reduced to this state. However, he is still a prince. Are you really planning on killing him?" said Princess Chang coldly.

Yi Yun said, "Your Highness, you are too harsh on your words. I only attacked in self-defense. I even stopped in a timely fashion because the Luo King arrived. As for Young Master Jiang Yuchan… I never expected Senior Luo King to be unable to save him. In that case, I will naturally have to do it, but to purge the poison of lightning and fire, I will need a special pill to protect the victim's lifeblood and soul. And the cost of this pill is nothing to scoff at. With my present wealth, I'm unable to refine it and I'm lacking in a lot of materials…"

"Oh?" Princess Chang pricked up her brows. "Don't tell me that the materials needed to refine this pills are the ones Treasure Fey Pagoda tried to purchase?"

The Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' Ruins Emperor spent most of his time in seclusion recently; therefore, many political issues were handled by Princess Chang. To put it more simply, she mostly managed the numerous Fey Thearchs in Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins. The other trivial matters were left to the other ministers.

Princess Chang knew of the Treasure Fey Pagoda's mass purchase of materials. All of them were rare and expensive!

Even the Luo King would feel the pinch to pay for that.

"Not everything, just a portion of it," said Yi Yun with a smile.

At that moment, even the slowest person understood what was happening. Wasn't he fishing in troubled waters?

Yi Yun had repeatedly emphasized that a tremendous price had to be paid if he helped personally. It was to build up his case for his final extortion.

Many of the warriors present also knew of the Treasure Fey Pagoda's list of materials. The rarity of the materials left people faltering. Furthermore, the more informed ones knew that Yi Yun had fought Jiang Yuchan because Jiang Yuchan had interfered with one of the items Yi Yun wanted to purchase—the Golden Feather Immortal Pistil.

Perhaps, back when Yi Yun left contingencies in Jiang Yuchan's body, he already had the intention of extorting the Luo King! Furthermore, he had expected the Luo King to appear.

The Luo King's appearance should have been a show of force. Logically speaking, Yi Yun was meant to be the one suffering.

But the opposite happened. The Luo King had appeared only to have his face figuratively smacked!

A junior had plotted against a Fey Thearch and had even succeeded. The seal which the Luo King had left behind had been easily removed by him. Yet, the seal he left behind was something even Princess Chang was powerless against.

This meant that Yi Yun's achievements in mystic arts and laws were completely incomprehensible!

"Senior Luo King, this is the list."

Yi Yun flicked his finger and shot out what appeared to be a purple piece of silk. It, along with the text on it, were a manifestation of lightning threads.

The Luo King narrowed his eyes without receiving the so-called list. All he did was stare at Yi Yun. People who knew the Luo King well knew that it was a manifestation of his anger. He was bent on killing Yi Yun.

He had disgraced himself completely and was now being extorted by Yi Yun. He would become the laughing stock of Heaven Fey City in the future!

"Senior Luo King, I shall bid you farewell for now. If you have any questions, you can always contact me."

Yi Yun cupped his hands as he spoke.

Now that no out for the Luo King was provided, hoping for him to agree on the spot was impossible. However, Yi Yun thought nothing of it. He was determined; if he was not out to fleece the Luo King, he would not have bothered with Jiang Yuchan.

At that moment, the Blood King laughed out loud. "Luo King, I'll shall take my leave as well. Thank you for your hospitality today. In addition, I heard that Xiaorou won a few hundred Chaos Crystals at your Fey Blood Plains. Why don't you cash it out to her now!"

Before the Blood King left, he did not forget to rub salt in the Luo King's wound.

Yi Yun clicked his tongue when he heard that. The Blood King sure wasn't a magnanimous person. People who offended him did not have good days ahead of them.

With her father backing her, Jiang Xiaorou decisively went to redeem the Chaos Crystals. Yi Yun's final battle with the black Sea Serpent ended with him bringing it under his control. It was naturally considered a win.

Having won three consecutive rounds, the dozens of Chaos Crystals which Jiang Xiaorou had brought had rose to seven hundred.

This was quite a huge sum too.

Her brother was truly impressive. They had been bullied by Jiang Yuchan in the beginning, but not only had Yi Yun won a huge sum of Chaos Crystals, it was even possible for him to earn priceless materials. It had even gratified the Blood King. It was really quite a earth-shaking move.

"Punk, when we return to the Blood King Palace, let's have a drink! I have an excellent thousand-year brew that I've been stashing away for an occasion like this," said the Blood King happily.

Yi Yun naturally agreed.

Beside them, Jiang Xiaorou could tell very clearly that her father completely acknowledged Yun'er after today's turn of events. Furthermore, it was an act of appreciation and partiality. If not, he would not have invited Yi Yun to drinks.

Chapter 1648: Flying Clouds Flowing Flower

The location of the Blood King's drinking grounds was still in the spirit mountain north of the city. It was a mountain as sharp as a sword, one that tore through the blue skies. Not only did it appear mighty, it was also a bountiful land of resources.

Originally, the spirit mountain belonged to a patriarch of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins. Many Fey Thearchs had their eyes set on it, but it was eventually bestowed to the Blood King.

Now, the spirit mountain had been named Snow King Peak, since "snow" was a homophone to "blood." After all, Snow King Peak was perennially covered in snow. Amid the snow, there was a clear pool that never froze. It was a beautiful vista to behold and had nothing to do with blood.

At that moment, Yi Yun and the Blood King were sitting in a pavilion in the middle of the lake having drinks. They were surrounded by immortal fruits and spirit food and served by nine fairy-like maidservants.

Jiang Xiaorou and Lin Xintong joined in the drinking as well.

The wine was a thousand-year-old vintage wine made from snow lotuses that were sourced from Snow King Peak. It was brewed together with ten-thousand-year-old melted ice water, which gave the wine a tiny bitter taste, but it was pure and refreshing. It left one highly spirited and refreshed after downing it.

It was the first time Yi Yun was tasting such excellent wine. Typically, wine left one groggy after drinking, but the wine made him more energetic as he drank it. It had the wondrous effect of nurturing his soul.

Yi Yun knew that such wine that could nourish his mind was priceless.

"Punk, you are siblings with Xiaorou, and since Xiaorou is my daughter, you are family to me. I heard from Xiaorou that your refinement of the Myriad Form Shura Pill requires the blood of the Ancestor Gods…"

The Blood King went straight to the topic. Yi Yun's mind stirred for he planned on fusing his bloodlines with the refined Myriad Form Shura Pills.

Now, Yi Yun had the Ancestor God bloodline, Dragon Emperor bloodline, as well as a human bloodline that resulted from his body-tempering cultivation.

The pills required materials in these three aspects to fuse them together.

Among these, the blood of the Ancestor God was rarer than a mighty Fey's Fey core. After all, the rulers-in-name of the Chaos Heavens were the Celestials. An attempt to purchase the blood of the Ancestor God would be equivalent to declaring war on the Celestials. The Celestials would not to tolerate it.

Therefore, the Treasure Fey Pagoda had left out the blood of the Ancestor God on the list of treasures it was purchasing.

Over the billions of years, the only one that showed open contempt to the Celestials and managed to kill an Ancestor God was the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch.

After he killed the Ancestor God, he sealed a portion of the Ancestor God's body in the Tian Yuan world. Later, the Blood King entered the Tian Yuan world and obtained the essence blood of the Ancestor God's body.

Now, he still had a little left of the Ancestor God's blood.

The Blood King took out a red jade bottle which was a spatial artifact. Contained in it was the blood of the Ancestor God.

He said, "I'm an ancient Heaven Fey after all. My bloodline is sufficiently powerful, so the all the Ancestor God's blood did was stimulate my bloodline and not remould my body. After I absorbed more than half of the Ancestor God's blood, there were already diminishing effects. I had kept it, planning to give it to Xiaorou after she transcends the Heavenly Tribulation and became capable of withstanding the potency of the Celestial blood. Since you need it now, I can give it to you."

The tiny jade bottle was handed to Yi Yun in such a simple manner.

Yi Yun took a deep breath and did not reject it. He was indeed in need of it.

"Senior, don't worry. The Myriad Form Shura Pills I'm refining will definitely be of great help to Sis Xiaorou. The effects will exceed that of directly absorbing the Ancestor God's blood. It can even be taken before transcending the Heavenly Tribulations!"

Yi Yun made a promise. He knew that his performance had won the Blood King's trust.

But even so, it was still something he had to be immensely grateful for. It was truly of timely assistance.

He planned on working hard to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills, so as to return his gratitude.

…

Time passed, and yet Yi Yun did not receive any response from the Luo King regarding his extorting list. He did not capitulate for it was impossible for him to submit to a junior.

Yi Yun thought nothing of it. He enjoyed the wine in Blood King Palace with the Blood King. During this period, Yi Yun also paid a visit to Jiang Xiaorou's mother—the Desolate Queen.

Back in the lower realm, the Desolate Queen had provided Yi Yun with a lot of care. Therefore, it was only right that he paid her a visit.

After so many centuries, the Desolate Queen appeared more gentle and virtuous. However, Yi Yun could also sense that she was under considerable pressure. Faced with the competition from the Blood King's harem, she could only rely on Jiang Xiaorou.

This also strengthened Yi Yun's resolve in refining the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

Now, as Fey Thearch, the Blood King had decreed the Fey to gather the materials for the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

Yi Yun did not sit idle during this period. Since the Luo King had no plans on getting him to rescue Jiang Yuchan, Yi Yun would pay the Fey Blood Plains a visit whenever he had the time.

Every time he visited, he would capture a Fey beast.

With Yi Yun already wiping the floor with the Fey Blood Plains' most powerful black Sea Serpent, how could there be another Fey beast that was his match?

And as Yi Yun's combat results were astounding, everyone would place their bets on him the moment he appeared.

Later, the Fey Blood Plains barred Yi Yun from entering. But how could they stop him? The numerous Fey Lords they assigned to the task were useless.

They had no idea what means Yi Yun had used to so easily enter the Fey Blood Plains. He would appear in the arena when they least expected it.

The moment he appeared, a black Sea Serpent would swim around the periphery of the arena, flashing its fangs and flailing its claws!

The black Sea Serpent also hated the Fey Blood Plains to the core. Having been placed in an advantageous position, it did its best to flaunt its prowess and worked hard to exact its revenge.

Therefore, the situation got out of hand. A black Sea Serpent with Yi Yun was a force that even Jiang Yuebai was no match for. In addition, countless spectators would place their bets on Yi Yun's victory with their Chaos Crystals. Chasing him out the arena would not only be a loss of reputation for them, but it would also incite public rage.

The Fey Blood Plains still depended on the audience to make a profit. Those that could pay the entrance fees to the Fey Blood Plains and still have the spare money to gamble were definitely of considerable status and strength.

As such, the Fey Blood Plains nearly went out of business due to Yi Yun's exploits.

Yet, seeking the Luo King's help was useless. Princess Chang had made it clear that matters of the juniors were to be resolved by juniors. Whatever Yi Yun had done was in line with the rules. There was no excuse the upper echelons could provide to intervene.

Furthermore, the Blood King did not sit idly by. He showcased his usefulness by participating in various events where the upper echelons of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins attended, guaranteeing Yi Yun's safety.

Therefore, not only had the Fey Blood Plains lost its support from the upper echelons, its owner, Jiang Yuchan, was in a dire situation himself. As such, it was left in a tragic state.

After a few arduous days, the Fey Blood Plains was temporarily closed!

And when that happened, Yi Yun decided to appear and sell off all the Fey beasts he captured, except for the Sea Serpent.

Originally, the Fey Blood Plains was the only de facto beast colosseum of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins. The others did not amount to anything, but after Yi Yun caused it to close down, the other factions began to stir.

A beast colosseum was a huge piece of pie. It was once the Luo King's and no one dared vie against his interests. But now that the Blood King was opposing the Luo King, they had to take a bite out of the pie to gain the Blood King's support!

In fact, the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins had many businesses that thrived through such means. They found a Fey Thearch to support them before setting up a business and expanding it!

Therefore, people had entered the Blood King Palace the past few days to make business negotiations.

Some of them offered excellent conditions. However, the Blood King did not accept them. Although what Yi Yun had done had made the Luo King suffer, it did not hurt him deep down. It was practically impossible to use these new businesses to completely rob the Luo King of his beast colosseum business.

The segregation of interests in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins was based on the strengths and qualifications of all the Fey Thearchs. It was not something that could be easily changed.

This continued until one day, the Blood King received news that his Fey Thearch decree had results.

Someone had offered an extremely rare material—Flying Clouds Flowing Flower!

Among all the materials Yi Yun was seeking, the Ancestor God's blood was the most difficult one; but thankfully, the Blood King had some of it.

Fey cores of powerful Fey were also rare.

As for the other treasured herbs, the rarest was the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower.

With it in hand, it made everything easier.

Back when Yi Yun extorted the Luo King, he did not include the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower. There was no point in going overboard in his extortion or it would only ensure that he did not receive a thing.

However, the person who had brought the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower surprised Yi Yun and the Blood King.

The person was from the Ghost race. His name was not important, to the point of people forgetting his name. People only remembered his title—Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor.

He had made a name for himself a long time ago. He was good in various killing techniques and excelled in medicine.

With a flip of a hand, he could send a person to hell; and with another flip of his hand, he could rescue a person from hell, reviving them in the process.

People that offended the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor were brewed into human puppets. He used his excellent medical skills to prolong their lives and used various means to torture them. They would only die after more than ten thousand years of torture.

This was probably the most painful way of dying.

And it was because of this that the mention of Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor changed the expressions of people in the Chaos Heavens.

Unless necessary, no one wished to have any dealings with the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor. Even if they were severely injured, they would not seek his medical services.

Getting the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor to treat any medical condition was like making a trade with the devil. He had too many means that could leave a person in a living hell.

The Blood King never expected the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor to come to him. He did not care about Fey Thearch decrees and was unmoved by anyone.

"The Flying Clouds Flowing Flower is a kind of sacred medicine meant for treating injuries. It's not odd that the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor can produce it. According to the descriptions of the voice transmission talisman, the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower is already a million years old, a top strain among supreme-grade ones. Other than the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor, perhaps no one in all of the Chaos Heavens can produce it," said the Blood King.

Yi Yun was moved by it. A million-year-old Flying Clouds Flowing Flower!

Yi Yun's purchase of these treasured herbs were done with the lowest of expectations. It was good enough having them, so he had not placed any demands on quality.

His original request was one that had bloomed.

Typically, it took 90,000 years for a Flying Clouds Flowing Flower to go from a bud to a blooming flower. But even so, it was extremely difficult to find one!

A million-year-old Flying Clouds Flowing Flower was like a flying cloud, so fleeting that it was practically impossible to find one.

Its worth was hard to place; it was unknown times more valuable than the standard Flying Clouds Flowing Flower that Yi Yun had asked for.

If he used such a Flying Clouds Flowing Flower to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills, not only would there be more pills, the quality of the pills would also elevate to a whole new state.

"According to Senior Blood King's description, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor probably is not lacking in Chaos Crystals. He probably has other motives for seeking us out."

It was obvious to Yi Yun that the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower in the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's hands was definitely not so easily attainable.

Chapter 1649: Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor

The information passed by the Blood King's subordinates only mentioned that the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor had a Flying Clouds Flowing Flower and that he was willing to make a trade; however, there was no mention of when it would take place, or what the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor wanted.

According to the prices of the Chaos Heavens, a recently bloomed Flying Clouds Flowing Flower could fetch five to six hundred Chaos Crystals. Yi Yun was completely capable of accepting such a price.

However, a million-year-old Flying Clouds Flowing Flower had a price of at least five to six thousand Chaos Crystals.

This was a huge sum of money that even the Blood King might have trouble producing, much less Yi Yun.

The Blood King had already provided the Ancestor God's blood, so Yi Yun did not feel that it was right to make him give up a large sum of Chaos Crystals as well.

Since there was no immediate news, Yi Yun decided to enter seclusive cultivation.

And it was during this time that Lin Xintong began attempting to condense her Divine Lord Royal Seal.

She cultivated in the Grand Reincarnation Technique, so the Divine Lord Royal Seal's condensation was extremely complicated. It was a very long process, but Lin Xintong was in no hurry. She did it a step at a time as she slowly figured out what it entailed.

Three days passed, and one morning, the Blood King finally received news from Treasure Fey Pagoda—the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor had arrived in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins and was living in the Yin Fountain Valley.

The Yin Fountain Valley was located west of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins where venomous bugs, snakes, and scorpions thrived. Typically, few Fey went to that godforsaken place, but to the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor, the Yin Fountain Valley was a lot better than Heaven Fey City.

Ghosts typically did not enjoy staying with Fey as the Fey had potent lifeblood powers. To a Ghost, these Fey warriors were like burning cauldrons. Although the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was strong, he did not enjoy seeing countless cauldrons flaring into the sky while in Heaven Fey City. It just left him uncomfortable.

Over the past few days, news of the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's visit to the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins also spread to Heaven Fey City. Although the ordinary populace remained unaware, the intelligence organizations in Heaven Fey City had already received the news and had in turn, sold the info. Although Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was someone people stayed away far from, he was still extremely adept in many magical mystic arts. There were still people who paid him attention, with some even planning on paying him a visit.

While these people were still making their decisions, Yi Yun and company had already arrived at the entrance to the Yin Fountain Valley.

This entourage included the Blood King!

The Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor had a terrible reputation, so the Blood King was worried Yi Yun would get into trouble if he were to go alone.

Not only did the Blood King come, even Rain Numinous had followed. The Blood King Palace's strongest combat forces were all present.

Other than that, there was Jiang Xiaorou, Lin Xintong, and Yi Yun's maidservant, Shan Ling.

The final person was the Treasure Fey Pagoda's Yuchi Huo. His strength was still considerable and he was the one who had previously liaised with the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor. He had personally appraised the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower and with his keen eye, there was definitely no mistake about it.

The Yin Fountain Valley was subject to cold winds. There were numerous venomous bugs around, but with the Blood King present, his aura of decimation was enough to prevent the bugs from approaching.

"The Indestructible Killing Dao lives up to its name." At that moment, a deep and sinister voice sounded from above like an owl.

Yi Yun looked up and saw a short elder draped in a black cloak. He was sitting on a nearby withered tree which was more than a dozen meters tall. The tree's old roots which were twisted and contorted seemed to meld with the elder who was casually sitting on them.

They had noticed the withered tree previously, but they had not seen the figure sitting there. His sudden appearance made it seem as though he had always been there.

Yi Yun naturally knew that the person before him was the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor.

This was because his cultivation level had reached that of a Ghost Thearch!

The Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor slowly lifted his head. Beneath his black cloak was a face as pale as a corpse's.

Beneath the Ghost Thearch realm, Ghost warriors only had a soul body.

Only by cultivating to the Ghost Thearch realm would one's soul experience the catharsis of the Ghost Dao Heavenly Tribulations which produced flesh and blood for them, allowing them to coagulate a body of flesh and blood once more.

But even so, the bodies they coagulated were like corpses which were filled with an air of death. Their skin was grayish-white and they had odd looks. Their voices were hoarse and jarring.

But legend had it that a rare peerless genius could be produced from the Ghost race every billion years or so. They could coagulate a perfect body which was no different from living flesh. Such Ghosts were not called Ghost Thearchs but Ghost Divinities.

"Heretic Hands, what do you plan on exchanging the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower for?" Blood King went straight to the point.

"Haha, Blood King, you really are impatient. Fine, let's jump straight into the trade negotiations." Heretic Hands' laughter was like grinding sandpaper against a wall. It was indescribably jarring to the ears.

"I heard that back when you decided on the Indestructible Killing Dao, you obtained one thing, didn't you?" Heretic Hands asked in a cold, sinister manner.

It left the Blood King shocked!

This was an extremely secretive matter to the Blood King. He had no idea how the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor learned of it.

Indeed, although the Blood King's talent back than was average, he had good luck. He had once obtained a Ravenjade Bodhi in a mystic realm.

The Ravenjade Bodhi was an extremely rare treasure for soul-nourishing!

And it was with the Ravenjade Bodhi that the Blood King dared choose the Indestructible Killing Dao. If not, no matter how firm and determined he was, or how indignant he was, choosing the Indestructible Killing Dao destined him for madness and the eventual loss of his life.

It was with the Ravenjade Bodhi that the Blood King managed to persist in the Indestructible Killing Dao for so long. But even so, he nearly fell into madness.

It was only when he reached the Tian Yuan world—after he had suffered a drop in realm, concealed his murderous intent, distanced himself from battle, and spent mortal-like days with Jiang Xiaorou's mother—that he finally succeeded.

In truth, the Ravenjade Bodhi was no longer of much use to the Blood King at present. After all, the Blood King's Indestructible Killing Dao was completed. The Ravenjade Bodhi's soul nourishing effects were much less effective on the Blood King who focused on cultivating his lifeblood.

However, the Ravenjade Bodhi became a symbol of the Blood King's memories. Back when he was in his life's deepest nadir, he had relied on the Ravenjade Bodhi to get back on his feet.

It was very important to the Blood King.

The Blood King was a person who cherished the past. His dedication to Jiang Xiaorou's mother was evidence of that.

"How did you know of that item of mine?" asked the Blood King coldly.

Heretic Hands smiled and said, "Your Majesty, your cultivation process is no secret. One can always infer from the breadcrumbs. That item's soul-nourishing effects is no longer of use to you, Your Majesty, but to me, it's immensely beneficial."

Ghosts focused on cultivating their souls. Any treasure that nourished their souls was priceless.

A Ravenjade Bodhi, if used well and coupled with soul-nourishing treasures, could aid the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor into transcending the second Ghost Dao Heavenly Tribulation, allowing him to coagulate a more perfect body of flesh and blood!

It was no wonder that the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was willing to exchange the extremely precious Flying Clouds Flowing Flower. He was after the Ravenjade Bodhi!

Indeed, the Ravenjade Bodhi's value to Heretic Hands was far greater than the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower's.

The Blood King drew a deep breath as he momentarily wore a conflicted expression.

Yi Yun saw it clearly. He was someone who could understand the Blood King's feelings the most. Placed in his shoes, if anyone were to ask for his Purple Crystal Origins, would he be agreeable to it?

Of course, the Blood King's Ravenjade Bodhi's value was far inferior to the Purple Crystal Origin's.

The difference was just too great.

"Senior Blood King, let's forgo this trade. If we had known that this was the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's plans, we wouldn't even have come."

Yi Yun initiated a suggestion. There was no need for him to use such a good strain of Flying Clouds Flowing Flower. He found ones that had just bloomed acceptable as well.

At that moment, Heretic Hands took out a jade box and a tiny interspatial ring.

The jade box opened to reveal a disk array which was in an activated state. The energy formed a hemisphere barrier that sealed a flower which looked like a flowing cloud inside.

The flower was in fact not considered a flower. The average person would even find it difficult to discern its shape. They would find it constantly changing, such that it made its actual state impossible to grasp.

This was none other than the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower. In terms of quality, it was practically the best.

"There are three thousand Chaos Crystals in the ring and three Fey Thearch level Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills!" Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor said. "Your Majesty, you should know the value of the Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills. It is extremely beneficial to your cultivation! The Ravenjade Bodhi is already of little use to you, while the Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills can even enhance your bloodline further. If you are willing to make the exchange, these are all yours!"

Heretic Hands was right. If they made the exchange, the Blood King was definitely not on the losing end. He might even come out as the winner.

Therefore, it was likely that Heretic Hands was about to experience his second lightning tribulation. But from the color of his skin, it was clear that his first lightning tribulation was not a success. The body he coagulated still had a rich cadaveric aura. Therefore, he probably wished to completely transform himself through a second lightning tribulation.

"Your Majesty, I have already produced the most generous conditions. Are you still disagreeable to it?"

With that said, Heretic Hands appeared to be losing his patience.

The Blood King let out a long sigh. "Whatever. I'll do the exchange!"

Although it was a item that held his memories, it was an item after all and not a person.

To the Blood King, his most important memories was with his wife who he met in the Tian Yuan world.

Back when he suddenly had to leave to end his obsession and resolve the burden that plagued his heart, he had inevitably caused his wife to suffer in the lower realm. This guilted him terribly.

Now, Jiang Xiaorou was his wife's obsession. If Yi Yun's pills could enhance Jiang Xiaorou's bloodline once more, the Blood King was willing to give up certain things.

Upon hearing the Blood King, Jiang Xiaorou bit her lips. As a daughter, there was no need for words to tell her that her father loved her deeply.

"Alright!" Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor threw out the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower and the interspatial ring.

The Blood Jade took out a pure black bodhi coruscating with a raven jade luster. As he caressed it fondly one last time, he wrapped it in lifeblood powers before sending it toward Heretic Hands.

The Flying Clouds Flowing Flower and interspatial ring were in hand!

Yuchi Huo was the first to receive it. When he scanned it with his perception, he determined that there was nothing wrong with it.

He handed the items over to the Blood King who did a brief examination before handing the flower to Yi Yun.

"Your Majesty, till we meet again!"

After Heretic Hands finished his sentence, his body phased away, transforming into a wisp of black smoke and vanished.

The Flying Clouds Flowing Flower was now in Yi Yun's hand. After scrutinizing it, he stored away the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower, but immediately after, he hesitated for a moment and took it out again.

"Oh? What happened?" Lin Xintong was most sensitive to Yi Yun's feelings.

Chapter 1650: Diabolical

Yi Yun remained silent for a long while. Back when both parties made the trade, Yi Yun had repeatedly probed the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower with his perception. He had even activated the Purple Crystal's energy vision, but he found nothing wrong with it.

But now…

"What is it, Yun'er?" Jiang Xiaorou walked over. "Could this Flying Clouds Flowing Flower be fake?"

Jiang Xiaorou held her breath silently. The Flying Clouds Flowing Flower had been seen by so many people. Furthermore, Yuchi Huo, who had seen numerous treasures as Treasure Fey Pagoda's store manager, had an excellent eye for authenticity. There was definitely no mistake in something he acknowledged in his appraisal.

"Young Master Lin, back when I liaised with Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor the first time, I had checked it thrice. It should be real, and the age of a million years could only be more, not less."

Yuchi Huo was still very confident in his eye for detail.

"This Flying Clouds Flowing Flower is definitely real," said Yi Yun. Through the Purple Crystal's energy vision, he could see the resplendent colors contained in the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower. It was extremely rich in energy.

However, when Yi Yun stored away the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower, he had placed it in the God Advent Tower. As such, it allowed the Nine Transformations Celestial Silkworm to make contact with the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower.

The Nine Transformations Celestial Silkworm was a divine beast that ate all sorts of treasured herbs to grow, so its sensitivity towards treasures herbs was a hundred or a thousand times higher than a human's!

Yi Yun was originally worried that the little guy would crave it, so he warned it.

But to his surprise, not only was the little guy not salivating, it was even warning him.

This left Yi Yun astounded!

"This Flying Clouds Flowing Flower has been tampered with. If I'm not wrong, it might be poisoned!"

When that was said, everyone present was stunned.

Poisoned!?

In fact, when warriors cultivated to their realm, their resistance toward poison was extremely high regardless of their race.

When human warriors discovered poison in their bodies, all they needed was to stir their Yuan Qi and burn the poison clean. The Fey had potent lifeblood, so they could directly rely on their lifeblood to refine away the poison. They could be described as being immune to all poisons.

Under such situations, very few experts considered the possibility of having their food or herbs poisoned.

Therefore, back when Yuchi Huo examined the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower, he did not even test it for poison.

However… there were still top lethal poisons in this world.

The difficulty of refining these poisons was a hundred times more difficult than refining a pill of the same grade. Furthermore, few people placed efforts into studying these.

However, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was one of those minorities. He was adept in poison refinement arts!

With this in mind, the Blood King was enraged. "That old bastard! He wanted to harm us? Why did he poison the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower when he already has the Ravenjade Bodhi!?"

Yi Yun pondered for a moment before saying, "Senior Blood King, have you ever crossed the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor before?"

"Not at all. I didn't even know him before today!" The Blood King's expression was nasty.

"In that case, it was probably a task given by someone else. This is truly a move I never anticipated. I really believed his excuse because of the Ravenjade Bodhi. Heretic Hands was aware of the Ravenjade Bodhi and it happened to be of great use to him. It was a flawless plan. We only believed that Heretic Hands was after the Ravenjade Bodhi which resulted in him producing the precious Flying Clouds Flowing Flower, but we never expected him to have an ulterior motive!"

Yi Yun was secretly alarmed. This was a very ruthless move!

"Are you implying that it's the… Luo King!?" the Blood King said coldly. Someone who they had crossed and was capable of getting Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor to take action could only be the Luo King!

Asking a favor of a figure like Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was too difficult, and since the Blood King did not know that the Luo King knew Heretic Hands, he had not gone out of his way to show precaution.

However, the Luo King had been a Fey Thearch for too long. He hid his hand well and whatever heritage or relationships he had was not something the Blood King was fully aware of. If the Luo King knew what Heretic Hands required and was able to satisfy him, requesting him to take action was a possibility!

"It's ninety percent him!" Yi Yun said. It was no wonder there was no contact from the Luo King after so many days. He had been secretly holding back because he had sought the help of Heretic Hands.

Furthermore, Heretic Hands had benefited greatly from the exchange. He had obtained the Ravenjade Bodhi as well as benefits from the Luo King!

"So that's the reason. I was wondering why Heretic Hands would know of my Ravenjade Bodhi. Only my enemies would pay such close attention to me to infer my trump card through my various exploits. It's no wonder if the Luo King knows about my Ravenjade Bodhi!" The Blood King's train of thought turned increasingly clear.

The Luo King was truly ruthless.

After all, if it was administered by the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor, the poison was definitely extraordinary!

If the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower was truly used to refine the pills, the outcome would be unimaginable!

Even if Yi Yun could barely survive it, Jiang Xiaorou would be doomed. Furthermore, the Blood King would believe that it was Yi Yun who harmed Jiang Xiaorou. There would be a falling out!

With this in mind, Yi Yun revealed a look of killing intent. "Luo King and Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor, I'll remember this!"

"Young Master Lin, how did you determine if this Flying Clouds Flowing Flower is poisoned? Also, look at the other items. Are the three Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills also poisoned as well?" Yuchi Huo said. The Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills were meant for the Blood King, and since he was the pillar of support for the Treasure Fey Pagoda, it would be terrible if anything happened to him.

At that moment, the Blood King took out the Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills and the three thousand Chaos Crystals as well.

In fact, the Blood King was also curious how Yi Yun had discovered the poison. Although they had not specially paid attention to the aspect of poison, they had a certain level of perceptivity towards poison. Now, even after Yi Yun's raising of the issue, they still did not detect anything after carefully scrutinizing it.

Indeed, Heretic Hands had formidable means. His poison was colorless, odorless, formless, and textureless!

Yet, it had been discovered by Yi Yun.

Yi Yun placed the three Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills on his hand and observed them for a moment. Then, he stored them away before making them appear back on his hand.

Of course, Yi Yun's study of it was only an act. He was completely relying on the Nine Transformations Celestial Silkworm to determine if it was poisonous.

However, Yi Yun did not wish for outsiders to learn of the Nine Transformations Celestial Silkworm's existence, afraid that it would be targeted by old powerful freaks.

Among the people present, he naturally trusted the Blood King, Jiang Xiaorou, and Lin Xintong, but he did not trust Yuchi Huo or Rain Numinous since they were still strangers to him.

"The Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills have been poisoned as well. Furthermore, it's a slow poison. With the potency of this poison, if Senior Blood King were to eat it, he might not die, but it would definitely harm his core.

Even Heretic Hands was unable to refine a poison that could poison a Fey Thearch to death. That would be too heaven defying. However, to be harmed at his core would already be a terrible situation for the Blood King!

It would not be a surprise if the Luo King spared no expense to challenge the Blood King when that happened!

Even with Princess Chang intervening, she was unable to stop the Luo King if he truly insisted.

During the ensuing battle, the Luo King was bound to deliver a killing blow!

Even if he failed to kill the Blood King, he would gravely injure him, causing his realm to drop, never to rise again!

Furthermore, having gained insight into the Indestructible Killing Dao, the younger Blood King had a promising future ahead of him!

But if everything were to go according to the Luo King's plan, the future Blood King would no longer be a threat to the Luo King. With a drop in strength and increased difficulty in improving, while losing a great deal of interests after his defeat, the resources at his disposal would be reduced. Under such circumstances, how was the Blood King to fight the Luo King?

"Nice, nice of you Jiang Luo! I never expected that while in his silence, the old bastard had initiated such a diabolical scheme against me. I nearly suffered an irreversible failure!"

The Blood King had been killing his entire life before attaining his ambitions. After he became a Fey Thearch, he forcefully embedded himself in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins and bit off a huge chunk of the pie with his strength. During this period, it was inevitable for him to have offended others.

Once he lost power, the outcome would be unthinkable. He had no idea how many people would kick him while he was down. The higher one climbed, the harder they fell!

"Punk, I owe you one," said the Blood King.

Yi Yun said, "Senior Blood King, I'm already indebted to you. I haven't had the chance to repay you for that, so don't talk about you owing me. Besides, I was the one who offended the Luo King first. I was also the one who wanted to refine the pills. If not, there would not have been a chance for Heretic Hands to harm you."

The Blood King waved his hand and said, "The Luo King and I have been sworn enemies since a long time ago. Since he knows Heretic Hands, it would have only been a matter of time before he took action. I'll still remember what you have done for me."

Blood King spoke very decisively. At that moment, Yuchi Huo was still in a dilemma. After hesitating for a long while, he could not help but ask, "Young Master Lin, how did you determine that these pills and the flower are poisonous?"

He was not truly curious, but was feeling a little incredulous. As the store manager of the Treasure Fey Pagoda, he knew a thing or two about poison. Furthermore, the Blood King was unable to tell that the items were poisoned despite being a Fey Thearch, so why was Yi Yun so certain?

If Yi Yun made a mistake and this mistake instigated a war against the Luo King, it would be terrible.

Yi Yun naturally knew what was on Yuchi Huo's mind. He extracted a trivial amount of the medicinal essence from the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower and flicked it.

"Whoosh!"

The medicinal essence streaked across the air and entered a venomous python in the distance.

In a few seconds, the python lost all its vibrancy and turned into what seemed like a zombie snake.

Yuchi Huo had his perception locked onto the python's body from beginning to end, so he saw everything clearly. He immediately drew a cold gasp. The poison was completely overbearing!

It was not a poison that destroyed the body; instead, it robbed one of their vibrancy!

The venomous python was extremely resistant to poison due to its nature, but against a poison that robbed one's vibrancy, its poison resistance was meaningless.

"Young Master Lin's perception is astounding. I'm ashamed that I failed to discover anything despite examining the herb so many times. I nearly harmed His Majesty," Yuchi Huo said wistfully. In front of Yi Yun, he felt utterly useless.

Moments later, he realized that if both the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower and Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills were poisoned, they had suffered immense losses!

He was a merchant after all. He was very sensitive when it came to money. For these items, the Blood King had even thrown in the Ravenjade Bodhi; yet, all he got was for naught.

Yi Yun could read Yuchi Huo's mind as he said, "This poison might not be unremovable…"

"Oh? You are even skilled in poison?" The Blood King was taken aback as well. Poison as a mystic art was just too rare. Across the entire Chaos Heavens, few warriors studied poison. And for a freak like Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor to reach such pinnacle attainments, he was truly one of a kind.

Under such circumstances, it should have been too difficult for Yi Yun to remove Heretic Hands' poison.

Chapter 1651: Ghost Doctor's Poison

"Punk, what sort of preparations do you need to neutralize the poison?" Blood King asked.
