He was also astonished that Yi Yun had attained such a high level in laws and body-tempering at such a young age. He was the match of a quasi-Godly Monarch despite being a single-sealed Divine Lord. Not only did he know all sorts of sealing mystic arts, he even knew something as rare as poison theory. He was just too heaven-defying.

"There's no need for all that. All I need is a quiet place."

"Alright, let's return first. I'll definitely not let the Luo King's machinations against me go unanswered!" Blood King said coldly.

In the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins, Fey Thearchs were not to engage in fratricidal conflict. Although he knew it was the Luo King that had machinated all of this, it would be difficult to deal with the Luo King without actual evidence.

"Senior Blood King, pretend that you are unaware of this matter. I have my plans. Also, this matter must not be divulged by any one of us here. If it's possible, please swear on the Heavenly Dao."

Yi Yun's words were, in fact, directed at Yuchi Huo and Rain Numinous.

Yuchi Huo also understood his intentions. He immediately said, "I was the one who liaised with Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor. I nearly harmed His Majesty and Her Highness Soft Clouds. I deserve death. If this news were to leak, no matter how trivial, I'll be worse than a swine and deserve having my soul extracted and marrow refined. My Fey core will shatter and I'll be left with no descendants, never to rise up again."

In order to avoid suspicion, Yuchi Huo's swear was sufficiently vicious on himself.

Rain Numinous naturally made the vow as well. In consideration of the duo's feelings, Lin Xintong, Jiang Xiaorou, and Shan Ling made the vow as well.

"When we return to Heaven Fey City, act oblivious to what has just happened. Senior Blood King, make sure not to express any animosity toward the Luo King. If my guess is right, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor will not be leaving Heaven Fey City for an extended period of time. We will still have an opportunity."

"Oh?" Blood King was taken aback. If he read between the lines, Yi Yun's intent was to exact vengeance on the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor!

Heretic Hands was a Ghost Thearch. Dealing with him was easier said than done. Furthermore, he was in cahoots with the Luo King.

"Young Master Lin, why are you certain that Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor will not leave Heaven Fey City?" Yuchi Huo asked.

"Because of Jiang Yuchan!" Yi Yun said confidently. "Jiang Yuchan is severely injured and in need of medical attention. The Luo King has likely paid a huge price to seek the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's help. He will naturally be treating Jiang Yuchan. What the Luo King has done will not only save Jiang Yuchan, it will also destroy me and Sis Xiaorou, and even cause Senior Blood King to sink into oblivion through the Fey Thearch battle. It's truly killing three birds with one stone."

"I really have to thank you, Young Master Lin," said Rain Numinous softly. "However, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor will leave Heaven Fey City once he heals Jiang Yuchan, right?"

Yi Yun shook his head. "I left those injuries on Jiang Yuchan myself. It won't be that easily treated."

"Oh?" Upon hearing Yi Yun's words, Rain Numinous was taken aback. He was that confident?

Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was a medical genius in the Chaos Heavens. Yet, Yi Yun had made his claim with utmost certainty.

Yi Yun could resolve the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's poison, but the injuries left by Yi Yun in Jiang Yuchan's body were not that easily treated by Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor?

As a Ghost Thearch, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor had spent his entire life researching his field. Yet, he would lose to Yi Yun in his domain of expertise?

It sounded unbelievable.

The Blood King gave Yi Yun a deep look. Rou'er's brother was truly astonishing. He seemed to have endless means available to him. Every time one felt that they had overestimated him, he would shock them in a brand new way.

"It's truly Rou'er's blessing to have you as a younger brother," said the Blood King in a heartfelt manner. "Let's return to Heaven Fey City first."

The Blood King took out a mobile cave abode from his interspatial ring as everyone entered.

The mobile abode had flight capabilities, allowing it to fly back to Heaven Fey City.

At that moment, in an independent space of the cave abode, Yi Yun took out the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower and the three Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills!

Yi Yun was indeed not skilled in poison theory. However, he had some experience when it came to removing poisons. Back in the Fey God Tomb in the ancient battlefield, Yi Yun had met Bai Yueyin for the first time. She had been attacked by the demonic servants!

Those demonic servants used an apocalyptic poison to taint the stone marrow liquid which Bai Yueyin soaked herself in. Yi Yun was a Supremacy back then, and with various means, he helped Bai Yueyin treat the poison.

Even an apocalyptic poison left by Demon Gods could be treated by Yi Yun.

Therefore, Yi Yun was confident that he could do the same with the poison left by Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor!

"Poison Demon, come out! It's time for work!"

Yi Yun held a green jar and threw Poison Demon out.

The old fellow's cultivation level was becoming more profound, and all of this was because of its submission to Yi Yun.

Being with the correct owner was very important.

Before Poison Demon appeared, it already knew what it had to do. It looked at the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower and three pills in front of it in a supercilious manner.

"There is no poison in this world that I can't deal with!"

Poison Demon was a manifestation of a supreme poison. In a particular sense, it represented the laws of poison.

Furthermore, treating poison and removing poison from pills were two different things.

Treating poison required decomposing the poison into its components to slowly understand their effects, so as to concoct a corresponding antidote. It was several times harder than concocting poison!

Many people would naturally believe that such a method was needed to treat the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's formless poison.

However, how could Yi Yun do something so tiresome?

His method was simple and brutal. Suck out the poison directly!

Even if the average person knew of such a simple method, it was completely impossible for them to accomplish it. There was no way to determine which were the poisonous components that the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor had left behind, much less isolate and extract them.

But to Poison Demon, that was not a problem at all.

It was born out of poison.

When Yi Yun placed the poisoned Flying Clouds Flowing Flower in front of it, Poison Demon took a deep breath and revealed an intoxicated look.

Although Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's poison was formless and ordorless, that was only to the average person. To Poison Demon, its odor was extremely rich. It was like a cat catching a whiff of fish, or flies with shit.

"Good! Good stuff!"

Poison Demon nearly salivated. It looked like a drug addict that had been on cold turkey for days, to the point of their eyes turning green, only to suddenly see half a kilogram of its "deliverance" appear before it. The feeling was uplifting.

Without Yi Yun's instructions, it began sucking at the poison in the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower.

But a few seconds later, Poison Demon's expression changed. "This poison is formidable!"

After sucking a small portion of the poison into its body, Poison Demon suddenly felt that its vitality was being devoured. That alarmed it. It was born from poison, so how could any poison harm it?

"Cadaveric aura… This poison comes with a cadaveric aura. It's a power that can corrode life itself. I can be considered to have life, so if I were to consume this poison, I'll likely have my vitality snuffed out and die."

Poison Demon originally found the poison unchallenging. However, when it began absorbing the poison, it realized how multifaceted the poison Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor had planted was. It was extremely terrifying.

Chapter 1652: Jiang Yuchan's Injuries

"Cadaveric aura… that's quite expected!" Yi Yun was not surprised. "The Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor is a Ghost, a Ghost Thearch at that. It's true that you can't withstand the potency of the vitality corrosion powers embedded in his poison. However, that doesn't matter."

Yi Yun condensed his Yuan Qi forces and a few seconds later, the Azure Wood Divine Tree's phantom appeared behind him.

As an inheritor of the twelve Fey Gods, the moment the Azure Wood Divine Tree appeared, the pocket world was immediately affected. A rich vibrancy spread out with Yi Yun as center. Vegetation grew as spirit flowers bloomed. Instantly, the pocket world seemed to turn into an immortal's paradise!

The Azure Wood Divine Tree possessed the strongest vital powers. Yi Yun placed the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower in his hand as massive amounts of vital powers surged into the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower to neutralize the deathly powers within.

The Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was indeed powerful. Even with the Azure Wood Divine Tree's help, it took extremely long to get rid of the cadaveric aura within the flower.

However, no matter how powerful the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was, it was impossible for his poison to be constantly renewing. Every bit frittered away meant one bit less!

As time passed, the cadaveric aura in the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower was slowly neutralized by the Azure Wood Divine Tree.

Following that, Poison Demon began devouring the remaining poisonous elements in the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower.

Without the corrosive properties of the cadaveric aura, Poison Demon was completely unaffected by the lethal poison. The poisons even strengthened it.

After more than a day, Poison Demon completely devoured all the lethal poison in the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower.

Not only was Poison Demon unexhausted, it looked highly energetic.

Having removed the lethal poison in the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower, the remaining Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills were naturally not a problem!

…

Meanwhile, while Yi Yun was removing the poison, in Yuchan Manor north of the city.

Half a month had passed since Yi Yun's battle in the Fey Blood Plains.

In that period, Jiang Yuchan would experience a tormenting pain from time to time!

The lightning threads and fire seeds Yi Yun left in his body were too terrifying. They constantly wrecked his body.

Jiang Yuchan's flesh and blood was constantly decimated, but his potent Heaven Fey bloodline constantly restored his body. Most terrifying of all, the lightning and fire left behind by Yi Yun seemed to constantly renew itself. They could absorb Jiang Yuchan's powers and lifeblood to strengthen themselves. They were like the world's most terrifying diseases that strengthened while inside Jiang Yuchan's body.

During this period, the Luo King had sought many people in an attempt to treat Jiang Yuchan. However, none of the treatments worked. Instead, with the passage of time, the lightning and fire forces in Jiang Yuchan's body turned more potent as his situation turned for the worse.

Jiang Yuchan was also considered a strong-willed person, but after the prolonged torment of such excruciating pain, his vitality was constantly shaved off. He was on the brink of a collapse to the point of hoping to plead for Yi Yun's mercy. However, the Luo King refused to bow.

This day, the Luo King brought the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor.

This was a person who brought way more despair than hope. He was a doctor of death that killed more than he saved.

But at that moment, he was the only straw Jiang Yuchan could reach for.

The Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor caught a glance of Jiang Yuchan from afar, but he was able to tell that Jiang Yuchan's soul had greatly dissipated from the torment.

The Fey focused on their lifeblood. Their psyche and soul cultivations were nothing impressive. On this point, the Ghosts who focused on soul cultivation viewed the Fey in contempt.

"A Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins genius is just this and nothing more. To be left in such a pathetic state after such a minor injury. Furthermore, none of you Fey can treat him despite the fact that the injuries were inflicted by a human junior."

Heretic Hands let out a hoarse chuckle that left the Luo King's expression ugly.

The Fey belittled humans to begin with. This time, the injuries Yi Yun had left in Jiang Yuchan's body had smacked too many Fey mighty figures in the face. It left the Luo King extremely peeved. Now, he was even mocked by this old man. How could he be happy about that?

Heretic Hands had an odd personality and he was easily disliked. Of course, now that the Luo King had a request for him, all he could do was put up with it.

Heretic Hands walked to Jiang Yuchan's side and turned to the Luo King. "Luo King, don't forget the Heavy Star Sand and the Soul Entrenchment Rock you promised."

"Naturally!"

"Hehe." Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor reached out his narrow palm that was as thin as a chicken's claw and grabbed Jiang Yuchan's arm.

Jiang Yuchan grunted as his arm was lacerated, causing blood to ooze out.

Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor stretched out his long tongue and sinisterly licked his black fingernails which were stained with blood.

Moments later, his face gradually froze.

"Oh?"

His blade-like fingernails repeatedly streaked across Jiang Yuchan's body and soon, Jiang Yuchan's skin was lacerated with countless wounds. Even his face was contorted from the pain.

As large amounts of blood flowed out, Heretic Hands gradually wore a serious expression.

This was a injury caused by the nomological Great Dao!

Such injuries… were not easily healed!

Typically, damage to the body would incur harm on one's vitality. Even damage to the soul or one's vital essence was something the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor could handle.

Only Great Dao injuries were tough problems. To treat them, one had to crack the nomological shackles.

This was similar to treating poison. One had to break down the poison's components and slowly find a solution to each.

However, Heretic Hands could tell that the nomological attainments in the Great Dao injuries left by the human junior were extremely horrifying.

"This person's Dao of Lightning and Fire has reached an extremum. Fascinating." Heretic Hands recalled Yi Yun. As a ghost doctor, he could tell a person's bone age at a glance. Yi Yun was definitely less than a thousand years old.

Such a genius was quite terrifying.

In terms of Lightning and Fire laws, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor, who had transcended the Ghost Dao Heavenly Tribulation, was quite skilled in lightning laws. However, his attainments in fire-elemental laws were lacking. It was limited to the understanding of fire poison.

To use such means to crack Yi Yun's Dao was very difficult!

However, Heretic Hands was not the typical doctor. He was very familiar with life. He had taken billions of lives—humans, Fey, Ghosts, Fey beasts, almost every race!

He personally dissected every inch of their body and split apart every meridian to familiarize and taste the fresh flesh and blood as well as their souls.

He had many crazy ideas he wished to actualize.

Great Dao injuries were the kind of injuries he was worse at treating. However, he had other shortcuts!

"How is it? Can my grandson be saved?" Luo King asked.

Heretic Hands did not answer directly; instead, he remarked, "Interesting, very interesting!"

Having met with such a tough problem, not only did Heretic Hands shrink back, he even turned excited.

Such a reaction made the Luo King frown.

What does he mean by interesting? Is he planning on using my grandson as a guinea pig?

Although he had such a thought, the Luo King did not dare voice his opinion. He was a cold person. Even if it involved his grandson's life, he was unwilling to lower his dignity as a Fey Thearch by compromising.

"That Lin Yun has to be killed!"

The Luo King affirmed his decision to destroy Yi Yun. Since Yi Yun had means to leave Heretic Hands not entirely confident of treatment, it meant that his nomological insight was too terrifying. Adverse consequences were inevitable if he were allowed to develop his strength further!

Chapter 1653: Materials Gathered

After removing the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower's poison, Yi Yun also removed the poison from the three Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills in the same manner.

After completing the process, Yi Yun did a test by extracting a tiny portion of the medicinal essence and giving it to a lowly Fey beast. Not only was the Fey beast fine, it even had its lifeblood enhanced by its absorption of the tiny amount of medicinal essence.

In regards to this, Blood King was filled with mixed emotions. Yi Yun was not only nomologically powerful and physically strong, his understanding and removing of poisons were incredible.

Despite the difficulty of removing poisons being of the highest level, Yi Yun had managed to do so in just a few short days.

It was a pity that he was not his son.

Blood King even had the thought of acknowledging Yi Yun as an adopted son. If this were any other person, becoming the adopted son of a Fey Thearch would be like having something fall into their lap. Many people would yearn for that to happen.

However, he knew that an elite like Yi Yun had no need to rely on a Fey Thearch like him.

Yi Yun only stayed with them firstly to refine the pills, and second for Jiang Xiaorou.

Blood King's relationship with Yi Yun was maintained through Jiang Xiaorou.

"Senior Blood King, the Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills should be fine. Senior Blood King, if there's no other matter, you should enter seclusion and refine them. Such matters should not be delayed."

"Alright!" Blood King nodded. "Punk, I'm in your debt. I'll be leaving Xiaorou's wellbeing in your hands!"

Blood King threw out an interspatial ring.

When Yi Yun checked it, it was filled with Chaos Crystals!

Initially, Yi Yun's requirements for the Myriad Form Shura Pill's ingredients were of the lowest standards, but after obtaining a million-year-old Flying Clouds Flowing Flower, his requirements were no longer the same. To prevent wasting the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower's medicinal essence, the other materials needed to be of higher quality as well.

The budget needed immediately raised about eight times!

Yi Yun had previously promised to earn about one to two thousand Chaos Crystals. Through the betting and the sale of the captured Fey beasts, that could have been sufficient. Unfortunately, his fleecing of the Luo King failed. If not, it would not have been a problem gathering those ingredients.

Due to the rise in budget, Yi Yun sold the two Godly Monarch Royal Seals he had used as a congratulatory gift at Lin Xintong's coronation. Instantly, he gained another two thousand Chaos Crystals.

Even in the Chaos Heavens where there were numerous Godly Monarchs, a Godly Monarch Royal Seal was still of great worth. If he had sold them in the Sinkhole, the price would have been greater.

With three thousand Chaos Crystals, the shortfall was covered by the Blood King.

The Blood King was not stingy either. He instantly provided all his savings.

"Punk, I haven't been a Fey Thearch for long, so my wealth is still nothing to speak of. Thankfully, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor gave another three thousands Chaos Crystals in order to win my trust. They are all in there. You must refine the pills to the best of standards. If there's anything you lack, have the Treasure Fey Pagoda go to the Heaven Fey Bank to get a loan."

In fact, the Blood King did not mention that the wealth he produced had three thousand Chaos Crystals from a loan.

However, the Treasure Fey Pagoda was a huge enterprise. By mortgaging a portion of its business, it was not a problem to borrow a few thousand Chaos Crystals.

Finally, Yi Yun had a total of 21,000 Chaos Crystals in his hand. It was equivalent to to 210,000,000 Chaos Ores!

This was a staggering amount of wealth. One had to know that the typical genius prince in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins only had about dozens of Chaos Crystals as their liquid wealth.

As for the other princes, even Shaomang Xuan, who Yi Yun had killed, had less than twenty Chaos Crystals.

"Thank you, Senior Blood King. These should be sufficient!"

Yi Yun's original budget was about two thousand plus Chaos Crystals. Now that he had about nine times more, it left him delighted.

With the Blood King in seclusion, the acquiring of ingredients was completely left to the Treasure Fey Pagoda.

But this placed Yuchi Huo in a dilemma.

Even with immense wealth in hand, a lot of the materials were not that easily gathered.

"Young Master Lin, many of the ingredients are too rare. They have a price, but there's no one to supply them," said Yuchi Huo with a rueful expression. With the increase in budget, Yi Yun's requirements for the ingredients had increased in tow. It was already difficult previously, but it was now only harder.

The search went on for days before two acceptable strains were found. The Golden Feather Immortal Pistil was one of them.

Yi Yun said, "Senior Yuchi, don't fret. If I'm judging it right, the speed at which we will gather the ingredients will only speed up."

"Oh?" Yuchi Huo seemed to realize something when Yi Yun said that. "Young Master Lin, do you mean…"

"The Luo King will help us."

Back in the Fey Blood Plains' battle, Yi Yun had figuratively smacked the Luo King in the face. For this, the Luo King had sought the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor. Since he had spent a great price and put in so much effort, how could he allow Yi Yun to not refine the pill because of a lack of ingredients?

In fact, a figure at the level of the Luo King definitely had his patience. It would not have been a problem if he waited a few years. But most critically, the Luo King had also poisoned the Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills which the Blood King was consuming!

Although it was an extremely brilliant slow-acting poison, the Blood King was bound to discover it if things dragged on. From that, he could infer that the Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills had been poisoned!

If that happened, no matter how stupid Yi Yun was, he would realize that the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower was problematic as well.

To the Luo King, it was imperative he eradicated Blood King, a mortal malady of his. But when it came to Yi Yun, the Luo King did not think lightly of him either. With Yi Yun's talent, he would only become more difficult to deal with than the Blood King.

Therefore, the Luo King had to time it perfectly such that both poisons acted at the same time.

Yi Yun said, "The Luo King has deeper connections than the Blood King. He is already aware of the items on my list. If he is not confident that he can gather them for me in a short period of time, he would not have poisoned both items."

Yuchi Huo said, "Young Master Lin, what you say makes sense. It's no wonder you told His Majesty that his seclusion could not be delayed. Then, should we spread the news that the Blood King has entered seclusion?"

Yi Yun said, "The Luo King is likely aware of it. It was never a secret anyway."

The Blood King Palace was huge. It was impossible for it to be devoid of the Luo King's spies.

And the facts proved that Yi Yun's guess was right. The search for the ingredients became easier.

Many rare materials were purchased by Yuchi Huo subsequently.

This made Yuchi Huo feel a sense of lingering fear. The Luo King's deep connections were indeed terrifying. A portion of the ingredients were bought from secret markets. The buyers and sellers there used mystical masks to hide their identity. That could be written off, but there was another portion of ingredients which were sold to Treasure Fey Pagoda by various major factions.

This was obviously motivated by the Luo King.

The Luo King had been in power for so many years, so he had wide-reaching resources that involved many family clans. These family clans either had shared interests with the Luo King or the Luo King Palace had good relationships with a particular important figure in the family clan. At times, they could bribe the partners in bed of particular important figures into making insinuations. There were all sorts of means available, and this resulted in the Blood King Palace taking a few short months to acquire a vast majority of the ingredients!

Yi Yun's way of beating the Luo King at his own game was truly brilliant.

"The Luo King sure is terrifying. Yet, such a terrifying person thinks so highly of Young Master Lin. He spent such a huge price in order to doom Young Master Lin…" said Yuchi Huo wistfully.

He came to the Blood King's seclusion chamber and updated him on the ingredient purchase process.

The Blood King's seclusion was only to refine a pill, so he did not require freedom from disturbances.

"Got it. For Xiaorou to have such a brother as an aide sure is her blessing."

This was the second time the Blood King was feeling impressed. The Luo King probably never dreamed that all he had done was to suffer a double loss and benefit Yi Yun for nothing.

If not, how could Yi Yun's refinement of the pills go that smoothly?

"What other ingredients are missing? Prepare them for him at any cost," said the Blood King.

Yuchi Huo reverently answered, "He's short of a Fey core. However, I have already received news that a Fey Thearch Fey core will soon be auctioned in the capital. For this auction, I have gotten the Treasure Fey Pagoda to borrow 8000 Chaos Crystals from the Heaven Fey Bank. We will definitely get it!'

"Alright, take your leave."

Yi Yun's original requirement for the refinement of the Myriad Form Shura Pills was that of a quasi-Fey Thearch's Fey core.

Yi Yun even felt that he was going a little crazy after having that many Chaos Crystals. He was even buying a Fey beast's Fey core at the Fey Thearch level.

The Fey beast's Fey core at the Fey Thearch level was a lot more valuable than a Godly Monarch Royal Seal.

Fey Thearch level Fey beasts were even rarer. All of these Fey beasts grew up in the wilderness independently, experiencing countless difficulties and the Nine Heavenly Tribulations before becoming a Fey Thearch Fey beast.

To kill them? It was just too difficult!

Furthermore, many Fey beasts would prepare a graveyard for themselves. These graveyards were extremely hidden, so finding their corpses was extremely difficult.

Every Fey core at the Fey Thearch level was something that could only come by luck, but not by searching for it!

Godly Monarch Royal Seals were the condensed laws of others. Many geniuses did not even wish to refine one they found for themselves, and preferred condensing their own Godly Monarch Royal Seals.

However, Fey Thearch Fey cores did not share the same situation. They were top treasures that could be used for pill refinement.

Be it humans, the Fey or the Celestials, all of them needed Fey cores.

Yi Yun went with Yuchi Huo to the auction to purchase it himself.

This was the more exclusive auction house in Heaven Fey City. It was not held by any conglomerate but hosted by the imperial household. Many people came for its reputation, but as Yi Yun was willing to pay an obscene amount of money, he eventually defeated his opponents. He spent 22,000 Chaos Crystals to win the Fey Thearch Fey core!

Yi Yun was thrilled with the Fey Thearch Fey core in hand.

Although the trading price of 22,000 Chaos Crystals was exaggerated, it was still acceptable. If they had met someone who wished to spite them, it would not be strange to have the price reach 30,000 Chaos Crystals.

Finally, Yi Yun went up the stage under the watchful eyes of everyone to do the exchange for Chaos Crystals and the Fey Thearch Fey core.

The feeling of handing over such immense wealth was actually quite exhilarating.

Of course, this was what Yi Yun felt. The audience below only felt it was not worthwhile for the Blood King.

They had obviously heard of news that Yi Yun was trying to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills and had also seen the list that the Treasure Fey Pagoda had provided.

The list was already exaggerated enough, but it was even more ridiculous at that moment. All the qualities of the ingredients were elevated. The Blood King was probably mad to put the Treasure Fey Pagoda into tremendous debt so as to invest so heavily in Yi Yun.

Although Yi Yun had won fame from a single battle at the Fey Blood Plains, people only believed that he was personally strong. Someone strong could still be a cheat. As a junior, why would his refining of pills need such immense wealth? How was it possible? It was even unheard of for divine alchemists when they refined pills.

Chapter 1654: Array Core

With the Fey Thearch Fey core in hand, Yi Yun had finally received the last of the ingredients he needed!

Yi Yun's refinement of the pills involved—

Fey Thearch Fey core! Million-year-old Flying Clouds Flowing Flower! Blood of the Ancestor God!

Just gathering these three was astounding enough. In comparison, the million-year-old Flying Clouds Flowing Flower was the cheapest.

And the most valuable of all was the Ancestor God's blood, something even the Luo King could not obtain.

With everything ready, Yi Yun picked an auspicious day to begin his refinement!

And the place Yi Yun chose was the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda.

Although the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda had the words 'pagoda' in it, it was actually a major faction. To put it simply, the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda was the alchemist association of the Heaven Fey City. It nearly monopolized all the alchemists in the Heaven Fey City and was considered a top faction.

The Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's Pagoda Lord was also a Fey Thearch. He was also the only Alchemy Monarch of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins.

In fact, the alchemy practiced in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins was more akin to what was practiced by Tian Yuan world's Desolate Heaven Masters. They seldom used spiritual plants and instead used the bones, flesh and blood, and Fey cores of Fey beasts!

The Fey's alchemical arts took a different path from that of humans.

In terms of influence and monetary strength, the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda was far above that of the Treasure Fey Pagoda. The latter was merely a merchant organization that earned its profits through the bid-ask spreads, while the former controlled the refinement of pills. Having pills was equivalent to having many Fey warriors at their throats.

Yi Yun reserved the most luxurious alchemy room in the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda, with a rental cost of three hundred Chaos Crystals!

This price was equivalent to the entire wealth of two or three extremely wealthy Fey Lords!

Apart from that, the rental also required a hundred merit points from the Blood King.

Using the entire wealth of two to three extremely wealthy Fey Lords and a hundred merit points of the Blood King to rent an alchemy room? This sounded like madness.

However, the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's alchemy rooms were worth every crystal!

This was because it was one of the nine major array cores of the Heaven Fey City's Heaven and Earth massive array.

A city like the Heaven Fey City had been situated in the Chaos Heavens for billions of years. In the long river of history, the Heaven Fey City had produced geniuses, so the accumulations it amassed was staggering!

In addition, the Heaven Fey City was a spot where numerous underground spirit veins gathered, making it a wonderland.

The Heaven Fey set up a Heaven and Earth massive array in the Heaven Fey City and sealed the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi there, making the city rich in Yuan Qi. It was more than ten times what could be found in the surrounding regions.

This was also the reason why Heaven Fey City's property prices were worth their weight in gold!

However, although the Heaven Fey City had rich Heaven Earth Yuan Qi, it was restricted by the Heaven and Earth massive array since it was a shared resource. Absorbing it was no problem, but once one absorbed a certain level of Yuan Qi, it would be restricted by the massive array.

Under such circumstances, the typical expert's breakthrough was silent, without causing so much as a stir.

But in the Heaven Fey City, there were a handful of nine array cores which did not share the restrictions of the massive array.

Of these nine array cores, three were in the Ruins Emperor Palace—two were occupied by a patriarch each, and the Ruins Emperor had one!

The remaining six were scattered outside the palace.

Under normal circumstances, the nine array cores were left unused. In order to gather Heaven Earth Yuan Qi, they were only used when absolutely necessary.

For instance, when a Fey Thearch was about to break through, they would apply for an array core for their seclusion.

Or if they were refining divine pills or divine armaments. They would apply to use the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda or the array core at the Artisan Divine Pagoda.

The usage of the array core was not free. Using it expended a lot of things. Typically, the various Fey Thearchs would not be that extravagant for their seclusions.

However, Yi Yun was just that extravagant!

His pill refinement could only be described as extremely high profile!

There were already many people watching Yi Yun. He was refining a pill no one had heard of before, so who knew if he would succeed or fail?

However, due to his rental of the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's pill refinement array core, he immediately caused a commotion.

What a prodigal! An utter prodigal!

Furthermore, what right did a human junior have to use their Heaven Fey City's array core?

Not only was the average Fey warrior unable to use the locations of the array cores, but they almost never even had a chance to see them!

Even the Ruins Emperor's usage of the array cores every year was limited. Now, the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda was renting it to Yi Yun.

Although three hundred Chaos Crystals and a hundred Fey Thearch merit points were costly, it still left many Fey unhappy.

What right did he have!? Why should a sacred land of them, the Heaven Fey, be left to a human to use?

"Don't be envious. Although it's blasphemous that the lowlife, Lin Yun, can step into the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core, perhaps it's the Pagoda Lord himself who is secretly overjoyed."

When someone raised this point, everyone was stunned before they realized what was happening.

The Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core was charged by the day and not the usage process!

The array core was usually left unused to accumulate Heaven Earth Yuan Qi.

Every array core had to be used at specific points in time. If the amassed Yuan Qi was sucked dry by the rentee, it would be a terrible loss.

On the contrary, if the rentee had a "limited appetite," capable of only absorbing minute amounts despite renting for half a month, the pagoda would make a killing.

"So that's the reason. Haha, so that's what the Pagoda Lord has in mind."

"Three hundred Chaos Crystals aren't cheap to begin with. It's even rarer with the Fey Thearch merit points. Most important of all, the array core cannot be used after a long period of time. When the Yuan Qi is at its richest, it can be used by the Pagoda Lord. Perhaps, the Pagoda Lord has plans on refining a special pill."

People discussed and came to a realization.

It was no wonder that the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda did not reject Yi Yun's entry into the array core.

A fool and his money are soon parted, and the fool was none other than Yi Yun.

However, Yi Yun was not necessarily a fool. He could be having nefarious ideas, since he was not the one paying for it.

Many people were guessing at the means Yi Yun used to win the Blood King's trust to the point of him investing so much in him.

For items like a Fey Thearch Fey core, even if an alchemist grandmaster were to refine one, they would do so very carefully, afraid that they were unable to bring out the medicinal essence of the Fey core. After all, the energy contained within was overly terrifying.

As for Yi Yun, he had everything go smoothly for him. Not only was he using a Fey Thearch Fey core for his cauldron of pills, he was even using all kinds of treasured herbs, The amount of energy combined together far exceeded the Fey Thearch Fey core!

How was it possible to infuse so much energy into the pill? It would definitely result in a lot of waste. It was even possible that the excessive energies would cause the cauldron to blow up.

That would all be alright if it was the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's Pagoda Lord who did the refinement, but how old was Yi Yun?

People guessed that Yi Yun would use up or transfer away the large amount of resources in the chamber!

When the time came, he could make an explosion and claim that the pill refinement had failed.

However, he had caused such a huge stir and the ingredients he used were of top grade. He had even rented the array core of the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda. Could he simply write off everything by claiming failure?

Chapter 1655: Jiang Lichen

Would the Blood King spare Yi Yun after he caused such a big hooha and put on an entire farce of extravagantly wasting resources?

The outcome was difficult to tell. After all, everyone acknowledged Yi Yun's strength.

The Blood King had become Fey Thearch only recently. He was only beginning to build up his faction and had a weak foundation. Even if he encountered a larcenous person like Yi Yun, he still needed to rely on them if they were a genius.

At noon, the alchemical process began!

Yi Yun stayed in a chamber to refine his pills, so it was silent. No one could observe him.

But even so, thousands of people gathered around Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda. Even if they could not see a thing, they could not help but look toward the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda.

This could very likely become a huge joke.

If that were the case, the person to bear the brunt of the jokes would not be Yi Yun, but the Blood King.

In the years following Blood King's breakthrough to Fey Thearch, he had affected the interests of many old Fey Thearchs. Many people were waiting to see the Blood King suffer a setback.

…

When Yi Yun began the refinement process, an azure-clothed man sat on a high platform above the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda. In between his brows was a purple mark that looked like a faint constellation.

As for his clothes, they were not adorned with any accessories. He looked as simple as could be. However, his body exuded a faint air that was not necessarily that of a supreme being's. Instead, it was like a distant galaxy, ethereal and indistinct, visible but not reachable.

He was none other than the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's Pagoda Lord. He was also the Alchemy Monarch of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins—Jiang Lichen.

The Fey Thearchs of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins might show respect to the Ruins Emperor openly, but oppose him in private. But all of them had to be on good terms with Jiang Lichen.

There was no other choice. No matter how intractable the Fey Thearchs of Heaven Fey City were, they often needed to seek Jiang Lichen's help.

At that moment, Jiang Lichen was having a game of chess with someone. Sitting across him was the Luo King, Jiang Luo!

The game had been ongoing for a full day. Jiang Lichen held the advantage, and without a surprise upset, the Luo King would find it difficult to make a comeback.

However, Jiang Lichen continued playing, laying his pieces in an unhurried manner.

Many a time, he was not considering the game, but enjoying the sense of calm while playing.

"Is Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor still at your place?" Jiang Lichen suddenly asked.

Few people knew that the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was acquainted with the Luo King, but Jiang Lichen knew. He was one of the older Fey Thearchs of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins, having attained the realm of Fey Thearch long before the Luo King.

"Yes. Heretic Hands is treating Yuchan."

"The treatment has taken that long?" Jiang Lichen asked.

"Heretic Hands isn't nomologically skilled. Furthermore, that human bastard has done lots of research in the laws; hence, it has taken so long. However… it's close to success."

"I see…" Jiang Lichen nodded. "According to the Heaven Fey City rules, Fey Thearchs are not to have any fratricidal infighting. If you were to fight Blood King, it would require the destruction of a foundation, the bottom line of a Fey Thearch conflict."

The Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins cherished every Fey Thearch. They were just too rare and what the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins used as the pillars of their society.

However, what if it was only an injury instead of the destruction of a foundation?

The Luo King knew that there were many gray areas.

"My revenge is mainly directed at that human bastard. It should be fine just dealing with him, right!?"

"That's fine. You can do anything you want to Lin Yun," said Jiang Lichen indifferently.

The division between "us" and "them" was irreconcilable!

The Fey's attitude towards human was that of contempt, but also that they could be controlled.

Simultaneously, they had to be careful against them!

For humans that became Godly Monarchs, they would not easily offend them, but they would be very happy to see human Godly Monarchs perish.

Besides, the Blood King had so many enemies in the Heaven Fey City that even he did not know the exact number. How could they be willing to see Yi Yun develop his strength?

Yi Yun and Jiang Xiaorou shared a very close relation. This was already sufficient to be a point of attack on Jiang Xiaorou and the Blood King.

"Good! Brother Lichen, I'm assured having heard you say that. Unfortunately, that punk will be wasting so many resources before his death," said the Luo King wistfully.

"Those things are all excellent pill refinement ingredients. Brother Lichen, the Nine Cycles Heavenly Tribulation Pills that you have been preparing for decades are probably inferior when it comes to preciousness, right?"

Jiang Lichen's refinement of the Nine Cycles Heavenly Tribulation Pills was known by many Fey Thearchs in the Heaven Fey City.

The pills' name was self-explanatory. They were used after nine cycles of Heavenly Tribulations, enhancing the body-tempering effects of the Heavenly Tribulation by twenty percent.

Transcending the Heavenly Tribulations was a necessary process for Fey Thearchs.

The fact that the Nine Cycles Heavenly Tribulation Pills could enhance the body-tempering effects of a Heavenly Tribulation made their value obvious!

Many Fey Thearchs, including Fey Thearchs outside the Heaven Fey City, coveted those pills.

Over the years, many non-Jiang Fey Thearchs visited Jiang Lichen after learning of the news. They were aware that it was not pragmatic to hope to obtain a Nine Cycles Heavenly Tribulation Pill from Jiang Lichen directly, but there were bound to be opportunities if they made his acquaintance.

The Fey Thearchs who visited Jiang Lichen were all famous figures. If he rejected their request, Jiang Lichen might feel his conscience being pricked.

As such, if he were to make another cauldron of pills in the future, there was a chance of them purchasing a pill.

"Yes, the price of the ingredients used for the Nine Cycles Heavenly Tribulation Pills are not that ludicrous. However, as long as it expends a sliver of my Origins of Lightning Tribulation, I will not refine any more. Alchemy is not simply about using expensive materials. Even an Alchemy Monarch would find it difficult to control the vast energies. No matter how many treasured herbs are used, all of that will be wasted."

Jiang Lichen did not continue on.

He planned on waiting three years after Yi Yun was done with his pill refinement before refining the Nine Cycles Heavenly Tribulation Pills!

In fact, Jiang Lichen had been monitoring the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi gathered within the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda for the past twenty years.

All of that was for his goal of refining the Nine Cycles Heavenly Tribulation Pills!

Now, the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi inside the array core had only amassed to a certain level. According to the rules, every array core had to be used after a specific period of time.

Equal sharing of resources was a rule of the Heaven Fey City. Which Fey Thearch wouldn't need resources? What right did Jiang Lichen have to keep an array core closed to accumulate Heaven Earth Yuan Qi?

Jiang Lichen's reputation was sufficiently high that the other Fey Thearchs did not dare pick a bone with him.

But with the passage of time, the Yuan Qi within the array core increased. It was no longer within control.

It was normal for people to covet it, such as the Blood King! Jiang Lichen's relationship with the Blood King was only ordinary!

Thankfully, Yi Yun had served himself right to his doorstep while the Blood King was in seclusion. It effectively prevented him bringing trouble onto himself.

Since Yi Yun had entered the array core, Jiang Lichen would then have an aboveboard reason to reject all other Fey Thearchs from entering for the next three years, with the Blood King having even less priority.

After Yi Yun entered, another three years would ensure that the array core was filled with Heaven Earth Yuan Qi!

Back when Yi Yun decided to rent the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core, he had only done so because he wanted to freely absorb Heaven Earth Yuan Qi and not be restricted by the Heaven Fey City's massive array.

He never imagined that the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core held such monetary value.

Yi Yun saw a spirit fountain inside.

As the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi was so rich, a liquid spirit fountain had been condensed!

According to the array core's rental agreement, the spirit fountain could not be taken away. Absorption had to be done inside.

"Oh? There's an array formation obstruction?"

When Yi Yun approached the spirit fountain, he was slightly taken aback. The spirit fountain's surroundings were sealed with a mystical array. Cracking it was not easy.

It also meant that although the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda had immense treasures left inside the array core, they were under lock and key.

If the average person came and did the appropriate absorptions, how much could they absorb?

However, this was not a problem for Yi Yun at all.

With the Purple Crystal Origins in hand, the array formation could not stop him at all.

Yi Yun's refinement would expend an astounding amount of Heaven Earth Yuan Qi. The spirit fountain was truly of timely assistance, allowing the Myriad Form Shura Pill's quality to be enhanced further.

"I made the right choice in coming to the Heaven Fey City. The Myriad Form Shura Pill is supposed to be very difficult to refine, but it took me such a short period of time to make the preparations. Furthermore, the quality of the ingredients have far exceeded my expectations."

"The Heaven Fey City is just too nice. First, it was the Luo King who pulled the strings and logistics to aid me in preparing the materials. Now, the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda has aided me in preparing the best alchemical grounds. Even I'm feeling a little guilt-ridden."

Yi Yun was very thrilled.

The pill refinement was no trifling matter. No one in the world except himself could complete it.

The refinement of the Myriad Form Shura Pills needed the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence laws. And this was something only Yi Yun was equipped with.

Apart from that, the pills needed massive amounts of precious materials. The amount of energy involved was too massive that even Fey Thearch alchemists would find it uncontrollable.

However, Yi Yun had the Purple Crystal Origins. He could easily control all the energy in the treasured herbs, while still having the capacity to extract the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi from the spirit fountain to provide for the refinement.

Yi Yun took a deep breath as his mind stirred. All sorts of previous materials appeared in his hand.

He opened the cauldron!

The cauldron he was using was the Ascending Dragon Cauldron.

In terms of cauldron quality, the Ascending Dragon Cauldron was the best. Furthermore, it had the Dragon Emperor bloodline in it. It was most suitable to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

As for the fire needed for the refinement, Yi Yun was using the Heretical God Fire.

The Heretical God Fire was the strongest flame in the universe.

"It's time. The stars have aligned. If I'm unable to refine the cauldron of pills to perfection under these conditions, I'm no different from trash."

Yi Yun never thought of the possibility of him failing. What he wanted was absolute perfection!

Yi Yun first took out the hundred-thousand-year-old Golden Feather Immortal Pistil.

"Energy extraction."

Yi Yun interfaced his spiritual energy with the Purple Crystal and extracted the medicinal energies from the Golden Feather Immortal Pistil at an extremely fast speed.

If this scene were to be witnessed by other alchemists, they would probably be left astounded.

No matter how brilliant an alchemist was, they would be very careful with energy extraction. Any tiny mistake could destroy the herb. Even with excellent technique, it was very difficult to completely extract all the medicinal energies.

However, this process was the easiest to Yi Yun.

Instead, it was the refinement process with the Heretical God Fire that Yi Yun needed to take slowly…

Chapter 1656: Pill Refinement Finished

Yi Yun immersed himself in the pill refinement for three consecutive days. It was as though he was in an ethereal state, fully focused on the Heretical God Fire, ingredients, and the nascent Myriad Form Shura Pills.

And surrounding the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda, the spectators that came to watch the farce did not have that much patience.

They only came on the day Yi Yun began his pill refinement, but when they realized that Yi Yun had sealed himself in the chamber to refine the pills, they slowly left.

All they cared about was the outcome which they would use as a topic of conversation over meals.

However… five days after Yi Yun began his pill refinement, a wind stirred up in the city.

Winds stirring in Heaven Fey City was nothing odd, but this wind was a result of Yuan Qi.

At that moment, the rich Heaven Earth Yuan Qi in Heaven Fey City were being triggered by a force. With the Yuan Qi wind's blowing, countless tiny blobs of light appeared in the sky. They were of all colors and bobbed up and down in what seemed like an unending sea.

Some people could not help but reach out their hands to grab the tiny blobs of light in an attempt to absorb the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi, but their expressions changed immediately once they did. The pure energies within the blobs of light were bound by mystical laws. Not only was it impossible to direct them, they even felt like their internal energies were about to tear out of them to go with the blobs of light.

From afar, people watched the gorgeous vista that was in actuality filled with danger. They were all very alarmed.

"What's going on?"

People found it incredulous. This was because the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi was restrained by the arrays in Heaven Fey City. No one could easily direct the powers. Even a Fey Thearch had no means to violate the rule.

However, the Yuan Qi light blobs that covered the area were way too formidable. It was obvious that the surrounding Heaven Earth Yuan Qi had been directed over.

Could it be…

Everyone suddenly had a thought. Only the nine array cores of the Heaven Fey City were unrestricted by the array formations, allowing them to use all the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi in the city.

In fact, such Heaven Earth Yuan Qi phenomena occasionally occurred in the Heaven Fey City.

An example was… when a Fey Thearch broke through!

To go from a Fey Lord to a Fey Thearch, the phenomena that arose out of it was more spectacular than the one before them. However, such scenes were very rare, so may Fey warriors had never witnessed one before.

It resulted in these people feeling astounded by the phenomenological scene before them since this phenomena was different from a Fey Thearch's breakthrough.

But regardless, it was likely triggered by one of the array cores. Such a scene was only possible if something incredible happened in the array core.

As for the nearby array core…

People looked around and emanated their perceptions. Not all the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi in the city was being directed. The effect only extended to about a fifth of the city.

And two array cores were situated inside this region.

One was on the periphery, while the other happened to be right smack in the middle.

And this array core was none other than the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda!

Could it be that…

The sudden thought left everyone appalled. They looked toward the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda and saw dense clouds blotting out the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda. Lightning flashed about like purple swimming dragons.

Without a surprise, the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core was the heart of the phenomena!

But now, who was inside the pagoda's array core?

Everyone knew that Yi Yun had entered the pagoda's array core a few days ago. However, no one knew what he was up to.

"Could it be… Lin Yun?" someone said in disbelief.

"What makes you think Lin Yun has the ability to cause such a phenomena? Perhaps Lin Yun has already come out and a Fey Thearch has already entered the pagoda."

People found it unacceptable that a junior could trigger such a incredible phenomena. It sounded too shocking that they only wished to believe what they chose to believe.

However, there were people in the know who rejected this premise. "Impossible. Pagoda Lord Jiang Lichen has use for the pagoda's array core. If Lin Yun is out, the array core will not be used any time soon."

These words turned the faces of many Fey warriors nasty. They refused to believe that the phenomena was a result of Yi Yun.

Yi Yun was younger than 99% of them.

One with a human bloodline and who was way younger than them was able to trigger such a phenomena. Could it get any more depressing?

"Lin Yun… could he have broken through?"

The first thing that came to everyone's mind was Yi Yun's breakthrough. He had obtained many top-grade treasured herbs previously, so it was possible for him to make a breakthrough.

However, it was impossible for a human Divine Lord's breakthrough to stir up all the Yuan Qi in Heaven Fey City. It was impossible even with an array core for that would be on the level of a Godly Monarch.

However, there was an elder in an alchemical attire among the crowd. He was looking in the direction of the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda as he shook his head with a mixed expression. He said sadly, "This is not a Divine Lord's breakthrough…"

"What?"

"Not… Not a breakthrough…"

The elder appeared to be delirious as he repeated his words. Finally, he suddenly thought of something and rushed towards the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda!

When he came close to it, he even felt a faint spiritual suppression. It was naturally emitted by the alchemical chamber where Yi Yun was.

And then—

"Boom!"

A huge explosion sounded as heavenly lightning smote down.

Thick purple-colored heavenly lightning looked like fractured heavenly columns. It was as if the sky was collapsing!

The elder's heart leaped when the lightning struck. With the fastest possible speed, he went to the Pagoda Lord's residence and saw Jiang Lichen!

This man who stood at the pinnacle of the Heaven Fey City's alchemical progress had an extremely ugly expression.

At the moment the phenomena occurred, he had already thought of an unbelievable possibility—

Yi Yun's had succeeded in refining his pills!

Not only was it a success, the refinement was too astounding. It resulted in such phenomena and even caused Heavenly Tribulations the instant the pills were produced.

The instant when the Heavenly Lightning smote was likely when Yi Yun opened the cauldron.

At that moment, Jiang Lichen no longer cared that the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi that he had been accumulating for two decades had been used by Yi Yun.

He only felt that he was struck with a heavy blow.

He knew very well what materials Yi Yun had used—those materials gathered together produced such strong energy that even a Fey Thearch alchemist could not control it, much less refine it into pills.

Jiang Lichen believed that perhaps only such unrefinable pills could result in a phenomena of such scale in Heaven Fey City.

And all of this was all thanks to a human junior?

This was no longer amazement, but Yi Yun was completely incomprehensible. He could not understand how Yi Yun had done it.

Jiang Lichen had been researching alchemy for years; yet, a human junior was already capable of making him bemoan his inadequacy.

This even made Jiang Lichen generate suspicion about his own alchemical skills.

Such a blow was more terrifying than the loss of some Yuan Qi in the array core.

Meanwhile, in the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's alchemical chamber, Yi Yun was looking at the Myriad Form Shura Pills inside the Ascending Dragon Cauldron.

Even after experiencing all sorts of turmoil, he was feeling exhilarated at that moment. This was the most perfect cauldron of pills he had refined. A total of twelve perfect pills.

Each one of them were lustrous and they condensed the purest energies and laws!

In a certain sense, these twelve Myriad Form Shura Pills were equivalent to the Heavenly Dao. Yi Yun knew that even he could not refine such a cauldron of pills again for a long time to come.

The moment he had this thought, six of the Myriad Form Shura Pills landed in his hand.

He planned to eat them directly!

The nine array cores of the Heaven Fey City were excellent grounds for cultivation. Now that he was in one, the spirit fountain which had accumulated previously only had half of its energies left.

As for Yi Yun's interspatial ring, there was a thousand Chaos Crystals remaining.

With such conditions, Yi Yun naturally wanted to take advantage of the moment when the Heaven and Earth laws were condensed together thanks to the nascent formation of the Myriad Form Shura Pills and directly refine them into pills.

Yi Yun consumed all six of the Myriad Form Shura Pills!

To him, the medicinal effects of the six Myriad Form Shura Pills were more than enough to fuse all his bloodline as one.

He had other plans for the remaining six pills.

After Yi Yun swallowed the pills, he jumped into the Ascending Dragon Cauldron.

"Whoosh!"

The remaining spirit fountain in the array core was instantly sucked into the Ascending Dragon Cauldron, allowing Yi Yun to instantly be soaking in it.

Following that, Yi Yun threw out the thousand Chaos Crystals. Extending his hand to swat them, all of them shattered and the energy within exploded!

Next, the Dragon Emperor bloodline that had been slumbering in the Ascending Dragon Cauldron for billions of years was stirred alive.

"Ang!"

With a dragon's roar, a divine dragon phantom condensed out of lifeblood surged out, tearing through the pagoda and into the clouds.

This was the power of the Dragon Emperor's bloodline.

Everyone in Heaven Fey City saw this scene.

They were completely confounded. What was happening?

The lifeblood powers emitted by the Dragon Emperor phantom in the sky was like gushing stars that far exceeded their imaginations!

People originally believed that this series of phenomena was a result of Yi Yun's breakthrough. However, as a human, how was he able to manifest such potent lifeblood?

Even the members of the royal family who had awoken their Heaven Fey bloodlines could not match a tenth of this amount of lifeblood power even if they summoned their Heaven Fey totems!

However, this was still not the end. After the Dragon Emperor's phantom, people saw an incorporeal godlike figure in the sky.

The godlike figure had long limbs and a blurred face. It contained an extremely strong aura that left people unable suppressed. Many did not dare look straight at it.

Shortly after the godlike figure appeared, it fused with the Dragon Emperor phantom. Many people did not know that the godlike phantom was actually the power of the Ancestor God!

The fusion of the Ancestor God's powers with the Dragon Emperor's bloodline was the goal of Yi Yun's refinement of the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

And following that—

The entire Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda emitted a bright light. The surrounding sky and the countless energy spheres formed out of Yuan Qi surged towards the pagoda!

Hum Hum Hum…

A strong wind howled as blinding light bloomed!

All the spherical blobs of light were absorbed by the fusion of the Dragon Emperor and the godlike body. The blob of light rapidly expanded to about half a kilometer.

The Heaven Earth Yuan Qi cloud was also devoured by the massive blob of light. Countless bolts of purple lightning struck down onto the blob of light.

The Heaven and Earth laws instantly condensed into something corporeal as they rained down and infused into the gigantic sphere of light!

Chapter 1657: Jiang Yuchan Recovers

Meanwhile, in the Luo King Palace—

With Luo King's standing, he naturally had no right to possess an array core in his palace. However, the Luo King had used large numbers of Chaos Crystals to construct a massive array in an underground chamber right in the middle of the Luo King Palace.

This array usually amassed Heaven Earth Yuan Qi. When it was used, the array would be triggered to burn fifty Chaos Crystals at a time, so as to release rich Heaven Earth Yuan Qi.

Although it was much weaker than the Heaven Fey City's nine array cores in terms of Heaven Earth Yuan Qi quality, it was still a rare cultivation ground!

The activation price of fifty Chaos Crystals for such a large array was not cheap. Even Jiang Yuchan had little chance of using it.

But over the past few days, Jiang Yuchan had been receiving treatment in the core chamber.

He was also accompanied by the Luo King and the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor!

Compared to a month ago, Jiang Yuchan's condition was a lot better.

Jiang Yuchan had been suffering a tormenting pain every moment back then. With the Luo King and other mighty Fey being powerless, he was left in despair.

This changed when the Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor appeared.

Indeed, Heretic Hands lived up to his name. After a long period of treatment, he had slowly repressed the Dao injuries in Jiang Yuchan's body.

Now, although Jiang Yuchan had yet to recover his strength, his body was no longer in pain. However, he still did not dare use his lifeblood powers.

Heretic Hands had implanted more than a hundred blood charms in his body. They restrained the powers of Lightning and Fire and, over time, the powers of Lightning and Fire would be devoured by the blood charms.

"Thank you, Daoist Heretic Hands."

The Luo King placed great importance on his grandson. He was the most outstanding one among his grandchildren. Over these days, he had spent a considerable price treating Jiang Yuchan and had even accompanied him personally.

Thankfully, everything was going according to Heretic Hands's plan. The Lightning and Fire powers inside Jiang Yuchan's body were weakening and had been completely sealed.

"Luo King, it will take at most half a year before he makes a complete recovery," Heretic Hands investigated Jiang Yuchan's body and said hoarsely.

Upon hearing that, Jiang Yuchan felt like he had received life anew.

It was not easy!

After making a trip to the gates of hell, he cherished his life even more.

As for Yi Yun—the culprit who caused him to be in his present state—he vowed to rip him into pieces!

"Grandfather, I want revenge!"

"I know. Heaven Fey City will not interfere to seek revenge for you. But with the time that has passed, the poison which Daoist Heretic Hands left in the Flying Clouds Flowing Flower should be about to trigger.

At that moment, the Luo King was filled with confidence.

Even the stumbling block, the Blood King, that stood in the way of killing Yi Yun would be finished by him.

"Alright, I'll maim him personally after he's heavily injured!" A cold glint flashed in Jiang Yuchan's eyes.

Luo King nodded. Yi Yun was fast becoming a mental demon for Jiang Yuchan. It was best if Jiang Yuchan resolved it with his own hands. It was definitely possible for Jiang Yuchan to deal with a poisoned Yi Yun.

And at that moment—

"Phew–"

A blue light emitted from the array formation as it flashed in front of the Luo King.

It signified that someone outside was seeking an audience.

The Luo King frowned. The Heaven Earth Yuan Qi inside the chamber was highly compressed. Every communication with the outside world would lead to sizable losses. He did not wish to be disturbed.

"Come in!"

With a thought, the array formation opened. The person who entered was none other than the Luo King's confidant and Jiang Yuchan's teacher—Jiang Yuebai!

"What's the matter?"

Upon seeing Jiang Yuebai's expression, the Luo King's heart palpitated. Did something happen?

"Your Lordship, the Heaven Fey City has produced a phenomena caused by Heaven Earth Yuan Qi…"

"Oh?" The Luo King pricked up his brows. He naturally knew that a phenomena which was a result of Heaven Earth Yuan Qi in Heaven Fey City typically had to do with an array core.

"Which array core?"

"The Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda! Lin Yun's alchemical ground!" Jiang Yuebai took a deep breath before saying.

The Luo King, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor, and Jiang Yuchan felt that hearts skip a beat. What was the meaning of this?

"I just received news from the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda. This phenomena is likely a result of Lin Yun's success. And the grade of those pills…"

Jiang Yuebai did not finish his sentence. The three people present were all knowledgeable people. They knew very well what the statement meant.

When a pill was formed, it could cause phenomena, but that was more common in lowly worlds.

In lowly worlds, the Heavenly Dao laws were extremely low in grade. It was easy to cause nomological resonances.

But what sort of place was the Chaos Heavens?

In the known universe, the Chaos Heavens represented the supreme laws!

And the Heaven Fey City was one of the core regions of the Chaos Heavens!

Any pill that could cause phenomena in Heaven Fey City meant the stirring of the Heavenly Dao. It had never happened as far as the Luo King could remember.

No Alchemy Monarch or Alchemist Sage was capable of doing that in history!

But from what Jiang Yuebai had mentioned, Yi Yun had managed to do it?

Most of the ingredients which Yi Yun used to refine were sought out with the help of Luo King Palace. The Luo King knew how precious those ingredients were.

Such a pill could actually be successfully refined!?

This was preposterous!

The Luo King was taken aback for quite a while, feeling as though time itself was moving slowly.

He shot a glance at Heretic Hands. At that moment, even the arrogant and cold Heretic Hands wore a look a shock that was worse than the Luo King's.

Heretic Hands was not an alchemist, but he would occasionally refine various pills, mystical pills and poison pills mostly. His understanding of alchemy was deeper than that of the Luo King's. Therefore, the shock he suffered was worse.

"How can Lin Yun refine such a pill? He is way too terrifying!"

The Luo King wore a worried look. If Yi Yun was so skilled in alchemy, his influence would rise again. But of all things, he had completely offended Yi Yun.

"Daoist Heretic Hands, could your poison…"

That was what the Luo King was most worried about.

"The poison I implanted is colorless, odorless, formless, and textureless! Besides, this poison is a unique mystical formula known only to me. No matter how developed Lin Yun's alchemical skills are, there's no way for him to see through my poison."

Heretic Hands was very confident about his poison arts. Different professions are like different worlds. Alchemy was completely different from poison arts.

Heretic Hands refused to believe that a human genius would waste his precious cultivation time to study poison.

"But… I'm worried that with his alchemical skills being so high and his repeated creation of miracles, he might not be poisoned to death even if he ate your poison."

"How can that be possible?" Heretic Hands nodded. "I did underestimate the punk, but Luo King, do not deify him. His alchemical skills might have some trickery involved. If not, I absolutely can't believe that he can reach such a level of attainment with less than a thousand years of study. If that's the case, all the Alchemy Monarchs and Alchemist Sages in the Chaos Heavens have lived in vain!" Heretic Hands said firmly.

In fact, his inference was very logical.

"Daoist Heretic Hands, what you said makes sense. Sorry for my loss of composure. This fellow must have taken a shortcut, but even so, it's terrifying.

"We have already delivered the poison. It's naturally a joy if he dies from it. If he doesn't, then he will know that we tampered with it. He will definitely hate us. To be hated by someone like this…"

The Luo King did not finish his sentence, afraid he would annoy Heretic Hands.

After all, he was the one that dragged Heretic Hands into this.

However, Heretic Hands did not seem angry. Instead, he licked his lips as a covetous killing intent flashed in his eyes.

He wished to know what trickery Yi Yun had used in his alchemy.

He guessed that it involved a huge secret of Yi Yun's. If he were to obtain it, the aid it would give him would be unfathomable!

Since he was already a sworn enemy of Yi Yun, he might as well bet it all before Yi Yun fully developed his strength!

"Luo King! If Lin Yun has really eaten my secret poison, he will weaken in the next ten days. It will be the best time for us to attack!"

Since he had decided on taking action, Heretic Hands did not pin his hopes on his secret poison. Regardless what Yi Yun did, he would give his all!

Chapter 1658: Breakthrough in Strength

The phenomena in Heaven Fey City continued, slowly spreading from the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's vicinity to half of Heaven Fey City!

All people could see was numerous light and nomological spheres appearing tens of thousands of feet high into the sky. They kept condensing like sprouting buds before flying towards the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda.

At that moment, the pagoda was like a resplendent sun. The massive energy contained within it left one shuddering in fear!

Blood King watched all of this from afar.

With his level of insight, he knew that not only had Yi Yun successfully refined the Myriad Form Shura Pills, he had also consumed them right inside the pagoda!

However, Blood King could not estimate the cultivation level that Yi Yun had attained.

Everyone had their individual paths.

Fey warriors cultivated in different bloodlines; human warriors cultivated in different laws; and Ghost warriors had souls that were different intrinsically.

There were no two individuals in the Universe that took identical paths, but most people took similar paths. When once reached a certain level of expertise, like Blood King, they were able to figure out certain things.

Clearly, "most people" did not include Yi Yun. His path was something that Blood King had never seen before.

"I wonder what sight will await me when he becomes a Godly Monarch…" Blood King thought wistfully.

Meanwhile in the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda, Yi Yun had absorbed too much of the Heavenly Dao laws that his second Divine Lord Royal Seal began to slowly condense.

This was something even Yi Yun did not expect.

A second Divine Lord Royal Seal?

Before he ate the Myriad Form Shura Pills, he had never thought that the pills would aid him in condensing a Divine Lord Royal Seal.

He had originally imagined that he would begin condensing a Divine Lord Royal Seal after being sufficiently prepared.

"I never expected the energy in your body to reach such a state…" Bai Yueyin's voice suddenly sounded in his ears.

When one's energy and laws reached extreme potency, a Divine Lord Royal Seal would be automatically formed. It was only natural when faced with the ripest of conditions.

In fact, Yi Yun was too powerful, so powerful that he could not even repress his own cultivation level.

Of course, Yi Yun never thought of repressing his cultivation level. He even yearned to become a Godly Monarch right away.

Although the second Divine Lord Royal Seal had formed, it was only in a nascent state.

It was still a distance away from completion.

However, from that nascent state, one could tell many things.

Yi Yun's first Divine Lord Royal Seal was a result of the Heavenly Dao fragment, which symbolized the Heavenly Dao laws. If Yi Yun summoned it out, its surface would look like that of a miniaturized universe that contained countless galaxies.

As for the second Divine Lord Royal Seal, it was not a nomological one but a product of vitality.

The nascent Royal Seal was condensed out of three vitalities—Human, Celestial, and Fey.

This was the fusion of Yi Yun's three lifeblood powers.

The Divine Lord Royal Seals formed in ordinary human warriors were a manifestation of Heaven and Earth laws.

As for Yi Yun's Divine Lord Royal Seals, the first was a manifestation of Heavenly Dao laws while the second was formed by lifeblood and vitality.

Compared to other human warriors, he was already taking a completely different path.

As his Divine Lord Royal Seal became more corporeal, Yi Yun's lifeblood powers and vitality surged towards the second Divine Lord Royal Seal like a tidal wave.

With the Divine Lord Royal Seal taking center stage, a blood-colored vortex formed inside Yi Yun's body. Even though his vitality and lifeblood powers were extremely potent, it still left him extremely weak to have them instantly drawn away.

The nascent Divine Lord Royal Seal had a huge appetite and devoured as though it was sucking Yi Yun's body dry.

His flesh and blood vessels dried up slightly. Thankfully, the energy around him was too rich. As Yi Yun's lifeblood was emptied by the Divine Lord Royal Seal, new energy took its place.

At that moment, Yi Yun's body was like a reservoir that was drained of water while the surrounding energies were like condensed raindrops.

As the raindrops entered the reservoir, they were absorbed without end!

If not for condensing a second Divine Lord Royal Seal, Yi Yun would not have been able to absorb that much energy. Perhaps a lot of it would have been wasted, a true waste of such heavenly treasures.

Soon, Yi Yun felt that more than half his vitality had been absorbed by the second Divine Lord Royal Seal!

However, when his vitality was transplanted, instead of feeling weakened, he felt that his vitality was more cohesive. Yi Yun's vitality could be described as a roaring flame in the past. Although it was powerful, it was not concentrated.

But now, the Divine Lord Royal Seal which had condensed his vitality was like a scorching red blade that was completely indestructible.

Now, Yi Yun felt that he had infinite energy in his body. Even he did not know how strong he actually was.

This made him yearn for a delightful battle to test his strength.

Yi Yun had consumed six of the twelve Myriad Form Shura Pills, with six remaining.

Of those six, two were intended for Jiang Xiaorou, and two for the Blood King. Yi Yun had plans for the other two.

As for Lin Xintong…

Since she focused on laws and Yuan Qi, Myriad Form Shura Pills which were meant for body-tempering were of little use to her.

At that moment, the phenomena that enveloped half of Heaven Fey City had come to a pause. However, the clouds that covered the sky lingered on and began raining.

Each drop of rain contained remarkable Yuan Qi. Warriors did not think much of the Yuan Qi, but the weaker ones could not help but collect the rain.

Some people even used buckets and basins. If they could really collect a bucket of it and extract the Yuan Qi from within, it was equivalent to a Chaos Ore.

Yi Yun thought nothing of that. He opened the alchemy chamber's door and strode out.

And at that moment, there were a considerable number of people gathered outside the chamber.

A number of these people were from the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda while another group of people were from the various factions of Heaven Fey City.

Everyone was looking at Yi Yun.

At that moment, Yi Yun had become the focus of attention in Heaven Fey City!

The reason was naturally because of Yi Yun's refinement of his pills. Everyone was curious over the pills he refined.

"Young Master Lin. I'm Purple-robed Elder of Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda. The Pagoda Lord wishes to meet you," said an elder in purple alchemical robes.

"Young Master Lin, might I know what pills you refined? My master wishes to purchase them."

Compared to the purple-robed elder who had minced his words, there were others that cut to the chase.

For the pills to cause phenomena on such a massive scale meant that they were no trifling matter. Many important figures in Heaven Fey City had been paying close attention to the situation over the past few days.

"Sorry, I do not plan on selling this cauldron of pills for the time being." Yi Yun directly rejected the offer.

Chapter 1659: Laws of the Same Origins

"Oh?"

Everyone was taken aback. Although they had guessed that it would be difficult to obtain the pills Yi Yun refined, such a straightforward rejection without any chance of negotiation left many pissed.

"Young Master Lin, the Yuan Qi that has been accumulated for twenty years in my Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's core array has been mostly expended by you. My Pagoda Lord has not said a thing about the loss, but you aren't even agreeing to meet him?"

The purple-robed elder was somewhat peeved. Of course, he did not dare offend Yi Yun without knowing the effects of the impressive pills Yi Yun had just refined.

Just Yi Yun's name was still quite threatening.

If Yi Yun truly grasped the refinement methods of a particular divine pill, that would be highly remarkable.

Yi Yun naturally knew what was on these people's minds. They now saw value in him and wished to know what kind of pills he had refined.

Yi Yun said, "I do have matters to tend to. I'll bid you farewell for now."

After saying that, Yi Yun headed out.

Everyone felt infuriated, but none of them said a word.

They were hoping to think of means to figure out what kind of pills that Yi Yun had refined.

They were not like Blood King who knew ahead of time what Yi Yun was refining, what his cultivation process was, and what the phenomena caused by the pills entailed.

These people only saw endless phenomena happening.

Yi Yun's production of the pills had caused too great a stir.

However, the effects of a pill could not be fully determined from the stir it produced.

This was like how a Fey beast could be extremely powerful, but it was not necessarily tamable.

Bringing it back might result in one being devoured by it.

Immediately, many people sent voice transmissions to report to their masters.

From their point of view, Yi Yun was too arrogant. For him to act so superciliously to all the major factions because of mere pills which had unknown effects, wasn't he afraid of incurring public outrage?

His sister, Jiang Xiaorou was still vying for the throne. If too many people were offended, how could one vie for the throne?

Many people had already made up their minds. They planned on badmouthing Yi Yun once they left Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda so as to create enemies for him.

Due to the pills, none of them dared to offend Yi Yun in public. However, it was still possible to do it behind his back.

Yi Yun was unconcerned with their thoughts. He was least afraid of offending people.
