Having increased his realm drastically, he had the Blood King backing him on paper, but in truth, he relied on his own power.

To put it bluntly, it was already nice of him not to provoke others, so how could he be afraid of being provoked?

Previously, he had held back sufficiently while facing the Luo King in Heaven Fey City.

Yi Yun was not one to enjoy holding back. Only when his strength was insufficient did he have to act weak. When he had the strength, he could naturally slaughter whatever was in his way, demon or god.

"Yun-er!"

After Yi Yun walked out the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda, he heard a sweet voice. Jiang Xiaorou had already been waiting for him.

There was also Blood King and Rain Numinous.

"Senior Blood King, Sis Xiaorou."

Upon seeing these people, Yi Yun felt relieved. He took out two pill boxes and said, "Thankfully, I didn't let you down."

Blood King received the pills with great solemnity. Others might not be certain, but Blood King knew very well that Yi Yun had a cultivation breakthrough all thanks to the pills!

The potent lifeblood powers they contained left Blood King alarmed.

Yi Yun said, "These Myriad Form Shura Pills are no trifling matter. After refining them, sealing their medicinal essences required quite a bit of work. I can only seal the medicinal essence of one pill. These do not have any, so both of you should consume them as soon as possible."

"Besides, my rental of the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core is not yet done. There's still rich Yuan Qi inside. Also, there are still Heavenly Dao nomological fragments left in there thanks to my breakthrough. I have already reached a limit and can't absorb any further. It's the perfect time to cultivate in there now."

"Nomological fragments?"

Blood King was stunned. He was a Fey who cultivated in body-tempering laws and lifeblood powers. Nomological fragments which were very useful to humans were of little use to Blood King and Jiang Xiaorou.

Despite that, Blood King did according to Yi Yun's instructions.

Ignoring everything else, the remnant Yuan Qi inside the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core was indeed rich. It would be a waste not using it.

When everyone saw this scene, their expressions twitched.

They naturally heard what Yi Yun had to say. What was he implying? One could eat the pills immediately after they were refined?

Isn't that too soon?

Everyone was planning on letting their masters use the powers available to them to see the effects of Yi Yun's pills, but there was no need to do any probes. They could see it for themselves.

"To refine pills using that many top-grade materials, it likely makes an extremely violent product. Not testing the pill and consuming it directly might be fine for the Blood King, but Jiang Xiaorou's foundations are weak. Can she withstand it?"

This Yi Yun was too confident!

As they watched Blood King and Jiang Xiaorou enter the array core, the faces of the members of the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda twitched.

This was an outright wipe out; they were not leaving one bit left.

Yi Yun had wiped out a portion of the Yuan Qi that had been accumulated for twenty years, and now, the remaining was to be used completely by the Blood King and Jiang Xiaorou.

Of course, Pagoda Lord Jiang Lichen no longer cared about the Yuan Qi.

What he cared was about his alchemical skills.

If Yi Yun could refine pills that far exceeded his alchemical skills at such a young age, it would deal a terrible blow to him.

…

At that moment, inside the array core, the Blood King and Jiang Xiaorou had already begun internalizing the pills.

The Blood King had originally believed that the nomological fragments that Yi Yun had left behind were of little use to him, but he realized he was wrong when he began internalizing the pills.

Despite not cultivating in laws, the remnant nomological fragments remarkably still gathered towards them the moment they began internalizing the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

Although it was not as spectacular as Yi Yun's cultivation process, they still naturally fused into their flesh and blood, stirring up their bloodline powers.

Why was this happening?

Blood King was astounded. Although he did not cultivate in laws, he could sense that the quality of the Great Dao laws Yi Yun had left behind was extremely high. Such mystical objects could not be understood or grasped and used without years of arduous cultivation.

Blood King was right. Due to the remnant laws in the array core which stemmed from the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch, the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence's Dao of Major Destruction stemmed from the same source as the Myriad Form Shura Pill.

Laws of the same origin did not need the Blood King's control. These fragments sensed the internalizing of the Myriad Form Shura Pills and gathered automatically.

If not for Yi Yun's breakthrough ahead of Jiang Xiaorou and Blood King, their internalizing of the Myriad Form Shura Pills would not have gone that smoothly.

Chapter 1660: Totem Mark

As the Blood King constantly internalized the Myriad Form Shura Pills' medicinal essence, surging lifeblood powers spread through his entire body.

The feeling was just too comfortable!

It should be pointed out that the Blood King had obtained the Ancestor God's blood while in the Tian Yuan world. By absorbing the blood, he stimulated his ancient bloodline and managed to become a Fey Thearch.

Such a fortuitous encounter would probably leave many so envious that they could vomit blood. Blood King was also thankful for his experiences, but…

If he truly recounted the days he spent absorbing the Ancestor God's blood, the tormenting pain definitely left a deep impression on him!

The Celestial blood burned his flesh, blood, and meridians. It was like bubbling bronze liquid that was pumped into his blood vessels. As the blood flowed through his body, inch by inch, it scorched his body. The pain was obvious.

After learning that Yi Yun had successfully refined the pills, he was mentally prepared to suffer the pain of the pill's body-tempering. He wasn't afraid for himself, but was more worried that Xiaorou would be unable to withstand it.

But now, he never expected that the Myriad Form Shura Pill's medicinal essence had fully dispersed. Not only was there no pain, it even felt like he was bathing in ambrosia, as his flesh and blood strove hard to absorb the energies and laws in the area. His very life seemed to be undergoing another evolution.

He even sensed that the Myriad Form Shura Pill's powers stemmed from the same source as his bloodline powers!

"Ha!"

Potent powers surged within Blood King's body as he could not help but involuntarily roar!

Behind him, a huge heptagon star totem appeared out of thin air.

It was the Blood King's Heaven Fey totem!

Meanwhile, countless points of light gathered behind Jiang Xiaorou. They similarly condensed into a Heaven Fey totem.

The two totem phantoms were like suns, one small one large, as they shimmered right above the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda!

"That's… the Heaven Fey totem!"

The people had yet to disperse. After the astounding phenomena Yi Yun stirred, they had yet to catch their breaths when they felt the wanton surging of Heaven Earth Yuan Qi again. Furthermore, less than an hour had passed before they saw the gigantic Heaven Fey totems appear.

"That blood-colored totem… is the Blood King's!"

The Blood King cultivated in the Indestructible Killing Dao. His Heaven Fey totem also seemed to be dyed red, making it extremely recognizable.

But at that moment, there was no need to determine based on the color. Everyone knew that the Blood King and Jiang Xiaorou had walked into the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core.

They were internalizing the pills that Yi Yun had just refined.

They could instantly see the results of Yi Yun's pills!

The large Heaven Fey totem was the Blood King's, while the smaller one was naturally Jiang Xiaorou's.

Above the totem, on each of the six corners of the heptagon star, at the twelve o' clock position was the Extreme Yang Illumination, while the six o' clock position had the Extreme Yin Nether Glow!

The other four corners were the azure dragon, vermilion bird, white tiger, and black turtle!

The two sacred opposites and the four spirits of heaven!

The Heaven Fey ancient Fey's bloodline was a class of bloodline that powerful Fey beasts of ancient times possessed. And it was because of this that Heaven Fey had stronger bloodlines than the ordinary Fey. Fey who became royalty had lived in Heaven Fey City since time immemorial. They relied on their everlasting bloodline's powers to remain in power for billions of years!

Yi Yun had naturally not left. All he did was watch the two totems appear in the sky.

At that moment, he knew that his assumptions were right. The Heaven Fey totem was very related to the twelve Fey Gods of the 12 Empyrean Heavens and the Sinkhole.

Based on this, the twelve Fey Gods were not only limited to the 12 Empyrean Heavens and the Sinkhole, but reached throughout the multiverse.

Yi Yun's Myriad Form Shura Pills came from the Ascending Dragon Cauldron.

Due to this aspect, the Myriad Form Shura Pills was also related to the twelve Fey Gods. This was also why the Blood King felt that the medicinal essence stemmed from the same source as his bloodline.

As Yi Yun pondered over it, his eyes lit up suddenly.

He clearly saw that another mark on Jiang Xiaorou's Heaven Fey totem was lighting up!

The superiority of a Heaven Fey's bloodline depended on the number of Ancient Fey marks which lit up on the six corners of the Heaven Fey totem.

The Blood King had lit up four!

And Jiang Xiaorou had lit up two!

Young juniors were considered talented geniuses if they were capable of lighting one mark!

Many of the Heaven Fey Ancient Fey clansmen were unable to manifest a Heaven Fey totem to begin with, much less light up the marks.

As for juniors who were below a thousand years of age, only a handful were capable of lighting two marks across the entire imperial city.

And these people were all promising competitors for the throne of the Ruins Emperor!

…

Apart from Yi Yun, others naturally saw this scene.

When the third mark on Jiang Xiaorou's Heaven Fey totem slowly lit up, everyone was astonished.

Yi Yun was human after all. In fact, he did not have a deep understanding of the Heaven Fey ancient Fey's bloodlines or their Heaven Fey totems. But the people present were different. As Heaven Fey, the concept of bloodlines had long been embedded in their hearts.

Many would be willing to lose half their lives to improve their bloodlines further.

Heaven Fey had very strict demands for their descendants. Good-for-nothings had no right to enjoy any resources and were abandoned.

However, there had been many cases of good-for-nothings in history that obtained a huge opportunity after being abandoned, allowing them to light up many totem marks and have a monumental rise!

As long as one's bloodline was powerful, their return would not only be filled with the joy of smacking the faces of those who belittled them previously both literally and figuratively, they would also obtain immense riches and lofty positions.

They could even form their own family clans and become a candidate for the throne!

Under such circumstances, Jiang Xiaorou, who was already a genius, was still able to light up another mark. This was shocking!

"Isn't Princess Soft Clouds just several centuries old?"

It was unknown who said it, but when they did the math, they ended up at a loss for words.

The famous Ninth Prince only lit up a tiny bit of the third mark when he was three thousand years old.

It was only a thousand years later when he completely lit up the third mark.

But even so, the Ninth Prince's bloodline was already considered leap and bounds above the rest.

Most of the other eight princes who were born before the Ninth Prince only lit up two marks.

Jiang Xiaorou's single step was too exaggerated.

In contrast, people like Jiang Yuchan were like stars before a moon when compared to Jiang Xiaorou. They immediately paled in comparison!

With Jiang Xiaorou's third mark turning brighter, it was just a matter of time before it was fully lit. What kind of opportunity was this?

And this opportunity…

People recalled that Jiang Xiaorou had entered the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core to consume the pills.

It also meant that the changes she had undergone were a result of internalizing the pills which Yi Yun refined?

Pills that could make a top genius like Jiang Xiaorou achieve such huge improvements in her bloodline in less than an hour, such that she was capable of lighting additional totem marks, indicated just how astounding their effects were!

Just based on this, Yi Yun was in absolutely hot demand in the Heaven Fey City!

With this in mind, people looked at Yi Yun in a different light.

Some felt envious, others fearful and respectful. There were others considering if they could benefit themselves through Yi Yun.

Regardless, one thing was certain: The present Yi Yun was not to be messed with.

Chapter 1661: Ruins Emperor

While most warriors in Heaven Fey City were casting their attention on Jiang Xiaorou, the truly important figures were paying attention to Blood King!

Heaven Fey City could be considered as home to many Fey Thearchs. Every one of them was someone who stood at the pinnacle of the Chaos Heavens. And at the Fey Thearch realm, any attempt to make further breakthroughs in bloodline was as difficult as ascending to the heavens.

Under such circumstances, any rise in strength was extremely alluring to every Fey Thearch!

Although Jiang Xiaorou was a genius, she was a junior in the end. If Yi Yun's pills could raise a junior's strength, making it priceless, it was still nothing extremely astounding.

However, a pill that could augment a Fey Thearch would be heaven-defying.

Now, nearly all the Fey Thearchs in Heaven Fey City were paying attention to the Blood King's Heaven Fey totem!

That group included even the reigning Ruins Emperor—Jiang Jiuzhu!

In all of the Heaven Fey City, apart from the two patriarchs, even the Ruins Emperor, Jiang Jiuzhu, had only lit up four Fey beast marks, identical to the Blood King.

This difference was something Jiang Jiuzhu wished to mend even in his dreams. If that happened, he could even become the third patriarch of Heaven Fey City one day!

Yet, Jiang Jiuzhu had not seen any hopes of taking that step.

Now, the Heaven Fey City was about to designate the crown apparent since Jiang Jiuzhu had been Ruins Emperor for too long.

As the superficial lord of Heaven Fey City, Ruins Emperor could enjoy resources far greater than the other Fey Thearchs!

For instance, the Ruins Emperor had one of the nine array cores all to himself.

Most people believed that Heaven Fey City's Ruins Emperor existed to manage Heaven Fey City and be its policy maker. In fact, Jiang Jiuzhu knew very well that the position of Ruins Emperor was in actual fact the candidacy to be one of the patriarchs of the Heaven Fey ancient Fey.

He had occupied the spot as Ruins Emperor for too long and had yet to make any significant progress. As such, both patriarchs did not hold much hope for him.

In fact, before Jiang Jiuzhu, most Ruins Emperors failed to become a Fey Patriarch during their reign.

The two patriarchs were able to look on the bright side of things. If one didn't work, they just needed to switch to someone else and nurture them. After all, Heaven Fey City had been established for billions of years. There was plenty of time.

The search for a crown designate was, in fact, a signal by the two patriarchs. It was letting Jiang Jiuzhu know that it was time he abdicate the throne and not be a dog in the manger. Leave opportunities to the next generation.

With regards to this, Jiang Jiuzhu was obviously unwilling to accept it!

At that moment, he was staring intently at the Blood King totem high in the sky.

Compared to Jiang Xiaorou, the Blood King's totem was undergoing slower changes!

But it was indeed changing. Every change was extremely difficult, as though it was through the expending of an immense amount of time.

Yi Yun's pills ultimately did not help the Blood King light up his fifth Ancient Fey mark, but it created a faint connection between the four Ancient Fey marks that did light up.

Originally, the Blood King's Heaven Fey totem was nearly empty in the center, but now, there were blood wisps that resembled bloodlines across it.

These blood wisps formed a blurry pattern that resembled a crude Fey demon.

Of course, that was only Jiang Jiuzhu's feeling towards it.

If he had seen Yi Yun's 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence, he would discover that structure of the patterns was somewhat similar to the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence.

Of course, the patterns themselves were very different from the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence.

In fact, the Heaven Fey Ancient Fey's Heaven Fey totem was different to begin with.

For instance, the Blood King had embarked on the Indestructible Killing Dao; his totem was red like fresh blood.

The state and patterns on the Heaven Fey totem resembled its owner's Martial Dao to a certain extent.

However, just the consumption of some pills had caused an abnormal change to the Heaven Fey totem. It was truly incredible!

Jiang Jiuzhu could sense that the additional patterns in the middle of Blood King's Heaven Fey totem were no embellishment. They contained mysterious powers.

Yi Yun's Myriad Form Shura Pill was indeed insufficient at lighting up the Blood King's fifth Fey beast mark, but it had put in place conditions for the lighting of his fifth Fey beast mark.

The Fey Thearchs could tell that not only had the Blood King's Heaven Fey totem changed abnormally, it was truly becoming stronger.

Pills that could be effective on Fey Thearchs were just too valuable.

"Send out a decree, I wish to meet Lin Yun!" the Ruins Emperor said to his aide.

"Yes, Your Majesty." His aide bowed and left.

…

The phenomena above Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda continued for more than half a day after Yi Yun made his pills.

At evening, when the sun was setting in the west, the night sky resembled blood. All the Yuan Qi above Heaven Fey City had been swept clean after being absorbed thoroughly.

And at that moment, golden light radiated out from the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's array core before laughter sounded into the firmaments.

"Hahahah! This feels great! Great!"

Blood King soared into the sky with a two-handed saber on his back, appearing right above the array core.

His lifeblood surged, turning redder than the sky painted by the setting sun.

"What a great pill. A Myriad Form Shura Pill is able to cast one's foundation!"

Blood King's voice was filled with arrogance as the flowing of his blood sounded like a tumultuous river. It could be heard even from miles away.

Yi Yun was nearby, waiting. He had watched the scene of the Blood King and Jiang Xiaorou internalizing the pills as a guardian. It was to prevent the Luo King from pulling any crazy schemes while the duo was having a breakthrough.

When the Blood King came out of his seclusion, his lifeblood surged into the sky, releasing tremendous might.

At that moment, one could sense his rise in strength even if they were not a Fey Thearch.

This only made many wish to see the true nature of the pills that Yi Yun had refined.

If they could obtain one pill for their respective masters, it would be a most meritorious task.

Many people were considering how they should interact with Yi Yun from then on.

At that moment, a rumbling sound was heard. A flaming chariot streaked across the sky and appeared in front of the Blood King.

The chariot was pulled by nine dragon horses. Standing on the chariot was a warrior in golden armor.

He had astounding lifeblood and sharp eyes. Everyone knew that he was of the Ruins Emperor's Golden Armored Guard. Their ranks numbered less than a hundred people and they were close aides of the Ruins Emperor. It was also the elite company of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' military.

The company was formed of powerful Fey Lords, but due to their skill at combining forces, their collective strength was able to repress even Fey Thearchs!

"By order of the imperial decree! Lin Yun is to enter the palace for a meeting with His Majesty!"

The Ruins Emperor's imperial decree was simple.

But this sentence alone was enough to win the attention of many Fey Thearchs.

Emperors of mortal worlds had to attend morning court sessions every day, meeting all sorts of people. However, the Heaven Fey City's emperor was different. Even the princes and princesses of the Heaven Fey City seldom met him. His summoning of Yi Yun implied how highly he thought of him!

As the Luo King watched this from afar, his expression turned nasty. Now that the Ruins Emperor had intervened, it meant that Yi Yun's standing had been elevated. Any schemes against Yi Yun would only become harder!

Chapter 1662: Standoff with Ruins Emperor (Part 1/2)

Ruins Emperor Palace was a sacred land of the Heaven Fey City. Not only did the Ruins Emperor himself cultivate in the Ruins Emperor Palace, the other two Heaven Fey patriarchs would also seclude themselves perennially in there.

Legend had it that before Heaven Fey City was established, this piece of land was once a land of peril!

The Chaos Heavens had many lands of peril where death was deemed certain upon entry. But in fact, many of them had a limit to their danger. That limit was at the Divine Lord realm and below.

However, the land of peril upon which Heaven Fey City stood was one that could perish Fey Thearchs or Godly Monarchs!

The Fey deemed this restricted zone No Return For Thearchs.

Even across the Chaos Heavens, it was a terrifying land of peril.

People naturally avoided such a land of peril.

But typically speaking, the more dangerous some place was, the more hidden opportunities there were.

The No Return For Thearchs was one such example.

Yet, under such circumstances, the Fey produced a peerless Fey Patriarch billions of years ago. With his astounding strength, he entered the forbidden zone for centuries and fully explored the area. It could be said that he fully conquered it!

He obtained countless opportunities and also reversed the situation in No Return For Thearchs. With his stunning means, he locked down the nine divine veins buried underground.

From then on, the danger in No Return For Thearchs became less drastic. Eventually, it did not even pose a threat to Fey Lords.

Therefore, the peerless Fey established a city in No Return For Thearchs, which was none other than Heaven Fey City.

The Heaven Fey City of back then was far grander than it was now. It was a golden age for the ancient Heaven Fey.

However, billions of years passed by and, as all things change with time, be it the ancient Heaven Fey or Heaven Fey City, neither of them were restored to their former glory.

The nine divine veins under Heaven Fey City also weakened drastically.

But even so, when Yi Yun entered the Ruins Emperor Palace, he felt a formidable strength transmitting from underground. The stirrings made it feel like the ground was breathing.

Even the tiles beneath Yi Yun's feet were made of the beast blood of powerful ancient Fey mixed with Purple Gold Divine Mud. Through a unique flame, together with special means, the mixture was cast into the tiles.

Walking through the corridors of the palace felt like walking through a powerful Fey beast's body. It felt like the ground was alive, made of flesh and blood.

Such potent lifeblood powers boiled upwards. If a human warrior who was physically weak and had a low cultivation level was there, they probably would not even be able to stand straight. As for Ghost warriors, it was possible they would evaporate.

"Just the tiles of this palace are priceless. This entire Ruins Emperor Palace is basically piled from Chaos Crystals."

Yi Yun reflected over the ancient Heaven Fey's heritage. Billions of years of accumulation truly led to unimaginable wealth.

"His Majesty summoned Young Master Lin. Blood King, please halt."

Outside the Ruins Emperor Palace's main hall, a young man dressed in a colorful robes with python embroidery walked out. He actually stopped the Blood King!

As he was worried about Yi Yun's entry into the palace alone, the Blood King had accompanied him. However, he was stopped at the door.

The young man's identity was no trifling matter. He was the Sixth Prince, the only crown candidate who was directly related to the Ruins Emperor.

He was the Ruins Emperor's great-grandson!

Although Ruins Emperor was unwilling to abdicate, he would rather leave the throne to his great grandson if forced to abdicate since that was slightly better.

And it was because of this relationship that the Sixth Prince had a high chance of inheriting the throne.

Blood King frowned slightly, but at that moment, Yi Yun said, "It's fine. Senior Blood King, you can just wait for me here. I'll meet the Ruins Emperor alone."

The python-robed youth looked at Yi Yun in surprise upon hearing that. His eyes effused an indescribable look.

It was partially the admiration of Yi Yun's guts, and partially mockery.

"Be careful then. Immediately shatter the voice transmission jade slip if anything happens," Blood King exhorted.

Yi Yun's present identity had turned supernatural after his refinement of the Myriad Form Shura Pill. But simultaneously, his situation became extremely precarious.

He had no idea what the Ruins Emperor had in mind.

Elephants were hunted for their precious tusks. Rhinoceroses shared a tragic fate because of their horns. Yi Yun's Myriad Form Shura Pills were too important. Without a matching strength, he would be coveted by others.

Blood King was afraid that he could not protect Yi Yun if it came to a critical moment. Perhaps, Yi Yun would be imprisoned and forced to refine pills.

This was also the reason for the Sixth Prince's look of mockery.

After all, Yi Yun was only a human. To the upper echelons of the ancient Heaven Fey, it was impossible his interests were aligned with the Fey regardless of his relationship with Jiang Xiaorou.

…

Inside the hall, Yi Yun met Ruins Emperor.

This middle-aged man who ruled over the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins on the surface was dressed in a purple cloak. Embroidered on his chest and sleeves were the ancient Heaven Fey totems.

He faintly emitted a blurry red glow. Yi Yun could tell that this glow was not a deliberate display. Instead, it naturally condensed as a result of his formidable lifeblood.

The Ruins Emperor was indeed stronger than the Blood King!

Yi Yun cupped his hands and bowed. "Greetings Your Majesty, I'm Lin Yun."

Yi Yun bowed a junior's bow instead of a bow towards royalty.

All Ruins Emperor did was prick up his brows towards such an action. He thought nothing of it.

"Did you injure the Luo King's grandson, Jiang Yuchan?" Ruins Emperor asked. His voice came across as unperturbed, like he was a god or buddha. Yi Yun knew that this was a bearing that resulted from prolonged enjoyment of a high status, one that oversaw all life. His every action and word gave one the feeling that he was not to be slighted.

However, Yi Yun did not share such a feeling. A person's state of mind was determined by their strength. Yi Yun had the strength to prop himself up.

"That was me!"

"You nearly took his life." Ruins Emperor's voice sounded cold.

Even so, Yi Yun knew that the Ruins Emperor was unconcerned with Jiang Yuchan's outcome. His direct descendant was the Sixth Prince. Jiang Yuchan was a competitor to the Sixth Prince, so to put it bluntly, the Ruins Emperor probably yearned for Jiang Yuchan to suffer a tragic fate.

However, he was Ruins Emperor after all. In name, he had to watch over his people. Therefore, it was his duty to interrogate Yi Yun sternly for his injuring of Jiang Yuchan.

But actually, instead of calling it an interrogation, it was more to take Yi Yun down a notch due to his ulterior motives.

Yi Yun knew that the Ruins Emperor had raised Jiang Yuchan's condition only to begin the conversation.

"Indeed!" said Yi Yun lightly.

Ruins Emperor was taken aback. He had raised the issue of Yi Yun nearly taking Jiang Yuchan's life; yet, Yi Yun had given the same answer.

Since Yi Yun's actions were justified, the typical person would defend themselves with those justifications if they were in his shoes, but Yi Yun's reaction was completely impervious.

To say something like "are you aware of your wrongdoings" would only place the Ruins Emperor at the disadvantage, so he decided to end the topic and said, "The materials you needed to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills were not only limited to the ones you purchased, right?"

Yi Yun's heart palpitated when he heard that. He raised his head and looked at the Ruins Emperor once again.

It was not surprising that the Ruins Emperor already knew the Myriad Form Shura Pills' name since Yi Yun had mentioned it a few times.

What left Yi Yun slightly astounded was the implication of the Ruins Emperor's words. He was referring to the blood of the Ancestor God!

Chapter 1663: Standoff with Ruins Emperor (Part 2/2)

The Blood King's possession of the Ancestor God's blood was his secret to begin with.

Yi Yun came from the Tian Yuan world and having heard Jiang Xiaorou's description of the Blood King's growth, he surmised that the Blood King might possess the Ancestor God's blood.

It was unlikely the Ruins Emperor knew of the secret.

However, when Yi Yun's pills were formed, the phenomena which resulted included a scene of Human, Fey, and Celestial fusion despite it lasting only for a few seconds.

However, it was likely that the Ruins Emperor had noticed something from the auras of the phenomena. He had likely seen the Ancestor God's blood before and because of that, he could sense the Ancestor God's aura from the phenomena!

If the Ruins Emperor could tell, it was likely the other two patriarchs did as well!

Using the Ancestor God's blood for the refinement of pills was intolerable to the Celestials. The Celestials regarded the Ancestor God as a superior the way the Fey saw the Heaven Fey Patriarchs.

If Yi Yun were to use the Fey cores of the two patriarchs of Ruins Emperor Palace, would the ancient Heaven Fey let the matter rest if they learned of it?

Just the exposure of this matter would lead to the full-blown assault of the Celestials against Yi Yun!

And even the Blood King was unable to protect Yi Yun in that scenario.

This was the Ruins Emperor's play. Jiang Yuchan had only been mentioned in passing, but this issue was truly his trump card.

Yi Yun knew very well that at the end of the day, the Ruins Emperor wanted the Myriad Form Shura Pills' recipe!

It was naturally best if the recipe to pills that benefited the Fey tremendously was in his own hands!

The Ruins Emperor was looking straight into Yi Yun's eyes.

The Celestials were the true overlords of the Chaos Heavens. In addition, the Ruins Emperor and the two patriarchs he represented were the overlords of the Fey. If Yi Yun were to decline sharing the recipe, it was equivalent to offending two major factions in the Chaos Heavens simultaneously!

Such courage was not something even a Fey Thearch or Godly Monarch would have.

When faced with similar situations, the typical junior would probably be flustered with nervousness and be amenable to endless demands even if they could appear calm on the surface.

However, Yi Yun was different.

He remained calm and the Ruins Emperor could sense that his calmness was not faked.

Yi Yun said, "The recipe to the Myriad Form Shura Pills does include the Ancestor God's blood. If Your Majesty were to leak this news, it will be impossible for the Fey to obtain the Myriad Form Shura Pills as well. This recipe would be declared taboo by the Celestials."

"Anything will be better than not having it. Besides, you are a human." The Ruins Emperor's words had a threatening hint to them. "Anyway, if you are willing to hand it over, I will give you whatever you want. I will provide you with astounding amounts of resources, allowing you cultivate smoothly! If your recipe were to be a big boon for the Fey, your request of letting Jiang Xiaorou inherit the throne would also be negotiable."

Yi Yun was not furious with the Ruins Emperor's threat. It was completely opposite. He felt that the Ruins Emperor was being rather polite.

He originally believed that the Fey were closer in temperament to beasts, and that the upper echelons of the Fey were like ancient Fey beasts that would not let any benefit slip past them, Yi Yun's interaction with them made him feel that the conditions provided by the Ruins Emperor was considered pretty good.

In a warrior's world, strength was supreme. Without sufficient strength, one should be grateful if transactions were done by force alone. It was ultimately better than completing the transaction by death.

The typical junior would probably happily accept the conditions given the double threat of the two massive factions of the Celestials and Fey as well as the stunning benefits that were offered.

However, Yi Yun was naturally not the typical junior.

He said indifferently, "It's not that I do not wish to give you the recipe… it's just that even if I were to give it to you, you will not be able to understand it."

"Oh!?" The Ruins Emperor's eyes flashed coldly!

Yi Yun had said those words with a casual and indifferent tone. But at that moment, his tone could hardly be distinguished from a supercilious one.

The Ruins Emperor was unsure if Yi Yun was deliberately looking down on the Fey. His expression was perfect, making it impossible for his true thoughts to be identified.

However, if Yi Yun's words had changed to: "It's not that I'm not imparting you my knowledge. It's just that even I were to give it to you, you will not understand if because all of you are illiterates."

That would result in zero cordiality.

Just as Yi Yun said those words, he suddenly felt a massive lifeblood force emit from the grand hall. The lifeblood powers surged like a tsunami!

In fact, Yi Yun had noticed prior to these turns of event that there was an additional person in the room. He just feigned ignorance.

And now, the concealed person was clearly peeved by Yi Yun's accusation, and he finally stopped hiding.

Yi Yun turned his head back and saw a person walk out from the darkness. Yi Yun had already guessed at his identity.

He was the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's Pagoda Lord—Jiang Lichen.

Jiang Lichen had become Fey Thearch earlier than the Luo King. He was a Fey elite of the same generation as Ruins Emperor, Jiang Jiuzhu. He had also witnessed Jiang Jiuzhu's ascension to the throne.

As Jiang Lichen focused on alchemy, he had no intention of vying for the throne. Therefore, Jiang Lichen was one of the few Fey Thearchs who had a decent relationship with Jiang Jiuzhu.

The Ruins Emperor did not know alchemy, so he allowed Jiang Lichen to listen in to see if Yi Yun was up to any tricks.

He never expected that Yi Yun would not resort to any tricks. Instead, he made arrogant remarks that generally, he was not acting against the Fey but that the Fey race's pills and poisons were all garbage.

This was equivalent to a slap in the face of Jiang Lichen.

Jiang Lichen represented the highest alchemical standards among the ancient Heaven Fey, but Yi Yun did not give an excuse that it was unlikely they could master the pills, but that none of them could understand a thing!

How could Jiang Lichen put up with that?

"So it's Pagoda Lord." Yi Yun still gave a junior's bow, but such an etiquette only looked like mockery to Jiang Lichen.

Jiang Lichen looked at Yi Yun with burning eyes. "I've always heard of people who act in undue confidence, but I've never seen one so arrogant as you. Young man, being overly arrogant can lead to death out of the blue."

Jiang Lichen's words had a faint killing intent to them.

Yi Yun laughed, "Pagoda Lord, there are all sorts of specializations. It's not that I'm looking down on the Fey's pill refining techniques, but when it's a recipe that involves some secret arts of mine, the Fey's alchemists might not have a solution to it. Pagoda Lord, if you are unconvinced, you can give it a try."

Jiang Lichen's eyes narrowed when he heard that.

This was equivalent to Yi Yun's announcement of war!

He planned to compete with Jiang Lichen over pill refining arts!

As for Jiang Lichen, he represented the ancient Heaven Fey. That also involved the reputation of the entire Fey's alchemical skills.

If they were to lose…

Ruins Emperor looked at Jiang Lichen. "Lichen, don't be goaded."

Rationally speaking, it was impossible for Yi Yun to defeat Jiang Lichen. No matter how much of a genius he was, he was limited by his age. The Ruins Emperor guessed that Yi Yun's refinement of Myriad Form Shura Pill was done by some trickery.

However, through this trickery, Yi Yun had refined the Myriad Form Shura Pill and stirred up a phenomena. This was under the circumstances of everyone waiting to watch the farce.

Such a person was naturally no idiot. Since he dared raise a challenge, it was likely that he had some skill to depend on!

If one truly treated him as the typical junior, the only one to suffer was themselves! The Luo King was quite a famous Fey Thearch. He had no lack of strength or means. Yet, didn't he still suffer under the punk?

Chapter 1664: Fey Altar

"Your Majesty, if I show fear towards this human junior, that's the end of my alchemical achievements."

However, as an Alchemy Monarch, he represented Heaven Fey City. Now that he was being mocked by a junior, how could he admit to it?

It would be like if someone threw a pile of shit at you, and not only did you catch it, you even licked it.

Jiang Lichen could not afford to lose face in such a manner.

"Alright…" Ruins Emperor nodded and did not continue.

"How do you want to compete? Where and when? What happens if you win or lose?"

Although Jiang Lichen was highly spirited, he knew that Yi Yun was not someone simple. It was best to figure out what tricks Yi Yun had up his sleeve.

If it was a domain he wasn't skilled in, he would absolutely not act stubbornly. That would cause him to fail miserably at an easy task.

Yi Yun cupped his hands and said, "Pagoda Lord, you are being too harsh in your words. I do not want this competition to harm any feelings. I made the suggestion only to prove what I just said and not prove that my alchemical skills are better than the Heaven Fey City's. I just wish to tell His Majesty that the recipe to refining the Myriad Form Shura Pills is useless even if I give it to others.

"Besides, of the ingredients needed for the Myriad Form Shura Pills, the Ancestor God's blood is particularly difficult. As for the other valuable ingredients, they are naturally not difficult for the Heaven Fey City to gather with its heritage. However, the Ancestor God's blood is nowhere to be found."

As Yi Yun said that, he noticed that the Ruins Emperor was silent. This left him slightly taken aback. Could it be that… the ancient Heaven Fey actually had the Ancestor God's blood?

The Ancestor God's blood was not obtainable from any random Celestial expert. That would not make it rare.

It had to be from a patriarch of the Celestials!

After the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch vanished, the Ancestor God was the strongest in this universe!

Yi Yun and Blood King had obtained some Ancestor God blood thanks to their opportunities.

Could it be that the ancient Heaven Fey also had some?

On careful thought, the peerless Fey patriarch who established the Heaven Fey City was an astounding figure. In the billions of years that followed, the ancient Heaven Fey had incredible accumulations. It was not impossible for them to possess some Ancestor God blood.

Upon coming to this realization, Yi Yun did not speak further. Instead, he took out a jade box.

"Inside this jade box are two Myriad Form Shura Pills!"

The moment Yi Yun said that, Jiang Lichen's and Ruins Emperor's eyes lit up!

Just a few of the precious pills was enough to move Fey Thearchs, without even the need to mention the heaven-defying price of the ingredients used in the recipe.

"Your Majesty, I'm just competing with the Pagoda Lord. If the Pagoda Lord is able to completely refine the medicinal essence and energy out of these two Myriad Form Shura Pills and restore them to their original states, I'll admit defeat. I'll hand over the recipe and also offer the two Myriad Form Shura Pills to you, Your Majesty!"

The competition Yi Yun suggested was, in fact, very simple.

If it was a one-on-one alchemical competition, it would be pointless if he were to publicly smack Jiang Lichen in the face.

Furthermore, Yi Yun's alchemical skills mostly came from the Sinkhole, and compared to the Chaos Heavens, it was unlikely he had an advantage.

Even if he were able to prove his alchemical superiority, he would only end up offending the ancient Heaven Fey, bringing him no benefits.

Yi Yun wished for a transaction which was beneficial to him. This was the reason why he left two Myriad Form Shura Pills.

"Extraction and restoring the medicinal essence?"

Jiang Lichen pondered for a moment. To put it plainly, pills were simply a vessel for medicinal essence and energy.

There were three major steps in alchemy. First, the extraction of medicinal essence from the various materials. Second was to refine the medicinal essence with alchemical fire. The third step was to fuse the medicinal essences into one, forming a pill!

Now that Yi Yun challenged Jiang Lichen to extract the medicinal essence from the Myriad Form Shura Pills without destroying them, it was equivalent to going backwards from the third step.

In fact, the third step of pill refinement was the relatively easier step.

An experienced alchemist could tell the technique and process used by the alchemist who refined the pill from studying it.

If he was unable to reverse the third easiest step, then it meant that it was basically impossible for him to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills. It was not even possible to understand the recipe.

"Hand me the pills," said Jiang Lichen with a deep voice. He remained careful even though the challenge appeared simple.

"Pagoda Lord, there's no need to rush. What if you fail to figure it out?

"What will you do?"

Yi Yun looked at the Ruins Emperor when he finished his sentence. "Your Majesty, if Pagoda Lord Jiang fails to restore the Myriad Form Shura Pills, then these two Myriad Form Shura Pills will be offered to you, but… I wish to borrow the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' Fey Altar!"

The moment that was said, Ruins Emperor's and Jiang Lichen's eyes narrowed slightly.

This Yi Yun was really ambitious!

Back when Yi Yun planned on helping Jiang Xiaorou clinch the throne, he had kept the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' Fey Altar in mind.

Back then, Rain Numinous had said that the royalty of the top few clans of the Chaos Heavens would jointly hold a trial for the members of the royalty which tested them on every aspect!

The person who got first would win handsome rewards, including entry into the Fey Altar!

The so-called Fey Altar was an altar that worshipped the heavens in one of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' forbidden grounds. Over the billions of years, the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins had many powerful Fey choose to die in there before their natural death. The lifeblood powers that released upon their death continued lingering in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' forbidden ground. If one used a mystic technique to stir the powers, especially if it was a peerless genius, they could call upon the Heavenly Tribulation on the altar!

It was the most supreme Heavenly Tribulation in the Chaos Heavens!

The three bloodlines in Yi Yun's body had fused together after his consumption of the Myriad Form Shura Pills, but ultimately, it was a fusion which lacked tempering!

In addition, Yi Yun's cultivation time was rather short. Before he broke through to become a Godly Monarch, he needed the Heavenly Tribulation's tempering.

And previously, Yi Yun's experience of the Heavenly Tribulation in the Sinkhole was too weak. Compared to his body that was in need of tempering, that was nothing worth mentioning.

Yi Yun eagerly wanted to enter the Fey Altar!

Besides, even if Jiang Xiaorou won first in the competition between the royal candidates and even became crown designate, she would be the only one to enter the Fey Altar.

As a human, it was impossible for Yi Yun to enter with Jiang Xiaorou.

Therefore, when Yi Yun refined the Myriad Form Shura Pills, he had an idea.

He allowed Blood King to publicly internalize the pills and made everyone in Heaven Fey City see his advancement.

Pills that could enhance a Fey Thearch were worthy of a spot at the Fey Altar.

Ruins Emperor looked at Yi Yun and realized his goal.

The Fey Altar's Lightning Tribulation had the risk of death even for princes who had stimulated their ancestors' bloodline, much less humans.

This human had cultivated in both laws and body. His progress was enough to leave many Fey embarrassed.

Was there really no danger to allow such a person to develop his strength?

Ruins Emperor was hesitant.

Yi Yun could tell what was on Ruins Emperor's mind as he said, "Your Majesty, don't worry. Although I'm human, my sister, Jiang Xiaorou is an ancient Heaven Fey. I will not destroy my sister's foundations and I can swear that upon my Dao heart. In the future, as long as the Fey do not cross me, I will not be at odds with the Fey's interests."

Chapter 1665: Pill Testing

Yi Yun was ultimately not from the Chaos Heavens. The future fate of the humans and Fey in the Chaos Heavens was not something he needed to concern himself with.

Under the Heavenly Dao's evolution, the various races had to fight for their own survival.

Therefore, swearing on his Dao heart to not be at odds with the Fey's interests was nothing.

From Yi Yun's point of view, the greatest danger was the Ancestor God.

He had no idea when the Ancestor God would recover and he had little time to strengthen himself. He needed the opportunity to transcend the Fey Altar's Heavenly Tribulation.

It was naturally against the rules for humans to enter the Fey Altar.

However… the allure of becoming Fey Patriarch was too great.

The Ruins Emperor was no longer young. If he could not attain his goal in the years to come, there would be no more hope left for him.

The two patriarchs had already decided on making him abdicate—once the crown designate became a Fey Thearch.

The Fey ran things differently from mortal kingdoms. When mortal emperors abdicated, they could become an Emperor Emeritus.

As for a Fey emperor, they could only abdicate in an ignoble manner, leaving them with titles such as former Ruins Emperor.

That was their end.

Being accustomed to a life of glory, it was understandable how one found the drawing of curtains unacceptable. The Ruins Emperor still wished to fight back against his eventual outcome and he saw hope in the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

"Alright, if you can swear upon your Dao heart, I can permit your entry into the Fey Altar."

Rules were set by people. Compared to his own breakthrough, breaking them was nothing.

"Lichen, test the pills!"

Ruins Emperor looked at Jiang Lichen. Without his instructions, Jiang Lichen had already begun examining the pills that Yi Yun had given him.

The last step of a restoration was neither considered difficult nor easy.

However, Yi Yun's pill was very different.

He had never seen the patterns and laws on the pills ever.

Originally, Jiang Lichen had done some research on the alchemical techniques of the humans, Ghosts, and Souls. That gave him a healthy amount of confidence.

However, the pills in front of him did not appear to be a result of any alchemical system in the Chaos Heavens.

It was mystical and complex, completely indescribable.

This was akin to the story of a gifted scholar of the mortal world.

This scholar memorized all the important books, was proficient in poetry and the analects. He was great at writing essays, and even well-versed in the zither, chess, calligraphy, and painting, as well as archery and horse-riding.

The scholar was practically flawless!

Being top scholar was a sure bet, and it was even possible for him to be a double top scholar in both civil and military examinations.

However… when he went to take the test, what he faced was… the modern-day National College Entrance Examination.

The examination involved mathematics and combined sciences of physics, chemistry and biology. It would appear like Greek.

The English examination script would look like scribbles.

The only thoughts this promising scholar would have was: are these examination questions? What are these? What does this symbol do? Also, he would not even have seen multiple-choice questions before.

At that moment, Jiang Lichen's feelings were akin to the poor scholar's.

Yi Yun's refinement of the Myriad Form Shura Pills used the Heretical God Fire as its flame. The laws stemmed from the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch's Dao of Major Destruction and Major Creation. His alchemical techniques stemmed from the Sinkhole's divine alchemist's heritage.

Every aspect left Jiang Lichen at a loss.

He did not even need to consider how to solve the problem posed to him, because he couldn't even understand the problem statement.

He could already determine that it was impossible for him to restore the pills. It was not a matter of time, but a futile attempt akin to a tiger's attempt to devour the heavens. There was no incisive point of attack.

And worst of all, the pill that he had no idea how it was refined effused a potent medicinal essence; it even had a spiritual quality to it. Jiang Lichen had no doubts to its effects.

On second thought, what Yi Yun said about how they would not comprehend the recipe even if it was given to them was really not empty talk.

He was not mocking them, but simply illustrating a fact.

Sadly, he felt humiliated and became afire with righteous indignation, hoping to prove the alchemical arts of Heaven Fey City.

Seriously… that was embarrassing.

Jiang Lichen wore a bitter look. He never expected the pills to be so unorthodox.

When he noticed that the Ruins Emperor had cast him an askance look, Jiang Lichen widened his mouth. He originally planned on acting to consider a little longer. After all, it was embarrassing if he admitted defeat after taking a few looks.

However, with the realization that Yi Yun had already guessed that he could not understand it at all, any further acting would make him appear like a monkey putting on a show for him. That would be even more awkward.

Forget it…

Jiang Lichen handed the pills back to Yi Yun and bit the bullet. "Pardon my ineptness, I'm unable to figure it out."

Jiang Lichen's straightforward statement stunned the Ruins Emperor. That fast?

He did not even take a minute. Although the Ruins Emperor did not know alchemy, he knew what that implied.

The study of alchemy was not something that could be accomplished in a day. If Jiang Lichen could not even understand it, asking him to refine the pill would be an impossible task.

Without surprise, there was perhaps no second person in the Chaos Heavens who could refine those pills.

Obtaining the recipe would be pointless.

After understanding this, the Ruins Emperor looked at Yi Yun differently. He was amazed that the Myriad Form Shura Pills could only be refined by this one person…

And worst of all, these pills were of paramount importance to the Fey. Handling the situation became quite challenging.

Unfortunately, Yi Yun was not a clansmen of the ancient Heaven Fey…

Many thoughts went through the Ruins Emperor's mind. He was very tempted to keep Yi Yun with the Fey, but he did not dare use any forceful means.

After all, Yi Yun's development appeared to be boundless from the looks of it. He was only able to make Yi Yun act according to his will for now, but once he offended him and allowed Yi Yun to leave, the situation would only deteriorate.

The Ruins Emperor hesitated for quite some time before deciding to maintain a friendly relationship with Yi Yun. After all, Jiang Xiaorou was his sister and, from the looks of it, their relationship was pretty good. If Jiang Xiaorou helmed the Fey, would Yi Yun's Myriad Form Shura Pills not be given to her?

He said, "Alright! I can permit your usage of the Fey Altar! However, there is an additional condition. After you transcend the lightning tribulations, I still need you to refine another cauldron of pills. The ingredients will be provided by us Fey. You can take ten percent of the resulting pills!"

The ancient Heaven Fey had the ingredients ready and the main reason why the Ruins Emperor promised Yi Yun ten percent of the pills was because he feared that Yi Yun would not put in full effort.

Of course, for such rare pills, ten percent was too little.

Yi Yun found it acceptable. After all, the ingredients were unpurchasable with his present monetary situation. Furthermore, the Fey Altar was promised.

"Alright!"

Yi Yun agreed to it and set in place the contract.

The situation was not a trifling matter; it even involved the entire ancient Heaven Fey's interests.

The Ruins Emperor could not make the decision himself, so once Yi Yun left, he reported the situation to the two patriarchs.

With that, Yi Yun's entry into the Fey Altar was immediately permitted.

The Fey did things swiftly, so Yi Yun's entry into the Fey Altar was set for three days later.

The opening of the Fey Altar was of immense importance. It was impossible to hide the opening of the array from the Heaven Fey City's Fey.

Instantly, there was an uproar among the Fey!

Yi Yun, a human, was not only entering their array core, but he was also entering the Fey Altar!?

If it was just the Heaven Fey City's array core, the powerful Fey geniuses could still have a chance of enjoying that luxury, but the Fey Altar was practically reserved only for royalty.

Even the princes and princesses needed to be conferred titles first. And there were only a few dozen of them in Heaven Fey City. And titled princes and princesses needed to make massive contributions or have excellent results in experiential tests with other races, winning glory for the Fey, before they had a chance at entering the Fey Altar.

Among all the princes, only the Ninth Prince and Sixth Prince had ever entered the Fey Altar.

The Ninth Prince had lit up the third mark of the Heaven Fey totem.

As for the Sixth Prince, he was the direct great-grandson of the Ruins Emperor. With the Ruins Emperor's merit points, he barely earned a chance at entering the Fey Altar.

Now, faced with Yi Yun's entry into the Fey Altar, how could the reaction among the Fey warriors not be intense?

"Grandfather, I can't accept it. Why!?"

Among all the princes, the one who found it least acceptable was Jiang Yuchan!

He had been injured by Yi Yun and tormented by the lightning and fire forces. He nearly lost all his will to live and only through the Ghost Doctor's help did he barely last to this day. However, it would still take him half a year to completely recover.

Under such circumstances, his reputation was almost in the dumps!

The Fey did not pity failures.

Jiang Yuchan's battle with Yi Yun was witnessed by countless warriors in Heaven Fey City. He failed miserably!

A tenet of Fey warriors was that failure was a disgrace to the race, so he deserved death. Furthermore, Jiang Yuchan was defeated by a human. It was even more embarrassing!

In fact, after losing to Yi Yun, Jiang Yuchan's chances at clinching the throne had dropped drastically. Unless he had fortuitous encounters in the future or made great meritorious contributions to redeem himself, the Heaven Fey would not tolerate a failure like Jiang Yuchan inheriting the throne.

To stand up again, Jiang Yuchan had to first crush Yi Yun beneath his feet.

But now, Yi Yun had not only refined the Myriad Form Shura Pills, he had even won the favor of the Ruins Emperor. He had entered the Ruins Emperor Palace and wad even permitted entry into the Fey Altar!

That was the Fey Altar!

A forbidden land of the ancient Heaven Fey. All he could do was dream about it, without any chance of entering it his entire life.

What right did a human like Yi Yun have to do so?

Compared to Yi Yun, their standings were like night and day!

"Grandfather, I can't accept it! All he did was rely on pills to become a core figure among the Fey?

"With those pills, he convinced His Majesty and the two Patriarchs? Grandfather, didn't you say that Ghost Doctor poisoned the ingredients? Does he look poisoned in any way?"

Jiang Yuchan fully believed Ghost Doctor's words in the beginning, but now, Yi Yun was basically frolicking around!

Yi Yun's craftiness appeared to be above that of the Ghost Doctor's. That old fogey had been fooled!

If that were the case, weren't they acting like idiots previously, being fooled without realizing it?

They had used their family clan's resources to gather all the materials for Yi Yun.

When Yi Yun failed to find the materials, they helped!

When Yi Yun's finances were lacking, they even reduced the price a little!

This was not just as ridiculous as helping someone count the money used to purchase themselves, but more like sending themselves up to the gallows and helping the executioner grind the blade!

What Jiang Yuchan said was something the Luo King naturally knew as well.

He believed that he was in power in the Heaven Fey City all these years. And even if he did not have perfect strategies, he was someone with a myriad of means. Yet, his actions the past few months were humiliating.

"Young Master Yuchan, are you blaming me?"

At that moment, a sinister voice suddenly sounded. Jiang Yuchan's neck shrank when he heard that.

Ghost Doctor!

He had naturally received the news regarding Yi Yun's entry into the Fey Altar.

Chapter 1666: Hidden Killing Intent

Jiang Yuchan naturally did not dare act impetuously in front of Ghost Doctor. He had yet to recover from his injuries, so he still relied on Ghost Doctor.

"The poison in Lin Yun's pills appears to be ineffective. From the looks of it, the Nine Orifices Essence Yang Pills consumed by the Blood King have also been cleansed of their poison," Luo King said to Ghost Doctor.

He found his own words incredulous. Using poison as a solution was just too rare!

As a Ghost Thearch who studied poison, probably no one could match Ghost Doctor in all of the Chaos Heavens. How did Yi Yun actually resolve the poison?

Ghost Doctor said, "For him to have the ability to refine such phenomenological pills in the Heaven Fey City, it's not impossible for him to resolve my poison.

"He definitely uses some trick! Be it pill refinement or the removing of poison, all of his astounding acts must have been accomplished using some unknown secret.

"And this secret is very useful to us. When the time comes, I can share the secret with you."

Luo King felt the allure.

He had already offended Yi Yun; now that Ghost Doctor was willing to aid him, it was indeed the best time to deal with Yi Yun.

"Alright, I will find an opportunity," Luo King said to Ghost Doctor.

After Ghost Doctor left, Jiang Yuchan said gloomily, "Grandfather, you might have promised Ghost Doctor, but how are you to deal with Lin Yun? He just entered Ruins Emperor Palace and is now someone the Ruins Emperor is relying on. If we were to touch him, wouldn't we anger the Ruins Emperor?"

Jiang Yuchan had fallen into despair after learning this news. He felt that it was impossible for him to exceed Yi Yun's standing for the rest of his life.

If his standing and strength were both inferior to Yi Yun's, how was he to seek revenge?

"Do you really think that the Ruins Emperor wishes to protect him?" Luo King said lightly.

Jiang Yuchan was taken aback. "Why do you ask?"

"Leadership is rendered ineffective by subordinates that grow in power. Lin Yun's talent is heaven-defying. He has yet to become a Godly Monarch, but he is already capable of stirring up a storm in Heaven Fey City. Wouldn't it be worse when he becomes a Godly Monarch? When the time comes, perhaps Jiang Jiuzhu will not be his match either!

"Do you think Jiang Jiuzhu will trust a person like him that cannot be controlled, especially when he's human? That he will like him?

"Furthermore, with Lin Yun's close relationship with Jiang Xiaorou and Blood King, what if he insists that Jiang Xiaorou is made crown designate with the Myriad Form Shura Pills as condition? Then, the ancient Heaven Fey might one day lose its independence. Do you believe that Jiang Jiuzhu would be willing to risk such threats?"

"Grandfather, so you are implying that?" Jiang Yuchan's heart stirred. He never thought too deeply about it.

"Lin Yun's Myriad Form Shura Pills might stimulate the ancient Heaven Fey's bloodline. They can allow young geniuses to enjoy an enhancement to their bloodline and can be useful to Fey Thearchs. This gives Jiang Jiuzhu no choice but to rely on Lin Yun.

"Lin Yun is like a fruit tree with thorns. Although the fruits are extremely sweet, one can injure themselves if they aren't careful when plucking the fruits! Furthermore, the more he develops his strength, the sharper his thorns become!

"If we pluck off all the thorns on this fruit tree and allow it to only bear fruit without pricking anyone, Jiang Jiuzhu would probably be filled with gratitude towards us."

"Grandfather, what you said makes sense!" Jiang Yuchan's eyes lit up. He was unaware of the Ruins Emperor's thought processes without being in his position, so when he heard the Luo King's explanation, he immediately felt enlightened. "Then, when do we take action?"

Jiang Yuchan felt somewhat eager.

"This Lin Yun has a death wish. He even has the wish to use the Fey Altar to transcend the Heavenly Tribulations at such a critical point in time. The Fey Altar is a sacred land of our ancient Heaven Fey, so how can a human be allowed entry? Jiang Jiuzhu was forced to agree to Lin Yun's conditions, so he's definitely unhappy about it. If we mess up Lin Yun's Heavenly Tribulation and make him suffer failure, his body will crumble and that will be the end of his martial path. He might even drop in realm, never to rise again!

"And if such a thing should happen, Jiang Jiuzhu will appear infuriated on the surface, but actually feel delighted deep down!

"That old fox, Jiang Jiuzhu, wishes to have his piece of the cake without taking any risks. By taking action for him, we are helping him shoulder the blame."

The Luo King knew the Ruins Emperor for too long. He knew Jiang Jiuzhu's character—suspicious and one who did not take risks. He enjoyed instigating his opponents against each other as he sat out to reap the future spoils.

"Then, are we going to be Jiang Jiuzhu's vanguard just like that?"

"How can that be possible?" Luo King's eyes flashed coldly. "Didn't Ghost Doctor say that Lin Yun has a secret? Since Jiang Jiuzhu isn't one who takes risks, he would not dare attack Lin Yun when things remain unclear. Such a person only wants to reap the spoils without taking the risks. He can win petty gains, but he will never accomplish anything major!

"All we need to do is snatch the secret that Lin Yun has and we will be in control of everything."

"Grandfather, what you said makes sense!" Jiang Jiuzhu's heart raced. If everything went smoothly, the crown as Ruins Emperor was even possible for him!

…

When news of Yi Yun's entry into the Fey Altar spread, many people came to pay him a visit even if many Fey were envious. After all, just the standing which Yi Yun had demonstrated made him an important figure in Heaven Fey City.

For the next two days, Soft Clouds Mountain Manor bustled like a city. Many people sent congratulatory gifts, but Yi Yun left all these matters and guests to Jiang Xiaorou to handle.

The relationships in Heaven Fey City were complicated and he naturally had no interest in involving himself in the intrigue.

He quietly waited for the third day to arrive.

The Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' Fey Altar was similar to the Heaven Fey City's array cores.

Every time the Fey Altar opened, it would greatly drain the accumulated lifeblood powers. However, there were nine array cores in Heaven Fey City, but only one Fey Altar. It made the rarity of entry evident.

"Punk, it's extremely dangerous to transcend the Heavenly Tribulations in the Fey Altar. Even Fey geniuses can have their bodies collapse and turn to dust. You have to be careful in transcending the tribulation. I have prepared some treasured herbs for you. They can fortify your body at critical moments."

Blood King took out an interspatial ring and handed it to Yi Yun.

Yi Yun received it and scanned it with his perception. The treasures inside… had probably wiped clean everything in Treasure Fey Pagoda.

Among the many Fey Thearchs, the Blood King was not considered rich. The refinement of the Myriad Form Shura Pills previously had placed him in debt. The treasures in the interspatial ring were probably worth ten to twenty thousand Chaos Crystals. It was unknown what the Blood King pledged to obtain this round of resources.

After all of this, the Blood King would probably take a few centuries to recover.

"Thank you, Senior Blood King. After this Heavenly Tribulation, the Ruins Emperor has made me agree to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills again. I will obtain ten percent, and when the time comes, I'll definitely repay you."

Without the Blood King, it was impossible for Yi Yun to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills so smoothly.

"Senior Blood King, I have a request that you help guard my tribulation transcendence," added Yi Yun.

"I'd have gone even if you didn't mention it."

Blood King nodded. It was impossible to predict what was on people's minds. It was not that he could not predict that the Luo King would attack Yi Yun, but that Yi Yun would be relatively weaker and in his most dangerous state when transcending the tribulations.

With the principle that precaution averted peril, the Blood King would definitely do his best to guard Yi Yun while he transcended the tribulations.

An uneventful night passed. Early the next morning, Yi Yun opened his eyes after a night of meditation. Today was the day he transcended the tribulations. He had made immense amounts of preparation for this day!

Chapter 1667: Day of Tribulation Transcendence

The Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins's Fey Altar was not inside Heaven Fey City, but in a mountain valley west of the city. It was the bedrock of the Heaven Fey City's establishment.

Legend had it that billions of years ago, the Fey Altar was the core of the forbidden zone known as the No Return for Thearchs. After it was leveled by a peerless Fey Patriarch, he established the Fey Altar at the core. While suppressing the forbidden zone, he also focused the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi of the nine dragon veins beneath it.

Since time immemorial, this zone had an unparalleled allure to the Fey. It attracted countless powerful Fey to experience Nirvana here.

When Yi Yun stepped into this land, he sensed the rich vital powers that emanated the area.

The soil was solid and dark red. It felt like he was stepping on thick flesh. According to the Blood King, it was not only a place for Fey beasts to undergo Nirvana in their waning years, but also where war broke out. This place was also a battlefield.

The dead Fey beasts were of various levels, including Fey Thearch-level Fey beasts, as well as powerful ancient Fey that possessed the bloodlines of divine beasts.

Although billions of years had passed, Yi Yun was still inundated by a thick smell of blood that covered the land. He even felt as though he had been stuck in a sea of blood.

"Step into the Fey Altar and experience the nine stages of Heavenly Tribulations. Life or death, it's up to you. Even among the Fey, there have been many geniuses who failed to transcend the tribulations throughout history. Their bodies collapsed, putting an end to their martial paths. Have you thought it through?"

When Yi Yun stepped into the mountain valley, a black-dressed woman appeared out of thin air and said those words.

Even the Blood King turned respectful when facing the black-dressed woman.

She was a Guardian Elder of the Fey Altar, and was of extremely high standing. Even the Ruins Emperors was her junior long ago.

"Yes."

Yi Yun looked the black-dressed woman deeply into the eye. She gave him a feeling that she was different from ordinary Fey. She had extremely rich Fey beast blood, as though she was half Fey.

The woman was not only a Fey, but likely a descendant of a Fey beast.

Some Fey beasts could take on a human form after cultivating to a certain realm. They could copulate with Fey to produce offspring, but such situations were rare. However, once a child was born from this union, they would usually have extremely potent bloodlines.

"Then, go on!" the black-dressed woman said lightly before turning to leave.

If the Fey's genius disciples were to transcend the tribulations, the black-dressed woman might stand guard outside, but as a human, Yi Yun did not enjoy such treatment.

Yi Yun's entry into the Fey Altar was already the most the Fey could permit. It was naturally impossible to hope that the Fey could protect him.

The Blood King was the only person who agreed to protect Yi Yun.

He sat cross-legged at the entrance to the valley as he closed his eyes in meditation.

Yi Yun walked deep into the valley and saw a reddish-brown stone altar. It was about a hundred feet across and it was simple and mottled. Having experienced the elements for ages, it did not look anything special. If the typical Fey Lord came and was unaware of the Fey Altar's origins, they would probably imagine it to be an ordinary stone platform.

However, Yi Yun possessed the Purple Crystal, and through its vision he saw that the stone altar was enveloped by a faint reddish glow. It was not made up purely of Heaven Earth Yuan Qi. Within it lingered countless of fragmented souls of dead Fey beasts, the powers of shattered Fey cores, and the bloodline powers of divine beasts…

After billions of years, these energies had fused into one, and they contained the mystical secrets of life.

Yi Yun walked to the Fey Altar and looked up into the sky.

It was noon, the point when the Sun was brightest, and the Yang Qi thickest.

However, when Yi Yun cast his gaze out, he saw that the sky looked gloomy. It looked like it was being warped by a bottomless abyss that enveloped him and the Fey Altar.

The area above the Fey Altar had formed a world in and of itself…

…

At that moment, many people were looking at the Fey Altar from afar.

Yi Yun's transcendence of the tribulations could be said to be the focus of attention!

And it wasn't only the ancient Heaven Fey, even the members of clans which had good relationships with the ancient Heaven Fey came.

In the entire history of the ancient Heaven Fey, this matter could be considered quite a wonder. In the recent billion years, the Fey Altar had not been opened to any other race.

Due to the Myriad Form Shura Pills, Yi Yun's fame had already turned widespread. Everyone knew that this person could refine divine pills that defied the heavens and changed fate itself.

However, no matter how brilliant one's alchemical skills were, it did not mean that they had powerful bodies. Transcending the tribulations at the Fey Altar was extremely difficult. For Fey geniuses to transcend the tribulations, they needed at least a century or two of preparation. Just triggering a Heavenly Tribulation was not easy.

As people talked about it, the sky suddenly darkened. Following that, violent Heaven Earth Yuan Qi stirred and formed a thick tribulation cloud.

Purple bolts of lightning tore through the tribulation cloud.

"It's starting…"

There were many people gathered and watching from afar. They looked at the thick tribulation cloud and waited for the Heavenly Tribulation to descend.

"From the looks of this tribulation cloud, it's at least a sixth-stage Heavenly Tribulation."

A sixth-stage Heavenly Tribulation was actually nothing much.

However, Yi Yun was human and for him to trigger a Heavenly Tribulation without any preparation was already remarkable. Many of the Fey Lords among them had not even attempted to transcend a Heavenly Tribulation their entire lives.

The tribulation cloud became heavier as if it was about to crush the sky; the ground quaked in response. The dark cloud blanketed the entire Heaven Fey City, looming over the city as if it was about to destroy it!

"Oh? Something isn't right."

There were people whose cultivation level was close to that of Fey Thearchs that suddenly sensed the abnormality of the tribulation clouds.

"This tribulation cloud feels like it was triggered from high in the sky. It doesn't seem related to the Fey Altar…"

As people puzzled over the matter, a gust of cold wind howled from the tribulation cloud. Gradually, people saw a massive ghost face appear within the tribulation cloud. It had hideous fangs and a dominating cadaveric aura.

Around the ghost face was raging sanguine light. It reached out in every direction with its thick and heavy aura. It made the rich smell of blood linger even up to 5000 kilometers out.

The air seemed to turn sticky as thick blood permeated the blood clouds and dyed the sky.

"What's happening!?"

People exclaimed. The six-stage Heavenly Tribulation had already made people feel that something was amiss, but now, it was even more ridiculous.

The ghost face had appeared out of the blue. It was impossible for a ghost face to appear from a sixth-stage Heavenly Tribulation, and such a phenomenon was unprecedented.

"This ghost face and sanguine light, as well as the rich cadaveric aura are clearly features of a Ghost Heavenly Tribulation."

"That's right. It's a sixth-stage Ghost Tribulation! It was a sixth-stage Fey Tribulation in the beginning, which would be normal since Yi Yun has a Fey beast bloodline in him. But why did a sixth-stage Ghost Tribulation follow?"

As everyone felt something amiss, many of the mighty figures with Fey Thearch cultivation levels had already come to a realization.

The sixth-stage Fey Tribulation and the sixth-stage Ghost Tribulation were separately triggered. But as they happened at the same spot, they were stacked and compounded together!

Some sharp Fey Thearchs had already released their perception to probe the tribulation cloud. The results shocked them to the core!

It was unknown when a hidden space had been opened up high in the sky, but something was sealing the objects that could trigger Heavenly Tribulations within.

Then, they looked at the Fey Altar where Yi Yun was, still emitting a divine glow, remaining silent. It was highly likely that the triggered Heavenly Tribulations had nothing to do with the Fey Altar!

"This is a Heavenly Tribulation not triggered by Lin Yun!" said an expert. "Lin Yun is likely still in preparation and has yet to begin! Someone has perturbed the Heavenly Tribulation…"

"Perturbed the Heavenly Tribulation!?" people exclaimed.

Warriors were at their weakest when transcending the Heavenly Tribulations, so they were most vulnerable to others fishing in troubled waters. But to actually interfere in the Heavenly Tribulation was not that easy.

This was because anyone who entered the Heavenly Tribulation's range would suffer the indiscriminate attacks of the Heavenly Tribulation!

Yi Yun was in an important land of the ancient Heaven Fey after all. It would be inexcusable if a Fey Thearch were to storm in to kill Yi Yun.

Therefore, the Luo King had employed a different method.

He helmed the Fey Blood Plains, which had no lack of high-staged Fey beasts. He captured two of them and made Ghost Doctor do whatever he could to stimulate the Fey beasts' vital potential, regardless of the consequences to the beasts. It made the powers within them reach an extremum in a short period of time, one that was sufficient to trigger a tribulation.

These two Fey beasts naturally wouldn't survive the process.

Due to the Ghost Doctor's means, the Heavenly Tribulation they triggered was of a motley variety. However, it didn't matter since that was exactly what the Luo King wanted.

Such a chaotic Heavenly Tribulation would merge with the Heavenly Tribulation that Yi Yun triggered. It would eventually generate a terrifying destructive force.

At that moment, the soul and flesh of the transcendent candidate would suffer the bombardment of the Heavenly Tribulation.

"Punk! It's Jiang Luo! He has taken action!"

Blood King's Yuan Qi voice transmission tore through the storm and sounded in Yi Yun's ears.

He was in charge of protecting Yi Yun. If the Luo King were to attack, he would definitely fend him off. However, the Luo King had not done anything but perturb the Heavenly Tribulation.

That made the Blood King's protection of Yi Yun useless.

The guardian could not enter the Heavenly Tribulation's range or dare approach the transcendent candidate, much less help them transcend the tribulation.

If he did, not only would the Blood King suffer the assault of the Heavenly Tribulation, it would even make the Heavenly Tribulation turn more chaotic and transform into a storm that destroyed everything.

"Senior Blood King, my lifeblood has already been infused into the Fey Altar. The Heavenly Tribulation that belongs to me has already begun triggering. As long as I experience the tempering of the Heavenly Tribulation, those powers will return to me. If I were to halt midway, I will lose all those powers and my transcending of the tribulations will fail completely…"

Yi Yun remained seated in the middle of the Fey Altar. He looked up into the sky as the cloud loomed maniacally over him. A Ghost beast and a Fey beast had gradually fused as one.

"Ka-cha!"

A bolt of heavenly lightning smote down, but it did not strike Yi Yun and instead hit the void elsewhere. Two wails sounded as blood rain splattered down.

The Fey beasts that were hidden in the sky had consumed their vitality after having their powers raised with complete disregard of the consequences; therefore, they had no means of surviving the Heavenly Tribulation. They were smote to smithereens by the heavenly lightning.

Large amounts of Fey beast blood burned in the sky as their two Fey cores exploded.

Violent energies nourished the heavenly lightning, causing the Lightning Tribulation to turn even more terrifying.

"It's already a ninth-stage Heavenly Tribulation."

Everyone held their breaths. The two Fey beasts had nominal strength, but combined together, they triggered a ninth-stage Heavenly Tribulation, and one that was mutated!

Although the typical Heavenly Tribulation was dangerous, most of its energy was used to temper and nourish the flesh.

But such a mutated, violent ninth-stage Heavenly Tribulation contained even purer destructive energies. These energies were not beneficial to the flesh, making it even harder for them to be used to temper the body.

"This Lin Yun will likely perish here today. He kept too high a profile and offended too many people. He deserves it," a Fey warrior said.

They were in no way worried that the Myriad Form Shura Pills would be lost to the ancient Heaven Fey if Yi Yun perished; instead, they relished his misfortune.
