For the past few days, Yi Yun had benefited greatly, making many of them red with envy. They rejoiced now that Yi Yun was in a perilous state.

"Don't worry, His Majesty will not let Lin Yun die. He will definitely help at the final moment. The ones who want Lin Yun dead should be Jiang Luo and Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor!"

The only people capable of attacking in such a manner at such a grand setting could only be Jiang Luo and Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor. Since it was by their hand, Yi Yun had no right to blame it on the Ruins Emperor. The ancient Heaven Fey did not owe him anything and had no duty to protect him.

The Luo King and Jiang Yuchan watched this scene from afar, and Jiang Yuchan did not hide the mocking smirk he had plastered across his face.

"This lowlife human bastard sure is greedy. He still doesn't want to stop the tribulation at this point in time. If he were to escape now, he might still be able to live. Of course, we will not let him continue living," Jiang Yuchan said with clenched teeth.

"Yuchan, you are right. Sometimes, one needs the courage to make sacrifices, but unfortunately, not everyone can be that decisive," the Luo King said staidly.

No matter how powerful a ninth-stage Heavenly Tribulation was, it was triggered by two powerful Fey beasts. Furthermore, it was not targeted at Yi Yun. He was only within the Heavenly Tribulation's range and suffered its assaults. Escaping would have been safe for him.

However, Yi Yun did not seem willing to leave.

"Oh? This is…"

As the Luo King said that, he suddenly saw the divine light above the Fey Altar intensify. It was as though a sun had been born out of the land.

The dazzling divine light added radiance and beauty to the ninth-stage Lightning Tribulation in the sky above. It made it look like an apocalyptic scene.

"What? This Lin Yun is still injecting his lifeblood and lifeforce into the Fey Altar?"

Everyone was dumbfounded from shock when they saw what was happening before their eyes.

Was he so eager to die?

The wiser choice was to sever the connection with the Fey Altar and escape as quickly as possible.

Putting that aside, the very least one could do was terminate the eruption of lifeblood powers and make the Heavenly Tribulation weaker if possible.

But now, Yi Yun appeared to wish for the Heavenly Tribulation to become stronger and more perfect. It was madness.

"Whew!"

At that moment, a glaring beam of light shot out from the Fey Altar and pierced through the tribulation cloud and into the sky like a sword of light.

Energy surged as divine light blasted outwards in a blinding dazzle!

Following that, immense suppressive forces surged from every direction. The appearance of the suppression many everyone feel like their hearts had heavy chains attached to them, making it almost impossible for them to keep beating.

The weaker warriors could hardly breathe and even weaker ones felt faint before they collapsed to the ground.

Their backs and the back of their hands were all covered in cold sweat.

Ka Ka Ka!

The sky beneath the tribulation cloud began to warp.

The space kept producing shattering sounds as though it could no longer bear the burden. Massive amounts of spatial fragments rained down as though the sky was collapsing.

"What… What exactly is happening?" someone said with a trembling voice.

The ninth-stage Heavenly Tribulation triggered by the two powerful Fey beasts was already shocking enough.

But now, a power more terrifying than before had appeared, the former paling in comparison.

"This is a Heavenly Tribulation, a real Heavenly Tribulation. Could it be…"

A Fey Thearch widened his eyes as he looked toward the Fey Altar.

This Heavenly Tribulation was triggered by this human youth!?

Chapter 1668: Hard to Escape

A Fey Thearch widened his eyes as he looked toward the Fey Altar.

This Heavenly Tribulation was triggered by this human youth!?

"A Heavenly Tribulation at this level is a… Chaos Heavenly Tribulation!"

At that moment, the numerous Fey Thearchs in Heaven Fey City felt mixed emotions. They walked out of their seclusion chambers and looked in shock at the wanton Chaos energies that surged in the sky.

A fear reared its head from deep in their souls and washed over them. What level did this human junior cultivate to?

This was way too terrifying!

"Boom! Boom! Boom!"

The Chaos tribulation cloud expanded and right beneath it, the grotesque ghost face was enveloped by the Chaos tribulation cloud and slowly devoured.

The ninth-stage Heavenly Tribulation triggered by the combined forces of two powerful Fey beasts merged with the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation bit by bit.

This was like an avalanche that could wipe out thousands of kilometers of farms and kill thousands, but if it swept into the sea, it would only be like a splash in a pond, incapable of changing the sea at all.

At that moment, if the ninth-stage tribulation cloud was an avalanche, then Yi Yun's Chaos Heavenly Tribulation was the sea!

The scene of the devourment of the ninth-stage tribulation cloud widened everyone's eyes.

The original idea was that Luo King's attack was a fundamental solution. Even if it didn't kill Yi Yun, it could destroy his martial path. But to everyone's surprise, the Heavenly Tribulation that Luo King triggered at great cost couldn't unleash its fury before it was devoured by Yi Yun's Heavenly Tribulation!

Hu! Hu! Hu!

A strong wind howled as millions watched the Heavenly Tribulation. All of them resembled statues, seemingly having forgotten how to speak.

It was unknown who was the first to retreat out of fear. In just moments, millions of warriors had unknowingly distanced themselves from the Fey Altar. They were afraid that the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation's range would become so huge that it would embroil them as well!

"Whoosh!"

At that moment, a golden beam of light shot out from the Fey Altar. Yi Yun shot into the sky with the Ascending Dragon Cauldron beneath him!

High in the sky, the rain of blood from the two Fey beasts continued burning and splattering down.

Yi Yun breathed in the thick and sticky air that was filled with the smell of blood. He smiled at the distant Luo King. "Luo King, thank you for sacrificing two Fey beasts that can transcend the tribulations for my Heavenly Tribulation. It must have cost you a limb, I suppose? You really shouldn't have…"

Luo King wore a nasty expression as he said, "You have yet to transcend your Heavenly Tribulation; do you really think it's so easy to transcend a Chaos Heavenly Tribulation?"

"That's an unknown, but your grandson might not be able to survive the calamity that's going to befall him." As Yi Yun spoke, he suddenly looked at Jiang Yuchan. "You haven't recovered, so be careful that your injuries don't get triggered by the Heavenly Tribulation…"

Once Yi Yun said those words, Jiang Yuchan, who was dozens of kilometers away from Yi Yun suddenly felt a sharp pain in his chest!

It was an excruciating pain that seemed to tear his very soul apart. The poison of lightning and fire which Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor had used a mystic technique to repress suddenly tore through its shackles and erupted fully.

"Ah!"

Jiang Yuchan let out a tragic scream as a mouthful of blood spewed out from his mouth!

He felt like countless blades were slicing at him, dismembering him from the inside.

Not just that, it felt like venomous worms were burrowing in his flesh after biting through his skin and were squirming through his meridians.

Jiang Yuchan convulsed as he fell to the ground. Blood spewed out from his seven orifices.

"Huh!?"

The Luo King looked at Jiang Yuchan immediately as his face turned as black as the tribulation cloud above.

He naturally did not believe what Yi Yun had said—that the Heavenly Tribulation had triggered Jiang Yuchan's injuries. It had to be Yi Yun's doing.

However, Jiang Yuchan had already been poisoned by Yi Yun for quite an extended period of time. Jiang Yuchan had resisted it himself, along with having the Ghost Doctor's help in removing it. Now that the power of lightning and fire had been restrained, how was it possible that Yi Yun could trigger it again with a mere thought?

"Grandfather, save me…"

Jiang Yuchan's eyes were filled with indignation. He struggled to extend his hand to grab at the Luo King, but blood kept spewing out of his mouth. There was speckles of black and purple lusters to his blood, manifestations of the poison of the Heretical God Fire and Heretical God Lightning!

Ghost Doctor grabbed Jiang Yuchan's wrist and, after probing it, his expression changed.

He had no idea what method Yi Yun had used to rejuvenate the poison of lightning and fire remotely with a mere thought. But the forces were violently erupting like an unending stream!

And Jiang Yuchan's vitality was depleting at a discernible pace.

It was impossible to save him.

Ghost Doctor naturally could not rescue him. He watched helplessly as Jiang Yuchan struggled in pain before dying.

A prince died just like that.

And Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's medical and poison skills were completely trounced by Yi Yun!

He looked up and glared at Yi Yun with bloodshot eyes.

Yi Yun chuckled. "What are you looking at me for? I was planning to treat Jiang Yuchan, but to save face, you refused my help. You were bent on hiring some quack, and didn't care if he couldn't treat the injuries. If he just stayed at home and rested, he could have lived for two more years. Didn't I say? Don't bring a patient to watch a Heavenly Tribulation. Since he was so bent on dying, why blame me?"

Yi Yun's words were heard by millions of warriors present.

They were dumbfounded by what they heard. Yi Yun was not only taking a strong stance while transcending a Heavenly Tribulation, he was even openly killing Jiang Yuchan!

He thought nothing of enraging the Luo King and also wiping his hands clean of the murder of Jiang Yuchan.

Yi Yun's words were reasonable. He was truly willing to treat Jiang Yuchan, but the Luo King had rejected his offer. Now that Jiang Yuchan was dead, no one could tell how Yi Yun had delivered the lethal blow.

Could the blame actually be pinned on Yi Yun? If anyone were to be blamed, it was all because of how incompetent Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was. He was completely trounced by Yi Yun in every aspect.

The pangs of fury in Luo King's heart reached an extremum.

He silently pressed his interspatial ring, making his intentions clear. Yi Yun, who had smacked his face in public, was someone he wanted dead.

But he was hesitant about the consequences if he attacked Yi Yun at the Fey Altar.

And then—

Boom!

Above the heavens, the Chaos Lightning Tribulation finally began!

Terrifying waves like tsunami swept over and radiated for thousands of kilometers. The entirety of Heaven Fey City was blanketed by this mighty suppression!

Yi Yun looked at Luo King and sneered. "If you wish to attack me, give it a try."

As Yi Yun spoke, the lightning in the sky finally appeared!

Chaos Heavenly Lightning was zapping through the clouds!

The lightning was black, seemingly devoid of light. It devoured everything as though it was not a bolt of lightning, but a deep, bottomless spatial rift! Just seeing the lightning made one feel like their irises were being ripped apart.

"Puah!"

Even from dozens of kilometers away, Fey warriors spewed out blood from their mouths. They had never transcended a Heavenly Tribulation before and their lifeblood had yet to be tempered. The Chaos Heavenly Lightning caused their lifeblood to erupt!

With such terrifying Heavenly Lightning present, would Luo King dare to attack Yi Yun?

Once he entered the Lightning Tribulation's range, he would also suffer the indiscriminate attacks of the Heavenly Lightning!

Furthermore, Luo King was a Fey Thearch. Once he entered, the interference of his potent powers might result in him suffering the brunt of the attacks!

Luo King's expression changed rapidly, but ultimately, he chose not to do a thing.

He could choose to attack when Yi Yun was at his weakest after transcending the tribulations.

Chapter 1669: Tearing Open the Multiverse

"Ghost Doctor, once the Heavenly Tribulation ends, we shall attack together. You hold back the Blood King while I deal with Lin Yun," the Luo King sent a voice transmission to Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor.

Ghost Doctor wore a look of hesitation. They were near the Fey Altar forbidden zone. As a Ghost, he had to consider the consequences of launching an attack in such a venue.

"Many of the people who came to watch are well acquainted with me. If we can take clear control of the combat situation, they will also help us. There's no danger of anything going wrong. As for the Ruins Emperor, he will not stop us. All he cares about is the Myriad Form Shura Pills."

As Luo King spoke, the thunder in the sky had transformed into rolling sound blasts. They spread out like tsunamis and the sound waves could even be seen by the naked eye.

The powerful impact shook the heaven and earth! Many of the Fey beasts lurking within a five hundred kilometer range were stirred by the thunder as they quivered in fear.

"Is a Chaos Lightning Tribulation that terrifying?" People kept retreating as the power of Chaos infused into the Chaos Lightning, making it equal to the Heavenly Dao. They had only seen such a thing written in books, but had never seen it with their own eyes. How was this something flesh and blood could withstand?

At that moment, the lightning in the sky had turned into a sea of lightning. Countless black bolts of lightning pulverized space itself.

Finally, the lightning gathered together and manifested into a singular bolt of lightning that resembled a divine dragon before smiting down!

The boundless sky was split in two by this bolt of lightning!

Its rapturous killing intent made one's soul shatter from simply taking a glance at it.

And at that moment, a black figure appeared in the sky.

The figure was charging towards the highest heavens, right in the face of the lightning!

"It's Lin Yun!"

People widened their eyes. Placed against the backdrop of the heavenly lightning, Lin Yun's figure appeared too small.

His bone age was limited, after all. His cultivation level was only at that of a Divine Lord. To withstand the powers of the Heaven and Earth with such strength was a futile attempt.

"Perhaps he will be disintegrated by the Chaos Lightning Tribulation, then there's no need for me to take action."

Luo King looked at Yi Yun's figure with killing intent.

There was the grudge of his grandson's death, an act committed right in front of him, right under the eyes of so many that it was blatantly showing him utter disrespect and contempt.

How could he keep his foothold in the Heaven Fey City if he did not exact vengeance? It was likely he would become the laughing stock of the ancient Heaven Fey.

"Boom!"

Yi Yun charged into the Chaos heavenly lightning!

The lightning cleansed his body!

Instantly, Yi Yun felt the destructive powers bear down on him. His body nearly exploded from their might.

"I've refined the Heretical God Lightning and wield the power of Destruction, no matter how powerful the Chaos Heretical God Force is, they stem from the same source as me!"

Yi Yun roared inwardly as his clothes blasted apart. His bloodline erupted as it withstood the catharsis of the Chaos heavenly lightning!

In an instant, he was covered in blood.

Every inch of his lifeblood, meridians, bones, and vessels were being tempered and burned by the lightning.

The potent powers seemed bent on destroying him down to his very core!

Yi Yun felt shaken.

The Chaos Heavenly Tribulation's lightning even exceeded the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch's Heretical God Lightning!

It was the highest level of lightning laws he had ever seen.

Yi Yun clenched his teeth tightly as he sent his thoughts into the Purple Crystal Origins and used it to cleanse the rampant energies that were constantly damaging his body.

Simultaneously, he conjured the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence, which was also the Shura Heavenly Dao that the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch cultivated.

At that instant, a gigantic black wheel appeared behind Yi Yun. Shadows appeared on the wheel—countless Demon Gods!

"I have already cultivated in the Shura Heavenly Dao and have grasped a Primordial Destruction domain. From that moment forth, I became both Chaos and Destruction! I have already refined the Heavenly Dao fragment for myself and am an equal to the heavens. I refuse to believe I can't transcend this Chaos tribulation!"

Yi Yun roared as the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence behind him produced illusory figures of the Dragon Emperor, Azure Wood Divine Tree, and the ancient Ancestor God. These illusory figures were cast onto the black wheel!

Following that, countless bolts of black lightning engorged it, filling every pattern of the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence. He had already threw himself right into the Chaos tribulation cloud!

Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!

The black lightning within the tribulation cloud gathered toward Yi Yun!

Yi Yun's flesh began disintegrating bit by bit, turning into pure energy as each speck fused into the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence.

Following that, a huge vortex appeared in the tribulation cloud. It ground the space open, like a massive spatial passageway that led to an unknown universe…

This Heavenly Tribulation had even cracked open the Chaos Heavens' boundaries!

All the Fey warriors looked up. The sky had already torn apart completely. Boundless Chaos heavenly lightning continued surging to the core. It was already unimaginable what situation the core was undergoing.

"Yun-er…"

Beside the Blood King, Jiang Xiaorou held her breath. Even though she believed that Yi Yun could create miracles every time, she was still extremely worried at that moment.

The Chaos Heavenly Tribulation simply looked too terrifying. She was unsure if Yi Yun could withstand it.

The Chaos Lightning Tribulation blocked everyone's perception. Even Fey Thearchs were unable to probe inside to gauge Yi Yun's situation.

Time passed as the lightning remained like a massive sea.

Two hours, four hours…

The Chaos Lightning Tribulation lasted very long, weakening slowly after six hours.

At that moment, it was already evening. However, the Lightning Tribulation seemingly overturned the concept of day and night.

All people could see was that the sky above Heaven Fey City had vanished. It was replaced by a gigantic black hole. Through it was the infinite cosmos, with the massive galaxy as a backdrop…

Moments later, the tribulation clouds dispersed as the ravaging Heaven Earth Yuan Qi gradually calmed down.

The suppression that blanketed the area vanished as well.

Many Fey warriors could not bear the suppressive force before, but none of them wanted to cower in fear. After holding out for hours, their faces were pale and they were completely exhausted.

Despite seeing everything calm down, they had no means to determine what had happened.

"Where's Lin Yun? Has he been pulverized? Or did he get swept into an alternate dimension?"

People were reeling in bewilderment. They originally believed they would see the scene of Yi Yun being repeatedly devastated by the Lightning Tribulation and watch as his body disintegrated and blood scattered across the sky.

They even believed they would see his dantian shatter as the source of his vitality collapsed.

If that happened, it would be a delightful sight. If blame needed to be pinned, it was because a human warrior had triggered a Chaos Heavenly Tribulation, figuratively slapping all the Fey warriors in the face.

Due to their envy, none of them wished Yi Yun well.

Unfortunately, they did not see a thing. Apart from seeing Yi Yun covered in blood at the very beginning, they did not see any of the tragic states they imagined after he was devoured by the infinite Chaos Lightning Tribulation that shielded him from their perception.

This made many disappointed.

"It's impossible that Lin Yun could have escaped such a Lightning Tribulation unscathed. Perhaps he's still alive, but has been sucked into the multiverse. If that's the case, it's unlikely he can live."

The space between the multiverse was an absolute land of quiescence. There was no Heaven Earth Yuan Qi, only endless dangers.

Previously, despite making sufficient preparations, Yi Yun nearly perished while traversing the multiverse. In the end, he only survived thanks to the Nine Transformations Celestial Silkworm's blood essence and the Taixia Ancient Mining's rescue midway.

If he was heavily injured and found himself lost in the borders of the multiverse, he was basically doomed.

The Luo King ignored everyone's discussion.

All he did was stare at the massive spatial crack in the sky.

He refused to believe that Yi Yun would die that easily. The human punk had many means at his disposal.

Even if he were heavily injured and found himself lost in the multiverse's borders, Luo King believed that it was still possible for Yi Yun to return.

And at that moment, as long as Yi Yun lay dormant and cultivated for a few centuries, his strength would reach a terrifying state which would make him harder to deal with.

The Luo King had already decided that if Yi Yun did not appear any time soon, he would fly into the multiverse rift with Ghost Hands!

Even if he had to take unknown risks, he was bent on hunting Yi Yun down.

Nearly an hour passed as the multiverse rift in the sky gradually mended itself with spatial forces.

For a stable universe like the Chaos Heavens, the appearance of a spatial rift would result in automatic mending. It was a law of the universe.

The Luo King could no longer hold back as he began his plans to search for Yi Yun. Of course, if he delayed any further, the multiverse rift would close and he would have to find his way back to the Chaos Heavens. That would be risky.

Blood King looked at the Luo King as his eyes flashed with fighting spirit. Without a doubt, the Blood King would take action the moment the Luo King moved.

Once they entered the multiverse borders, the Ruins Emperor would ignore their battles.

It was very possible that both Fey Thearchs would engage in an intense battle in the multiverse borders, but without Yuan Qi to replenish them and the possibility of getting lost, the risk was immense.

"Blood King, are you really planning on joining me? I have Ghost Doctor with me. Do you plan on fighting the two of us alone? You really aren't afraid of death."

"You can give it a try. Perhaps I might not survive, but if I'm at the end of my rope, I'll still be able to drag you down with me. Do you really think that an old heretic like Ghost Doctor will risk his life for you?"

Blood King's voice was ice-cold, but at that moment, he suddenly looked up.

He saw a raven-black flash that tore over from the deepest depths of the multiverse rift.

"Huh!?"

Luo King widened his eyes as well as he stared intently at the raven-black light.

The blob of light was fast, and soon it tore through the surface of the spatial rift and entered the universe where the Chaos Heavens was.

Only then did everyone discern it.

It was a huge cauldron!

The cauldron had black dragon patterns on it and gathered within them were raging lifeblood powers. They did not appear like carvings, but more like a living thing.

This cauldron…

Luo King's heart skipped a beat. He naturally recognized it as Yi Yun's cauldron!

"Boom!"

The Ascending Dragon Cauldron crashed heavily into the ground, leveling a mountain. Countless pieces of rubble collapsed as the ground quaked!

However, the Ascending Dragon Cauldron was surging with lifeblood, preventing the collapsing boulders from burying it. People clearly saw that the cauldron rested on the peak of the collapsed mountain.

Yet, Yi Yun did not appear with the Ascending Dragon Cauldron.

"Could that punk be inside the cauldron?"

This thought flashed through Luo King's mind.

At that moment, the spatial rift in the sky was closing. If Yi Yun was heavily injured, he would not dare to continue hiding in the multiverse borders. Chances of his successful return would be slim.

All he could do was hide his heavily injured body inside the Ascending Dragon Cauldron and take the risk to return!

Chapter 1670: Surrounded by Wolves

If Yi Yun was recuperating in the Ascending Dragon Cauldron, it was naturally the best opportunity to rid of him!

With this in mind, the Luo King attacked, disregarding any possible repercussions!

He took a sudden step forward while behind him, a Heaven Fey totem appeared.

It had six corners, four of which had been lit. They were none other than the four divine beasts—the azure dragon, vermilion bird, white tiger, and black turtle.

Every Heaven Fey's Heaven Fey totem was different. The Luo King's Heaven Fey totem was like a completely different world with its four completed corners.

This Heaven Fey totem bore down on Yi Yun's Ascending Dragon Cauldron in a bid to crush him alive!

Blood King took action at the same moment the Luo King did.

The aura in the world changed the moment the Blood King moved. People felt as though they were thrown into Shura hell as a boundless sea of blood surrounded them. The sticky red air around them stifled them.

And Blood King appeared like Death walking out of hell. Just one look at him made others feel like they were losing their minds.

This was the Indestructible Killing Dao that he was known for!

At that instant, all of the Blood King's lifeblood powers spewed out. They condensed into a massive red phantom behind him.

The phantom was massive and had long limbs. It held a gigantic red sickle which he cleaved down at the Luo King!

Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!

The world trembled, almost collapsing under the might of the two Fey experts. Massive energies swept the area as the Luo King's body quaked before he flew out in retreat.

However, the Blood King did not have it better. The Death's sickle he condensed shattered from that one strike.

Although he recondensed it again, its color was paler. The suppressive force it emitted was not as intense.

The Luo King's and Blood King's strikes were dealt with full force. In a combat between two Fey Thearchs, both had equal strength they threw against each other, resulting in injuries to both!

The outcome of this bout sent reverberations through the hearts of everyone.

After all, the Luo King had been a Fey Thearch for a very long time. He was nearly of the same generation as the reigning Ruins Emperor.

As for the Blood King, he was a new Fey Thearch. Yet despite the relatively short time since his breakthrough, he could already match the Luo King.

How could they not be shocked?

As for the Fey Thearchs present, what they saw went deeper. At the instant the Blood King attacked, they had observed the Heaven Fey totem behind him.

The cultivation technique which Blood King cultivated in was unique. He directly infused the Heaven Fey totem into the Death's sickle and utilized the Heaven Fey totem through the Indestructible Killing Dao.

The Fey Thearchs could tell that after the Blood King consumed the Myriad Form Shura Pills, his Heaven Fey totem had indeed strengthened!

The strengthening effects weren't obvious, but at the level of a Fey Thearch, any quick growth was already extremely astonishing.

The Myriad Form Shura Pills were something the ancient Heaven Fey were bent on obtaining!

How could knowledge of the creation of such important pills be in the possession of a human junior?

The Ruins Emperor was definitely watching this battle from the sidelines. He would ensure that Yi Yun did not die, but he would also subdue him completely. Or perhaps, he would obtain the secrets to how Yi Yun refined the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

"This Lin Yun is dangerous. Perhaps His Majesty will intervene at the critical moment!"

People discussed in private. They could even sense the oddity of the prevailing mood. Many eyes in Heaven Fey City were watching this battle!

"The Blood King has likely infuriated the Ruins Emperor, as well as the Patriarchs."

A Fey Thearch spoke. Looming behind the Ruins Emperor were the ancient Heaven Fey's Patriarchs. The matter regarding the Myriad Form Shura Pills barely earned some importance in these Patriarchs' hearts. They must have acquiesced to the Ruins Emperor's decisions.

The Blood King was naturally foolish to stand up for a human and put himself at odds with the Ruins Emperor at such a moment.

This was practically making enemies out of all the ancient Heaven Fey!

After this battle, the Blood King might be estranged from the Heaven Fey. As for Jiang Xiaorou's claim to the throne, it was already a distant dream.

As people watched the commotion—

"Wu Wu Wu Wu!"

A cold wind raged as the black clouds that had already dispersed amalgamated once again. A huge ghost face appeared in the black cloud!

People looked up and saw that the ghost face was formed from countless wraiths.

Without a doubt, this was a move from a Ghost race expert. Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor had taken action!

Blood King and Luo King had just clashed. Having not recovered from their clash, Blood King had no means to stop Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's attack.

Roar!

The gigantic ghost head bore down and soon, the Ascending Dragon Cauldron was in its mouth!

Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor glided through the void as he grabbed the Ascending Dragon Cauldron with one hand and lifted it up!

He had Yi Yun in his grasp!

If it was the Luo King, he would not care about killing Yi Yun right away. However, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was different. He wanted to know Yi Yun's secret.

Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor's heart stirred as his body turned into an incorporeal smoke. He wished to grab Yi Yun and escape with him using a Ghost mystic technique.

But at that moment, a terrifying lifeblood forced surged into the sky from the Ruins Emperor Palace.

This lifeblood force held Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor in place.

Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor frowned. The lifeblood force was indeed potent. The owner of this force had strength above the Luo King and Blood King, and obviously himself as well.

The person was naturally… Ruins Emperor!

This old bastard had been watching by the sidelines, but once Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor attacked in a bid to devour Yi Yun's secret, the Ruins Emperor finally took action!

Under such circumstances, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor knew that it was impossible for him to take Yi Yun's secret for his own.

He was in Heaven Fey City after all. He had no means to resist the ancient Heaven Fey.

However, Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was not a trivial figure. He had long made plans.

He wanted to take a bite of the pie at this event, a huge bite.

By capturing Yi Yun, he had the initiative and advantage.

"All of you might be using me as a vanguard, but this vanguard is poisoned."

Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor let out a sinister smile as a green beam flashed from his palm. It looked inconspicuous, but it emitted a heart-chilling aura.

"Whoosh!"

The green beam launched for the Ascending Dragon Cauldron like a spirit snake!

And at that moment, the Ascending Dragon Cauldron was still in the jaws of the gigantic ghost head. The green beam of light flew straight into the Ascending Dragon Cauldron!

No one knew what that green beam of light was.

People immediately understood that Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor was trying to get the initial advantage by taking first grasp of Yi Yun.

He had unfathomable means. Ignoring the fact that the green beam could decide Yi Yun's fate, people would not be surprised if it could also control one's thoughts.

However, an azure radiance instantly bloomed from the Ascending Dragon Cauldron and shot at the ghost head's mouth.

A towering divine tree surged out of the Ascending Dragon Cauldron. Its countless vines were like countless azure dragons that bore through the ghost head!

The ghost head let out wails as large numbers of wraiths were decimated by the divine tree!

What!?

Everyone was alarmed. What was this divine tree that suddenly appeared?

Could it be related to Yi Yun?

Yi Yun had just transcended a Chaos Heavenly Tribulation, a tribulation that was like the apocalypse.

No matter how much a genius Yi Yun was, it would be impressive if he was only severely injured after surviving the Chaos tribulation.

How could he still have any combat strength left to fend off a Ghost Thearch's attack?

Chapter 1671: Lifeblood As One, Complete Mastery

The difference between a Ghost Thearch and a Divine Lord was like an unbridgeable chasm.

Yi Yun was at the Divine Lord cultivation level, so regardless if he transcended the Heavenly Tribulation, he was still a Divine Lord. The gathered warriors could only guess that the sudden appearance of the divine tree was perhaps an independent Fey plant?

Powerful Fey plants were far fewer than Fey beasts. There were even fewer of them that reached the Fey Thearch or Godly Monarch realm.

Where did Yi Yun acquaint himself with such a powerful Fey plant? It actually hid inside his cauldron and at a critical moment, fending off Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor.

In that case, even if Ghost Doctor and Luo King joined forces, they might not necessarily be Yi Yun's match.

Suddenly, the situation turned intricate.

Everyone kicks a man who is down. If Yi Yun had suffered complete defeat in front of the Luo King, the Ruins Emperor would naturally appear. Yi Yun would then completely come under the control of the ancient Heaven Fey.

But now, the situation was a little sticky.

The Luo King and Blood King matched each other, and Ghost Doctor's independent attack on Yi Yun had failed to be fruitful.

Yi Yun had too many trump cards. No one expected him to withstand a Ghost Thearch.

At that moment, Ghost Doctor wore an extremely nasty expression. He had attacked Yi Yun, but failed. He was irrevocably committed to a lost cause.

"This Fey plant…"

Ghost Doctor narrowed his eyes at the Azure Wood Divine Tree.

Deep in his heart was anger and greed.

Why was Yi Yun's luck so good? Yi Yun had a secret he had yet discovered; and now, there was the addition of this Fey plant.

Such a Fey plant was a lot more precious than any Fey beast. With such a Fey plant nurtured, he could constantly extract its leaves, fruits, and all sorts of essences. To an alchemist, it was of immense allure.

He was eager to kill Yi Yun and take all the benefits Yi Yun had.

Of course, he knew it was impossible.

He had determined that he could do nothing to the Fey plant in a short period of time. Even if he were to win, he would have to pay a certain price.

As such, Ghost Doctor even had the thought of retreating. Since he could not foresee any benefits, he had no intention to serve as the vanguard of others.

But at that moment, the Ascending Dragon Cauldron his claw held suddenly spewed out potent lifeblood powers. Like a raging inferno, it swept through the world.

"Chi! Chi! Chi!"

The gigantic ghost head that had yet to die despite being bored through by the Azure Wood Divine Tree was immediately consumed by flames. Countless wraiths wailed as they dissipated!

Hum! Hum! Hum!

The cosmos quaked! High in the sky, the multiverse rift which had yet to completely close up was triggered by this terrifying power. It began resonating with it and the closing stopped.

With winds and lightning that grew to a crescendo, they reached through the entire Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins. Even the factions that were on good terms with the ancient Heaven Fey sensed this terrifying power and the suppressive might that wantonly extended.

"What… is going on!?"

Everyone felt alarmed. The suppressive might of the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation was already nearly intolerable. They had suffered for hours, and now, a suppressive might appeared once again, one that was not much weaker than the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation's.

People sensed a terrifying power brewing within the Ascending Dragon Cauldron, one that was about to spew out!

The cauldron's lid had already been opened and the lifeblood powers were turning richer. Endless Heaven and Earth laws gathered over as sparkling specks of Dao patterns formed everywhere in the sky. They swarmed towards the Ascending Dragon Cauldron like birds paying homage to the phoenix.

This feeling was just too terrifying. It felt like the entire world was about to be devoured.

"Whoosh!"

At that moment in Heaven Fey City, a thick column of light surged into the sky, right into the firmaments.

People looked in astonishment at the columnar light's direction and surprisingly, it went… in the direction of one of the nine array cores in Heaven Fey City.

The Heaven Fey City's array core… had been triggered?

After the first array core was triggered, a second one followed right on the heels of the first! And a third!

Like a chain reaction, beam after beam of light charged through the clouds. Soon, all nine array cores in the Heaven Fey City were triggered!

All the power within the nine array cores drew towards the Ascending Dragon Cauldron.

Everyone's expression changed. Ruins Emperor could no longer sit still as he flew out of Ruins Emperor Palace.

He looked at the floating Ascending Dragon Cauldron with an astounded look.

How could the Heaven Fey City's array formation be triggered? Could it be that the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation had destroyed this universe's laws?

This affected even the ancient arrays of the Heaven Fey City?

He clearly sensed that the nine veins buried under Heaven Fey City were being triggered.

The brewing power within the Ascending Dragon Cauldron had likely drained most of its previous accumulations after undergoing the catharsis of the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation.

It was too hungry, so it began to gather the energy within the nine spirit veins of Heaven Fey City to replenish itself!

What is this…

Could it be… Lin Yun!?

An inexplicable thought flashed through the Ruins Emperor's mind.

What cultivation level did Yi Yun have? Even if he survived the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation, it should have been impossible for him to possess such immense power.

As the Ruins Emperor's expression changed, two ancient and mighty powers rose up from behind him, deep within Ruins Emperor Palace.

Heaven Fey Patriarchs!

The two Fey Patriarchs who presided over the Ruins Emperor Palace had not meddled in worldly affairs for many years. All they did was cultivate in seclusion. If it had nothing to do with the coronation of a new emperor for the ancient Heaven Fey or any major cataclysm that endangered the ancient Heaven Fey, they typically never appeared.

However, this power had shocked them into action!

All the ancient Heaven Fey warriors sensed the suppressive might emitted by the Fey Patriarchs' lifeblood. Compounded with the power emitted by the Ascending Dragon Cauldron, they could not longer stand firm. Some even slumped straight to the ground.

Fey Thearchs flew out of Heaven Fey City one after another. Regardless if they were in seclusion or refining artifacts, all of them flew into the sky to watch this strange phenomenon from afar.

At that moment, Ghost Doctor and Luo King were already wearing livid expressions. They already sensed a familiar aura within the energy storm that embroiled the entire land.

This aura originated from… Yi Yun!

Boom!

The Ascending Dragon Cauldron revealed the power that lurked within. A dragon's roar reached straight into the skies and even surged into the multiverse rift. Even without any Yuan Qi medium there, the void still resonated endlessly.

Following that, a human figure cloaked in light and tens of thousands of feet tall appeared!

The figure seemed made of light, was covered in flames and lightning, with dazzling sanguine and golden light.

His body was stalwart, but as his body was condensed of infinite laws, no one could discern his looks.

The giant emitted an extremely suppressive might that exceeded all the Fey Thearchs present.

The giant's gaze swept indifferently, sending anyone whose eyes met his gaze feel their hearts and souls quake. Their heartbeats even stopped as a result.

Those beneath the Fey Lord realm had long collapsed to the ground. Even the Fey Lords found it difficult to resist the suppressive might. They were circulating all their powers to barely stand.

"Hahahaha!"

The giant raised his head and laughed suddenly. The sky and land began trembling, resonating along with Heaven Fey City.

The feeling of having power and the control of the world was just too brilliant.

When manifested as a giant, he was like the heaven and earth itself. With just a mere thought, he could make mountains crumble and bring the sky down.

After a long laugh, the figure suddenly transformed into a rain of light which entered the Ascending Dragon Cauldron once again.

Everyone felt their bodies lighten. The suppression from before had vanished. Even the rumblings of the multiverse rift had stopped.

Many people were unaccustomed to the sudden disappearance of the suppression. They felt their chests turn heavy as their lifeblood churned.

When they looked at the Ascending Dragon Cauldron, they were alarmed.

All they saw was a black-robed youth above the Ascending Dragon Cauldron. They had no idea when he appeared.

His feet were on the divine cauldron as countless Azure Wood Divine Tree vines were flailing around him. As if they were his subjects, they gathered beneath his feet and seemed to be paying homage to him.

Upon seeing the youth, everyone felt that they had lost their souls.

The youth was none other than Yi Yun!

He seemed to be a little taller than before he transcended the tribulation. His looks had changed a little, making him look sharper.

However, people could still recognize him at a glance—he was Yi Yun!

The Chaos Heavenly Tribulation was a complete rebirth for Yi Yun!

He had consumed the Myriad Form Shura Pills previously, fusing the three lifebloods of human, Fey, Celestial together. They condensed into a Lifeblood Royal Seal, allowing him to take a huge step in his martial path.

But just this step was not as comprehensive as the step he took after experiencing the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation!

The Chaos Heavenly Tribulation had completely rejuvenated Yi Yun. Not only did his human, Fey, and Celestial lifeblood fuse together. Even the Heavenly Dao laws he cultivated in were completely infused into every inch of his flesh and blood. It could be said to be a fusion of body, essence, and soul.

And Yi Yun's cultivation had increased by leaps and bounds. After his wanton absorption of the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi in the nine spirit veins, the amount of energy was sufficient for an ordinary Fey Lord to attempt to break through to a Fey Thearch.

However, Yi Yun's foundation was too robust. The energy he needed for a Godly Monarch breakthrough far exceeded that of the ordinary Divine Lord. His cultivation level had reached the peak of the Divine Lord realm. He was nearly one step into the Godly Monarch realm.

It wasn't wrong to describe Yi Yun has being a half-step Godly Monarch.

Not only so, due to his physical metamorphosis, the present Yi Yun probably did not need to move to have the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi pass through his pores and infuse his body, nourishing his lifeblood and meridians. He had a perfect Seamless Body.

"You… You…"

Ghost Doctor was most sensitive to a human's body. The other Fey Thearchs might not be able to understand the physical metamorphosis Yi Yun had undergone, but he knew most clearly.

Just every breath Yi Yun took would strengthen him. Such a body invited so much envy that it could make one vomit blood.

After he transcended the Ghost tribulation, Ghost Doctor had transformed from a soul body to an imperfect body. To put it bluntly, it was a body akin to a zombie's.

Compared to Yi Yun, the difference was like night and day.

And with Yi Yun's potential and the secrets he held, Yi Yun had left him in the dust.

As for strength, just the suppressive might that Yi Yun produced was enough to stun everyone. How could such a suppressive might be a mere show?

Could it be that Yi Yun already had a strength far greater than a Fey Thearch?

Was it possible for a peak Divine Lord to defeat a Fey Thearch?

Just as Ghost Doctor had this thought flash in his mind, he suddenly felt a killing intent lock onto him.

Yi Yun was looking coldly at him.

From the moment Ghost Doctor poisoned the items, Yi Yun was already bent on killing him.

Not just defeating him, but killing!

He was to kill a Ghost Thearch with a half-step Godly Monarch cultivation level!

Chapter 1672: Netherworld River Domain

Upon sensing Yi Yun's killing intent, Ghost Doctor wore a hideous expression. He was unlike the others who were Fey Thearchs. As a Ghost, he stood alone without ally in Heaven Fey City.

However, Ghost Doctor thought nothing of it. Having been a Ghost Thearch for so many years, he had numerous means—all sorts of unfathomable Ghost mystic techniques—at his disposal.

Even a Fey Thearch at the level of the Luo King would not be able to defeat Ghost Doctor easily.

And to kill Ghost Doctor, one would need the joint forces of at least three Fey Thearchs.

Defeating and killing were two completely different concepts.

Even if Yi Yun was a freak of nature, giving him strength that matched a Fey Thearch after his transcending of the Chaos tribulation, that was nothing.

Ghost Doctor felt that he was far above adequate to deal with Yi Yun.

"Lin Yun, do you think you are invincible after transcending the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation?"

As Ghost Doctor spoke, his aura suddenly changed while his corpse-like body began to swell.

After Ghosts became Ghost Thearchs, they gained a body of flesh after transcending the Ghost tribulation. This body possessed potent combat strength.

The Ghosts also knew how to transform, but it was completely different from the Fey.

The transformations of the Fey were typically accompanied by bulging muscles, sharp teeth and bone spikes, and exaggerated wings.

Although ferocious, their transformations fully exuded the beauty of strength.

However, Ghost Doctor's transformation left one's scalp tingling.

His body swelled, but it was not a bulging of muscles. Instead, it was like a bloating corpse that swelled and turned waxy white.

He had little hair to begin with, but with his transformation, what little hair he had turned wet thanks to a sticky liquid that seemed to cover his head.

His eyes were recessed deep, his eyeballs vanishing. In its place were two balls of fire that burned with an eerie green glow.

His nose had rotted away, leaving behind two empty sockets. Beneath his "nose" was a mouth filled with two rows of sharp teeth. They were a glittering green, obviously containing terrifying corpse venom.

In a few seconds, Ghost Doctor had unfettered his body. He grew to five meters tall and his body was swollen. His head was nearly a skull, one that looked utterly sinister. It was repulsive.

"So that's what you look like." Yi Yun shook his head. Other than the freaks of nature that appeared in the Ghost race every billion years or more, coagulating a perfect body was easier said than done.

As for Ghost Doctor, he had cultivated in various poison arts and sinister Gu before he became a Ghost Thearch. He immersed his soul in poison and even though he could resist the poisonous elements, the corrosive effects they had on his body and soul could not be stopped. It resulted in his terrifying appearance.

His former appearance was just a disguise using a mystic art.

Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor cackled sinisterly. "Eating your perfect body will replenish my lifeblood. When the time comes, my body will be like a Ghost Patriarch's, a perfect zombie body."

As Ghost Doctor spoke, he extended his long tongue which was covered in green cadaveric liquid. It reached straight to his chest.

"Roar!"

Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor let out a roar as the surrounding space suddenly turned into one of austere gloominess.

Countless wraiths and demons flew out of nowhere, letting out their hysterical wails.

"Netherworld River Domain!"

All the powerful Fey present understood everything that was happening clearly. This was one of the most supreme techniques of the Ghost race. It was also a secret technique that belonged to Sunset Netherworld River, the faction behind Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor!

Ten thousand years ago, the Netherworld River Lord of the Sunset Netherworld River battled a mighty Soul expert and had cast the Netherworld River Domain.

At the final moment of the battle, the Netherworld River Domain unleashed its powers, inundating the world with its cadaveric aura, causing all life within a million kilometers to be reduced to bone!

That battle was fought on an independent world.

After the battle, the world turned into a land of death. Due to the presence of the countless ghouls, the world was still a forbidden area to this very day.

In years to come, the forbidden ground would produce natural treasures. Warriors below the Divine Lord realm would risk their lives, heading there to seek out opportunities.

The Netherworld River Lord had basically used a single move, the Netherworld River Domain, to create a forbidden zone!

Such a move was the acme of perfection!

Of course, using the Netherworld River Domain delivered an immense burden on one's soul. Even a Ghost Thearch wouldn't use it without good reason.

Ghost Doctor had actually put in his all when fighting Yi Yun!

Even though he knew Yi Yun was a Divine Lord, he did not belittle him. It was incredulous that a Ghost Thearch would employ a move that harmed his own soul while battling a half-step Godly Monarch.

"All of you prepare at once. Stop the Netherworld River Domain from spreading its cadaveric aura."

Ruins Emperor sent a voice transmission to all the Fey Thearchs present.

This was Heaven Fey City, the most prosperous land of the Fey. It mattered little if all life on a mid-level world was annihilated, but to permit the slaughter of Heaven Fey City was absolutely unacceptable to the Fey.

Now, with so many Fey Thearchs present, as well as the Ruins Emperor and the Fey Patriarchs, there was little to worry about.

Furthermore, with Ghost Doctor's strength, as long as he did not lose control of the situation in battle, he likely had the ability to flood Yi Yun with all the cadaveric aura, letting him bear the brunt of it all.

"Punk, this is the Netherworld River Domain. You have to be careful!"

At the moment the Netherworld River Domain appeared, Blood King had already informed Yi Yun of all he knew with a Yuan Qi voice transmission.

"A move that can wipe out all life of an independent world. What a sinister move."

The corners of Yi Yun's mouth produced a sinister smile. He was no goody two-shoes, but to view countless lives as nothing but dust disgusted him.

He silently extended his right hand where specks of stellar light appeared, circling an invisible center.

This scene appeared insignificant among the energy storms that raged in a region thousands of kilometers across, but the numerous Fey Thearchs present felt an indescribable aura from the stellar light in Yi Yun's palm. It felt like the aura of the Heavenly Dao, as though he held the Heavenly Dao in his hand.

What move was this?

Just as people held this thought in their minds, Yi Yun moved. He charged straight into the Netherworld River Domain.

He made the first move while fighting a Ghost Thearch!

Everyone held their breaths, afraid that they would miss any scene from this cataclysmic battle.

At that moment, no one thought little of Yi Yun. However, it was still a battle between a Divine Lord and a Ghost Thearch. There was a massive ravine that separated the two realms.

Yi Yun slowly clenched his fist and, at that moment, the sky vanished.

The dark clouds and the storms vanished. When people looked up, all they saw was the cosmos.

Galaxies interspersed with one another as endless starlight scattered.

The scattering starlight landed on Yi Yun and at that moment, it appeared as though he was a god of the universe who held control over everything!

Ever since he refined the Heavenly Dao fragment, everything he did and said was as natural as the law. Yet, he was only a single-sealed Divine Lord at that time.

Now, Yi Yun had already condensed his second Divine Lord Royal Seal and his cultivation level was closing in on the Godly Monarch realm. Having fused with the Heavenly Dao, his body, essence, and soul were one. It wasn't an exaggeration to describe him as a god!

"You will be the first Thearch-level expert that dies at my hand. I shall offer your blood for my supreme Great Dao!"

As Yi Yun spoke, he struck down with his palm!

This strike was like the falling of the skies!

"Ka Ka Ka!"

With a series of cracking sounds, Ghost Doctor's Netherworld River Domain was shattered!

Ghost Doctor's expression changed drastically. He had guessed that Yi Yun was stronger than most, but he never imagined that Yi Yun's strength would reach such a level. A simple pressing down of his palm made him feel as though he was facing an entire universe.

"Roar!"

Ghost Doctor let out a roar as he opened his mouth and spat out a glistening green sphere.

Upon seeing the sphere, everyone felt their hearts and minds reverberate.

A Ghost pearl!

This was the Ghost Doctor's Ghost pearl, similar to a Fey core. They were the condensation of all the Ghost warrior's cultivation. Once damaged, the consequences were unimaginable.

It was simply because Yi Yun's strike was too terrifying. Ghost Doctor, who was pushed into a corner, had no choice but to summon his Ghost pearl and risk it all!

The Ghost pearl could even self-destruct; the power of this self-destruction at the Ghost Thearch level was unimaginable. Even a Fey Thearch level Fey beast with the strongest body would be blasted to smithereens if they experienced the self-destruction of such a Ghost pearl.

The Ghost pearl shot straight at Yi Yun!

In a blink of an eye, Yi Yun's fist that controlled the Heavenly Dao released. He extended his fingers and grabbed the Ghost pearl!

All the Fey Thearchs had the color in their faces drain when they saw Yi Yun grab the terrifying Ghost pearl in hand. If any one of them were in his shoes, they would not have the guts to do so.

Upon seeing this scene, Ghost Doctor was enraged. Yi Yun was completely disparaging him!

He did not dare initiate the self-destruction of the Ghost pearl, but he could release all the Ghost aura he had accumulated in it for hundreds of thousands of years. He wanted to rob Yi Yun's life even if it was at the cost of damaging his cultivation level.

But when Ghost Doctor willed it to happen, his expression changed drastically!

He was appalled to discover that his connection with the Ghost pearl had been severed!

The profound Heavenly Dao laws had formed a Heavenly Dao wall that insulated the pearl from Ghost Doctor's perception.

All Ghost Doctor felt was a quaking heart and mind. The Ghost pearl was a product of his cultivation, and logically speaking, it was impossible for Yi Yun to sever his connection to it.

But…

Yi Yun had really done it.

Ghost Doctor felt that his Ghost pearl had been thrown into a different timeline and became obstructed by time itself. Today was just the continuation of yesterday, making their connection intrinsically tied together. However, regardless of what one did today, it did nothing to influence yesterday.

His connection with the Ghost pearl was identical to such a situation.

Yi Yun's Heavenly Dao had severed all his karmic connections with the Ghost pearl.

"This is yours."

Yi Yun threw out Ghost Doctor's Ghost pearl as a green shadow appeared out of thin air. It widened its gaping mouth and devoured the Ghost pearl!

The green shadow was none other than Poison Demon!

Yi Yun had thrown Ghost Doctor's Ghost pearl to Poison Demon!

Poison Demon was ecstatic for he sensed the terrifying powers contained within the Ghost pearl. As long as he devoured the pearl, his strength would rise exponentially!

"I said that your blood will be sacrificed to my Dao!"

As Yi Yun spoke, he struck down with his fist!

Having already condensed the ultimate Heavenly Dao laws which gathered from every corner of the world, he sent them to gather on Ghost Doctor's body.

A terrifying power erupted as the world raptured into a complete destruction!

"Ah, ah, ah!"

Ghost Doctor let out a crazy scream, but at that moment, his connection to the Ghost pearl had been nomologically severed by Yi Yun. He had weakened drastically and as things developed, the gap between his strength and Yi Yun's just widened!

Chapter 1673: Blood of a Ghost Thearch

When Yi Yun only had a single Divine Lord Royal Seal, he was able to defeat Ghost Ming who was also a Ghost Thearch.

And now that Yi Yun's cultivation level was that of a half-step Godly Monarch, he was completely different from the past!

In fact, after Yi Yun refined the Myriad Form Shura Pills, he already had the means to defeat the Luo King and Ghost Doctor. However, he was in Heaven Fey City after all. There was Ruins Emperor and the two Fey Patriarchs to consider.

The shock and awe rendered by the two Fey Patriarchs made Yi Yun hold back.

By appearing weaker than he was, he could deal a fatal blow at the critical moment.

Previously, apart from Lin Xintong and Shan Ling, no one, even Blood King and Jiang Xiaorou, knew of Yi Yun's true strength.

This also caused Ruins Emperor to make a horrendous judgment error. He thought he could use the hand of the Luo King to maim Yi Yun during his weakness from transcending the Heavenly Tribulation.

Unbeknown to him, Yi Yun was already unafraid of the threat of the Luo King and Ghost Doctor when he transcended the tribulations.

Now that he had transcended the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation, Yi Yun was absolutely fearless!

"Peng!"

Under the terrifying nomological blow, Ghost Doctor's body began rapturing.

His flesh, blood and bones fragmented and scattered!

Even Ghost Doctor's head was cleaved off. Two soul fires flickered as his long tongue hung out. He was in deep pain.

"Die!"

With a tap, Yi Yun directly reached Ghost Doctor's glabella.

This strike contained the Dao of Destruction that directly anihilated Ghost Doctor's soul mark. The two soul fires at his eyes gradually extinguished.

Upon seeing this happen, everyone in Heaven Fey City was astounded.

They widened their eyes as their throats twitched. They were left at a loss for words.

Yi Yun had killed a Ghost Thearch straight up!

The entire battle did not take more than a minute!

For a half-step Godly Monarch to slay a Ghost Thearch and even snatch away his Ghost pearl, Ghost Doctor was completely within Yi Yun's control from beginning to the end.

All his resistance was futile!

The difference in strength was massive!

Not a single Fey Thearch present had such strength. The strongest among them could at best defeat Ghost Doctor. Killing him would be a fool's dream.

And the weaker ones were unlikely to have much of an advantage over Ghost Doctor.

That meant that Yi Yun had the ability to kill any one of them!

At that moment, even the Ruins Emperor felt his head buzz.

Yi Yun had concealed his strength too well!

He had been completely fooled.

Even if Yi Yun's strength increased exponentially because of his transcendence of the Heavenly Tribulation, it was impossible to reach this stage.

By inference, it was likely that after he consumed the Myriad Form Shura Pills, or even at the moment he arrived at the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins, he already possessed the strength to deal with Fey Thearchs!

This was way too terrifying!

Who would have imagined that a human junior would possess such terrifying strength?

The present Yi Yun had already developed into a powerhouse. Ruins Emperor believed that he was no match for Yi Yun. Even the Patriarchs might not be able to suppress Yi Yun!

It could be said that Yi Yun had already elevated himself to the top echelons of the Chaos Heavens in terms of combat strength.

Even if the entire Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins was placed in front of him, he could face it as an equal. It was fool's talk to force Yi Yun to do anything. Any deals would have to depend on Yi Yun's mood.

And this was only just the beginning.

In time to come, if Yi Yun continued developing his strength, it would be…

Ruins Emperor did not dare think further.

The strongest expert in the Chaos Heavens!

Yi Yun would develop himself to become the strongest expert in the Chaos Heavens in the future!?

That was such a promising future. The thought that he tried to scheme against such a terrifying figure previously left Ruins Emperor feeling a lingering fear.

Thankfully, Ruins Emperor was careful by nature. He did not try to personally deal with Yi Yun and had simply left Luo King to his machinations by acquiescence.

It was unreasonable to wish for the Ruins Emperor to go out and protect Yi Yun. Therefore, it still appeared that decorum was upheld.

At that moment, Yi Yun extended his hand and grabbed Ghost Doctor's soul body. With his mental imprint destroyed, the soul body had lost its strength. Yi Yun shattered the soul body and infused the soul fragments into his body.

Following that, Poison Demon appeared and widened his jaws. He devoured Ghost Doctor's remnant corpse and soul whole!

All that was left was the Ghost Thearch's interspatial ring which landed in Yi Yun's hand.

Poison Demon was exhilarated!

Together with the Ghost pearl it just devoured, it was equivalent to Poison Demon having swallowed a complete Ghost Thearch!

The entire body of a Fey Thearch level Fey beast or Fey plant was a treasure, and naturally, so was a Ghost Thearch's!

However, humans and Ghosts were different. A Ghost Thearch's corpse was of little use to a human warrior, but to Poison Demon, it was a supreme treasure among supreme treasures.

Furthermore, Ghost Doctor cultivated in the poison arts. From the time he embarked on his ghost cultivation, he had researched countless poisons and medicines. All of these had subtly fused into his flesh and blood, and had been refined for tens of millions of years.

It could be said that Ghost Doctor's body was a supreme-grade container of poison.

And these poisons were now the possession of Poison Demon!

Poison Demon was Yi Yun's contract beast. A portion of its strength came from Yi Yun.

Originally, after Yi Yun transcended the Chaos Heavenly Tribulation, Poison Demon had already experienced a drastic increase in strength. Now, with Ghost Doctor's fresh corpse, its strength soared!

"Master, thank you for giving me new life! Hahahaha!"

Poison Demon laughed maniacally. It began digesting Ghost Doctor's powers. The Ghost pearl had now become core to Poison Demon.

Inside Poison Demon's body, countless green threads stabbed into the Ghost pearl as they constantly drew its powers.

The metamorphosing Poison Demon emitted a terrifying suppressive might.

Its looks were originally nothing much to speak of, but at that moment, it was floating in midair, emanating an aura that could suppress that of Ghost Thearch. It was as though he had transformed into a peerless Demon God!

Upon seeing Poison Demon flaunting his strength, everyone felt despair.

Ignoring the fact that Yi Yun was ridiculously strong, even his contract beast was this powerful?

As Fey Thearchs, they might not even be the ugly Poison Demon's match, much less be capable of dealing with Yi Yun!

Furthermore, Yi Yun had previously summoned the Azure Wood Divine Tree.

The tree likely had the strength to match a Fey Thearch as well.

For a person to have two Fey Thearch beings under his control, what sort of concept was this?

The Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins' patriarchs were powerful, capable of calling upon nearly twenty Fey Thearchs, but they were only their subordinates. They listened to them in name, but in fact, feigned compliance while acting in opposition.

But Yi Yun was different. Yi Yun had contracted beasts who had full allegiance to him!

These were only the trump cards that Yi Yun had shown. Who knew what his true means were?

"Rou'er, your brother…"

Blood King looked at Yi Yun, his expression extremely complicated.

Back when he summoned Yi Yun, it was because he was impressed by him. Who knew that Yi Yun was such a freak?

He had planned on helping Yi Yun because of Jiang Xiaorou, but now, from the looks of it, Yi Yun had no need for his help.

For him to help Yi Yun refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills, it was giving him aid in his time of need before he developed his strength.

In a way, he had left Yi Yun indebted to him.

"Father, I never imagined Yun'er to be this powerful. I thought that with you finding me, my growth has been without setbacks for the past few centuries as my strength grew by leaps and bounds. I thought that none of my peers could match me, but compared to Yun'er, I'm still far inferior."

Upon hearing Jiang Xiaorou's words, Blood King chuckled ruefully. "Don't bring it up. I thought that I was your biggest backer originally. But now from the looks of it, your brother is a stronger backer than me."

After cultivating for so many years, paying an immeasurable price for cultivating in the Indestructible Killing Dao, and his astounding opportunities in the Tian Yuan world, he had already reached the limits of a warrior. However, he could only lament his inadequacies when compared to Yi Yun.

"In time to come, when your brother fully develops his strength, it will be nothing even if you can't be Ruins Empress," said the Blood King wistfully.

Years ago, Blood King did not become Ruins Emperor and was far from the mark. By being Ruins Emperor, one gained better cultivation resources. It was obviously an alluring proposition.

But the Ruins Emperor was after all the spokesperson of the two Fey Patriarchs. If the Fey Patriarchs felt that any nurturing was lost on the Ruins Emperor, they would switch the ruler.

How could this be comparable to being Yi Yun's elder sister?

Yi Yun's future was possibly that of the strongest person in the Chaos Heavens!

This status was completely incomparable in honor.

…

Poison Demon emitted his suppressive might for nearly an hour. The phenomenon that appeared could only be said to outdo a Fey Thearch's breakthrough.

"Hahahaha!"

With the drastic increase in strength, Poison Demon seemed to grow dizzy with success. It was a demon that became delirious with joy to begin with. Now that it felt its strength increase, it was eager to let it all out.

"Master, are there some old entrails that need killing here? There's no need to trouble yourself with killing them. Let me cripple him!"

Poison Demon stared at Luo King intently as it revealed a cruel smile.

It wished to engage in a massive battle and revel in the delight of delivering its mighty blows. It was also a way to express its loyalty to Yi Yun.

Although there was the soul contract in place, making Poison Demon completely loyal to Yi Yun in body and mind, as a servant, Poison Demon had to demonstrate his value. If not, what right did it have to be bestowed with so many goodies?

Upon hearing Poison Demon issue the challenge, Luo King's expression turned as black as a wok's bottom.

He saw Ghost Doctor's death very clearly. Since Yi Yun could kill Ghost Doctor, he naturally could kill him as well.

He never imagined that his life would one day be in the hands of a junior.

Of course, the Luo King was different from Ghost Doctor.

He was an ancient Heaven Fey after all. Yi Yun was unlikely to kill him in Heaven Fey City.

"I know who you are…" Luo King took a deep breath as his eyes shimmered. "There was a rumor previously that a Heavenly Dao fragment appeared in the Xuanyuan Dune. A few miners that are in the Chaos Crystal business fooled the entire Chaos Heavens to vie for the Heavenly Dao fragment. Eventually, the Heavenly Dao fragment was snatched by a human…"

"I originally thought that the rumor was not to be believed. Now, I have to believe it. That human was you, right?"

When Luo King said that, everyone was alarmed.

Snatched the Heavenly Dao fragment!?

When they thought back to how Yi Yun had defeated Ghost Doctor, it was as though he was in full control of the Heavenly Dao. It was not impossible that Yi Yun had refined the Heavenly Dao fragment!

However… the Heavenly Dao fragment was something only the peerless Celestial experts could refine. Apart from them, the Fey, Ghost, and Soul experts could only watch powerless. How did Yi Yun, a human whose cultivation level was merely at the Divine Lord level, manage to refine the Heavenly Dao fragment?

That was simply unbelievable.

"If you think so…" Yi Yun looked at Luo King as the corner of his mouth suffused rich killing intent. Very well, he never imagined that Luo King would bite back at him just before his death!

Chapter 1674: Courting Death

Yi Yun had killed Ghost Doctor without any scruples, but against the Luo King, he needed to take into consideration the ancient Heaven Fey. But now, the Luo King had countered before he even took action!

The Heavenly Dao fragment was of great importance!

It possessed immense enticement to the Celestials!

The Luo King obviously knew this; he was deliberately involving the Celestials.

In the Chaos Heavens, the Celestials were supernatural existences. They were much stronger than the Fey; therefore, Yi Yun would end up plagued by the Celestials' pursuit.

With good luck, Yi Yun might even be eliminated by the Celestials, an extremely possible outcome for a human.

Yi Yun looked at the Luo King and grinned. This grin sent a baffling chill down the Luo King's back.

"What are you laughing at?"

"I'm laughing at how you might not have necessarily died. Although it was a 'might,' since you've courted death I will grant it."

Yi Yun said those words indifferently, leaving everyone stunned, both in body and mind.

This was Heaven Fey City. Yi Yun was planning to kill a Fey Thearch in front of so many experts!?

Such arrogant words were madness.

The Luo King was taken aback before he roared with laughter.

His face was flushed red as he laughed maniacally.

A Fey Thearch like the Luo King placed great emphasis to his status and reputation. However, once decorum was lost, he didn't care to keep up pretenses.

Since he had already offended Yi Yun to an irreconcilable state, there was no way to change Yi Yun's intent to kill regardless of his attitude.

"Do you think you are invincible because you killed Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor? This is Heaven Fey City. With the two Fey Patriarchs here, you can forget about acting so audaciously!"

The two Fey Patriarchs in Ruins Emperor Palace were the anchors of the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins. With them around, the Luo King would be fine.

At worst, he would not leave Heaven Fey City in the future, holing himself in his residence. There was nothing Yi Yun could do.

Just as this thought flashed in Luo King's mind, he suddenly saw Yi Yun release horrifying killing intent!

Oh!?

The Luo King felt reverberations through his heart. Was Yi Yun mad? Did he really dare attack!?

Jiang Luo was not a pushover either. Even if he was not Yi Yun's match, all he needed to do was survive Yi Yun's attacks for a period of time before the two Fey Patriarchs took action. That wasn't too difficult.

No matter how powerful Yi Yun was, it was impossible for him to fend off the two Fey Patriarchs. It would be inviting trouble on himself!

Although he knew that, the Luo King did not divert any attention. He roared maniacally, his lifeblood boiling and his muscles bulging!

A gigantic Heaven Fey totem appeared behind the Luo King. The four divine beast marks—the azure dragon, vermilion bird, white tiger, and black turtle—emitted an immense radiance!

The Heaven Fey totem formed a world in and of itself which enveloped the Luo King completely!

The Luo King knew Yi Yun's strength; therefore, he did not plan on counterattacking. All he needed to do was put his all into defending against Yi Yun's attack.

"Primordial totem, Lifeblood As One!"

Luo King's body crackled repeatedly as he stimulated the Heaven Fey bloodline in his body. He directly transformed into an ancient Fey!

His muscles tore through his clothes as he grew to thirty feet. His firm muscles matched the might of a Godly Monarch-level weapon.

Such a body had obvious defenses.

But at the same time, the Luo King lit up a purple mark at his glabella. This was a spiritual numinous treasure he had refined into his soul sea. It protected his soul.

The Fey's weaknesses were their lacking spiritual powers and weak laws.

However, with this artifact that protected his soul, Luo King had fixed this one flaw.

Now, it could be said that he was invulnerable!

He refused to believe that Yi Yun could tear through his defense.

In fact, at the moment Yi Yun took action, the Luo King had sensed the lifeblood powers of the two Fey Patriarchs spewing forth.

How could the two patriarchs allow any Fey Thearch to be killed in front of all the citizens of Heaven Fey City?

It was best if they lost decorum with Yi Yun. With them joining forces, they could cripple Yi Yun!

In fact, it was not difficult for all the Fey Thearchs, including the Ruins Emperor and Fey Patriarchs, to set up an array to trap Yi Yun in Heaven Fey City.

The Luo King had such thoughts flash past his mind rapidly, but…

The maelstrom-like blow he imagined did not appear. Instead, he was blanketed by an indescribable force.

A nomological force!

The Luo King frowned. He hated nomological forces the most. After Yi Yun refined the Heavenly Dao fragment, he was in control of the Heavenly Dao. In terms of laws, ten thousand Luo Kings were not Yi Yun's match.

Now, the Luo King had made his Heaven Fey totem a world in and of itself. Although he had the intention to attack and resist Yi Yun's laws, he focused 99% of his strength on defense. He had no more capacity for anything else.

"Stop it!"

At that moment, an ancient, angry roar sounded from the Heaven Fey City's Ruins Emperor Palace.

Following that, a glaring Heaven Fey totem that shone like the sun appeared out of thin air. Unlike the Fey Thearch totems, this Heaven Fey totem had five marks lit up. Even the sixth mark emitted a faint glow.

A five-mark Heaven Fey totem was a chasm many Fey Thearchs in Heaven Fey City could not cross their entire lives.

The two Fey Patriarchs were the only ones that possessed five-mark Heaven Fey totems in Heaven Fey City.

At that moment, the Fey Patriarchs had finally taken action!

This action rendered the world asunder. All the Fey warriors held their breaths and protected their lifebloods. They were afraid that their bodies would be crushed to paste when the Fey Patriarchs attacked with their peerless might.

"Junior! Let go of the grudge between you and Jiang Luo, and we, the ancient Heaven Fey can still befriend you. If not, don't blame me for being ruthless!"

The Fey Patriarch had his reservations against Yi Yun as well. He had the intent to retain Yi Yun, but was also afraid Yi Yun would escape. Once that failed, the grudge would be set in stone.

However, he didn't care now that Yi Yun was the one who made the first move.

The Fey Patriarch's strike was infused with all his strength. He meant to take Yi Yun down a notch with an opening gambit!

However… just as the Fey Patriarch's strike was about to hit Yi Yun, Yi Yun vanished!

At that instant, the Fey Patriarch felt the worldly laws amass, as though a blob of Chaos was before him.

Then, Yi Yun vanished.

The Fey Patriarch looked up into the sky abruptly—

The multiverse rift!

The multiverse rift in the sky had not disappeared yet. Yi Yun had used his astounding power to transport himself there!

It didn't matter if that was all he did. It would only signify that Yi Yun had escaped.

However, he actually… brought Jiang Luo with him!

In order to resist Yi Yun's attack, Jiang Luo had converged all his strength into his body, spreading it through his bones, flesh, blood, and soul.

It was to resist Yi Yun's blow and hold out till the Fey Patriarch rescued him.

However, Yi Yun had decided to meet trick with trick. He had teleported Jiang Luo, including the space around him, away.

Jiang Luo, who had focused on defense, had no way of resisting Yi Yun's move, nor did he expect it.

It was just like a turtle who had retracted its head and limbs. It would be difficult cracking its shell, but moving it was a lot easier.

With a momentary daze, the Luo King felt massive forces sweep over. He attempted to resist it, but he felt like a leaf in a stormy hurricane. He was completely helpless!

By the time he tore out of Yi Yun's nomological restraints, he realized that he was already within the multiverse rift.

Surrounding him was nothing but the void. He could not even sense an inkling of the Chaos Heavens.

He stood alone in space, facing one person—Yi Yun.

All of this took seconds. In the first second, he was still taunting Yi Yun, but the next second, he found himself standing in empty space facing Yi Yun.

The vicissitudes of the development made the Luo King's expression extremely interesting.

Now, he looked as though his parents had just died.

Especially when he swept his perception around him. He could not sense even a shadow of the two Fey Patriarchs' lifeblood powers.

Yi Yun's laws were outstanding to begin with. In the multiverse rift where laws were in disarray, it was simple for him to conceal their location.

With this in mind, the Luo King began to break out into cold sweat.

Yi Yun smiled at the Luo King and said, "What were you saying just now? I didn't catch you. Why don't you repeat it?"

Luo King: "…"

Meanwhile in the Heaven Fey Ancient Ruins of the Chaos Heavens!

Everyone looked up agape at the multiverse rift in the sky.

Heaven Fey City's two Fey Patriarch were named Grand Primordium and Grand Supremum.

The one who had attacked was Fey Patriarch Grand Primordium. However, before his strike connected, Yi Yun had openly left the Chaos Heavens, snagging a Fey Thearch in passing with him!

Despite the appearance of the two Fey Patriarchs, they had failed to ensure the safety of a Fey Thearch. If this spread, it would make the other races laugh their heads off.

High above the sky, Grand Primordium wore a nasty expression.

He had lived for eons and once had nature at his beck and call. And in the recent tens of millions of years, he had not taken action personally.

After tens of millions of years of silence, he had finally take action; yet, under the watchful eyes of the countless residents of Heaven Fey City, he ended up being tricked by a human.

It was extremely insulting!

He phased away and appeared at the multiverse rift. With another flash, he flew in.

However, the moment he entered the multiverse rift, he found it devoid of anything. He spread out his perception in search of Yi Yun and the Luo King, but was like searching a needle in a haystack. He found nothing.

He had already expected such a situation.

With Yi Yun's strength and nomological insight, it was easy for him to conceal two people in the massive multiverse rift.

Furthermore, it was possible that Yi Yun was billions of miles away with the Luo King.

Grand Primordium flew back into the Chaos Heavens with a gloomy expression.

At that moment, all the Fey warriors looked at him unblinkingly, waiting for him to say something.

Being the focus of attention made Grand Primordium so depressed that he nearly vomited blood.
