He had been the focus of attention countless times throughout his entire life. He was already sick of such adoration and focus and had decided to take a step back to allow the Ruins Emperor to handle matters.

Who knew that after all these years of reclusion, he would be the focus of attention again in such a manner?

He was completely embarrassed.

In fact, Yi Yun was hiding with Jiang Luo. Searching was harder than hiding to begin with, so it was nothing odd even if Grand Primordium failed to find them.

However, his people did not think so. All they could see was that Grand Primordium had been outmatched by Yi Yun.

The strongest Fey had lost to a human junior…

The blow to the Fey's confidence was obvious.

If this matter spread around, the ancient Heaven Fey would probably become a laughing stock.

Chapter 1675: Luo King's Death

"Bam!"

In the multiverse rift, a divine beam flashed. The terrifying Yuan Qi blast swept in every direction like a tsunami, but as there was not a shred of Yuan Qi in the space between the multiverse, the terrifying Yuan Qi fluctuation quickly vanished!

If this were the Chaos Heavens, such a Yuan Qi blast could have extended out for tens of thousands of kilometers, or even more.

But here, the Yuan Qi blast was like a tsunami that had met large swaths of sponges that rapidly absorbed the shock wave.

After traveling just dozens of kilometers, the Yuan Qi blast was fully attenuated.

The space between the multiverse was absolutely still. No matter how much of a stir one caused, it did not lead to anything. Even a Fey Thearch would feel despair when trapped in such a world.

At that moment, the Luo King was covered in injuries all thanks to Yi Yun.

He was slightly better than Heretic Hands Ghost Doctor since he had an ancient Heaven Fey body and had the Heaven Fey totem protecting him.

In terms of defense, he was practically flawless. Unfortunately, he was facing Yi Yun.

Having formidable defenses only meant that he was resistant to being beaten. That placed him in a situation worse than Ghost Doctor.

His flesh ruptured from the barrage of attacks Yi Yun dealt him. His bones fractured and his severed meridians were a mess.

Originally, with the Luo King's powerful body, he could heal from those wounds in five minutes.

However, why would Yi Yun give him that opportunity?

What was healed slightly ended up being broken more thoroughly.

With that, the Luo King was already reeling in despair. He knew that there was no way he could escape the calamity that had befallen him that day!

He never expected that he would one day be finished by a human junior despite having reigned supreme his entire life and having supernatural standing and power thanks to his conferment as king.

Furthermore, he would be dying in such an aggrieved manner.

"Poison Demon, I'll leave the rest to you." Yi Yun opened the green urn and Poison Demon's claws shot out from it.

The moment Poison Demon appeared, it smiled sinisterly at the Luo King.

In fact, devouring the Luo King had little effect on Poison Demon. After all, the Luo King cultivated in orthodox Fey martial techniques that had little appeal to Poison Demon.

Only the Luo King's Fey core provided any significant sustenance.

And this Fey core was also of little use to Yi Yun. He wished for Poison Demon to devour the Luo King only to deliver a more painful death to him.

He naturally showed no mercy to someone who repeatedly attempted to kill him.

At that moment, the Luo King felt his scalp tingle. He had seen the scene of Ghost Doctor being devoured very clearly.

To be devoured by such a heretic creature despite his standing was ten times more horrifying than death.

"Dream on!"

The Luo King roared as he charged straight for Poison Demon.

He did not charge towards Yi Yun; instead, he went for Poison Demon.

At that instant, Yi Yun knew that he was about to self-destruct.

It was impossible for him to kill Yi Yun with a self-destruction, but it was a lot easier killing Poison Demon.

His blast would likely wipe out Poison Demon.

Poison Demon was alarmed. It thought it could put on a good show after Yi Yun summoned it out, but there was nothing it could do when the other party was suicidal.

Its life was still of great worth, and it wished to continue on and enjoy the luxuries of life, while staying loyal to Yi Yun.

"Master…"

Poison Demon could not desert, so all it could do was plead for Yi Yun's help.

Yi Yun was not flustered with regards to Luo King's suicidal strike. With a thought, Yuan Qi stirred through his body.

"Explode!"

Yi Yun roared as the flying Luo King's body quaked!

Instantly, he felt countless blasts of wanton energy erupt from his body.

It was the power of lightning and fire!

Following that, the Luo King's already wretched meridians, flesh and blood, suffered damage and destruction once more!

He immediately felt a chill. He knew this situation very well because his grandson had been experiencing it for weeks.

Back then, Jiang Yuchan had been in the same situation. And now, Yi Yun's strength had risen significantly. He could use the same means on the Luo King now.

The instantaneous eruption of lightning and fire interrupted the flow of the Luo King's lifeblood powers.

Simultaneously, Yi Yun appeared instantly in front of the Luo King like a ghost before throwing a punch!

"Bam!"

The Luo King's body quaked as his organs were shattered by Yi Yun!

As for Poison Demon, it had already opened its gaping mouth…

At that moment, Jiang Luo felt despair and indignation, but there was no turning back. His life of glory had eventually led to such a tragic drawing of curtains…

The Luo King was dead…

Yi Yun watched the blood splatter in space as he took a deep breath. From today on, he already had the peak strength needed to control a world!

…

Meanwhile in Heaven Fey City, the crowd had not dispersed. People were waiting to see how the two patriarchs dealt with the face-smacking turn of events.

The situation was extremely awkward.

The two Fey Patriarchs, as well as the Ruins Emperor, were in irrevocably committed situations.

Who knew that the transcending of a Heavenly Tribulation by a human junior would develop into such a situation.

"Blood King! If anything were to happen to the Luo King, the responsibility is all yours! You colluded with a human to eliminate your opponent!"

A Fey Thearch spoke out.

As a newly-advanced Fey Thearch, Blood King's return meant that he had received a share of the pie which others used to enjoy. That caused him to offend quite a number of people.

As an old Fey Thearch, the Luo King had a much wider circle of acquaintances. Now, there were naturally Fey Thearchs who spoke in favor of the Luo King.

Due to Yi Yun's actions, the Blood King and Jiang Xiaorou were placed front and center.

However, the Blood King thought nothing of it.

His only worry at present was Jiang Xiaorou, but Yi Yun could provide her with enough care in the future.

As for himself, he was a Fey Thearch. There was no one he needed to fear.

Every Fey Thearch was fundamental to Heaven Fey City.

The two patriarchs had tried their best to protect Luo King, but failed. It was their own fault, so how could they vent their frustrations on the Blood King?

How would that be possible?

Just as a few Fey Thearchs were denouncing the Blood King, there was a surge of wind high in the sky.

The multiverse rift quaked open once again.

A black figure appeared out of thin air the next moment.

The person was none other than Yi Yun!

Yi Yun… still dared to return!?

All the Fey Thearchs who had denounced the Blood King instantly shut up. They did not dare say a word.

The Luo King was a message to those who would cross Yi Yun. Considering how Heaven Fey City failed to save the life of a Fey Thearch, who dared offend Yi Yun? It would only mean that one was sick of living.

"Where's Jiang Luo?" Elder Grand Primordium asked coldly.

"He's dead," Yi Yun replied calmly. He had returned because he had matters to deal with.

"Good… very good!"

Elder Grand Primordium raged inwardly. Yi Yun was showing no fear towards him!

He was certain that Heaven Fey City could do nothing to him!

And worst of all, it was true that Heaven Fey City could no longer stop him.

Ignoring Yi Yun's combat strength, just his ability to leave was unstoppable. He had been able to take a Fey Thearch with him previously, much less himself alone.

Therefore, Yi Yun dared to return.

He still returned despite having killed a Fey Thearch!

Seeing such a development, the warriors in Heaven Fey City lamented their inadequacies.

Yi Yun was just too strong.

This was the outcome one yearned for in cultivation.

To kill two powerful Fey Thearchs in a day, ignoring the two patriarchs of Heaven Fey City, all done at such a young age was truly the pinnacle of one's life!

Chapter 1676: Smacking Faces Through His Capabilities

"Patriarchs, I do not have any intention of making the ancient Heaven Fey my enemy. The Luo King and I had a private grudge and returning eye for eye is perfectly justified, isn't that so?" Yi Yun said with a smile.

The two patriarchs, Grand Supremum and Grand Primordium, remained silent. They didn't wish to say a word either. Their faces have been figuratively smacked so badly that they could not afford to mar their reputation further.

As the spokesperson of the two patriarchs, Ruins Emperor Jiang Jiuzhu had no choice but to fly out of the Ruins Emperor Palace and face Yi Yun.

Looking upon this human junior, Jiang Jiuzhu felt conflicted.

Just days ago, he had looked down upon Yi Yun from a domineering position.

Back then, he even believed that Yi Yun was being too sensational by bringing attention to himself. It was like a child carrying gold in a busy city. Without sufficient strength, he had showcased the Myriad Form Shura Pills and even attempted to negotiate with the ancient Heaven Fey. It was utterly foolish.

But now, he had to look up to Yi Yun. Even he was no match for Yi Yun.

This was still with Yi Yun not being a Godly Monarch. He would only be more terrifying if he broke through!

"What do you want?" Jiang Jiuzhu knew that for Yi Yun to return after killing Jiang Luo, he naturally had matters to discuss.

"Your Majesty, I'm still interested in the Myriad Form Shura Pills you mentioned."

Back when Jiang Jiuzhu summoned Yi Yun, he had offered to provide the materials for Yi Yun to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

After the pills were formed, they would be split proportionately.

This suggestion could be said to be win-win.

Yi Yun originally did not have much need for Myriad Form Shura Pills after his first consumption, but now, Yi Yun's cultivation level had reached the half-step Godly Monarch realm. His body had undergone the catharsis of the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Tribulation and he was in need of large amounts of energy to consolidate his foundation.

If he could consume enough Myriad Form Shura Pills, he would greatly shorten the process.

Upon hearing Yi Yun's words, Ruins Emperor wore an ugly expression.

Yi Yun had just killed Luo King, but he was completely ignoring the matter and instead was trying to open negotiations with the ancient Heaven Fey so openly and brazenly.

Sadly, the Ruins Emperor had no intention to keep Yi Yun there to refine the pills. If that happened, he had the slim chance of becoming the third patriarch of the ancient Heaven Fey.

The Luo King's death only served to embarrass the ancient Heaven Fey.

Thinking that would make Ruins Emperor really hate Yi Yun to the death would be a joke. He did not have any deep ties with the Luo King. His death meant little to him.

Yi Yun had naturally pinpointed this. He said via a voice transmission, "I can keep the pill refinement a secret. The warriors of Heaven Fey City will not know of it, nor will you face any embarrassment. Your Majesty and Patriarchs, what say you?"

Yi Yun would appear to leave the ancient Heaven Fey on the surface, or at the very least, vanish from everyone's sights to prevent the ancient Heaven Fey from being put in a difficult position.

The Ruins Emperor remained silent for a long while before asking with a voice transmission, "What percentage of the pills do you want?"

"Thirty percent! It isn't much. After my breakthrough, the quality of the refined pills would far exceed the previous batch."

"Thirty percent is too much! You just killed Jiang Luo. Do you think we, the ancient Heaven Fey, are pushovers? Do you think there's no price to pay for killing Jiang Luo?" Ruins Emperor said coldly. Yi Yun had originally negotiated for ten percent early on, but now, he was adding another twenty percent.

"I will not compromise on thirty percent, if not thirty then there's no deal. I'm not adamant on having the Myriad Form Shura Pills." Yi Yun was firm. "Jiang Luo exposed my identity, hoping for the Celestials to pursue me. My killing of him is only right. Do you really believe that I should swallow insult before your ancient Heaven Fey and allow myself to be schemed against?"

Yi Yun's words stunned Jiang Jiuzhu.

Yi Yun was right. As the ancient Heaven Fey were too powerful, they were already accustomed to being in command. They were used to other factions yielding and compromising.

Once one showed any intention to disobey, they would be met with the swift retribution and repression from the ancient Heaven Fey.

But Yi Yun alone was able to stand equal to the ancient Heaven Fey!

His future was without limit. Why should such a terrifying powerhouse yield to the ancient Heaven Fey?

To put it bluntly, why did he need to apologize when he had smacked faces through his own capabilities?

Jiang Jiuzhu did not say a word. He looked squarely at Yi Yun, who represented a terrifying power, a human that the ancient Heaven Fey could not afford to offend.

He even dared to be at odds with the Celestials, much less the ancient Heaven Fey.

Just as the Ruins Emperor was about to say something, Patriarch Grand Supremum's voice sounded in his ear. "If it's thirty percent, so be it. However, he needs to swear on the Heavenly Dao that he will never be at odds with the Fey if we do not cross him. If he's agreeable to it, I'm agreeable to letting Jiang Xiaorou become Crown Princess."

Upon hearing Patriarch Grand Supremum's words, Ruins Emperor sighed inwardly. He was destined to abdicate the throne.

As for Jiang Xiaorou, just her status as Yi Yun's elder sister made her the next Ruins Empress designate. This sounded incredulous, but Yi Yun was worth that much. The two patriarchs thought highly of Yi Yun and even if he had the Celestials as his enemy, they believed that he had a high chance of developing his strength.

By the time Yi Yun became a Godly Monarch, it would be difficult to deepen their ties with Yi Yun.

Yi Yun could very well become a powerful being just like Human Emperor Lin Ming from ancient times.

In contrast, the death of a single Luo King was nothing.

Ruins Emperor frankly passed on the two patriarch's conditions to which Yi Yun agreed easily. "Deal!"

Signing a contract with the Fey was something that had been agreed upon previously.

Regardless, Jiang Xiaorou's roots were with the Fey. Yi Yun naturally did not wish to make them his enemy.

As for the two Fey Patriarch's agreement to make Jiang Xiaorou Ruins Empress, they did so hoping it would make Yi Yun more inclined to help the Fey in the future.

It was considered a strategy placed in open daylight, one that Yi Yun was happy to see take place.

"I'll refine the pills in three days!"

Yi Yun flew off after transmitting his sentence via a Yuan Qi voice transmission.

He was not suited to appear in public in Heaven Fey City or the Heaven Fey City's imperial household would be utterly shamed.

Many warriors remained silent in shock even when Yi Yun vanished into the horizon.

In fifteen minutes, he had killed a Ghost Thearch and a Fey Thearch. It was just too terrifying.

It could be imagined that in days, Yi Yun's name would spread throughout the Chaos Heavens through various channels!

Together with the matter of him refining a Heavenly Dao fragment in the Xuanyuan Dune, Yi Yun would be pushed to the forefront of the Chaos Heavens.

Of course, being at the cusp of the news would mean that numerous factions, especially the Celestial faction, would target him.

…

The news spread like a storm.

Many factions in the Chaos Heavens focused on intelligence. They had created several long-distance array formations which were specially used for the transmission of information.

Although the Chaos Heavens was immensely extensive, in just half a day, the various top factions learned of Yi Yun's stunning feat of slaying two Godly Monarch-leveled figures.

And a day later, the smaller factions learned of it.

Following that, ordinary warriors began to learn of it bit by bit.

In time, news of Yi Yun was scoured by the various intelligence factions. They even knew that Yi Yun's first appearance was in the Taixia Ancient Mining.

Back then, he was heavily injured and his strength was far inferior to what it was now.

However, the growth of his strength was astonishing.

Chapter 1677: A Fey Thearch's Wealth

Taiyue Nation was an ancient human country situated in the Chaos Heavens. It had tens of millions of years of history and its territory spanned tens of millions of kilometers. It was considered a stable, if average, faction.

In the Chaos Heavens, factions like the Taiyue Nation were innumerable. Typically, few intelligence organizations would pay notice to this nation.

Northwest of the Taiyue Nation was a mountain range that extended for tens of thousands of kilometers. It was filled with primordial forests in which lived venomous worms, places that were devoid of human life.

This day, a man and three women flew to a spot above the nameless forest. Sweeping the area with his perception, the man checked the surrounding situation. "This shall be it."

The person who spoke was none other than Yi Yun.

The women with him were Lin Xintong, Jiang Xiaorou, and Shan Ling.

After leaving the ancient Heaven Fey, Yi Yun had been searching for a land for his seclusion, firstly to continue refining Myriad Form Shura Pills and secondly, to cultivation in seclusion.

The Heaven Fey City would be good, but Yi Yun was facing the possible pursuit of the Celestials. To further use the Ancestor God's blood to refine pills in Heaven Fey City would only be outright provocation against the Celestials.

The ancient Heaven Fey would not be able to withstand the wrath of the Celestials.

The mountain range he chose was far inferior to the Heaven Fey City's array core in terms of Heaven Earth Yuan Qi.

However, the lack of Heaven Earth Yuan Qi did not concern Yi Yun. The ancient Heaven Fey had provided him with sufficient Chaos Crystals and array formations to make up for that.

"This shall be it."

Jiang Xiaorou nodded. Yi Yun had brought her along with him when he left the ancient Heaven Fey.

Regardless, his strength was the key to everything.

To put it bluntly, the contest for the crown was merely a contest for resources. And now, the Myriad Form Shura Pills that Yi Yun was about to refine were the best kind of resource.

In a relatively long period of time in the near future, Yi Yun would choose to enter seclusion. Jiang Xiaorou naturally had to use this time to enter seclusion with him, so as to evolve her bloodline.

Yi Yun took out a disk array and casually set up a massive array. Instantly, hundreds of kilometers of the mountain range was enveloped within the array. With Yi Yun's present nomological insight, even a Godly Monarch would fail to notice anything off about the forest even if they were standing right there.

Yi Yun selected an inconspicuous mountain and dug open a cave abode that was well-facilitated within its belly.

The cave abode had dozens of chambers of varying sizes. The biggest one was made Yi Yun's alchemy lab.

Connected to the alchemy lab was Yi Yun's and Lin Xintong's master bedroom.

Beside the master bedroom was Shan Ling's room. Yi Yun's seclusion wouldn't be that short, so Shan Ling's presence would help tend to Yi Yun's and Lin Xintong's daily life and deal with some miscellaneous matters.

Yi Yun took out the Ascending Dragon Cauldron and placed it right in the middle of the alchemy lab.

Ever since he left the ancient Heaven Fey, Yi Yun had taken with him all the materials needed to refine the Myriad Form Shura Pills.

Since he had sworn on the Heavenly Dao, the ancient Heaven Fey were not afraid that Yi Yun would misappropriate the pills.

The price of going against his oath was just too much for a warrior like Yi Yun who had an unlimited future ahead of him. It was not worth it just to take the remaining percentage of the pills.

When he placed the alchemical materials in front of him, Yi Yun sighed at how deep the ancient Heaven Fey's heritage went.

A super faction that had existed for billions of years had reserves that were stunning.

Just the Fey cores of a powerful Fey numbered six. Each one had a quality that far exceeded the one Yi Yun bought at the auction.

As for the valuable herbs such as Flying Clouds Flowing Flower, them being a million years old was just the beginning. With these materials, the quality of the cauldron of pills would be greatly enhanced.

But now, Yi Yun was not in a hurry to begin the pill refinement. Instead, he took out two interspatial rings.

They were the rings left behind by Luo King and Ghost Doctor after their deaths.

The heritage of two Godly Monarch level figures!

This was of timely assistance to the presently poor Yi Yun.

His perception delved deep into the Luo King's interspatial ring and took out the items one by one.

The Luo King was an old Fey Thearch among the ancient Heaven Fey. He had accumulated his wealth for years, so it was immense. Inside the interspatial ring, just the Chaos Crystals alone numbered thirty thousand.

Back when Yi Yun refined the first cauldron of Myriad Form Shura Pills, he had sought the Blood King's help. All the Blood King could do was produce a few thousand Chaos Crystals. The rest was obtained from a mortgage of the Treasure Fey Pagoda.

Apart from the Chaos Crystals, there were all sorts of Fey cultivation manuals that numbered more than a hundred.

Yi Yun had no use for them and handed them to Jiang Xiaorou.

The Luo King's cultivation manuals mostly came from the ancient Heaven Fey. Although Jiang Xiaorou had read them previously, the Luo King had left behind his annotations and thoughts in the manuals.

These notes was considered secrets that no Fey Thearch would impart easily.

Jiang Xiaorou already had the Blood King as her teacher, and now, she had the addition of the Luo King. As she studied the insights of the two Fey Thearchs, Jiang Xiaorou resolved some of the questions that plagued her in the past.

Shan Ling, who was also a Fey, enjoyed the benefits as well. Just a sampling of the manuals benefited her greatly.

After the manuals were all sorts of pills, natural treasures, as well as artifacts.

Yi Yun found several Fey bones, Fey cores, and Fey blood in one of the Luo King's chest.

The Luo King also had a Fey Thearch level Fey core!

Yi Yun was about to enter seclusion; therefore, these items were of great use.

As for Ghost Doctor, he was a lot poorer than the Luo King. As a Ghost Doctor, he earned a lot, but his expenditure was great due to his research of all kinds of mystical medicines.

Ghost Doctor's interspatial ring only had 8000 Chaos Crystals.

However, Yi Yun found many exclusive mystic medicines, and a large number of books on alchemy and medicine.

Just the notebooks which Ghost Doctor wrote personally numbered more than ten.

These things were even more detailed and comprehensive than the divine alchemist's notebook that Yi Yun had received previously.

With Yi Yun's foundation, all he needed to do was spend some time reading the material, and his alchemical skills would quickly improve.

In Yi Yun's eyes, the items left behind by the Ghost Doctor were even more valuable than what the Luo King had.

After tidying up everything, Yi Yun began his pill refinement in seclusion.

For this pill refinement, the ancient Heaven Fey provided 15,000 Chaos Crystals and a Spirit Gathering Array.

Now, Yi Yun shattered all the 15,000 Chaos Crystals and created an array core environment in the middle of the Spirit Gathering Array.

Heaven Earth Yuan Qi appeared and instantly condensed into a spirit fountain within Yi Yun's alchemy lab.

This was quite an extravagant act.

With everything in place, Yi Yun's pill refinement process was extremely smooth. In half a year, he refined six cauldrons of Myriad Form Shura Pills.

Every cauldron created phenomena that was more alarming than the one back in Heaven Fey City. However, it was all suppressed by Yi Yun using an array formation.

The six cauldrons of pills made for a total of 72 pills. According to the agreement, Yi Yun took 22 of them.

Out of the 22, Jiang Xiaorou received 4 and the Nine Transformations Celestial Silkworm received 2.

The remaining 16 were used by Yi Yun to consolidate his lifeblood, in preparation for him to make his breakthrough to the Godly Monarch realm.

Yi Yun looked forward to the Godly Monarch realm. He had no idea how strong he would be once he attained it.

Chapter 1678: A Hundred Years

Spring passed, summer went by, and autumn came. At Yi Yun's realm, it was nothing odd for him to seclude himself in cultivation for centuries. For the two patriarchs of Heaven Fey City, it was quite common for their seclusions to use units of ten thousand years.

Yi Yun was undergoing one of the longest seclusions of his life.

He did not keep track of time, only being aware that the moist mud walls of the cave he was in had turned dry with time. Later on, due to the nourishing of the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi, the sand gradually turned into Chaos Ores.

Yi Yun's cave abode had already turned crystalline and would soon turn into a tiny mineral vein.

In the future, Yi Yun would leave behind some array formations and incomplete manuals here when he left. Then, far into the future, this cave abode would turn into a land of opportunity.

Perhaps tens of thousands of years later, someone would find this place by chance and inherit Yi Yun's heritage. Although the items he left would be trivial to him, it was enough to improve the conditions of some poor geniuses.

Years ago, Yi Yun had developed his strength bit by bit in the same way.

During the seclusion, Yi Yun and Jiang Xiaorou naturally did not undergo much change. However, Lin Xintong was different. As she cultivated in the Grand Reincarnation Technique, her originally fifteen-year-old appearance had matured into that of a tall, elegant lady.

After continuous cultivation, Yi Yun internalized all sixteen Myriad Form Shura Pills. The energies in him reached a peak state as his foundation and laws turned completely robust.

However, he was still at the half-step Godly Monarch realm.

It was not easy, even for Yi Yun, to break the shackles that prevented a human from attaining godhood.

"Yi Yun, you have spent about a hundred years in seclusion."

Bai Yueyin's voice suddenly sounded in Yi Yun's soul sea.

"Has it been a hundred years… Time sure passes quickly."

Yi Yun took a deep breath as he stood up from a meditative position.

After Yi Yun made the Heavenly Dao a part of him, his understanding of the Heavenly Dao had been enhanced. He had fully blocked the tracing mark the Ancestor God had left in him. For now, he was still safe.

As such, Yi Yun did not wish to exit seclusion for the time being. If he left, he had to face the pursuit of the Chaos Heavens' Celestials.

"Sis Xiaorou, the deadline of my agreement with the ancient Heaven Fey is approaching. You will have to go and take the Myriad Form Shura Pills back with you," Yi Yun said to Jiang Xiaorou.

"Alright, Yun'er." Jiang Xiaorou nodded. Having been in seclusion for so long, her strength had long improved. Now, it was not a given that an expert from the older generation like Rain Numinous could defeat her easily.

Jiang Xiaorou stored away the fifty Myriad Form Shura Pills and just as she was about to leave the cave abode, Yi Yun's heart palpitated. He looked up and over, sending his senses through the cave abode when he saw a group of human warriors flying through his array formation.

The group of people wore luxurious but damaged clothes. They were injured and they looked rather pathetic.

Their cultivation levels weren't high and they were even fleeing without any direction in mind. Naturally, they had no way to detect the array formation which Yi Yun had set up.

"Imperial Uncle, how's your injury? We can't keep escaping. Why don't we hide here? If we set up a convergence array and fool them, we can go west and escape into the Great West Nation," a youth wearing a robe embroidered with a python said. He wore a crown and although he wasn't old, he already had an air of supremacy.

The person he was speaking to was a long-faced middle-aged man. His face was darkened and his aura weak. Apparently, his body was plagued by demonic auras.

"Imperial Uncle?"

Yi Yun was taken aback. This fleeing group was from the royal family?

On careful thought, when Yi Yun chose the nameless mountain range to build his cave abode, he had a vague idea that it was part of the Taiyue Nation's territory.

He swept with his perception and indeed, he found a dark golden token on the youth's waist. On it were the words "Taiyue."

Could these people be the Taiyue Nation's royal family?

As he looked at the crown on the youth's head, even if he wasn't a king, he was likely a crown prince.

Although the Taiyue Nation wasn't a strong nation, it definitely had the immense heritage to establish itself in the Chaos Heavens. Typically, such a dynasty could last tens to hundreds of thousands of years without a problem.

Now, from the looks of it, the crown prince and imperial uncle were being pursued like wretches. It was likely that the Taiyue Nation was on the brink of collapsing.

What happened to this faction that should have continued on for a long period of time?

Yi Yun was intrigued, but he wasn't planning on being a busybody.

The changing of dynasties was extremely normal.

There was nothing right or wrong, just a conflict between interests.

However… when Yi Yun continued radiating his perception outwards, he was astounded.

He saw… demonic servants!

Large numbers of demonic servants were flying over from afar like locusts. It was an uncountable number!

The Celestial's demonic servants?

Yi Yun was taken aback. The Celestials had a low population and although they reigned supreme in the Chaos Heavens, it was rare to actually see a Celestial.

Typically, the Celestials would send demonic servants to complete anything they wanted.

The number of Celestial demonic servants was terrifying. It was something no race could compare with.

Although the demonic servants were powerful, the Taiyue Nation was a human kingdom. Why would they destroy a human kingdom?

Yi Yun knitted his brows slightly.

The Celestials had power over the Chaos Heavens, but they did not take the initiative to annihilate other races. In fact, although there was animosity among the various races in the Chaos Heavens, all of them avoided battle for no one could bear the consequences of war.

No matter how powerful the Celestials were, they would be in for a tragedy if they infuriated everyone else and caused the other races to join forces against them.

Yi Yun would not have found it odd if the Taiyue Nation had been wiped out by a human faction. However, there was something amiss about the situation if they were being pursued by demonic servants.

With this suspicion in mind, Yi Yun spread out his perception further.

From the direction the demonic servants came from, Yi Yun saw numerous destroyed cities. The demonic servants had left a path of destruction in their wake…

Had the Celestials declared war on the humans?

At that moment, the people from the Taiyue Nation also sensed that the demonic servants were chasing right behind them.

The middle-aged man, who was addressed as Imperial Uncle, wore a rueful expression as he said, "I can't last much longer. Leave first. I'll stay behind. Perhaps, I can still stall for some time."

"Imperial Uncle, you mustn't do so. Even if we need to stall for time, I should be the one doing it. I'm our country's crown prince. I'm already a good-for-nothing who has failed to protect my people. I should be the one stepping forward at this time…" said the crown prince seriously.

"No, you still have many citizens stored within your body's world. They as well as you are the seeds of our Taiyue Nation. You have to escape."

The middle-aged man's face suddenly had an abnormal ruddiness to it as his aura suddenly rose. He obviously planned on making an internecine sacrifice.

The crown prince and company wore looks of anguish. They had already sacrificed too much to escape this far.

And at that moment, they could see a large swath of black clouds far into the distance that nearly blotted out half the sky.

It was no cloud, but demonic servants!

Upon seeing so many demonic servants, the hearts of the Taiyue Nation royal family sank.

Even if the middle-aged man rushed over and self-destructed, it would be nothing more than a spark. It would not be of any help…

The middle-aged man said with a look of grief. "I suppose our Taiyue Nation will be completely destroyed today…"

At that moment, the suddenly felt the space around them warp.

An array formation?

Following that, they saw a huge green demon appear in the air!

Their expressions changed drastically as the behemoth's aura was terrifying. When did their Taiyue Nation ever have such a demonic behemoth?

It did not seem to be associated with the demonic servants due to its completely different aura.

They never expected that their blind escape would end up with them entering a demon's array formation.

"Whatever. Rather than die at the hands of demonic servants, I'd rather feed this demon…" the middle-aged man said with a sigh.

But immediately, they realized that the demon did not even spare them a glance when it appeared. Instead, it turned towards the demonic servants in excitement.

"Hahahaha! Let me have a face off with all of you!"

Poison Demon bared its fangs and swiped its claws as it charged towards the demonic servants!

Dense power blasted out from Poison Demon as it widened its mouth and devoured a huge swath of demonic servants.

In front of it, the demonic servants were unable to put up any resistance.

Poison Demon was excited. During the battle between Yi Yun and the Luo King, it had failed to contribute much. For that, Poison Demon brooded and was eager to find an opportunity to prove itself.

Now, although it was facing demonic servants of low caliber, the numbers were terrifying. To wipe them all out was not a simple task. Of course, only something of difficulty accentuated its value.

At that moment, Poison Demon widened its mouth as an aura that resembled hell emanated and enveloped the demonic servants in layers.

It was already an independent world that no demonic servant was capable of escaping.

"Eat! Eat! Eat!"

Poison Demon's body rapidly swelled like a huge toad that jumped into a pit of worms. The ferocious demonic servants had no means of resisting.

Outside Poison Demon's barrier, the Taiyue Nation warriors were in a daze. What sort of monster was the fellow who suddenly appeared? It was too powerful.

They knew that among the demonic servants, a number of them were demonic generals, which even Royal Sealed Divine Lords did not have an advantage over.

And at that moment, all they felt was a sudden change in scenery. The lush primordial forest and mountains vanished. Even the carnage between the demon and the demonic servants was gone.

For some baffling reason, they had been sent into a spacious cave.

It was dark and quiet, a place rich in Heaven Earth Yuan Qi. The surrounding stone pillars were lined with Chaos Ores, but they had no idea where they were.

At that moment, a black-robed youth appeared in front of the crowd. They failed to sense any Yuan Qi fluctuations from him, as though he was a mortal. But for some reason, they felt like they were facing the expansive cosmos when facing him. He was so enigmatic that he left people fearful and reverent.

The black-robed youth was none other than Yi Yun.

He did not mind exposing his cave abode. After all, with so many demonic servants dead, he could no longer stay in the Taiyue Nation.

The middle-aged man was enlightened as he immediately bowed down. "Senior, thank you for saving my life. I'm Tai Yuankun."

"There's no need." Yi Yun waved his hand indifferently. "Tell me what happened. Why did the Celestials invade your Taiyue Nation? It did nothing to deserve the Celestials' action against it, right?"

Chapter 1679: Unforeseen Circumstances

"Senior, you are absolutely right. To the Celestials, my Taiyue Nation is nothing." Tai Yuankun remained prostrated. Behind him were the Taiyue Nation's crown prince and subjects who also prostrated themselves. "The ones who destroyed my Taiyue Nation are the demonic servants, not the Celestials. In fact, having lived all these years, I have yet to seen a Celestial."

"Actually, it's nothing new for demonic servants to destroy human nations. The earliest instant was three decades ago. A human nation stronger than my Taiyue Nation named the South Court Dynasty was annihilated overnight. The cities were reduced to ruins and the death toll innumerable. Back then, the lord of the South Court Dynasty had a half-step Godly Monarch cultivation level, but he failed to cause so much as a stir in the cataclysm his dynasty faced. He died instantly and did not even leave behind a corpse."

Thinking back to the South Court Dynasty's final fate, the middle-aged man empathized with them for they were now in the same boat.

"In the two to three decades after the South Court Dynasty, there were several human factions of ordinary sizes that were massacred. Later on, the calamity of the demonic servants broke out in my Taiyue Nation. The old king died in battle and, with what I had left in my old life, I lived an abject existence. I risked death to take the crown prince and a few young princes and princesses away to escape the royal capital. We have no intention to reestablish our nation, only to leave behind some survivors of our Taiyue Nation's royalty…"

When the middle-aged man said that, he wore a painful expression. Although it was a deep-seated grudge, exacting revenge was just too difficult.

Yi Yun frowned slightly when he heard that. "Have the Celestials declared war against the humans?"

"No…" The middle-aged man shook his head.

"Since war isn't being waged, why are the demonic servants under the Celestials acting so wantonly by invading human territory? Are the human experts going to watch this happen without batting an eyelid?"

"I'm of inferior standing, so I do not know the full picture. All I've heard are rumors… It's said that the Celestial have control over the Godly Monarch level mighty figures of various races. It's not only limited to us humans. The numbers controlled are massive as though they are plotting something."

"Godly Monarchs are being controlled!?" Yi Yun was alarmed. Regardless of the race, Godly Monarchs were pinnacle existences. How could they be that easily controlled?

It wasn't a surprise if the Celestials controlled a few Godly Monarch figures, but to have many controlled was odd.

How could the experts of other races sit passively awaiting their end?

If the Celestials were overly domineering, it was very likely for all the races in the Chaos Heavens to revolt together.

"Do you know what means the Celestials are using to control the Godly Monarchs of other races?" Yi Yun asked.

The middle-aged man shook his head. "I'm unaware. It's said that the Celestials have produced a peerless expert. He is just too powerful, so powerful that no one dares to resist him…"

"Oh?"

Yi Yun's heart chilled when he heard that. The birth of a peerless expert?

A peerless expert that could become the strongest in the Chaos Heavens was not something that could happen overnight. Either a particular patriarch of the Celestials had broken through, pushing his cultivation level to a brand new level… or…

Yi Yun recalled the Ancestor God.

The Sinkhole's Ancestor God was the strongest person of the Celestials years ago. He was inflicted with such heavy injuries in the ancient war that took him billions of years to recuperate.

According to what Bai Yueyin said, the Ancestor God was about to recover from his injuries a century ago. Not only so, he had continued devouring the Sinkhole's Heavenly Dao.

The moment Yi Yun left, no one in the Sinkhole could resist the Ancestor God. Now, more than a hundred years had passed.

Perhaps, the Ancestor God had already completely fused with the Sinkhole's Heavenly Dao.

In that case, the Ancestor God's strength would naturally reach an incomprehensible state. Even if the various races combined forces, they were hardly a threat to him.

"What is this peerless expert of the Celestials planning?"

Yi Yun asked again, but the middle-aged man shook his head. He was only a trivial figure and knew little.

Yi Yun fell silent. From the looks of it, the situation outside was beyond terrible.

"Does this mean that the demonic servants have been attacking other races as well?"

The middle-aged man nodded. "The Fey have had many smaller factions destroyed by the demonic servants too. However, we humans suffered the most destruction. After the demonic servants annihilated our human nations, they took hold of our lands and made the fallen nations their nests. They began pursuing the hidden and fleeing humans. Now, everyone in the Chaos Heavens are on tenterhooks."

"I understand."

Yi Yun took a deep breath and turned towards Lin Xintong and company. "I believe it's time we leave…"

"Leave? But Yun'er, if the Sinkhole's Ancestor God has really come to the Chaos Heavens, the present you is definitely not his match. You have already repressed his tracing mark, giving you the perfect opportunity to cultivate. If you focus on cultivation and reach the Godly Monarch level, that would be the most sound strategy despite it taking some time.

"When the time comes, you might be able to fight the Ancestor God in a frontal assault! Why are you risking your life leaving seclusion at this time?"

Lin Xintong and Jiang Xiaorou felt that it was just too dangerous to leave.

Yi Yun said, "In a short span of a hundred years, such unforeseen circumstances have happened outside. The Ancestor God isn't that easily dealt with and I have a nagging feeling that the Ancestor God is plotting something grand. And it is of utmost importance!

"If not, he would not risk losing decorum with the other races of the Chaos Heavens by attacking so many Godly Monarch level figures and unleashing the demonic servants to wreak havoc.

"If nothing is done, and we allow the Ancestor God to complete his plan, the situation might turn worse. Xintong, Sis Xiaorou, you might have absolute confidence in me, believing that I can fight the Ancestor God once I become a Godly Monarch, but in fact, that might not be true! Over the billions of years, only the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch has truly slain the Ancestor God. If I were to allow the Ancestor God to set his plans into full motion, perhaps the day I fight him would be fraught with grim possibilities!"

Upon hearing Yi Yun's words, Lin Xintong and Jiang Xiaorou exchanged looks. Indeed, Yi Yun's repeated creation of miracles had given them undue confidence, as though he was capable of accomplishing anything.

But this time, the opponent was too powerful. Nothing in the past was comparable.

"Let's exit seclusion and return to the ancient Heaven Fey first. All of you will hide in the Ascending Dragon Cauldron and are not to expose a sliver of your aura."

Due to his oath on the Heavenly Dao, Yi Yun could not violate his agreement with the ancient Heaven Fey. But at that moment, it was likely that the ancient Heaven Fey had been infiltrated by the Celestials.

Returning to the ancient Heaven Fey was naturally dangerous.

"Alright. Yun-er, you have to be careful!"

As Lin Xintong and Jiang Xiaorou gave their warnings, they flew into the Ascending Dragon Cauldron.

With the Star Transference Heaven Changing Book and Ghost Ming's disguise techniques, Yi Yun changed his looks and aura completely. With his present strength, perhaps only the Ancestor God in person could tell that something was amiss. No one else was capable of identifying him.

"All of you shall stay in this cave abode. You won't be able to leave for now."

Yi Yun opened up a pocket world and sealed his abandoned cave abode. Having slaughtered large numbers of demonic servants, he did not wish for the people of the Taiyue Nation to be discovered for it could easily expose his whereabouts.

The array formation would trap them for at least ten years. The crude ores in the walls could be considered compensation.

Chapter 1680: Punishment of Extreme Hell

A hundred years was sufficient for numerous changes to occur in mortal cities, but to the Heaven Fey City, it was like a finger snap—even the city walls remained untainted despite all this time.

Everything looked identical to the moment before Yi Yun left to go into seclusion.

However, having cultivated to his present stage, Yi Yun was just too strong. His nomological insights were equal to the Heavenly Dao and he could acutely sense every change in the city.

Yi Yun noticed that the nomological patterns engraved in the city were different from a century ago.

The Heaven Fey City's worldly array had been modified!

The Heaven Fey City had been established for billions of years. Its worldly array had existed equally as long. When it came to such an ancient and powerful array formation, any minor change had to be a result of something of great importance.

"If I didn't guess wrong, the Ancestor God has already come to Heaven Fey City. He left something in the Heaven Fey City's main array…" Yi Yun said to Bai Yueyin in his soul sea.

The people in control of Heaven Fey City's main array were the two Fey Patriarchs, and this control was the symbol of them having the highest authority in Heaven Fey City.

And if the Ancestor God wanted to enter Heaven Fey City, the most direct method was to leave a mark of his own in the array. That way, the Heaven Fey City's array formation would be under his command.

"The Ancestor God's strength has already gotten to this level? To make the two Fey Patriarchs endure this in silence…" Bai Yueyin's heart turned heavy.

Yi Yun said, "The Heaven Fey City is important to the ancient Heaven Fey, but if… the Ancestor God clearly threatens the survival of the entire ancient Heaven Fey race, the two Fey Patriarchs can only bow."

If the Ancestor God was powerful enough to easily kill the two Fey Patriarchs and kill a Fey Thearch with a mere thought, what would happen to the ancient Heaven Fey?

In a very short period of time, the Ancestor God would be able to wipe out all the upper echelons of the ancient Heaven Fey. Heaven Fey City would then come under Celestial control without any leadership. They would be akin to a piece of meat to the Celestials, one that could be eaten at any time.

And once the Celestials were sick of it, draining the ancient Heaven Fey dry, they could abandon it without thought. The remaining factions in the Chaos Heavens would then split the ancient Heaven Fey like hyenas. Having lost their race's upper echelons, the ancient Heaven Fey would be completely vulnerable.

There was only one outcome left for them—annihilation.

Compared to being annihilated, handing over some control of Heaven Fey City to the Ancestor God was nothing.

As always, strength was supreme in the Chaos Heavens. One could do anything with strength.

"Yi Yun, if the Heaven Fey City is under Celestial control, there's likely a trap awaiting you," Bai Yueyin said via a voice transmission.

Yi Yun also guessed this was possibility. However, he had sworn on the Heavenly Dao through a contract with the ancient Heaven Fey. He had to deliver the Myriad Form Shura Pills to the ancient Heaven Fey, or he would suffer damage to his Dao heart.

But this matter did not daunt Yi Yun. He still had many means of delivering the Myriad Form Shura Pills to the ancient Heaven Fey. For instance, he could disguise himself, enter the biggest security company, and commission them to deliver it into the Ruins Emperor Palace at high cost. No matter how resourceful and powerful the Celestials were, there was no way they could find him.

As Yi Yun was considering his options, he chanced upon a notice on the Heaven Fey City's walls.

The notice looked somewhat aged and its content roughly depicted an incident—

As the ancient Heaven Fey's Blood King had betrayed the race, Punishment of Extreme Hell had been meted out on him. He is currently serving his punishment.

The notice was dated fifteen years ago.

For a notice to be left there for fifteen years, it was obvious that it was displayed for people to see, or in other words, for Yi Yun specifically.

Punishment of Extreme Hell!

What kind of punishment was that?

Yi Yun's heart sank. His relationship with the Blood King wasn't considered close, but he was Jiang Xiaorou's father and also one of the most important people in Jiang Xiaorou's life.

As for Jiang Xiaorou, she was one of the most important people to Yi Yun.

If Jiang Xiaorou were to learn that the Blood King was suffering the Punishment of Extreme Hell, how would she feel?

Ignorance is bliss, but now that Yi Yun learned of the news, he could no longer sit idle, nor could he keep it from Jiang Xiaorou.

When Yi Yun sent a voice transmission into the Ascending Dragon Cauldron, Jiang Xiaorou's face turned pale upon learning the news.

The outcome of the Punishment of Extreme Hell was uncertain.

If one was punished for months, it would just be a painful torture.

But if the punishment lasted years, or more than a decade, it would be one of the worst death punishments. It was one of the most extreme punishments of the ancient Heaven Fey.

And now, this notice was from fifteen years ago. Didn't it mean that the Blood King's Punishment of Extreme Hell had begun fifteen years ago?

Fifteen years!

The notice had vaguely mentioned the Punishment of Extreme Hell without any mention of time. However, Jiang Xiaorou knew that the Punishment of Extreme Hell would last until her father's vitality was completely worn out!

Ever since the Heaven Fey City was established, the Punishment of Extreme Hell was very seldomly used on their own Fey Thearchs. But because of her, her father had suffered this punishment.

What about her mother? What happened to her mother?

Instantly, Jiang Xiaorou's heart palpitated. Her father was a Fey Thearch and capable of withstanding torture. However, her mother lacked the strength to suffer any heavy punishments.

Jiang Xiaorou was gripped by anxiety, but she did not say what was on her mind. She also understood that all of this was caused by Yi Yun, but with his present strength, he was no match for the Ancestor God. To make Yi Yun rescue her parents would be akin to pushing him to the edge of a cliff.

"Sis Xiaorou, don't worry. This matter might not be as bad as you imagine…"

Yi Yun projected an avatar into the Ascending Dragon Cauldron and appeared before Jiang Xiaorou.

"Yun'er, I do not know what to do." Jiang Xiaorou did not wish for Yi Yun to worry, but she could not stop her tears from flowing. She hated herself for being too weak. There was nothing she could do.

Yi Yun said, "Although I haven't had many interactions with the Ancestor God, I can sense that he's a cold person who thinks little of life. He wishes to have the universe in his grasp and is very ambitious. Such a person does deserve being called god.

"With the Ancestor God's status and strength, I find it hard to believe that he will torture and imprison someone who's not very related to me to force my appearance. As he stands at such a lofty position, you can say that he disdains pulling such petty tricks. You can also say that he projects his coldness onto others. Regardless, do you think that if someone was enjoying the same status as I am, they would care about the Blood King?"

"Yun'er, do you mean…" Jiang Xiaorou was slightly taken aback. On careful thought, Yi Yun's position was indeed sufficiently high. To others, Fey Thearchs were impressive figures, but they were not necessarily so to Yi Yun.

At Yi Yun's level—ignoring the Ancestor God—even the two patriarchs of Heaven Fey City would not be easily threatened by one or two lives. What's more, these lives did not have much of a relationship with them.

Yi Yun said, "I feel that the person who targeted Blood King is someone else!"

Previously, the Taiyue Nation's royalty had mentioned that the Ancestor God was plotting something major. Under such circumstances, would he have the time or effort to handle such trivialities?

Chapter 1681: Soul-devouring Bone Grinding

Clouds hung low in the crimson sky as though they would unload their burgeoning load at any time. The land was covered with jagged boulders which were covered with layers of gray powder.

The powder was a result of years of weathering after the crumbling of bones.

In the middle of this world was a marsh. Instead of mud, the marsh was filled with sticky liquid that resembled flesh and blood.

This was where the Punishment of Extreme Hell happened. It was filled with the aura of evil, decay, savagery, and death.

In ancient times, before the Heaven Fey City was established, the land where it was located was a terrifying forbidden zone, known as the No Return For Thearchs. This was because even Fey Thearchs would perish upon entering.

And such a forbidden zone had been conquered by a peerless Fey expert, resulting in the establishment of Heaven Fey City.

But no matter how powerful the peerless expert was, he failed to completely purify the evil and dark entities in the forbidden zone. He eventually had to cast a powerful divine power, carving out an independent space beneath Heaven Fey City to seal all of the evil inside.

This was the underground Extreme Hell.

After billions of years, the various evil powers in the Extreme Hell had weakened, but they still existed.

The Punishment of Extreme Hell was to seal the punishee within the blood prison and use their lifeblood as a sacrifice to the evil demons within.

Typically, warriors beneath the level of a Fey Lord were only qualified to be sealed in the periphery of the Extreme Hell.

Only Fey Thearchs were sealed in the middle where the marsh of blood and flesh was.

At that moment, there was a man situated in the middle of the marsh. More than half his body, all the way to his chest was buried beneath the marsh.

He was none other than the Blood King.

Compared to the day when Yi Yun transcended the tribulations, Blood King looked a lot more haggard. He was nothing but skin and bones, and his body was covered in wounds. The sinister objects within the Extreme Hell marsh were like maggots which formed countless threads that bonded to Blood King's wounds and sucked at his lifeblood powers.

Such pain went deep into the body and soul, making it a pain more intensive than that of being dismembered.

However, Blood King kept his eyes tightly shut. He slept in the marsh and showed no reaction.

He was still alive and, despite the torture, the lifeblood in him remained potent and exuberant.

It was truly incredible that he was still in such a state despite enduring for fifteen years.

"As expected of someone who cultivates in the Indestructible Killing Dao. Apparently, he suits this place well."

At that moment, three additional figures suddenly appeared in the blood prison.

The person in the middle was tens of feet tall and loomed over all like a tower. His body suffused a bronze glow and he carried a gigantic black battle ax on his back which burned with a red sanguine glow. The banal aura was domineering!

He was a Celestial expert!

If Yi Yun was here, he would have recognized him immediately. The Celestial expert was Divine General Sanguine Ax whom he had met in the Xuanyuan Dune!

Back when Yi Yun fought Sanguine Ax in the Xuanyuan Dune, he had completely repressed him and siphoned off a portion of his Divine Blood Origins.

The Divine Blood Origins of Celestials were extremely valuable, to the point where replenishment was just too difficult. To Sanguine Ax, it was definitely an irreconcilable grudge.

However, knowing that he was not Yi Yun's match, Sanguine Ax had tolerated it back then.

Not only so, he had even torn open space to escape!

Having had his Divine Blood Origins siphoned, all he could do was flee. This was utterly insulting to Sanguine Ax.

Furthermore, Yi Yun had snatched his opportunity from him in the Xuanyuan Dune. If a ranking of living people who hated Yi Yun the most was tabulated, the person that would come out on top was definitely Divine General Sanguine Ax.

Sanguine Ax's attempt to monopolize the Heavenly Dao fragment for himself was a grave sin, but as he had some familial relationship with the Ancestor God, he was pardoned.

Not only so, he had even replenished the Divine Blood Origins which Yi Yun had siphoned off. His cultivation level and bloodline improved and it could be said that he had soared into prominence.

Having returned, the Ancestor God was focused on executing his plans. Sanguine Ax was servile to him and did special "chores" for the Ancestor God.

Of course, these so-called "chores" were astounding matters to the ordinary person.

For instance, annihilating more than a hundred factions of different races—one of them being the Taiyue Nation.

Another "chore" was to deal with the Blood King!

A large part of the reason why Sanguine Ax had done so was to breed demonic servants.

The Ancestor God's plan needed many demonic servants. As for the dissociation and growth of demonic servants, they all needed sustenance. The stronger the warrior, the greater sustenance they provided.

Previously, when factions like the Taiyue Nation fell, most of its citizens were devoured by demonic servants.

Such matters naturally incurred the displeasure of various races.

Fey Thearchs had resisted, but their outcomes… were tragic without exception.

The Blood King was one of them.

Back then, one of the Fey tribes under the Blood King was vanquished by the demonic servants—the tribesmen were all eaten.

The Blood King took action and killed large numbers of demonic servants and this infuriated the Celestials.

The Blood King was not worthy enough for the Ancestor God to take action. What truly repressed the Blood King was an Ancestor God Token!

The Ancestor God had created twelve Ancestor God Tokens. Each token had one of his lifeblood avatars sealed within.

These Ancestor God Tokens were distributed to loyal subordinates. And someone like Divine General Sanguine Ax was naturally given control over an Ancestor God Token.

Blood King was completely no match for the Ancestor God's lifeblood avatar. After an intense battle, Blood King was crushed and suffered an abject defeat.

He fell into the hands of Sanguine Ax and as Sanguine Ax's hared for Yi Yun went deep, he was eager to torture anyone related to Yi Yun.

Therefore, Blood King was banished into the Extreme Hell and suffered the daily turmoil of having his soul devoured and his bones ground.

Sanguine Ax wished to see how long Blood King could last. When the time came, he would feed his remains and lifeblood to demonic generals.

Meanwhile, the notice regarding the Blood King's Punishment of Extreme Hell was plastered on the city walls by Sanguine Ax. In the event the retarded Yi Yun had the foolish idea of trying to rescue Blood King, he would have rendered a great service to the Ancestor God.

"He who understands the times is a wise man. The Blood King deserves such a state for being impenetrably thickheaded."

Of the two people by Sanguine Ax's side, one was a demonic general, while the other was a Fey Thearch from the ancient Heaven Fey. He was none other than the Heaven Fey Relic Pagoda's Pagoda Lord, Jiang Lichen.

Jiang Lichen was the best alchemist in Heaven Fey City, and as such, always wished to obtain Yi Yun's secret to alchemy. However, Yi Yun was just too powerful and he was not his match at all. Therefore, he could only rein in his ambitions.

Later, the Ancestor God appeared, showcasing strength tens of times or even a hundred times greater than Yi Yun's.

Worst of all, the Ancestor God knew of a tracing mark that could be planted with a mere thought. There was no way of escaping the mark.

Later on, regardless of where one were, the Ancestor God would be able to find them.

If one had thoughts of rebellion, the Ancestor God could easily destroy them, for there was nowhere to run.

Jiang Lichen had such a tracing mark planted in him; therefore, he had no choice but to submit to the Ancestor God. He decided that he might as well pledge absolute allegiance to the Ancestor God because perhaps by doing so, he could obtain Yi Yun's alchemical secrets before he was annihilated by the Ancestor God.

Chapter 1682: Soul Search

Unbeknown to the conversing Jiang Lichen and Sanguine Ax, a perception had already projected into this independent world.

With Yi Yun's present realm and nomological insight, there was no independent space he could not find.

Yi Yun naturally saw the Blood King and even into the inside of his body, where he was surprised to sense an inchoate demonic servant.

The inchoate demonic servant was still in gestation while it siphoned the Blood King's powers.

The demonic servant's bloodline was extremely powerful. If it devoured the Blood King before completing its gestation, it would probably possess strength at the Fey Thearch level.

Had the Celestials become that overbearing? To use a Godly Monarch level figure of another race to gestate a demonic servant?

"Yi Yun, the Blood King has been sealed within the array formation. Furthermore, there are restraints on him. The moment you touch the Blood King, you will immediately trigger the array formation. Furthermore, the Ancestor God will be informed."

The Blood King was a trap which Sanguine Ax had set up in wait for Yi Yun.

However, Yi Yun thought nothing of it as he said, "No, the only person that I'm afraid of in the Chaos Heavens is the Ancestor God. This array formation was not set up by the Ancestor God after all. The person who is really torturing the Blood King is Sanguine Ax and this array formation is likely a product of the Celestial heritage.

Yi Yun's guess was right. The array formation in the Extreme Hell was indeed an ancient demon suppression array Sanguine Ax had taken from the Celestials.

From Sanguine Ax's point of view, this array was extremely impressive. The land of Celestial heritage was only an enhanced version of the same demon suppression array.

Even if the demon suppression array was unable to suppress Yi Yun, it had to be able to trap him for a moment. That was enough time for him to inform the Ancestor God of Yi Yun's appearance.

Yi Yun silently probed the demon suppression array in the Extreme Hell.

As he stood at the height of the Heavenly Dao, nothing could hide from him. Slowly, Yi Yun could see through everything within the array formation.

The corners of his lips suffused a sliver of killing intent. "I'm increasingly certain of my previous guess. The Ancestor God is plotting something. As for the other upper echelons of the Celestials… They believe me to be prey, but I'm actually the hunter!"

As Yi Yun spoke, he gently waved his hand. The surrounding nomological space instantly changed. He tore open a brand new space out of the Extreme Hell.

At that moment, Sanguine Ax was still conversing with Jiang Lichen when they suddenly felt the scene around them change. It left them alarmed!

The flesh-and-blood marsh vanished, as well as the boulders covered in thick bone powdered. They were standing in a pitch dark space and standing before them was a single person!

Even Sanguine Ax and Jiang Lichen were unable to react in time towards such a sudden unexpected change. With their strength, how could they be transported by someone else without them realizing it?

"You… You are Yi Yun!?"

Sanguine Ax widened his eyes as his heart palpitated.

How was it possible? There was a trap laid in the Extreme Hell; yet, Yi Yun had abducted both them both as though it was an unguarded space. Had the demon suppressing array lost its effect?

Sanguine Ax believed that he already had a high estimate of Yi Yun, but he never expected him to reach such a powerful state. It was completely unreasonable.

With a thought, a token appeared in his hand.

This was the Ancestor God Token, and sealed within was one of the Ancestor God's spiritual avatars.

As long as the spiritual avatar was activated, the Ancestor God would immediately sense the area. When that happened, Yi Yun was doomed.

However, the moment the Ancestor God Token was taken out, Sanguine Ax suddenly felt a crushing pressure extend towards him. Purple lightning and black flames were conjured out of thin air and bore into Sanguine Ax's body like venomous snakes.

The lightning and flames permeated every inch of his flesh and went deep into his meridians.

"Pa! Pa! Pa!"

Sanguine Ax's body resisted vehemently, but the strength of the lightning and fire was just too potent. It instantly obliterated the divine strength within Sanguine Ax's body.

At that moment, he felt that just a slight motion would cause the terrifying powers within his body to explode and turn him to ash.

Instantly, Sanguine Ax broke out into cold sweat.

He had planned on using the demon suppression array to stall Yi Yun while he activated the Ancestor God Token, but in fact, the demon suppression array was completely useless as it was instantly taken down.

Despite being a high and mighty divine general, he wasn't even able to trigger the Ancestor God Token in time.

The difference in strength left him in despair.

"Sanguine Ax, you were not my match a hundred years ago in the Xuanyuan Dune, much less now…"

As Yi Yun spoke, he walked towards Sanguine Ax and under his intense gaze, casually took away the Ancestor God Token.

And standing beside Sanguine Ax, Jiang Lichen's hands were clammy with sweat. Logically speaking, Yi Yun's strength should have reached a bottleneck if he did not break through to the Godly Monarch realm. Although his strength might be slightly higher than a hundred years ago, it wouldn't be that obvious.

But now, Yi Yun's strength was a lot higher than back when he slew the Luo King.

The root of the problem was that Yi Yun's cultivation level had risen too quickly previously. It did not have the time to consolidate.

After a hundred years, Yi Yun spared no cost to expend all the resources the Luo King and Ghost Doctor had left behind. Together with the Myriad Form Shura Pills, it made his foundation extremely robust. He was then able to fully express his nomological insights and lifeblood powers.

With the Ancestor God Token in hand, Yi Yun sensed the terrifying aura contained within it without any probing.

If Sanguine Ax had triggered the token, things would have been troublesome.

He casually produced a seal and sealed the Ancestor God Token.

Immediately following that, Yi Yun suddenly appeared in front of Sanguine Ax and threw out a punch.

Boom! Boom! Boom! Boom!

Yi Yun's fists rained down on Sanguine Ax's body, and each punch shattered his bones as his body ruptured with sprays of blood.

In just an instant, Sanguine Ax was covered in blood. The core divine patterns in his body had been brutally destroyed by Yi Yun.

Sanguine Ax spat out large mouthfuls of dark golden blood as his massive body flew backward and crashed heavily into the ground.

At that instant, Sanguine Ax was ashen. He knew that his divine body had been crippled by Yi Yun.

"You managed to escape back in the Xuanyuan Dune. You would have been fine if you had stayed hidden. Yet, you had to court death by returning. In that case, let me gather some information regarding the Ancestor God from you."

As Yi Yun spoke, he pressed down at Sanguine Ax's glabella with one hand as mental powers surged into his head like a tide.

Sanguine Ax's body quivered as his soul sea felt excruciating pain.

His soul was being searched by Yi Yun.

If he were a human or Fey warrior, such a violent way of soul searching would have scattered his soul. However, the Celestials were abnormally talented, allowing him to withstand the soul search.

As such, Yi Yun was able to easily read all his memories regarding the Ancestor God.

Chapter 1683: The Ancestor God's Ploy

After searching Sanguine Ax's soul, Yi Yun obtained a lot of information regarding the Ancestor God's recent actions. With that, along with his own conjectures, he finally guessed at the ploy the Ancestor God was planning.

This was something that shook Yi Yun both in body and mind.

If he did not guess wrong, the Ancestor God's final goal was to devour the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao!

The rank of the Chaos Heavens was much higher than the Sinkhole's!

As such, the Heavenly Dao forces in the Chaos Heavens far exceeded the Sinkhole's.

If it were the former Ancestor God, he would be completely powerless when faced with the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, but now, having refined the Sinkhole's Heavenly Dao for himself, he now possessed the strength to do so!

Once he refined the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao for himself, what kind of cultivation level would the Ancestor God attain?

It was completely unimaginable!

No matter how much of a genius Yi Yun was, what could he do against an Ancestor God who mastered the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao?

If the Chaos Heavens itself was under the Ancestor God's control, how was Yi Yun to defeat him in it? Was it even possible?

It could be said that when that happened, the entire Chaos Heavens would be the Ancestor God's territory.

The Ancestor God could fuse with the Chaos Heavens and with a flip of his hand summon the elements. He would be heaven and person combined, completely unassailable!

As for Yi Yun, obtaining even a sliver of strength from the Chaos Heavens would become impossibly difficult. Not only would he have to face the Ancestor God, he would be facing the rejection of the entire Chaos Heavens.

Under such circumstances, Yi Yun might even be instantly killed!

Bai Yueyin said, "Yi Yun, if your guess is right, the Ancestor God has gone through destruction to reestablish himself. It's like gaining a new lease on life. His strength is already completely incomparable to what it was in that ancient battle a billion years ago. Back then, it hadn't been easy for him to devour the Sinkhole's Heavenly Dao which gave us the opportunity to attack him.

"From the looks of it, the Ancestor God did not spend much effort hunting for you because of his more important goal. He now has enough strength to make the various factions in the Chaos Heavens submit to him. No one can stop him, which is why you aren't within the Ancestor God's sights."

Yi Yun nodded. He was indeed somewhat lacking when stacked against the Ancestor God's supreme goal.

"We can talk about this later. I'll first rescue the Blood King."

Yi Yun flew up and instantly, he appeared in the middle of the Extreme Hell.

At that moment, the Blood King's eyes were tightly shut as his body was buried deep inside the blood marsh. Even his breathing had come to a halt.

If not for his still potent lifeblood powers, he would look no different from a corpse.

"Senior Blood King, I'm here to save you."

With a beckon, Yi Yun pulled the Blood King out of the marsh.

As for the array formation, Yi Yun had long cracked it.

With a flick of his finger, a pill flew into the Blood King's mouth. It was none other than a Myriad Form Shura Pill!

Yi Yun still had several Myriad Form Shura Pills left. Due to his Heavenly Dao oath, he could not touch the Myriad Form Shura Pills reserved for the ancient Heaven Fey, but he still had a few reserved for the Nine Transformations Celestial Silkworm.

Yi Yun could temporarily use these few pills to help the Blood King.

The moment the Myriad Form Shura Pill entered his body, their essence immediately fused into his Heaven Fey bloodline.

Simultaneously, with a thought, the Azure Wood Divine Tree appeared behind Yi Yun. Emerald-green vines flew into the Blood King's body as they burrowed deep into his meridians.

At that moment, a tragic scream suddenly sounded from within Blood King's body. It was akin to the wail of evil demons being tortured.

Moments later, the Azure Wood Divine Tree retracted all the vines from the Blood King's body. At the end of the vines were blobs of black flesh and blood.

"Zhi! Zhi! Zhi!"

The black flesh and blood struggled and squirmed in an extremely ferocious manner. It was the demonic general embryo that had been planted inside the Blood King's body.

This embryo was considered royalty among the demonic servants; otherwise, it would not have the right or strength to devour a Fey Thearch's lifeblood.

It sensed the danger as its black flesh squirmed. Hidden in it was a mouth lined with two rows of sharp teeth.

It roared at Yi Yun who simply sneered and said indifferently, "Eat it!"

"Puah!"

The flesh and blood was instantly torn apart by the Azure Wood Divine Tree's numerous vines. Black blood scattered and was completely absorbed by the Azure Wood Divine Tree, leaving not one bit left.

With that, the demonic general embryo perished and became nutrients for the Azure Wood Divine Tree.

After obtaining the nourishment of such a high-ranking demonic general embryo, the Azure Wood Divine Tree enjoyed a rise in strength.

"I'm…" Following that, a frail voice sounded as Blood King opened his eyes. The medicinal essence of the Myriad Form Shura Pill in him had melted, igniting his lifeblood and turning him into a burning cauldron.

His strength was slowly recovering.

"Father!" Jiang Xiaorou jumped into the Blood King's embrace. Filled with worry, she asked, "Where's Mother?"

"Your mother is in my mobile abode."

Jiang Xiaorou heaved a long-awaited sigh of relief. Her heart had shrank when she saw only her father. She was afraid to hear that her mother was gone.

By storing her mother in his mobile abode, it was apparent that the Blood King was prepared to die with her. To his surprise, Yi Yun had rescued them from such a perilous situation.

This was something that left him greatly indebted.

"Young Brother Yi, no words can adequately express my gratitude for your help. In the future, this life of mine is yours."

"Senior, don't say that. Besides, your suffering of the Punishment of Extreme Hell is partially because of me. Furthermore, it's not time to talk about these…"

As Yi Yun spoke, he recounted the experience of the soul search…

"Devour the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao!?"

Blood King was alarmed upon hearing that. "Even the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao can be devoured?"

Yi Yun said, "That's likely the case. According to Sanguine Ax's memories, the patriarchs of various major factions have been found and planted with tracking marks by the Ancestor God. Now, all of them are setting up a massive array of immense proportions. It's likely the final preparation before the Ancestor God devours the Heavenly Dao. He had set it up decades ago…"

Bai Yueyin said, "This situation is identical to the one a billion years ago. Back then, the Ancestor God had set up a massive array in the Sinkhole. If the present situation is similar to that of the past, the Ancestor God himself is presiding in the middle of the array to watch over everything.

"With the Ancestor God presiding and guarding the array himself, it will be nearly impossible for us to destroy it."

Yi Yun nodded. "Even so, there are benefits to having the Ancestor God preside over the array formation himself. That way, he will not be able to divert strength elsewhere. It would result in our actions in the Chaos Heavens going unnoticed for a while…"

"Oh? You have a plan?" The Blood King was taken aback. With his inconsequential strength, it was already difficult to ensure self-preservation, much less threaten the Ancestor God.

Yi Yun shook his head. "All I can say is we take a step at a time. Our situation isn't that terrible yet. Although the difference in strength appears stark, the Ancestor God's strength hasn't been consolidated. He forcefully made the various Chaos Heavens factions submit to him and made Godly Monarch level figures serve him, and even fed large numbers of clansmen to the demonic servants. Such actions will definitely incur the displeasure of various major factions."

"The Ancestor God has several cooperating factors that he is exploiting, but he lacks the cooperation of the people. We might be able to use this…"

As Yi Yun spoke, he clenched his fists lightly. With the situation developing to this point, he could only take a risk.

Chapter 1684: Ignoring The Rules

Situated inside a huge floating palace were golden mats. Each mat was five meters in diameter, as large as a wrestling ring.

These were mats that were typically used by Celestials.

But now, sitting on these mats were experts from different races.

There were both men and woman, and they came from the Soul race, the Fey race, and the human race. Gathered together, the energy fluctuations they emitted caused even the very laws to quake.

These people were all Godly Monarch level experts. And among these Godly Monarchs, many of them were peak existences. A few of them were already at the patriarch level.

The two patriarchs of the Fey race were also among them.

Having this group of people gathered together could be described as having the strongest powers of the Chaos Heavens concentrated in one place. Any decision they made could determine the fate of the Chaos Heavens.

But now… all of them had heavy hearts as a dark cloud hung over their heads.

Every one of them was planted with the Ancestor God's tracing mark.

Many of them didn't even know when the Ancestor God had planted the mark in them. As for these marks, no one had the means to remove them.

Decades ago, the Ancestor God had appeared in front of all of them. Back then, he already possessed the power of the Heavenly Dao. It prevented people from having any thoughts of resistance.

However, when the Ancestor God revealed his ambition—to rule over the entire Chaos Heavens—there were people who stood forward to resist him.

It was not only the Blood King. There were many from other races, but it was because of their resistance that the others were thrown into despair. With a mere thought, the Ancestor God subdued the resistance.

The Godly Monarchs who resisted were all made into vessels to nurture demonic servants. Now, all of them were living lives worse than death.

In a way, the Chaos Heavens had turned into a land of wailing and despair.

The strength of the Ancestor God had clearly exceeded the peerless Fey Ancestor from billions of years ago. Only Human Emperor who appeared later could beat him.
