People felt grateful to the Human Emperor when contrasting him to the Ancestor God. If the Human Emperor had ruled by oppression, Godly Monarchs of that era would have had to live with their lives with their tails between their legs. They would be no different from slaves.

The greatest fear in a martial world was the appearance of an expert that tipped the balance. In front of such people, all rules became invalid. If the expert turned extremely ambitious, the entire Chaos Heavens would end up in peril.

"Another ten years have passed… We finally completed it in the time given…" a male human said with a sigh.

He was a human patriarch—Polar Thearch. The return of the Ancestor God immediately spelled trouble for the various patriarchs.

"According to the Ancestor God's instructions, we have set up the first two levels of the array formation. Every level takes ten years. Now, it's time we obtain the equipment needed for the third level's array formation, such as array flags and disk arrays…" Patriarch Grand Primordium from the Fey race said.

His voice sounded helpless. They had gathered here in the Celestial Palace to report on the completion of their mission and to receive a new one.

They did various things for the Ancestor God, but every mission they completed felt like they were digging their own graves deeper and deeper.

"What do you think the purpose of such a large-scaled worldly array is?" a female Soul Patriarch suddenly asked.

She was Wind Empress.

Her question caused everyone's hearts to palpitate.

The Ancestor God had them setting up the array for more than twenty years. They had naturally investigated the ultimate goal the Ancestor God had.

Everyone present was knowledgeable. With the passage of time, many people had some guesses.

However, the guess most of them came to was just too astonishing. They did not even wish to consider the problem and even subconsciously tried to avoid it.

Now that the array was beginning its third stage, they could no longer ignore the question when Wind Empress raised it.

"At the Ancestor God's level, nothing matters to him. What he wants is likely the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, right?"

This was said via voice transmission by Polar Thearch. They were in a Celestial palace after all.

"After the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao is devoured by the Ancestor God, our strength will likely decline sharply…"

"It will be weakened by at least thirty percent. The power of the Heavenly Dao would no longer be usable by us. When that happens, the Chaos Heavens will become the private domain of the Ancestor God. Resistance would be even more impossible…

"Furthermore, in time to come, it will become even harder to break through to the Godly Monarch realm in the Chaos Heavens. Perhaps, many geniuses will be stuck at the Godly Monarch bottleneck, never to improve. Even if they were lucky enough to break through to the Godly Monarch realm, they would not be as strong as the Godly Monarchs of the past. Furthermore, every time they take action, they would have to pay a non-negligible price for not being able to borrow the powers of the Heavenly Dao."

The person who spoke was War Excellency Sky Punishment, another human patriarch. He had described the situation that the Sinkhole was presently experiencing.

Hundreds of millions of years ago, the Sinkhole's Heavenly Dao was chipped. It caused Godly Monarchs to become rare occurrences in the Sinkhole. Even if someone broke through, the cost of taking action was just too high. As such, many Godly Monarchs chose to recluse themselves.

The martial path of the Sinkhole had basically been castrated by the Ancestor God.

Now, the Chaos Heavens was on the same path, and this was an outcome no Godly Monarch wished to see.

If that happened, the Chaos Heavens would slowly decline, never to return to its former glory.

Polar Thearch interlocked his fingers and held them to his forehead. He said with a heavy voice, "We cannot let this continue. If the array is completed, we would become the worst sinners in the history of the Chaos Heavens."

Everyone fell silent before Wind Empress shook her head. "Polar, it's easier said than done. How can we fight back? You should know that the Ancestor God can set up the array even without us. It will just take him more time and effort. Do you think we can really stop him?"

"Besides, if we were to resist, we could all be wiped out by the Ancestor God. When that happens, the demonic servant seeds he planted in our bodies would gestate into a bunch of high-ranking demonic generals. These things would be more obedient than us and fully capable of setting up the array for the Ancestor God…"

Wind Empress sighed as she spoke. It was a long sigh and what she said made everyone feel despair.

Resistance was futile. Their continued survival was only granted by the Ancestor God. Such a life was an abject existence. What was the point of reaching their present heights from all that cultivation?

"How would we know failure is certain if we don't try? If we can also find an ancient array formation, we can combine all the strength of the Godly Monarch level experts in the Chaos Heavens as one, and we might be able to deal a severe blow to the Ancestor God." Polar Thearch insisted, but he knew very well that having all the Godly Monarch level figures in the Chaos Heavens join forces was easier said than done.

The number of Godly Monarch level figures who were planted with tracing marks were the minority. Many of them did not wish to be embroiled in the maelstrom.

With so many Godly Monarch level figures, it was difficult for there to be any unity. Besides, the most critical point was that any one of them could betray the others in exchange for opportunities bestowed by the Ancestor God.

As long as there was a single betrayer, they were doomed.

The Godly Monarchs were discussing over voice transmissions when an indescribable oppression dawned on them. It left them stifled as they looked up. They saw an extensive red flame that appeared out of thin air and gradually, it manifested into the form of a gigantic man…

Chapter 1685: Heavenly Courts

Ancestor God!

Everyone's hearts skipped a beat when they saw the man appear out of thin air. They felt a shudder down their backs.

This was actually not the Ancestor God in person, only a mental projection. He had the ability to project his mental form anywhere that had his tracing mark.

Everyone stood up and faced the Ancestor God's mental projection. They felt a suppression on a spiritual level.

Silence…

Although the Ancestor God did not speak, everyone felt immense pressure. It felt as though the air had solidified due to the pressure, making it difficult to breathe.

Everyone was feeling uneasy due to the fact that they were just discussing resisting the Ancestor God via voice transmission.

The silence that could drive people crazy lasted for a full fifteen minutes until… the Ancestor God spoke. His voice was deep and full as it went straight into the soul.

"The third stage of the array needs to be completed in ten years!"

As he spoke, his gaze locked onto Polar Thearch.

Polar Thearch felt his heart quake when their gaze met. His soul sea trembled for the Ancestor God's gaze seemed to penetrate his soul sea defenses and go straight into the core of his soul!

"I'll be borrowing a few of your disciples," said Ancestor God slowly.

"What!?" Polar's heart tightened. He immediately wished to refuse, but at that moment, a powerful nomological force swept over the entire space and closed in around him. He found his body instantly restrained and following that, he felt a spatial attack. Two young Godly Monarchs from his faction who stood behind him were instantly devoured by space!

In just an instant, two young Godly Monarchs had vanished from Polar's perception.

Polar felt his heart gripped tightly as he could only feel stifled.

The two young Godly Monarchs were juniors Polar thought most highly of. If not for the Ancestor God's planting of a tracing mark in them, he would never have let them participate in the setup of the array.

Now that they had been sealed in an alternate space-time dimension by the Ancestor God, their outcome was a mystery…

This was a warning and a threat from the Ancestor God!

Although the Ancestor God was unable to listen in on the Yuan Qi voice transmissions among the Godly Monarchs, he could delve deep into their souls and sense the hatred they had.

He was soon finishing his seclusion to complete the final stage of the array. At this moment, he would be somewhat spread thin, so he could not allow for any mishaps to happen to the array.

If these Godly Monarchs began a mutiny and destroyed his array, he could kill them all, but venting his anger would be meaningless. All his time and effort would be wasted. He would have to regather the array materials wasted, and this was easier said than done.

The Ancestor God left, leaving behind a spatial bracer.

All the materials needed for the array, and the jade slips which contained the array setup instructions were stored in the spatial bracer.

Polar picked up the spatial bracer with an extremely mixed expression.

He had no idea if his two disciples would be able to keep their lives, but it was a possibility if he diligently finished the third stage of the array within ten years.

But when that happened, the Ancestor God would devour the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao.

It was a bitter pill…

Many people had such a feeling and felt that they needed to do something.

"Say, what stage do you think Yi Yun will cultivate to? Will he be able to match the Human Emperor of the past?" War Excellency Sky Punishment suddenly commented.

Everyone was taken aback hearing that.

Yi Yun… This name had already vanished for a hundred years. To the Chaos Heavens, a hundred years was like a fingersnap.

But in these hundred years, too many things had happened. It made people feel as if Yi Yun had vanished for a long time.

"Sky Punishment, don't tell me you are counting on Yi Yun to fight off the Ancestor God?" Polar shook his head. Back when the Ancestor God suddenly appeared, many people did have such a thought, especially the humans. They treated Yi Yun as their hope.

However, when the Ancestor God's motives were made known, everyone felt a little despair.

If the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao wasn't devoured by the Ancestor God, Yi Yun might really be able to compare with the Human Emperor from the past. Unfortunately, the Ancestor God could not give Yi Yun the chance to develop his strength.

After the Ancestor God fused with the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, even Yi Yun's breakthrough to the Godly Monarch realm would be obstructed. Although he might be able to eventually break through, he wouldn't be able to demonstrate the strength of a Godly Monarch in the Chaos Heavens.

As for the Ancestor God, his strength would become unassailable. For Yi Yun to attempt matching the Ancestor God, it was no different from pitting an egg against a stone.

"What a pity. If Yi Yun had been born ten thousand years earlier, perhaps the Ancestor God would not be his match now."

Polar sighed and did not think about it further. He had heard that Yi Yun was not a local of the Chaos Heavens and it was likely he would ultimately leave the Chaos Heavens and return to his original world. However… he still needed to deal with the pursuit of the Ancestor God.

"Let's set up the array."

Polar waved his hand and took the spatial bracer. He distributed the materials according to the information contained in the jade slip.

After which, Polar and Sky Punishment left together.

They came from the same human faction, a faction known as the Heavenly Courts.

It was also the leader of all the human factions.

In fact, in the Chaos Heavens, many races had an absolutely powerful faction leading them. These factions gathered the strongest experts of the race.

These super factions would take the initiative to absorb these top experts into them by providing very generous conditions. Because only by doing so would they be able to find their place in the Chaos Heavens. It allowed all the top experts to be cohesive so as to achieve balance with the other races.

The headquarters of the Heavenly Courts were situated in the Heavenly Palace. Like Heaven Fey City, the Heavenly Palace held down a wide distribution of spirit veins and the Heavenly Palace was situated in the middle of the spirit veins.

The richness of the Yuan Qi there was in no way inferior to that of Heaven Fey City.

Polar Thearch and War Excellency Sky Punishment returned to Heaven Fey City with ashen expressions. They had brought more than ten disciples along with them to the Ancestor God's palace, but returned with two missing. It was embarrassing that they could not even protect their own disciples.

"Patriarch is back."

The moment Polar and Sky Punishment entered the Heavenly Palace, many human experts came to receive them. In recent years, the humans had fallen completely under the control of the Celestials. To have so many people head to the Ancestor God's palace left humanity on tenterhooks, afraid that something would happen.

"Sigh…" Polar sighed when he saw the welcoming crowd.

When the crowd saw the duo's expression, they felt something amiss, as if…

"Patriarch… Where's… Where's my father? Why isn't he with you?"

A weak girl's voice sounded. It was a girl who looked sixteen. She was dressed in an aqua-green dress and looked pure and adorable.

Her pretty raven-black eyes were seeking her father's figure among the crowd, but she failed to find him…

Furthermore, she could not sense her father's aura at all.

Connecting it to Polar's ashen expression, the girl already found it ominous…

Upon seeing the girl, Polar felt ambivalent. This was his disciple's only daughter, a princess who was beloved by the Heavenly Courts. Even Polar himself liked her a lot.

All he could do was to speak the truth. "Your father… was made to stay in the Ancestor God's palace. He won't be coming back for now…"

Chapter 1686: Ring

The girl felt a jolt through her after hearing Polar's words. She entered a state of shock. Father… isn't returning?

Although Polar had said that it would only be temporary, the girl knew that things were not that simple.

"Patriarch… I…"

"Ling'er, cultivate well and don't be too sad. Perhaps, your father will return safe and sound ten years from now…"

Polar could not bear the pain and the only thing he could do was console the girl. Even though he knew very well that with the Ancestor God's temperament, he would very likely make Ling'er's father into a vessel to nurture demonic servants.

Ancestor God was cruel and ruthless, or it could be said that he showed no concern for life. To the Ancestor God, all the lives he met were no different from rocks or dust. Would an alchemist care if ores felt pain when throwing them into a refinement cauldron?

Ancestor God viewed life in the same way.

"Even Martial Uncle isn't back…" someone in the crowd commented.

The Heavenly Courts had lost two of their youngest, most promising Godly Monarchs on this trip to the Ancestor God's palace.

Instantly, the atmosphere in the Heavenly Courts turned silent. The two patriarchs did not say a word and simply walked off and flew towards their personal palaces.

"Senior Brother, do you really want to tamper with the array?"

War Excellency Sky Punishment suddenly asked while flying. Previously in the Ancestor God's palace, Polar had suggested that everyone joined forces to resist the Ancestor God. Now that they were back in the Heavenly Courts, Polar had steeled his resolve after seeing the looks of Ling'er and his young disciples.

Polar and Sky Punishment had known each other for too long. Although Polar did not say it out loud, Sky Punishment had sensed it.

However, tampering with the Ancestor God's array was extremely dangerous. Even if they succeeded, death was certain. And what Polar wanted to do could only delay the Ancestor God's devouring of the Heavenly Dao instead of stopping him.

"Junior Brother, I've already lived to a ripe old age. I think it's enough. I do not wish to live such an abject life and personally destroy the future of martial arts in the Chaos Heavens…" Polar sighed and shook his head. "I'm afraid my two disciples will never return…"

"Senior Brother, do you know that the entire Heavenly Courts might be embroiled in this if we were to destroy the Ancestor God's plans. It will be destroyed by the Ancestor God's anger! We humans might end up extinct! Without the Heavenly Courts, humanity will lose its standing in the Chaos Heavens. Even annihilation of our race is possible.

"Besides, are you really confident you can destroy the Ancestor God's array?"

Polar fell silent when he heard Sky Punishment. The Ancestor God had naturally left behind certain contingencies by spending that much effort and resources to set up the Chaos Heavens array. Destroying it was obviously not going to be easy.

Perhaps, his plan might be discovered by the Ancestor God midway, and eventually fall short of success.

Polar considered for quite some time as he opened the isolation array in a chamber. Then, he took out an ancient interspatial ring and said with a voice transmission, "Junior Brother… with things developing to this point, there are certain things I need to tell you. Back when Human Emperor Senior Lin Ming came to the Chaos Heavens, I got to acquaint myself with him. I helped him do certain things and received his kindness. Senior Lin was human after all. Although he did not interfere in matters regarding the Chaos Heavens, he still left with me an item that could secure the light that shines on humanity from providence before leaving. All these years, I have yet to use it, but perhaps, it's time to use it…"

"Oh?" Sky Punishment was taken aback. "Something Human Emperor Senior Lin left behind!?"

Human Emperor had long left the Chaos Heavens by the time Sky Punishment was born. All he knew was legends regarding the Human Emperor and he was acutely aware how powerful the Human Emperor was.

The value of something that he left behind to secure humanity's fate was obvious.

It was something that allowed the Heavenly Courts to secure its standing.

"Senior Brother, can the item you mention be used against the Ancestor God?"

"It would be hard, but there's hope…" Polar said as his heart palpitated. He flipped his hand and the ring vanished.

He had sensed the aura of a stranger.

The aura was still very far from the Heavenly Courts, but it was abnormally powerful.

Polar released his perception outwards to sweep over the newcomer, but he failed to find the person.

This tightened Polar's heart. Who could it be?

A few seconds later, a faint figure appeared in Polar's and Sky Punishment's chamber like a ghost.

It was a black-robed youth with brows as sharp as swords. His aura was converged, and although they knew his strength was already unfathomable, they were still unable to tell just how powerful he was.

Yi Yun!

Polar immediately knew the identity of the man without even needing to think.

Such a young human with such immense strength could not be anyone but Yi Yun.

However, Polar never expected Yi Yun to infiltrate their chamber without anyone realizing it. After all, the chamber was isolated by an array!

For him to achieve that, how deep did his nomological insight go?

Yi Yun seemed to know what Polar was alarmed about. He smiled and said, "You must be Senior Polar, am I right? Senior, I happened to encounter the array you set up in the past. Although it has been modified, it's fundamentally the same."

Yi Yun had read records of Polar's array formation in the notes left behind by Human Emperor. Back then, Human Emperor had left behind some of his heritage in the Heavenly Courts, so Polar was considered half a disciple of Human Emperor.

"This…" Polar was taken aback. From the looks of it, Yi Yun had deep ties with the Human Emperor as well.

"I apologize, Senior Polar. Although I've heard how righteous and noble you are, when faced with the dangers posed by the Ancestor God, numerous Godly Monarchs in the Chaos Heavens have submitted to him. I naturally wouldn't dare show myself in front of Godly Monarchs, so I have been hiding in the Heavenly Courts to secretly observe. However, when you took out the ring…"

Yi Yun had been in the Heavenly Courts for a few days, and he had witnessed the entire conversation between Polar and Sky Punishment.

Although they were using Yuan Qi to communicate, he could tell from their expressions. Furthermore, Polar had taken out the ring allowing Yi Yun to tell that the both of them were truly determined to resist the Ancestor God. At the very least, they had not become the Ancestor God's minions.

And although Yi Yun wasn't aware of the ring's origins, he could sense the aura contained within it.

It was the Human Emperor's aura with unprecedented intensity.

And it was because of this item that Yi Yun had chosen to show himself.

He alone was unable to resist the Ancestor God. He needed to gather all the forces that could be gathered.

Upon hearing Yi Yun mention the ring, Polar's heart tightened. It was essential to the Heavenly Courts, fundamental to all humanity!

Now that it had caught the interest of someone stronger than him, he could not help but turn nervous.

"Senior, do you still have scruples towards my allegiance in the matter? I'll be the last person the Ancestor God will ever pardon. That's because he ultimately views me as a threat."

Yi Yun spoke very frankly. Anyone in the Chaos Heavens could be used as a double agent to spy on an anti-Ancestor God alliance except Yi Yun.

Polar took a deep breath and took out the simple ring again. "The ring is here. What do you have in mind?"

Chapter 1687: Opening of the Array

Yi Yun took the ring and sank his perception into it. Without needing Polar to introduce the ring to him, Yi Yun already knew it was left behind by Human Emperor.

The array formation which Ancestor God wanted set up took ten years for each stage, and ten years allowed for many things to happen.

"Perfected Yi, the Ancestor God should be in seclusion to make his final preparations. He's thinned out at the moment which is why he deliberately took two of my disciples as a warning. This is the best time to take action if you're ready to lead. What do you want us to do?"

Polar was decisive as well. Since he had planned to ally with Yi Yun, he no longer had any scruples.

"I need all the information on the array formation the Ancestor God is setting up. Also, I will be replacing one of the Godly Monarch of your Heavenly Courts to join in the setting up of the array formation… I have ten years to study the Ancestor God's array formation, and perhaps I'll be able to find an incisive point to tamper with it…"

The Ancestor God's array formation covered the entire Chaos Heavens.

The reason why he amassed so many Godly Monarch level figures was that he needed to assure he had more than a hundred spirit vein cores in the Chaos Heavens.

It included the spirit veins of Heaven Fey City and the Heavenly Courts. All of them were within the envelopment of the Ancestor God's array.

Yi Yun's plan to infiltrate a tiny part of such a massive array hinged on his comprehension of the Heavenly Dao allowing him to avoid the Ancestor God's perception while he figured out certain things.

"Replace a Godly Monarch? However, all the Godly Monarchs involved in setting up the array have tracing marks planted by the Ancestor God. The Ancestor God will discover the replacement."

"I'm able to crack the tracing mark."

The person who was first planted with a tracing mark was Yi Yun himself.

It took him quite a considerable amount of time to wipe it away, having needed to internalize the Heavenly Dao and reach the half-step Godly Monarch realm to do so.

"You can crack it?" Polar was overjoyed. He never expected Yi Yun's nomological insight to reach a level capable of resisting the Ancestor God.

He had been studying the tracing mark of the Ancestor God for decades without any progress. Furthermore, the more he studied it, the more he realized how great the gap between him and the Ancestor God was.

"Cracking it is very troublesome. Even when I'm doing it, it takes a few months time, but once it's cracked, the Ancestor God will immediately learn of it. Therefore, I won't be able to crack the mark for the Chaos Heavens' Godly Monarchs."

"I understand." Sky Punishment nodded. If a large number of Godly Monarchs had their implanted marks removed in succession, the Ancestor God would probably exit seclusion immediately.

"All I'll be doing is transferring the mark of a Heavenly Courts disciple onto myself. After that, I would disguise myself as him both in identity and aura, completely replacing him in his participation in the array setup."

Yi Yun had obtained a cardinal disguise treasure from the Ghost race and the Star Transference Heaven Changing Book. With both in effect, it was very easy for him to disguise himself as a Godly Monarch.

As long as he didn't face the Ancestor God in person, he would not be discovered.

"Alright!"

Polar directly agreed. In fact, he was betting the fate of the Heavenly Courts on Yi Yun. If Yi Yun failed, the Heavenly Courts would definitely be implicated and the outcome obvious.

…

Time passed as the years went by. The Ancestor God chose twelve excellent spirit veins in the Chaos Heavens and seventy-two sub-first grade spirit vein sources for the array.

Each one of the twelve excellent spirit veins was famous in the Chaos Heavens. For example, there was the humanity's Heavenly Courts spirit vein, the Fey's Heaven Fey City spirit vein, and the Ghosts' Sky River of the Netherworld, etc!

The top races of the Chaos Heavens, excluding the Celestials, each had one such spot. Possessing one was enough for them to reign supreme!

The top races occupied seven excellent spirit veins in the Chaos Heavens, two joint occupations, and one which was occupied by the ancient divine beasts. The final two spots were located in forbidden zones which Godly Monarchs could not enter; therefore, they could not be used.

However, after the Ancestor God appeared, nothing proved to be a problem. The twelve excellent spirit veins were all taken under his control. Hence, it could be said that the Ancestor God wielded control over the entire Chaos Heavens!

As for the remaining seventy-two sub-first grade spirit veins, although they were described as "sub," they were highly coveted by various major sects. Occupying even one made them a top faction in the Chaos Heavens.

Of course, all the spirit veins were now under the Ancestor God's command. He had set up a huge array formation that was akin to a giant spider web. It reached deep into every corner of the Chaos Heavens as it constantly drained its powers, as though it was about to suck the Chaos Heavens dry.

Over the years, the various major factions could clearly sense that weakening of the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi contained within the spirit veins. To put it at a broader perspective, the entire Chaos Heavens' Heaven Earth Yuan Qi was slowly thinning.

The Chaos Heavens was at present a supreme universe in the known-multiverse. To have that status in question due to having its rich Yuan Qi sucked by an array formation was testimony to how terrifying the Ancestor God and the array formation were.

The unease many people felt increased. They could even foresee that martial arts in the Chaos Heavens was embarking on a slow death. The Ancestor God appeared to bent on sucking the Chaos Heavens dry of everything.

The deadline of ten years gradually approached.

The people involved in setting up the Ancestor God's array involved more than a hundred Godly Monarch level experts. Every one of them were illustrious among the Godly Monarchs in the Chaos Heavens.

At that moment, in a valley, more than ten Godly Monarchs were gathered. They were clearly from the various races of the Chaos Heavens. And leading them was the Heavenly Courts' patriarch, Polar.

"Senior Polar, didn't you say that there's some problems with the array formation here? Why don't I detect any problems?" a Soul Thearch asked.

They originally believed that they were gathered here to help in setting up the array formation. It was a situation that commonly happened. After all, the scale of the Ancestor God's array formation was so huge that a single Godly Monarch was unable to complete it on their own most of the time.

As the Soul Thearch spoke, the entire valley's atmosphere suddenly changed. An indescribable law enveloped the entire valley and formed a domain that isolated the valley from the outside world.

"Oh? Polar, what's the meaning of this!?"

The hearts of the Godly Monarchs present jolted as they were immediately placed on high alert.

"Nothing. Everyone, do you still remember the suggestion I raised ten years ago?" Polar said unhurriedly.

Back then, Polar had suggested for all the Godly Monarchs to join forces to resist the Ancestor God.

"Polar, you're mad. Although none of us wish for the Ancestor God to rule over the Chaos Heavens, all of us combined fighting the Ancestor God is like smashing eggs against a rock. Even if we aren't afraid of death, we do not wish to die in vain."

"Quickly dispel this domain and let us leave. We will pretend as if this never happened. We will keep mum about it and not snitch on you. If we take action, we'd be doomed the moment the Celestials notice it."

The Godly Monarchs spoke one after another. They had a total of eleven people, so they were not afraid of Polar.

Polar said, "I won't be able to dispel this domain even if I wish to because it's not set up by me. If you think what I said doesn't hold enough weight, what if someone else were to say it?"

As Polar spoke, a black-robed youth slowly walked out of the valley. There was no Yuan Qi fluctuation from his body, but he seemed to be center of the world. It was a reverent existence.

"You are…"

"Yi Yun!?"

Someone recognized Yi Yun. In fact, after the battle at Heaven Fey City, Yi Yun's portrait had been spread throughout the Chaos Heavens.

Now, Yi Yun was undisguised and his looks were his own. Everyone naturally recognized him.

Chapter 1688: Chaos Heavens Beacon Fires

Yi Yun's appearance plunged everyone into silence.

Just Polar alone was insufficient, but Yi Yun was different. It hadn't been long since Yi Yun appeared in the Chaos Heavens, but he was the most promising and illustrious figure that had appeared in the Chaos Heavens over the past billion years apart from the Ancestor God.

Be it Yi Yun's friends or enemies, all of them admitted that Yi Yun was the only peerless human who had any chance of attaining the same achievements as Human Emperor.

But…

Even so, the present Yi Yun was no match for the Ancestor God at all.

Even with Yi Yun leading them, it was still highly possible that they would be wiped out when resisting the Ancestor God.

"So it's Young Master Yi. I've heard so much about you. I know that you are arch enemies with the Ancestor God, but even if you ally with us, we won't be able to provide you with much help," a female elderly Ghost said.

Her skin was sallow and looked as though it was slathered with a layer of resin oil.

Yi Yun said, "Everyone, do you believe that I've been forced into a corner by the Ancestor God? That I want to pull all of you down with me to be my cannon fodder so that I have a chance of survival?"

"Not at all, but…" the female elderly Ghost said again, but she was interrupted by Yi Yun. "I have already cracked the Ancestor God's tracing mark inside of me. I can swear on my Dao heart that this is the truth and nothing but the truth."

"What!?"

Upon hearing that, everyone appeared moved. Yi Yun had actually found a way to dispel the Ancestor God's tracing mark?

All of them had spent great effort in trying to understand the tracing mark, but they eventually discovered that unless their nomological insight or psyche powers reached that of the Ancestor God, there was no way of removing it.

"Then, Young Master Yi, would it be possible for you to…" The female elderly Ghost could hardly speak out of embarrassment. However, with the tracing mark on her, it was like a nightmare. She could not rest easy and felt that the Ancestor God could rob her of her life at any time.

The pressure was just too great. The removal of the mark was something they yearned for even in their dreams.

"I'm sorry. It's not possible for now. Even for myself, removing the tracing mark was not simple, nor do I have that much time. It will also alert the Ancestor God. The reason why I'm telling you this is to let you know that I have a route of retreat. Instead, the one who doesn't is you, the Chaos Heavens."

Upon hearing Yi Yun's words, everyone fell silent. Indeed, if Yi Yun did not have a tracing mark, he could leave the Chaos Heavens and hide in a pocket world. The Ancestor God might not be able to find him. Although he would have to live in anxiety, the chances of survival were still huge.

They were different. After the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao was devoured by the Ancestor God, the only outcome left for them was to be loyal dogs of the Ancestor God. They would live abject existences and could be abandoned at anytime. It was even possible for them to be used as vessels to breed demonic servants.

Yi Yun added, "I also revealed this to you all to tell you that I am somewhat confident in entering into direct conflict with the Ancestor God. If we were to wait till he devours the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, his Dao will be fortified forever. After that, I would likely not be able to do anything. This is the final chance. To me, it's a chance to fortify my Dao, but for you, it's a chance for survival.

Yi Yun's words moved the hearts of everyone. Someone asked, "Young Master Yi, what are your chances of success?"

"Fifty-fifty. Man proposes god disposes. In order to avoid the Ancestor God's detection, I have been contacting all of you through Senior Polar in batches. Each batch has about ten plus people. You are not the first batch."

"Oh? Young Master Yi has contacted that many people? Aren't you afraid that someone will snitch?"

"I am. That's why I will take a wisp of your intrinsic soul. I will swear upon my Dao heart to not cause any damage to your intrinsic soul. After everything is done, I would immediately return your intrinsic soul to you. Not only will it not damage your martial fundamentals, it will also provide you with opportunity in the future! If I were to violate this agreement, the foundations of my martial Dao will crumple and I will fall from my present spot."

As Yi Yun spoke, he beckoned gently. Bits of stellar light flashed from his palm. All these stellar light were the intrinsic souls of Godly Monarch level figures which were left with Yi Yun.

Upon seeing this, everyone knew that Yi Yun wasn't lying. There was no reason for him to lie either. Under the present circumstances, it was necessary he kept contingency plans. If not, even they would not risk their lives with Yi Yun. They wouldn't know better if they were walking into a trap.

Many people were moved. Although Yi Yun claimed to only have a fifty percent chance of success, there was still hope if they tried. If they didn't, it would only be a slow death.

After thinking about it deeply, people chose to sign contacts with Yi Yun.

After the first one, a second one stepped forward. As the number of people who signed contracts with Yi Yun increased, those who were on the fence finally made up their minds.

Everyone eventually chose to ally with Yi Yun.

Regardless of their true inclinations, Yi Yun thought nothing of it. He had their intrinsic souls in hand and the Ancestor God's actions were indeed against the Chaos Heavens and not something that won the hearts of people. Yi Yun refused to believe that someone would forgo their lives for a master who had not won the hearts of people.

…

Time slowly passed as the mood in the Chaos Heavens grew increasingly suppressed. It was the calm before the storm.

Everyone knew that the setup of the array was coming to an end. A shadow hung over every faction and it felt stifling.

On this day, in a particular spot in the Chaos Heavens, a divine beam of light soared into the sky like a heavenly column that penetrated the firmaments. Everyone within half a million kilometers saw the column of light tear through the land and penetrate the universe.

People could tell that the column of light stemmed from Ethereal Lake.

It got its name because it was an extremely mysterious lake. As it was unpredictable and ethereal, the typical warrior found it difficult to pinpoint its ever-changing location.

Legend had it that people who bathed and drank with the water in the Ethereal Lake would have their cultivation levels increase greatly. They could break through several realms and become an overlord of a dominion.

Many warriors of lowly cultivation levels were attracted to the legend of Ethereal Lake. They even set out, wishing to find it with good luck.

But no one expected that someone had fixed the Ethereal Lake in place with a gigantic array flag three decades ago. The lake stopped drifting erratically and later, all its waters were slowly drained by the array flag.

At the same time, array formations were set up around Ethereal Lake, preventing anyone from approaching.

Now, the column of light which stemmed from Ethereal Lake had spewed out all the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi accumulated within this mystical land. As such, Ethereal Lake was destroyed.

From then on, Ethereal Lake was no more in the Chaos Heavens!

As for Ethereal Lake, it was simply one of the seventy-two sub-first grade spirit veins sources which the Ancestor God had chosen in the Chaos Heavens.

Beyond Ethereal Lake, there were seventy-one divine beams shooting out from different lands. If one viewed from far away in the universe, it would appear as if the Chaos Heavens had beacon fires lit up everywhere. It was splendid and mysterious.

Everyone knew that the array formation that the Ancestor God had set up was finally activated.

Chapter 1689: Divine Emperor

The seventy-two beacon fires burned for days!

All the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi within the Chaos Heavens spewed forth!

Over the past few decades, the Yuan Qi density in the Chaos Heavens had been weakening by the day, but from the moment the beacon fires were lit, the Chaos Heavens' Yuan Qi density reached an unprecedented peak, one not seen for billions of years!

Now, sects and factions saw their territories being so dense in Yuan Qi that Yuan Qi fog and Yuan Qi clouds condensed as they rained Yuan Qi!

With the Yuan Qi downpour, cultivating in the rain for a month was equivalent to a normal year. This was a perfect opportunity to cultivate, but most warriors had no mood to do so.

None of the major factions in the Chaos Heavens took action. All of them remained silent…

It was like the calm before a huge storm, a sign of the final apocalypse.

The calmer it was, the more repressed people felt!

Many warriors knew that the ignition of the seventy-two beacon fires was just a prelude.

In the following days, the twelve main beacon fires would be ignited in succession!

When the twelve main beacon fires were ignited, all the Yuan Qi in the Chaos Heavens would erupt. When that happened, the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao would be devoured by the Ancestor God!

When that happened, what were the people of Chaos Heavens to do?

From the Chaos Heavens' birth as a martial civilization, it had not met such a cataclysm for billions of years!

Ordinary warriors felt lost.

Divine Lords and Godly Monarchs seemed to roam in despair.

Only the cream of the Godly Monarch crop, those patriarchs and members of the upper echelons of the major factions knew that a massive battle that would determine their fate would happen in the coming days.

They felt uneasiness and even an ominous horror that was a distant emotion to them.

All of them were all-powerful figures that ruled over the Chaos Heavens. Once upon a time, they stood apart from the secular world, reclusing themselves and caring nothing for worldly affairs. Under such circumstances, few things mattered to them. They never left their seclusion unless it was something major, so they never encountered a situation that left them in horror…

But now, with the apocalypse at hand, even the patriarchs of the various races were like lost birds in a thunderstorm. Without any means to protect themselves, all they could do was wait passively.

They hoped to see Yi Yun create a miracle, but the chances of this miracle happening were extremely slim.

The two patriarchs of Heaven Fey City, Grand Supremum and Grand Primordium, shared this feeling. They bore such a burden as the days passed.

As they had participated in setting up the array, they roughly knew that the twelve main beacon fires would ignite within the next two days.

Success or failure were days away!

"Pa!"

A chess piece landed on a chessboard. In front of Grand Supremum was a chessboard and opposite him was Grand Primordium.

The duo had been having the chess game for ten days.

At times, they would not place a piece for as long as an hour. Grand Supremum had thought for quite a while before he finally landed his move, but it was not considered a brilliant one. It exposed his weakness and it was a move that could lead to his defeat.

"Senior Brother… You…" Grand Primordium raised his head and looked at Grand Supremum in surprise.

"Junior Brother… We might not be able to continue our game for there's no piece to land, unless…"

Grand Supremum trembled as he said those words. At that moment, Grand Primordium's expression changed as he felt an overwhelming aura surge over.

He stood up and looked into the distance. Tiny black dots had appeared along the horizon.

In a few blinks of an eye, the black dots enlarged. They were bronze giants!

Celestials!

The Celestials were always mysterious and few in number. Yet, there were a total of a hundred Celestials in Heaven Fey City!

Nearly all these Celestials had combat strength at the Godly Monarch level.

They were clearly the best warriors of the Celestials.

All across the Chaos Heavens, a Celestial could fend off the combined forces of three pinnacle existences of the other races!

Now, a hundred Celestials had appeared in Heaven Fey City. It could be said that the entire horde was here!

The ten plus Fey Thearchs in Heaven Fey City could no longer sit still as they rose into the air, seemingly prepared to face the enemy.

However, compared to the Celestials, they were just too weak.

About ten of them had to fight a hundred Celestials. Furthermore, most of them were not the Celestials' match in a one-on-one skirmish.

The situation wouldn't turn for the better even if all the Fey Thearchs of the Fey race was gathered, much less when there were only the Fey Thearchs of Heaven Fey City.

The bronze giant that led the celestials was thousands of feet tall. When he stood outside Heaven Fey City, the towering city walls did not even reach his knee!

Even the majestic Heaven Fey City appeared as minute as a sandcastle at the beach.

Divine Emperor!

Someone recognized the leading bronze giant to be the reigning Divine Emperor of the Celestials!

The reigning Divine Emperor was not the Ancestor God, but he the current ruler of the Chaos Heavens' Celestials.

The Ancestor God came from the Sinkhole and was the former Divine Emperor.

In ancient times, the Ancestor God had passed the throne of Divine Emperor to the present Divine Emperor when he left the Chaos Heavens.

Now that the Ancestor God was back in a bid to devour the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, his status could be said to be the patriarch of the Celestials.

As for the Divine Emperor, he remained the Divine Emperor.

Although the Divine Emperor's strength was inferior to the Ancestor God's, he far exceeded the patriarchs of the various races. The combined forces of Grand Supremum and Grand Primordium were not necessarily the match of the Divine Emperor.

The Divine Emperor had arrived with many Celestial experts. Behind them was a dense horde of demonic servants which resembled locusts.

These demonic servants seemed to blanket the world when gathered together. It looked like a massive dark cloud.

The number was in the millions!

And there were many powerful beings among the demonic servants!

The leaders were the eight demon marshals, and all of them had combat strength at the Godly Monarch level.

Behind them were hundreds of demonic generals, each of them having the strength of demon lords!

This was another horrifying force. In addition, there were countless Supremacies and Daolords behind them… The demonic servant army, together with more than a hundred Celestial experts, meant that Heaven Fey City could be flattened with a mere thought!

Grand Supremum and Grand Primordium were floating in midair as they experienced the immense pressure.

Was the Heaven Fey City which had a heritage of billions of years about to be annihilated today?

The demonic servant army grew in size and at this point, numbers lost their meaning. It was comprised of demonic servants that had been amassed by the Celestials for billions of years.

Most of the time, the Celestials' demonic servants were in a slumber. Only when needed were they awakened.

Many demonic servants had been asleep for more than a hundred million years. Furthermore, the Celestials had been feeding and nurturing them in recent years.

Just the demonic servant army was enough to leave one in despair.

The city appeared to be crumbling under the mass of dark clouds!

Numerous Fey warriors walked out of their houses in Heaven Fey City and looked at the terrifying arm that could wipe them out.

The strong trembled, the weak wept.

"Oh? It's you?"

Grand Supremum creased his brows. He saw that quite a number of Godly Monarchs from the Ghost and Soul race were with the demonic servant army.

There were a few whom Grand Supremum knew. They had signed a contract with Yi Yun a few months back.

At this moment, these people were following the demonic servant army and wearing disconsolate expressions. Grand Supremum's heart sank involuntarily. The ominous premonition he'd had come true…

Chapter 1690: Enemies All Over the Universe

The Godly Monarchs of the Soul and Ghost races appeared ashamed when they met the two Fey patriarchs.

Against the army horde of the Celestials, with the Ancestor God as their backer, the peak races of the Chaos Heavens became nothing but jokes. The difference in strength was just too great.

The Ghosts had barely resisted the Celestials before they submitted. The Souls quickly capitulated when that happened.

Not everyone had the courage to face the threat of having their race annihilated.

The Ghost patriarch was among the army, standing out because he was different from the typical Ghost Thearch. They often had a corpse-like body after they condensed one, one that was sallow or pale, without any signs of life.

However, this Ghost patriarch had fair and supple skin like he was made of porcelain. He looked extremely young, only with turbid eyes.

His Ghost body was near perfection.

To achieve this, the Ghost patriarch had spent more than a hundred million year transcending numerous Ghost tribulations. Of course, once the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao was devoured, his body would never attain perfection.

"Grand Supremum, Grand Primordium, Ancestor God is aware of Yi Yun's alliance with the Godly Monarchs of the different races."

The Ghost patriarch sent a voice transmission to them.

Grand Supremum's heart sank. "How did the Ancestor God learn of it? Who betrayed us?"

"It might not be a betrayal…" The Ghost patriarch sighed. "Perhaps the Ancestor God had left some contingencies or he is truly so powerful that it is beyond our comprehension. In short, we have failed. The Celestial army attacked and threatened the annihilation of my race. I'm ashamed to say that I couldn't fight them and had to submit."

Compared to having his race annihilated, the inability to attain a perfect body was trivial.

There was hope as long as he survived.

Perhaps the Ancestor God would only rule the Chaos Heavens for hundreds of millions of years, but he would not rule it forever.

This was because after he devoured the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, the Chaos Heavens would slowly lose its value to the Ancestor God. Therefore, it was possible that he would leave when he was done.

Legend had it that beyond the universe were other universes. Human Emperor Lin Ming had left this universe with Empress Sheng Mei.

Perhaps there would come a day when the Ancestor God would leave as well.

An existence like the Ancestor God would have transcended Samsara and any mortal bindings. It was unlikely he would rigidly stick to this universe.

And once he left, everything could be redone once again.

Experts could be nurtured again after the death of others. Martial heritage could be mended even if they were severed. Even if the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao was devoured, time would eventually allow the Chaos Heavens to restore itself.

As long as they waited billions of years, the lost Yuan Qi would slowly return.

However, if their entire race was annihilated, it would be over. When that happened, there was no way to make a resurgence once the Ancestor God was gone.

It was not worth it to be spiteful.

"All of you still have a wisp of your intrinsic souls with Yi Yun. You can choose to submit to the Ancestor God, but what's the price of rebelling against Yi Yun? Can you pay that price?" Grand Primordium asked in return.

"Yi Yun isn't as ruthless as the Ancestor God. He might crush our intrinsic souls, but it would be meaningless for him. Besides… even if he does crush our souls, it would only be us who perish. It's better than having our entire races annihilated…"

Upon hearing the Ghost patriarch's words, Grand Supremum and Grand Primordium found it bitingly ironic. The reason for their betrayal was simply because Yi Yun was likely kinder.

This was probably the prime example of the saying 'the kind gets bullied.'

Even more ironic of all was that both Grand Supremum and Grand Primordium lacked the courage to resist the Ancestor God despite understanding this principle.

It was fine if they died, but to have the entire Heaven Fey City perish with them?

"Grand Supremum! Grand Primordium!"

At that moment, the reigning Divine Emperor spoke.

"In the Ancestor God's name, I will be hunting down Yi Yun! Now, I'll be using your Fey army. Are you agreeable to it?"

The Divine Emperor's voice resounded through Heaven Fey City.

The words sounded like the most saddening dirge in Grand Supremum's and Grand Primordium's ears.

The entire Chaos Heavens was being slowly destroyed by the Ancestor God and the only one who put up a resistance was Yi Yun, but because of his resistance, he was to be hunted across the entire Chaos Heavens!

"Are you defying me with your silence?" asked the Divine Emperor.

Grand Supremum and Grand Primordium remained silent.

The Divine Emperor's gaze turned cold as a sliver of murderous intent burned. "I'll give you a minute to consider! The Ancestor God will leave the matter of your betrayal for now, but not again! If there's another time, your entire race will be annihilated!"

"As for Yi Yun… he naively believes that he has wiped away the Ancestor God's mark on him. In fact, from the moment the Ancestor God began interacting with the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, nothing in the Chaos Heavens could be kept from him. Yi Yun's location is already known to the Ancestor God. There is no way he's escaping! I'll ask you once more. Are the Fey planning to die with Yi Yun? If that's the case, I'll fulfill your wishes!"

The Divine Emperor's voice was overbearing. Grand Supremum closed his eyes in pain as he felt as though his backbone was being pulled out. He bit down on his lips, and despite being completely unwilling to do so, he said, "The Fey obeys the order…"

Grand Supremum felt that he had used all his strength to deliver those words. He felt that the hundreds of millions of years of cultivation had been for nothing!

At that moment, he was not betraying Yi Yun but himself.

"Very good!"

Divine Emperor gave a satisfied smile. "Grand Supremum, hear my orders! The Fey will send twenty Fey Thearchs and a hundred thousand warriors to follow my Celestial army to annihilate the rebel!"

As the Divine Emperor spoke, he led his huge demonic servant army into the territory.

The point of getting the peak races to provide personnel was simply to make them submit. Everyone knew that the peak races would lose their core members, making it impossible for them to resist the Ancestor God again.

Three days later, the Celestial army swept through the Chaos Heavens. Countless warriors saw this astounding scene from afar.

While the Celestial army traveled, demonic servants from every land gathered to meet them.

It went from ten to twenty million to nearly a hundred million!

Such a huge demonic servant army blotted out the sky!

Other than that, the allied army of the various peak races numbered hundreds of thousands. Although the numbers were small, they were not lacking in strength. It was still a terrifying force to be reckoned with.

Having so many people gathered was, in fact, not to wipe out Yi Yun. Instead, it was to guarantee the absolute success of the Ancestor God's devouring the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao.

Otherwise, once these peak races of the Chaos Heavens took action, even if they were moths hurtling towards a flame, it was still possible for them to interfere in the Ancestor God's devouring of the Heavenly Dao.

The Ancestor God could not allow any problems to arise as it would lead to imperfection. It would prevent his strength from reaching a peak, and pulverizing the rebels would not remedy the situation at all.

Another day later, the massive army that comprised of the Chaos Heavens' peak combat forces charged into the Heavenly Courts!

The Heavenly Courts was the core force of humanity.

The grandeur of the scene attracted many warriors in the Chaos Heavens. Although they were afraid, they tailed the army to witness the turn of events that had not happened in a billion years.

Chapter 1691: The Peak of the Heavenly Courts

Faced with the Ancestor God's might, humanity was the only one among the peak races that did not instantly submit.

Tens of millions of demonic servants, a hundred Godly Monarchs, and an army of hundreds of thousands comprised from various races stood outside the Heavenly Courts.

The Heavenly Courts naturally had no means to resist. As the Celestial army arrived, the Heavenly Courts did not set up any array defenses. Even the entrance arrays were not activated.

In fact, activating the array was meaningless. An army of this scale would blast apart the array with one combined blow. It was even possible that the palace complex of the Heavenly Courts would be leveled along with the array.

At that moment, in the middle of a square in the Heavenly Courts, the two patriarchs, Polar and Sky Punishment, were sitting on seats of honor. And beneath them were the Godly Monarchs of the Heavenly Courts.

Apart from them, the other Godly Monarchs from other human factions had arrived here one after another.

With humanity, or perhaps it should be said the Chaos Heavens, facing a life-and-death crisis, it was praiseworthy that more than half the Godly Monarchs of humanity came despite knowing that it was a fatal endeavor. In fact, even for those Godly Monarchs who did not come, it was simply because the factions behind them wished to leave seeds for the continuation of their martial lineage.

Humanity, including the two patriarchs, had a total of thirty-two Godly Monarchs present.

Among them was the Taixia Ancient Mining's Godly Monarch—Divineheart.

Godly Monarch Divineheart once met Yi Yun at the Xuanyuan Dune and established some ties. With his strength, he was considered relatively weak among the thirty-two Godly Monarchs. In the tumultuous turmoil, his strength did not even cause a stir.

Upon seeing the army that blotted out the sun above the Heavenly Courts, Divineheart felt wistful. Once upon a time, becoming a Godly Monarch was his greatest goal in life. He was already satisfied, but now, from the looks of it, he was nothing more than a tiny splash in the massive ocean.

"Polar, I'm here to slay Yi Yun in the name of the Ancestor God."

The Divine Emperor towered over the humans in mid-air like a massive mountain. The Heavenly Courts' palace appeared like toy houses made of wood beneath his feet.

Polar sat there silent, as though he did not hear him.

"Hand over Yi Yun!" the Divine Emperor said again. His words left everyone taken aback.

Was Yi Yun in the Heavenly Courts!?

Previously, the Divine Emperor had said that even if Yi Yun wiped the tracing mark from himself, Yi Yun's location could be found by the Ancestor God ever since he interacted with the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao.

Everyone believed that Yi Yun might have found a secret place to hide or even escape the Chaos Heavens. But to their surprise, Yi Yun was actually inside the Heavenly Courts.

The Celestials' pursuit of Yi Yun would naturally pass by the Heavenly Courts, so it became one of the most dangerous spots.

At that moment, there was no such thing as the most dangerous place being the safest place.

Polar still did not offer a response. He stood up slowly and floated into the sky. This continued until he reached a height equal to the Divine Emperor's eye level.

"Do you not plan on handing him over?" Divine Emperor's bronze face revealed a sarcastic smile. "Yi Yun seems to have maleficent thoughts. Despite knowing he's about to die, he still uses your Heavenly Courts as a shield. If not, why would he choose his final hiding ground to be the Heavenly Courts? The Heavenly Courts is considered the core of humanity. By choosing this spot, is he planning on embroiling the Heavenly Courts and bringing about its destruction?"

As he spoke, Divine Emperor slowly extended his hand. In the middle of his palm, a gigantic axe appeared out of thin air.

The gigantic axe was made of metal and suffused a dark golden luster. No one doubted that the land would be split apart if the axe came cleaving down.

The Divine Emperor looked at Polar as if he was looking at a dead man.

Although the Ancestor God did not pursue the faults of the Ghost, Soul, and Fey patriarchs, it did not mean that he had turned a blind eye to the rebellious plot against him.

There was a price to betrayal. Apart from Yi Yun, someone had to be punished to assert his authority.

And this someone was undoubtedly Polar. For the past ten plus years, Polar's rebellious intention had been clear. Even before Yi Yun appeared, Polar had incited others to rebel.

"From the looks of it, you plan on resisting?"

Other than Polar, none of the other patriarchs of the other races dared to fly to a height equal to the Divine Emperor. All of them looked up to him except Polar.

"You make it sound like you would intend to spare us." Polar sneered. He was unafraid of death. Decades ago, back when he had attempted to ally the various Godly Monarchs from the Chaos Heavens together, he was already aware of the possibility of being killed in action.

"It's fine if you die, but do you plan on having the entire Heavenly Courts accompany you in death?" Divine Emperor's voice came with rich killing intent. If Polar went on his knees and allowed himself to be executed, he did not mind pardoning the Heavenly Courts.

However, if Polar intended to rebel, then the Divine Emperor would show no mercy. With an army numbering tens of millions, how could it not shed blood?

And the Heavenly Courts was the best sacrificial object.

The moment the Divine Emperor said that, the Ghost, Soul, and Fey Godly Monarchs lamented inwardly. The races behind them were their soft spot. They could not ignore them.

Was Polar mad? Was he unconcerned with the death of humanity?

Polar looked straight at the Divine Emperor. Despite facing the threat, he still did not show any signs of fear. All he did was let out a long sigh, looking somewhat doleful.

"We warriors have been cultivating our entire lives. What was it for? It's not to enjoy riches or sex. Nor is it about being placed on a pedestal while enslaving those beneath us! We cultivate to fight against our fate! We do not wish to let Samsara run its course, so we cultivate for years! Our martial heritage has been passed down for millions of years, billions of years, and will be so for trillions of years! It's not for us to kneel down to beg for mercy after gaining mastery. With the backbone broken, there's no way one can straighten one's back. Since the Celestials wish to destroy my Heavenly Courts, my Heavenly Courts will be facing you in a battle of blood."

Upon hearing Polar's words, Divine Emperor was truly taken aback. He fell into a trance for a moment before he roared with laughter.

"Hahaha! One can still live with their backbone broken. In time, it's still possible to recover with treasures. But the annihilation of a race would end with nothing. Polar, I never expected that all your disciples and grand-disciples, along with the Heavenly Courts, would have to accompany you in death because of a moment's joy. If you wish so, I'll make it happen!"

As the Divine Emperor spoke, the millions of demonic servants surrounded the Heavenly Courts.

They were setting up an array!

Once the array formation was set up, all they would need to destroy the Heavenly Courts would be a mere thought!

Upon seeing this situation, the Godly Monarchs from the Fey, Soul, and Ghost races were extremely unwilling, but they had no choice but to participate in this annihilative battle of targeting the Heavenly Courts.

They could could go through the motions, but they could not avoid the battle. Otherwise, the Ancestor God would be settling scores with them after annihilating humanity.

Just as the demonic servant army was setting up its array formation, the world suddenly began to tremble slightly. Thunderous sounds came out from deep underground like the angry bellow of an ancient divine beast.

The stir spread in every direction at an astonishing speed. If one pursued the shock wave with one's perception, they would discover that the stirrings were not weakening as they spread. Instead, they were drawing on the powers of the Heaven and Earth, turning stronger and faster as they proceeded.

It appeared to be sweeping through the entire Chaos Heavens!

The numerous warriors of the Chaos Heavens were alarmed by this stir.

Just days ago, the Ancestor God's activation of the massive array had already sent a stir in the Chaos Heavens. Was this the result of the Ancestor God again?

Ordinary warriors might have been baffled, but the Celestial's Divine Emperor knew very well that this stirring had nothing to do with the Ancestor God!

Chapter 1692: Sublimation of Life

If this phenomenon that swept through the entire Chaos Heavens was unrelated to the Ancestor God, could it be related to Yi Yun!?

The Divine Emperor immediately rejected the possibility after some thought. The might and the influence of the phenomenon was just too terrifying. He refused to believe that anyone apart from the Ancestor God was capable of this.

Ignoring the fact that Yi Yun had not broken through to the Godly Monarch realm, it was still impossible even if he had already broken through.

But what was exactly going on? Could it be that the Ancestor God had set up an array and his forceful extraction of the Chaos Heavens' Yuan Qi had resulted in the resistance of the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao? Was this some unexpected outcome?

With this in mind, the Divine Emperor felt a little worried. And at that moment, in the direction of the epicenter, three faint figures had appeared high in the sky.

The figures were neither human nor beast, but three basic shapes.

They were in the shapes of a cube, a sphere, and a flat card.

What were these three figures?

The Divine Emperor was not the only one stunned; everyone was.

Even Patriarch Polar was not entirely sure what was happening. He only had some guesses in his mind.

These three items, especially the cube and the sphere, were likely left behind by the Human Emperor.

Patriarch Polar had naturally seen what Human Emperor had left behind in the ring. Although Human Emperor had mentioned before that the items in the ring might one day save humanity, Patriarch Polar was unable to use these two items because he didn't gain their recognition.

At a most critical juncture, Patriarch Polar had taken out the ring which Human Emperor had left behind, hoping to trigger Human Emperor's powers within. He hoped that with the Human Emperor's powers, the Ancestor God could be fought off.

Polar did not hold much hope for a positive outcome.

However, he never expected that Yi Yun had apparently obtained the Human Emperor's recognition. Not only so, he had even taken out a third heavenly treasure. Although Polar had no idea what it was, it shared the same aura as the other two heavenly treasures. This was the aura of the supreme Great Dao.

All of this was only known to Yi Yun himself.

Not only did he know what heavenly treasures the Human Emperor had left behind, he even knew what the Purple Crystal Origins was.

Back then, Yi Yun had learned of the twelve ancient Fey Gods while in the Sinkhole.

The twelve Fey Gods were actually manifestations of the Great Dao laws of the Universe. They were not only limited to the Sinkhole, but represented the Great Dao laws of the Multiverse.

For instance, the Chaos Heavens' Fey's Heaven Fey totem also had shadows of the twelve Fey Gods.

The first nine Fey Gods of the twelve were no secret. They were the Extreme Yang Illumination, Extreme Yin Nether Glow, Empress Earth Dao Tree, Dragon Emperor, Seven-colored Phoenix, Kun Peng, Heavenly Man, the manifestation of time—River of Forgetfulness, and the manifestation of space—Solitary Nothingness.

But the final three were a mystery to the rest of the martial world.

However, Yi Yun knew that the Purple Crystal Origins he possessed was one of the final three Fey Gods!

Yet, never did Yi Yun imagine that the items left in the Human Emperor's ring were the remaining two Fey Gods.

Calling them Fey Gods was not accurate. They were actually just amalgamations of the Universe's Great Dao laws.

Human Emperor had left behind his heritage mark on these two items. Only a person who had obtained Human Emperor's heritage could receive the recognition of the mark.

Back when Yi Yun obtained that recognition, not only did he obtain the two items, he even saw some of the past of the Human Emperor.

Inside the cube were some of Human Emperor's memory fragments!

Human Emperor was also known as the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch in the Sinkhole and his name was Lin Ming. Back when Lin Ming first embarked on his martial path, he had obtained the cube.

Lin Ming had called it the Magic Cube, but it did not have a real name.

The Magic Cube had helped Lin Ming greatly in the beginning. If not for it, Lin Ming would never have become Human Emperor later.

Fundamentally, the Magic Cube was a heavenly treasure condensed from Soul laws.

As for the sphere, it was the condensation of the body cultivation laws. Human Emperor had called it the Grandmist Spirit Bead.

Finally, the Purple Crystal, which was possessed by Yi Yun, was the condensation of Energy laws.

Soul, Energy, Body corresponded to three tenets of Spirit, Qi, and Soul in reverse order.

The three major laws were fundamental to people.

It was fundamental to life.

It was fundamental to the Universe.

Similarly, the Multiverse had Spirit, Qi, and Soul!

Spirit represented all objects in the Universe. The myriad objects were the flesh of the Universe.

Qi represented all the energies in the Universe. The myriad objects were born amid the Heaven and Earth energies. That was the Qi of the Universe.

As for Soul, it was the Heavenly Dao laws of the Universe. This was the Soul of the Universe, just like how everything has a soul!

Therefore, the three heavenly treasures condensed out of the three laws were no longer treasures. Combined together, they were the seeds of the Multiverse!

Three heavenly treasures concentrated the Origins of the Universe!

If the Multiverse were to be destroyed and the three heavenly treasures were to absorb the remnants of the Universe and its emitted energies, they would slowly accumulate enough energy to explode at a particular moment. They would spew out all the mass, energy, and Heavenly Dao laws they stored within and would form a new Universe. This would essentially be a Big Bang for a new Universe.

After creation would be destruction.

But destruction implied new life.

This was also a fundamental aspect of the Martial Dao which Human Emperor cultivated in!

The 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence represented Major Destruction, while the Primordial Chaos Heavenly Dao represented Major Creation. Both were present within these three Universe Seeds.

As for Yi Yun, he had already cultivated the Dao of Major Destruction and Dao of Major Creation. When he finally gained insight into all of this, the three heavenly treasures flew straight into Yi Yun's body!

The Magic Cube condensed from Soul laws fused with Yi Yun's soul.

The Purple Crystal condensed from Energy laws fused with Yi Yun's dantian.

The Spirit Bead condensed from Body Cultivation laws had fused with Yi Yun's flesh and lifeblood.

All of these raised Yi Yun's strength rapidly!

Not only was it an increase in strength, it was a sublimation of life's natural order!

The shackles that had held Yi Yun back all this while were destroyed immediately!

Yi Yun had entered the Godly Monarch realm in one step!

At that moment, Yi Yun had fused Spirit, Qi, and Soul as one. He had become one with the Heaven and Earth, as well as the Multiverse!

He even sensed that the entire Chaos Heavens had become a part of him. He could sense the throbbing of the lands of the Chaos Heavens. He did not need to open his eyes, for with a mere thought, he could sense everything that was happening in the Chaos Heavens. Even a tiny bug could not escape Yi Yun's detection.

Not just this, his perception could spread beyond the Chaos Heavens if Yi Yun so wished.

Although Yi Yun was powerful in the past, he was only mortal when it came to life's natural order. But now, his standing in life's natural order was that of a god.

Having stepped into the Godly Monarch realm, he had truly gone from mortal to God. He was completely different from any Godly Monarch in the Chaos Heavens.

This was also why Yi Yun had caused the entire Chaos Heavens to resonate with him when he broke through to the Godly Monarch realm!

Chapter 1693: Godly Monarch Realm

The projections of the three heavenly treasures vanished one after another as they fused with Yi Yun.

However, at the moment Yi Yun broke through to the Godly Monarch realm, he knew very well that the three heavenly treasures did not truly belong to him despite having fused with him.

At the end of the day, they were Universe Seeds of this Multiverse, an inchoate form that led to the birth of the next Multiverse.

He could borrow their powers, but he was unable to really take them away.

This was also why the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch had left them behind when he left the Multiverse. They had to stay behind to give birth to the next Universe after infinite time.

But when that happened, with Yi Yun reaching a new realm, he would no longer needed the three Universe seeds.

He would ultimately leave the the Multiverse like the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch to head to a brand new world, to probe infinite unknowns.

Of course, the three Universe seeds were the absolute source of Yi Yun's strength.

Boom!

The world trembled as Yi Yun appeared in the sky like a god. He stood equal to the heavens and all the warriors in the world had a feeling that they could not look straight at him. It was as though this world was being compressed by his mere appearance.

"Is that really Yi Yun? Were the phenomena from before because of him? Has he broken through?"

The Divine Emperor was alarmed. Although he had such a guess moments ago, he rejected it for its ludicrosity. But from the looks of it, the terrifying energy blast had clearly come from Yi Yun.

He had broken through to the Godly Monarch realm?

But why were there such phenomena when breaking through to the Godly Monarch realm?

Despite their race being called Celestials, they were still mortal beings. Now, he felt that he was facing a god when facing Yi Yun.

At that moment, all the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi swept backwards and formed a gigantic Yuan Qi vortex and surged towards Yi Yun. The Yuan Qi and laws gestated from the worldly phenomena were returning to Yi Yun.

Divine Emperor's expression changed slightly as he bellowed, "Set up the Godfiend Array, destroy the Heavenly Courts, obliterate humanity, and kill Yi Yun!"

He was feeling an intense sense of unease. He needed to seize the moment before Yi Yun consolidated his cultivation level to severely injure him.

The array set up by tens of millions of demonic servants was something no Godly Monarch in the Chaos Heavens could defend against. Even the Divine Emperor himself couldn't do so.

Furthermore, he would be presiding over the Godfiend Array personally to ensure Yi Yun's death.

After the Divine Emperor issued his order, tens of millions of demonic servants began gathering around the array formation. A terrifying annihilative force swept through the Heavenly Courts.

In just an instant, the Heavenly Courts' array began to crumble! All the palaces were enveloped by sanguine and dark clouds. It was as if hell had descended upon them.

Patriarch Polar stood forward as he drew his sword. "Heavenly Courts disciples, we shall fight to the last man, never to retreat one step!"

"Kill!"

"Kill!"

Yi Yun's breakthrough filled all the human Godly Monarchs with fighting spirit. They flew out from various spots in the Heavenly Courts and charged at the demonic servant array!

Even though they knew that they were too weak against the Celestial's army, they could not allow the array formation to successfully take form while Yi Yun was still consolidating his cultivation.

When it was an array that comprised of tens of millions of demonic servants, it was not that simple to activate.

"Kill the Heavenly Courts' Godly Monarch first!"

Divine Emperor ordered the Godly Monarch Celestials. His order was similarly directed to the Godly Monarchs of the Ghosts, Souls, and Fey.

At this moment, the Godly Monarchs of the other races were wavering on their decision.

The Celestials' might was redoubtable, but with Yi Yun's strength alone, he had shook the Chaos Heavens and seemingly was meeting the Celestials as equals.

At this moment, their hearts and minds were involuntarily aligned with Yi Yun.

"Boom! Boom! Boom!"

At that moment, the land ruptured as rocks and soil flew into the air. Black dragons flew out of the collapsing soil and swept the demonic servant array!

Any demonic servant struck by the dragons was annihilated instantly.

Even the many demonic generals equivalent to human Divine Lords suffered the same fate.

"What!?"

Everyone felt a jolt through their hearts. When they focused their eyes, they saw that the countless black dragons were actually thick tree roots.

And behind Yi Yun, a towering tree had extended its lush foliage to block out the firmaments!

Just the tree's height alone far exceeded the Divine Emperor.

Meanwhile, people heard a sharp shriek from the tree's crown. A gigantic green demon pounced down from the tree like a tiger. It charged into the demonic servant army and, like a tiger in a herd of sheep, engaged in a massacre!

The green demon looked even more sinister than the demonic servants. Its body was covered in green fog that was lethally poisonous. Being tainted by just a tiny bit of it was enough to corrode one's body to bone!

Its gaping mouth could devour a palace and there were few rows of sharp teeth lining its mouth. Just one bite from this green demon was enough to be devour large numbers of demonic servants.

Upon seeing this scene, the Divine Emperor was enraged, but he did not fluster. There were tens of millions of demonic servants. Even if the towering tree and the green demon were imposing, there was no way they could kill all.

"Set up the formation!" the Divine Emperor roared.

He wanted to activate the array formation as Poison Demon and the Azure Wood Divine Tree engaged in their slaughter.

As energy rose exponentially, the human Godly Monarchs were instantly placed at the disadvantage when facing the Celestial's obstruction.

The Divine Emperor knew very well that only by activating the demonic servant array formation would there be a chance to destroy Yi Yun. Otherwise, once Yi Yun's foundations were fully consolidated, there was no way he could fight him.

Tens of millions of demonic servants paid the price to buy time. Just as the array formation was about to be finished, all the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi were isolated from the area.

Space was sealed and the laws changed, forming an alternate dimension.

At that moment, only Poison Demon was engaging in the slaughter. The Azure Wood Divine Tree roots which had been delivering immense damage to the demonic servants had vanished.

However, the Divine Emperor did not relax his guard. It appeared like the calm before the storm.

Sou! Sou! Sou! Sou…

At that moment, one divine root after another tore out from the ground. Each divine root was a twisted mass of dozens of tree roots, making them as thick as a heavenly column!

There were a total of twelve divine roots which resembled twelve nails. They completely impaled the demonic servants' array.

The Divine Emperor's heart palpitated. The twelve divine roots had impaled exactly where the twelve array cores were.

The Godfiend Array was mighty and mystical, and it was obviously something Yi Yun could not see.

However, while Yi Yun was consolidating his breakthrough in cultivation, he could instantly tell the lifeline of the Godfiend Array.

The twelve divine roots held down the twelve array cores. Although the Divine Emperor could break the divine roots one after another, there was no longer any time for him to continue activating the array.

This was because the Divine Emperor could tell that high in the sky, Yi Yun had already completely absorbed the Yuan Qi and laws. His cultivation level had already consolidated.

At that moment, the aura in the world changed. What was a sleeping dragon had finally awakened.

Chapter 1694: Divine Emperor Vanquished

After completing the breakthrough, Yi Yun had fused Spirit, Qi, and Soul as one. All the Celestial warriors present, even the demonic servants with low intelligence, faced Yi Yun feeling horried. This was a suppression from the difference in life's natural order. It was like a rabbit facing a mighty hawk.

"Ancestor God, inform the Ancestor God quickly!" a Celestial divine general said immediately.

With the way things were developing, informing the Ancestor God was the most correct way of handling the situation. No matter how strong Yi Yun was, he would not be able to defeat the Ancestor God.
