Among the crowd, a seventy-foot-tall Celestial divine general immediately took out a voice transmission token. Its range covered the entire Chaos Heavens.

However, the instant the divine general took out the token, he felt his energy drain rapidly. What seemed like a gentle wind was blowing across him, causing all his actions, including his vitality, to be sealed completely. Despite being a mighty divine general, he was not even capable of activating the voice transmission token.

A stunning scene happened immediately after that. The divine general's body began to rapidly lose its luster. Its originally bronze skin turned grayish-yellow as it began to dry and age. His golden hair also turned like yellow withered grass as it began falling out.

The divine general was rapidly losing his vitality!

In just a few blinks of an eye, all of the divine general's flesh and blood withered, leaving behind a body of skin wrapping around golden bones before he plummeted from the sky.

Boom!

The withered bone crashed to the ground and crumbled.

A Celestial divine general died so simply. Even at his point of death, his rotten and dry eyes were filled with horror and disbelief.

The Godly Monarchs present were all knowledgeable people. They obviously knew that Yi Yun had used the laws of time to kill the divine general.

Time had been accelerated, draining him of his vitality and causing him to rot.

Such means were usable in the hands of others, but it could only be used against weaklings when the difference in strength was humongous.

To use the laws of time to kill a Godly Monarch was nearly impossible. After all, a Godly Monarch's lifespan was extraordinarily long. To use the laws of time to siphon off all their vitality was an inconceivable act.

"Everyone, join forces to kill Yi Yun!" ordered the Divine Emperor angrily.

"Where's the Ancestor God?" Some of the Celestial divine generals were already panicking.

"Ancestor God is in seclusion… He is in his final stage of fusing with the Heavenly Dao. The twelve array cores are about to be activated…"

Divine Emperor's expression turned immensely heavy. They had gathered so many divine generals and demonic servants, to the point of allying with the other peak races to get them to provide an army. In name, it was said to annihilate Yi Yun, but in fact, it was to serve as a shock-and-awe measure for the Chaos Heavens. It was to ensure that everything would go smoothly at the final moment when the Ancestor God fused with the Heavenly Dao.

But who would have imagined that this redoubtable Celestial army would be on the brink of defeat while facing Yi Yun!

To extraordinarily powerful figures, numbers were of little meaning. This was also why the peak races had no choice but to submit to the Ancestor God.

The Celestials had more than a hundred Godly Monarchs. Still, unless they set up an array, they were nothing but fleeting clouds in front of Yi Yun.

"Set up the array. Celestial Dao of the Nine Firmaments!" the Divine Emperor ordered via a voice transmission. However, the instant his sentence finished, another Celestial divine general rapidly rotted away under everyone's shocked gaze into a dessicated corpse!

"No matter how powerful he is, the speed at which he can kill is limited. Let's join forces to vanquish Yi Yun!" Divine Emperor roared loudly.

At that moment, not only were the hundred plus Celestial divine generals setting up an a array, even the tens of millions of demonic servants were beginning to enter their own formation.

With both things happening at the same time, Yi Yun could only deal with one and not the other.

Once any of the arrays were set up, Yi Yun could very well be inflicted with immense damage.

And at this critical juncture, Polar flew high into the sky!

"Fellow Daoists!"

Polar's voice was infused with Yuan Qi as it resounded for 5000 kilometers.

"We who cultivate do so to defy the heavens and change fate, to escape the cycle of Samsara! Today, the Chaos Heavens is facing an unprecedented crisis. Yi Yun has already broken through to the Godly Monarch realm and is equal to the Ancestor God. Are you still willing to be slaves!?"

Polar's shout sounded like thunder.

The dozens of Godly Monarchs from humanity, Souls, and Fey had their hearts burn with fighting spirit. Their fighting spirit did not stem from Godly Monarch Polar's words, but from desire for freedom and life of the race behind them.

They had indeed been repressed for far too long.

From the day the Ancestor God appeared, all they could do was put up with it, again and again. Even though their Godly Monarch peers were killed, all they could do was act oblivious.

And today, all of this repression finally boiled to a reaction.

"Fight! Fight! Fight!"

The patriarchs of the few major races shouted in unison, causing dozens of Godly Monarchs from various races to charge towards the Celestial divine general's formation!

"Boom! Boom! Boom!"

Energy which could render the world asunder caused large swaths of palaces in the Heavenly Courts to collapse. Even the void was penetrated.

The battle royale between nearly two hundred Godly Monarchs caused energy surges that could tear through the Chaos Heavens itself.

And in fact, that did happen. A huge hole had opened in the Chaos Heavens as a rift in the Multiverse was forcefully opened up.

However, no one fled towards the Multiverse rift. Be they the Celestials or the Godly Monarchs from the peak races, none of them feared this battle!

At that moment, the Divine Emperor's eyes looked like they were cracking.

The division between "us" and "them" was irreconcilable. If not for the Ancestor God's need to devour the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao that required the help of these Godly Monarchs, he would have long exterminated them all. He would do it even if it would incite a war with the major Chaos Heavens races.

And now, the Divine Emperor was pushed into a corner with no means of retreat. The Azure Wood Divine Tree and the green demon were wreaking destruction among the demonic servants. The army from the peak races numbering hundreds of thousands had also entered battle with the demonic servant army. Although they could not pose any threat to the demonic servant army, it made it impossible to take up a formation in such a situation.

"Where are your eyes looking? Your opponent is me!"

Suddenly, a voice that sounded like Death sounded in the Divine Emperor's ears. His heart shrank as he looked up immediately and saw Yi Yun floating above him in black. His eyes were filled with killing intent.

"I'll use your blood as a sacrifice to my path towards matching the Human Emperor!" Yi Yun raised his hand slightly as a black 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence was conjured behind him. It absorbed all destruction forces.

The Demon Gods on the wheel represented destruction.

Back then, although Human Emperor had rescued all life, destruction was the Human Emperor's totem.

Yi Yun knew very well that even if he had fused the three Universe Seeds together, there was still a huge gap between him and the Human Emperor. However, that didn't matter. The Human Emperor had been cultivating for billions of years while Yi Yun had only cultivated for about a thousand years.

He had the time to study the Heavenly Dao to escape the cycle of Samsara and wield power over the world!

"Die!"

Having accumulated immense destructive forces, the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence surged downwards. The Divine Emperor let out a roar as he bulged his muscles and burned his divine blood. Blinding golden light emitted his body!

At that moment, Divine Emperor did not hesitate to burn his Divine Blood Origins.

Behind the Divine Emperor, his boiling divine blood conjured a gigantic Demon God. It had three faces and three thousand arms. Every hand wielded a weapon.

This was the strongest Martial Dao that the Divine Emperor cultivated in.

Only by burning his Divine Blood Origins could he use it. No Godly Monarch in the Chaos Heavens, including each race's patriarch, could put up a resistance against the three-thousand-arm Demon God.

In this battlefield, even though there were more than a hundred Godly Monarchs embroiled in a battle, they were all suppressed by the Divine Emperor's three-thousand-arm Demon God! Everyone looked at this astonishing scene.

The might of such a move would appear in the annals of history!

However… it was a pity that the Divine Emperor's opponent was Yi Yun.

"Boom! Boom! Boom!"

The 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence pressed down mightily as all the weapons in the three-thousand-arms of the Demon God shattered within seconds.

The Demon God flew towards the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence, but the force of Major Destruction was impossible to defend against. The Demon God's numerous arms began to explode one after another.

Boom!

The three-thousand-armed Demon God was completely devoured by the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence as the black 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence looked like a grinder that could destroy everything. People even heard the Demon God's cry while being ground.

"Puah!"

The Divine Emperor spat out a mouthful of blood. He clenched his teeth and planned to burn the last of his Divine Blood Origins to ignite an explosion of the Demon God inside the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence.

Even if he failed to blast Yi Yun to death, it would blast apart his divine power.

But at that moment, a pair of cold eyes appeared before the Divine Emperor.

Through those eyes, the Divine Emperor seemed to see countless Universes, and they were undergoing birth and destruction.

They were Yi Yun's eyes.

"Cha!"

Laws condensed to form a gigantic god-slaying sword that cleaved from heaven to earth!

The Divine Emperor's bronze body which was thousands of feet tall was split into two by Yi Yun's strike!

Following that, the blade slashed horizontally as the Divine Emperor's body was split into four.

"Cha! Cha! Cha!"

Sword beams flew in every direction, each as blinding as the sun. The Divine Emperor's corpse was diced up by Yi Yun, and even at the moment of his death, the Divine Emperor's eyes still had a trace of shock and indignation.

He had attempted to self-destruct his corpse with the last of his consciousness, but Yi Yun's successive blows had split up his body, severing all his major meridians. It made self-destruction impossible.

Divine blood splattered down like rain!

When everyone saw this scene, the battle that was happening like a raging fire slowed down.

The Divine Emperor was dead!

A Divine Emperor of a generation had been slain by Yi Yun!

And this process took less than a minute.

With the death of the Divine Emperor, the Celestials had lost their leadership. Regardless of how courageous they were, they lost their morale. On the contrary, the allied forces of the peak races had their morales raised.

"Kill! Kill! Kill!"

Millions of people roared, causing a resonance from the land. Rich lifeblood powers raged like the flames of war, tearing through the Multiverse rift!

The huge Celestial army was left in shambles by a million people!

Of course, the main reason for this was Yi Yun!

Yi Yun could vanquish Godly Monarchs with a mere raise of his hand.

With a mere thought, he could obliterate tens of thousands of demonic servants!

Apart from that, the Azure Wood Divine Tree and Poison Demon were causing wanton destruction. These two slaughterers fed upon the very powers of the demonic servants.

A large amount of the Divine Emperor's blood that had splattered was absorbed by the Azure Wood Divine Tree and Poison Demon. They became stronger as they fought!

Against such an enemy, the huge Celestial army lost the courage to do battle. Instantly, the battle became a one-sided slaughter.

Finally, some Celestial mighty figures could not hold out any longer and escaped towards the Multiverse rift.

With the first, there was the second and third.

With more than a hundred Godly Monarchs and tens of millions of demonic servants, it was impossible to kill them all. Even Yi Yun wasn't capable of doing so.

As they scattered, some of them burrowed into the Chaos Heavens while others flew into the Multiverse rift. All of them were in a fluster!

At this moment, the once-formidable Celestial allied army suffered an abject defeat!

Chapter 1695: From Waxing to Waning

In the past few decades, the grudge between the peak races and the Celestials accumulated and deepened. Now that the Celestial army was in shambles and attempting escape, how could these races miss the chance to seek revenge?

"Kill!"

The peak races of the Chaos Heavens let out deafening war cries, as all the warriors began a relentless pursuit. Many people were even pursued into the Multiverse rift.

If one was powerful enough, diving into the Multiverse rift for a short distance posed no danger.

In the sky, large numbers of demonic servants had been vanquished. That, however, paled in comparison to the loss of Celestial divine generals.

These divine generals had always enjoyed lofty existences, ones that far exceeded the Godly Monarchs of the other major races. But now, under Yi Yun's pursuit, they were unable to join forces to face off the common enemy. One by one, they perished.

During the chaotic retreat, Yi Yun slew more than ten of the hundred plus divine generals that were fleeing!

In a battle that determined the survival of races, there could only be blood.

When everything gradually calmed down, the entire sky, stretching out for thousands of kilometers, was enveloped by the demonic aura dissipated by the death of the demonic servants. There were stormy aura blasts and spatial rifts everywhere.

Patriarch Polar was covered in blood, but he wore a delighted look on his face.

This battle was worth it!

Even if Yi Yun were to really be defeated by the Ancestor God, he felt that the number of kills he racked up was worth it.

After the Divine Emperor was vanquished, Patriarch Polar himself had killed a Celestial divine general alone!

In addition, Patriarch Sky Punishment also killed one, while the other Heavenly Courts Godly Monarchs joined forces to kill two. Humanity as a race had subdued four.

Such a battle outcome was of noteworthy proportions. To the Celestials of the past, there might not have been a single divine general death for more than a hundred million years.

As the Celestials had always been placed on a high pedestal, which other-race Godly Monarch would dare to offend them? Whenever a Celestial divine general and an other-race Godly Monarch ventured into a mystic realm together, the Celestial would always reap the highest benefit while all the other Godly Monarchs could do was exercise forbearance bit by bit.

If they were to come to blows because of their interests, it was easy to incur the wrath of the Celestials, which might ultimately doom them. No one could ensure the safety of a person the Celestial had earmarked for death.

And the exaggerated outcome of the battle was all thanks to Yi Yun!

At that moment, the various patriarchs and Godly Monarchs were looking at the black-robed figure in the sky.

Yi Yun stood there with a seemingly ordinary aura. He resembled a mortal that didn't expose any terrifying auras. However, his body was dyed in dark gold blood.

Around him were bodies of bronze giants.

Divine generals and the Divine Emperor were among the bodies!

These corpses effused a surging baneful aura, but all the energies instantly dissipated when they approached Yi Yun.

The battle today was all thanks to Yi Yun. Even without his killing of the Divine Emperor, his achievements had exceeded all the combined forces of the Godly Monarchs from the various peak races.

The Celestial divine generals had more than twenty perish!

The number of demonic servants deaths was innumerable.

Apart from the humans, the other Ghost, Soul, and Fey patriarchs looked at Yi Yun as they held back their words. They felt guilty and ashamed facing Yi Yun.

Previously, they had all betrayed Yi Yun.

At that moment, the Fey patriarch stood forward. He had some ties with Yi Yun and could probably exchange a few words.

"Young Master Yi, I have to apologize sincerely for going back on our contract. My soul is in your hands, and I have nothing to say about how you punish me. However, our betrayal was our personal decision and had nothing to do with the Fey race as a whole. Young Master Yi, I hope that you will allow the Fey to continue their bloodline in the future…"

Yi Yun and the Ancestor God were at irreconcilable odds. Although Yi Yun's chances of victory seemed low, he was bound to reign supreme if he were to win by chance. In that case, all the lives of the different races would be in his hands.

The fates of these races would all depend on Yi Yun's mood.

When that happened, Yi Yun would be the absolute ruler of the Chaos Heavens!

Yi Yun gave a nonchalant glance to the Fey's Patriarch Grand Supremum who bowed his head in silence.

Behind Patriarch Grand Supremum, the other Fey Godly Monarchs felt their hearts palpitate when they sensed Yi Yun's gaze on them. It was as though they had been seen through completely.

The repressive might that Yi Yun gave off was just too potent. The huge difference in strength and the decision of their future fates made them feel like they were subjects before a king when facing Yi Yun.

Yi Yun did not speak. All he did was give the Godly Monarchs a glance before ignoring them.

At this moment in time, he was no longer concerned over such matters. The various peak races had given him help in this battle after all. At the very least, they had held back the Celestial divine generals and prevented them or the tens of millions of demonic servants from forming an array.

Even if both parties had managed to set up an array formation, Yi Yun still had means to deal with them. It was just that Yi Yun would have to pay quite a nontrivial price to do so.

At that moment, Yi Yun did not wish to waste a single bit of his Yuan Qi.

Because… his true opponent was not the Divine Emperor.

This was only the prelude to the huge battle ahead of him.

Yi Yun waited silently and at that moment, hundreds of thousands of warriors from every race, including the Heavenly Courts' disciples, dozens of Godly Monarchs and patriarchs were silent. None of them knew what Yi Yun was waiting for.

"It's about time…"

Yi Yun suddenly said out of the blue, but no one understood what he was talking about. It was at that moment when the land suddenly quaked. The tremors were thousands of times, if not millions of times, more terrifying than any earthquake in the past!

The earthquake was not localized but was happening throughout the Chaos Heavens!

If one were to view the Chaos Heavens from the Multiverse rift, one could clearly sense that the entire Chaos Heavens was trembling.

Even the Multiverse membrane was quivering as though it would shatter at any moment!

And if the Multiverse membrane were to shatter, the Chaos Heavens would be cease to be the Chaos Heavens. It would become a part of the Multiverse rift and when that happened, all the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi in the Chaos Heavens would seep into the Multiverse rift until all Yuan Qi was gone!

When that happened, the Chaos Heavens would be in the same situation as the Xuanyuan Dune!

Mining could be done in the Chaos Heavens, but it would no longer be a suitable place for cultivation or even just living.

Everyone noticed this phenomena—the Multiverse membrane was shaking!

"This…This is…"

The Godly Monarchs had drastic changes in expression. This sudden turn of events chilled their hearts. Once the Multiverse membrane shattered, the outcome would be disastrous!

"Is it the Ancestor God?"

Everyone's hearts palpitated. Such a cataclysmic turn of events could only be a result of the Ancestor God!

"Array core… the twelve array cores have been activated…"

Patriarch Grand Supremum suddenly realized what was happening. Before he finished his sentence, a blinding beam of light blasted out from the Heavenly Courts' back mountains, thrusting into the sky like a sword of god.

Countless palaces fell within the radius of the beam and were obliterated, instantly vanishing from existence!

Back when the Ancestor God chose to set up the Chaos Heavens array, he had chosen twelve spots with rich Heaven Earth Yuan Qi as the array core, and another seventy-two sub-first grade spirit vein sources as key array nodes.

These twelve array cores were where the main veins of the Chaos Heavens were. It included the Fey's core Heaven Fey City, the humans' Heavenly Courts, the Ghosts' Sky River of the Netherworld among its ranks!

About two weeks ago, the seventy-two sub-first grade array nodes had been activated.

Now, it was time for the twelve main array cores!

The patriarchs present emanated their perceptions and indeed, they saw divine beams surging into the sky from their own territories!

It was the same with Heaven Fey City and Sky River of the Netherworld!

The divine beam spewed out Yuan Qi that had been accumulated in these lands for billions of years.

Now, it was gushing out like water. It was like the draining of a pond to catch fish, so how could they not feel the pinch?

As the various patriarchs felt the pain, they knew without a doubt that the Ancestor God had begun devouring the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao!

The array could no longer be stopped.

The earthquake that embroiled the entire Chaos Heavens would only turn more terrifying. Ghastly cracks appeared out of thin air as huge ravines formed at astonishing speeds. All of them spread out for millions of kilometers and went hundreds of thousands if not millions of feet deep!

This was the steepest of precipitous ridges!

And as these cracks deepened, a terrifying aura seeped out from the bottom of these ravines. It seemed to freeze the souls of everyone present as if these ravines led to the netherworld.

"This is… the force of world annihilation…"

As Godly Monarchs of the Chaos Heavens, everyone present was knowledgeable. They had often visited Great Worlds on the brink of destruction. This included Yi Yun who had been to the Azure Wood Great World which was on the brink of collapse. From there, he had learned the laws of Major Destruction.

Back then, the Azure Wood Great World was filled with corrosive Apocalyptic Fumes.

And now, although the auras suffusing the Chaos Heavens ravines were far less corrosive than the Apocalyptic Fumes, they showed some resemblance!

This meant that the Chaos Heavens was beginning to wane!

Of course, for such a huge universe, for it to totally decline, the process would probably take a billion years or more!

Even so, this phenomena of going from waxing to waning left the warriors of the Chaos Heavens feeling despondent and in despair.

Their territories were about to fall, and the Chaos Heavens was beginning to wane. Where were they to go?

Chapter 1696: Chaos Heavens Heavenly Dao

Although this battle with the Celestial army left them delighted, the allied forces realized they would likely be the Ancestor God's target for revenge.

The situation was irredeemable. If Yi Yun were to be defeated by the Ancestor God, they would most likely be killed.

"Young Master Yi, the Chaos Heavens' Origins has been siphoned by the Ancestor God, dooming the Chaos Heavens to wane in the future. Do you have any plans on leaving the Chaos Heavens?" Patriarch Polar asked.

His question immediately gave the present Godly Monarchs ideas.

Even before Yi Yun broke through to the Godly Monarch realm, he had apparently been capable of tampering with his tracing mark. Although Yi Yun didn't manage a thorough removal back then, he had now broken through, so it was likely that he could completely remove the tracing marks.

As long as he removed the tracing marks, they could leave the Chaos Heavens and head for the billions of worlds out there in the Multiverse. With the Multiverse being so huge, it was impossible for the Ancestor God to pursue them.

If that were the case, all their lives would be saved.

As for the trillions of people that shared their race, losses were inevitable in this calamity.

However, they could take advantage of the moment to select the most outstanding and talented members of their race, those who had the highest potential to amount to something, and take them away.

As for the rest that remained in the Chaos Heavens, their fates were in the air. However, the Celestials were a small race. To rule over the Chaos Heavens, they needed slaves. It was unlikely they would kill too many people.

When the distant future came, the core members of their race would have produced more offspring and could one day return to the Chaos Heavens.

With this in mind, many Godly Monarchs were tempted.

It was extremely difficult to cultivate to their present state, so as long as they had a chance to live, no one wanted to die.

Of course, all of this depended on Yi Yun. Without him, they could not even wipe away the tracing marks. Death was still a certainty no matter where they fled to.

The Ghost patriarch said immediately, "Young Master Yi, if you are leaving the Chaos Heavens, us Ghosts are willing to follow you and honor you as lord!"

"Us Souls are agreeable as well. We can open up a Great World and create a brand new world. When that happens, Young Master Yi will be supreme lord of this new world." the Soul patriarch added as well.

Yi Yun sneered. "New world?"

With the Ancestor God present, any new world that reached a certain scale was bound to be discovered by the Celestials. Unless he and the bunch of Godly Monarchs chose to live like hiding rats, there was no way to escape trouble forever.

Yi Yun took a deep breath as the Yuan Qi in him spun like a tornado. At his fingertip, a Heavenly Dao Royal Seal slowly suffused. It was like an infinite starry sky that had been compressed to a point.

Yi Yun lightly touched the void in front of him and, at that moment, what seemed like a calm water surface rippled out as a spatial fluctuation.

The ripples grew in size and formed a spatial wave that ultimately developed into an overwhelming tsunami!

The spatial dimension laws grew more violent until space was torn apart with Yi Yun's fingertip at its center.

A huge spatial rift appeared in the sky. It was as though the entire Chaos Heavens had shattered because of this rift.

"This is…"

A spatial passageway that leads to the Multiverse rift?

That was the first idea on everyone's mind, but all of them had seen Multiverse rifts. The other end of Yi Yun's spatial rift did not look like the typical dead and silent Multiverse rift.

Where did the passageway lead to?

Could it be that Yi Yun had opened up a passageway that led directly to another Multiverse from the Chaos Heavens?

With this in mind, everyone felt fascinated.

"Young Master Yi, this is…" the Soul patriarch could not help but ask.

And at that moment, a terrifying destructive aura spread out from the other end of the spatial rift. Through the crack, people saw countless black holes and turbulent flows, as well as destructive streams that burgeoned rapidly.

"That is…"

"Apocalyptic Fumes!"

The Godly Monarchs had drastic changes in expression. Amid the Apocalyptic Fumes were auras that belonged to the Chaos Heavens. Could it be…

"This isn't a passageway that leads to the Multiverse. It's…"

"It heads straight to the core of the Chaos Heavens, and also the passageway that leads to the Ancestor God's array core," Yi Yun said softly.

The Godly Monarchs turned pale. They were worrying about the Ancestor God's pursuit, but Yi Yun had directly opened up a spatial rift that led straight to the Ancestor God's array core!

The Ancestor God's array core was surrounded by numerous array formations. How did Yi Yun tear through space to create a passageway that lead straight in?

"You plan on fighting the Ancestor God?" the Soul patriarch said in disbelief. Was Yi Yun mad? Even if he had vanquished the Divine Emperor, he was no match for the Ancestor God.

Just as he finished his sentence, he watched helplessly as Yi Yun took a step forward and entered the spatial rift!

Yi Yun floated forward alone, having taken the initiative to seek out the Ancestor God before the Ancestor God came looking for him.

What sort of madness was this!?

And in fact, it was indeed difficult for the present Yi Yun to fight the Ancestor God!

However, Yi Yun had participated in the setup of the Ancestor God's array formation. During those ten years, he had gained an understanding of the Ancestor God's array formation, and precisely because of this, he had pinpointed the location of the Ancestor God's array core and was able to gain access.

He was certain that the Ancestor God was devouring the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao at the moment. It was a crucial period for the Ancestor God; if not, he wouldn't have mobilized tens of millions of demonic servants and about a hundred Celestial Godly Monarchs to awe the Chaos Heavens.

This was Yi Yun's only chance!

If he were to sit idle and watch the Ancestor God devour the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, it would be the end. The entire Chaos Heavens would be reduced to a burning hell.

Every step Yi Yun took caused the chaotic space to regain its calm under his feet. Black holes vanished as the turbulent flows were attenuated.

All this was natural and harmonious. The Ancestor God brought destruction upon the Chaos Heavens while Yi Yun brought new life to this space.

Gradually, Yi Yun fused with the core of the Chaos Heavens, making it impossible to distinguish the two from one another.

As for the Heavenly Dao Royal Seal inside his body, it began to surface and fuse with the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao.

"This is…"

Upon seeing this scene, Polar's heart quaked. Yi Yun was not directly challenging the Ancestor God to battle. Instead, he was fusing with the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao. Could it be that…

"He's trying to snatch the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao from the Ancestor God?"

It was not only Polar. The Fey, Soul, and Ghost patriarchs all came to the same conclusion at the same time.

Although Yi Yun appeared to casually walk into the core of the Chaos Heavens, he had in fact summoned all the laws he cultivated in. These laws were beginning to fuse with the Chaos Heavens.

The Ancestor God had caused the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao to surface through his massive array which was powered by 84 wonderlands.

Although the Ancestor God wished to devour the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, Yi Yun could also refine the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao for himself by entering its core!

He had the strength needed to do so.

He was snatching food from the tiger's proverbial mouth!

No one expected that this was Yi Yun's plan.

He was going to use the Ancestor God's array to empower himself!

To put it in another way, ever since Yi Yun participated in the setup of the Ancestor God's array formation, he already had this plan in mind. Everything was just to set his plan into motion.

Now, Yi Yun had summoned out all the laws in his body. It was a bet he staked everything on!

Chapter 1697: Ancestor God Token

Yi Yun's figure vanished into the array's core to the widened gazes of everyone. All of them tried to make out the subsequent scene, but the rift closed quickly, isolating them from the array's core completely.

"What… do we do now?" The Godly Monarchs exchanged looks.

The Ghost patriarch had a look of hesitation. Without Yi Yun, they had no way of removing the tracing mark on them, which meant that they could not leave the Chaos Heavens. As such, all they could do was wait for the outcome of the battle.

No one expected Yi Yun to be crazy enough to vie for the Heavenly Dao against the Ancestor God.

The Ancestor God had been setting up the array for decades and logically speaking, victory was a certainty. Yet, Yi Yun had created too many impossible miracles.

Of course, the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao would be gone if it was devoured. However, it was better in the hands of Yi Yun than the Ancestor God. At the very least, Yi Yun wouldn't take ownership of their lives or sever their heritage.

…

The world was a gray blur as far as the eyes could see. Yi Yun had already arrived in the core of the array. In this space, his perception was infinitely compressed, making it nearly impossible to release it outwards. However, after Yi Yun's laws fused with the surrounding space he was in, he could detect everything around him.

He knew very well that the gray substance around him was the nebulous Primordial Chaos.

For a world to prosper, it needed constant flesh and blood to provide for renewal. The river of time was bound to rot all things, and the Heaven Earth Yuan Qi was bound to slowly dissipate. Spiritual lands would slowly drain and the life they produced would slowly go extinct…

If the universe was unable to mend itself, it would slowly go down the route of decline.

And the material resource for a universe to heal itself came from the nebulous Primordial Chaos that gave birth to all things. It was like the stem cells of a person. The human body has countless cells dying each day, and these cells can develop into bone marrow, blood, muscles, organs, and other body parts to make up for any damage to the human body.

But unfortunately, the number of stem cells in a body will slowly reduce with the passage of time. As such, the human body will naturally ail. It could be said that the fundamental reason for aging is the loss of stem cells.

A universe's path to destruction was no different than the human body's.

However, it wasn't just the shortage of nebulous Primordial Chaos. Amid the nebulous Primordial Chaos, there was also infinite Origins energy. Combined together, they could produce the Chaos that gave birth to everything.

This was fundamental to the Chaos Heavens and also a guarantee for the prosperity of the Chaos Heavens. The Chaos Heavens originally possessed enough to maintain its prosperity for hundreds of billions of years, but the appearance of the Ancestor God snuffed out all of that. By devouring the Origins, it was equivalent to him robbing the Chaos Heavens of its longevity and the light that shines upon it from providence.

After the Ancestor God finished the devouring, the Chaos Heavens would rapidly ail, and he would be able to digest the universe's Origins and obtain infinite power, giving him a lifespan equal to the universe.

The Ancestor God's boundless ambition was so huge that it destined the death of countless lives and martial civilizations. He might even vanquish several peak races and various Great Worlds.

Now, that devouring had begun.

Yi Yun could sense that deep in the core of this space, there was a vortex that devoured everything. To this space, the vortex was nothing, but even a solid dyke can collapse because of an ant hole in it. As the vortex devoured the Chaos powers, it slowly expanded and accelerated its devouring speed.

This vortex was formed by the Ancestor God.

In order to devour the Chaos Heavens' Origins, the Ancestor God's body had already manifested a nomological form.

Once his devouring began, he could not be interrupted.

Yi Yun took steps towards the vortex and at that moment in time, he suddenly felt the surrounding space freeze.

A terrifying suppression emitted from the vortex's core and enveloped Yi Yun.

Yi Yun even felt his bloodline stifle. It was as though all his Yuan Qi flowed slower in his body.

This suppression stemmed from the rage of the Ancestor God.

"Human! How dare you enter this area?"

A deep voice that sounded like clanking metal sounded from everywhere. It was as though the world itself was speaking.

Indeed, the Ancestor God did not expect Yi Yun to find the core of the array and be able to infiltrate it. Just this alone implied that Yi Yun's nomological insights were already close to his.

"My being here is all thanks to you." Yi Yun laughed. "Without your array, I wouldn't have been able to find the entrance. It was you who found where the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao is, and all I did was follow in your footsteps."

The first person who forged the path faced the greatest difficulties. In order to set up the array, the Ancestor God had drained immense amounts of Yuan Qi from the various wonderlands. Even he had expended a great deal of effort to do so.

From this point of view, Yi Yun had benefited quite immensely.

Of course, it was impossible for Yi Yun to deal with the Ancestor God now.

As for the Ancestor God, it would be difficult for him to immediately annihilate Yi Yun for his devouring had begun. His body was in a nomological form meant for devouring, and Yi Yun wasn't an easy opponent. To kill Yi Yun, he would need to return to his original form.

And once he did revert his original form, his devouring of the Heavenly Dao would come to an end. Everything would then be for naught.

"Human, do you think you have what it takes to snatch the Heavenly Dao from me?" The Ancestor God's voice reverberated through space as he could already tell Yi Yun's intentions.

The Celestials could devour the Heavenly Dao to begin with, and the Ancestor God was the strongest Celestial. In terms of devouring the Heavenly Dao, no one could compare to him.

Furthermore, the array was set up by him. He was absolutely confident in his ability to devour the Heavenly Dao.

Besides, this worldly array was nothing to scoff at.

The Ancestor God knew very well that he could not manifest his true body when devouring the Heavenly Dao. Even though he was confident that the array's core would not let anyone gain entry, he had taken precautions and left contingencies in the array.

At that moment, killing intent surfaced in the array.

"You have developed your strength too quickly. I'm very astonished and I know that you carry secrets. I'm very interested for these secrets to become mine!"

As the Ancestor God spoke, golden tokens appeared around Yi Yun.

They were Ancestor God Tokens!

The Ancestor God Token was a manifestation of his mental soul and possessed a portion of his strength. The Ancestor God was occupied, but these soul avatars didn't suffer from his limitations.

The nine mental soul avatars could produce twice their combat strength under the array's augmentation.

Under the present circumstances, the Ancestor God's efforts were all placed on devouring the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao. He wouldn't hesitate to let his nine avatars self-destruct to achieve his goal.

Such a setup was enough to heavily injure or even kill Yi Yun!

Upon seeing this scene, the corners of Yi Yun's mouth arced. "The contingency you left behind sure isn't bad. It would have been a little troublesome for me to deal with them, but unfortunately… the speed at which you devour the Heavenly Dao is just too slow…"

Just as Yi Yun finished his sentence, three streams of light flew out of Yi Yun's body and surrounded Yi Yun in a triangular formation.

These three streams of light were the three Universe seeds. They were the amalgamation of the Spirit, Qi, and Soul of the next Multiverse.

And although the Chaos Heavens was a huge universe, it was only a portion of the Multiverse. It was just the biggest branch in the Multiverse's crown of branches.

The Chaos Heavens similarly possessed Spirit, Qi, and Soul!

In the core regions of the Chaos Heavens, there was the nebulous Primordial Chaos that made up everything. That was the Chaos Heavens' Spirit. The Origins energy that filled the area was the Chaos Heavens' Qi. And finally, the Heavenly Dao that governed this universe was the Chaos Heavens' Soul!

Yi Yun had in his control the Universe seeds formed from Spirit, Qi, and Soul, and before the three Universe seeds, the Chaos Heavens' Spirit, Qi, and Soul were instantly stirred!

Momentarily, Origins energy surged around Yi Yun like tumultuous tsunamis! The nebulous Primordial Chaos gathered over from every direction like the assaulting storm! And the Heavenly Dao laws that filled the space were almost completely fused with Yi Yun.

This combination made him more than ten times faster than the Ancestor God!

When the Ancestor God transformed into a devourment law, all he did was stir up a vortex. But around Yi Yun was a black hole!

The three Universe seeds resonated with the Chaos Heavens' Spirit, Qi, and Soul as they surged constantly towards Yi Yun.

Yi Yun's strength was rising rapidly!

At this moment in time, Yi Yun was no longer experiencing a simple rise in cultivation level, but a sublimation of life's natural order!

Upon seeing this unforeseen circumstance, the Ancestor God was alarmed. Having lived for billions of years, few things could perturb him in this world. However, Yi Yun's speed at devouring the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao far exceeded his level of understanding!

"What exactly is happening…"

The Ancestor God looked at the three Universe seeds beside Yi Yun. He couldn't tell what they were despite being extremely knowledgeable for he had never seen the Universe seeds before.

At this moment, the three Universe seeds had fused with Yi Yun's life. They were filled with Yi Yun's aura and looked akin to Yi Yun's Divine Lord Royal Seals.

Could this be the Divine Lord Royal Seals that Yi Yun cultivated?

The Ancestor God found it ludicrous. He knew very well that such a powerful treasure could not even compare to the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao. How could it be condensed out of life itself?

Chapter 1698: Terrible Price

Amid this ravaging energy storm, the array formation that the Ancestor God had set up began to totter. Although his nine avatars were present, they were unable to benefit from the augmentation of the array.

Ancestor God was reeling in panic. He could sense that the three heavenly treasures that were floating before Yi Yun were condensed from the Spirit, Qi, and Soul of the Multiverse. And the core of the Chaos Heavens was its Spirit, Qi, and Soul. This resulted in Yi Yun having the ability to vie for the Heavenly Dao in a far superior manner.

It would be too late if he didn't disrupt Yi Yun now.

Even though his avatars could not be augmented by the array, the Ancestor God still activated them. They let out staggering roars as they charged at the core of the black hole where Yi Yun was.

The nine avatars looked identical to the Ancestor God. Although they weren't as huge as he was, they were more than a thousand feet tall. Their eyes were vacant and cold, but their bodies emitted different auras. There was Deathly Silence, Destruction, Baneful Aura, all Dao that the Ancestor God cultivated in.

He had already decided that his nine avatars could be sacrificed. He planned on self-destructing them the moment the nine avatars closed in on Yi Yun.

No matter how strong Yi Yun was, it was impossible for him to remain unharmed when caught in the nine avatars' self-destruction. He would have to abandon the devourment of the Heavenly Dao to withstand the attack of the nine avatars. And when that happened, it was unlikely Yi Yun had the ability to continue resisting him even if he remained alive.

The nine avatars instantly tore through space and appeared on the black hole's boundary.

Following that, an abyssal aura suffused their bodies.

This aura gave off the feeling that they could vanquish all before them.

"Die." Ancestor God transmitted his cold voice into the black hole which spun continuously. The nine avatars exploded simultaneously as a blinding radiance instantly swept through space. Terrifying energies instantly blanketed the black hole.

At that moment, everyone in the Chaos Heavens sensed an energy fluctuation. The awaiting Godly Monarchs in the Heavenly Man saw a flash of white light along the horizon.

And at that moment, an even more potent tremor was felt.

Ancestor God's cold voice had an unexpected hint of shock. "What?"

He felt that the destruction and devourment energies emitted from the black hole were slowly grinding and absorbing the self-destructive energies of the nine avatars!

Following that, he saw spinning wheels appear slowly from the black hole. There were illusory scenes of demons struggling as the entire wheel effused an aura of annihilation.

It was these wheels that were absorbing the terrifying energies of the self-destruction!

10000 Demon Wheel of Existence!

In fact, Yi Yun was barely holding up at that moment.

The self-destruction of the Ancestor God's avatars was just too powerful. Just using the Heavenly Dao-fused 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence was not enough for Yi Yun to completely neutralize its strength.

Yi Yun's body had experienced the fusion of Human, Fey, and Celestial bloodlines, and had been reconstructed by the Myriad Form Shura Pill and the Heavenly Dao. It was already flawless. Apart from the Ancestor God, even the Divine Emperor's body was not as strong as Yi Yun's.

But even so, Yi Yun's organs, limbs, and meridians were constantly lacerating and exploding amid the nine avatars' self-destructive explosion!

Yi Yun clenched his teeth, knowing to secure his soul sea. He attempted to use the powers of Primordial Chaos to restore his body, but the speed of restoration could not match the speed of destruction.

With him about to completely lose control over the black hole, Yi Yun's Primordial Chaos Demon Bead in front of him emitted a blurry light. This light was like a rain after a drought that nourished Yi Yun's flesh and body.

His ruptured meridians constantly repaired as his innards healed.

The intense pain overwhelmed Yi Yun's soul sea, and ended up making him think even clearer.

The Primordial Chaos Demon Bead was the manifestation of Spirit among the Spirit, Qi, and Soul. So-called Spirit referred to the flesh.

The Primordial Chaos Demon Bead had immense bloodline powers stored in it. A portion of it had been left behind by the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch.

However, the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch was unable to take this Universe seed of a Multiverse to other universes; therefore, he had left it behind.

And now, the remaining energies in the Primordial Chaos Demon Bead prevented Yi Yun from taking any more grievous injuries.

The explosion of the nine avatars was all for naught!

The Ancestor God also suffered a backlash from his avatars' explosion. His Origins lifeblood suffered a tremor.

At that moment, the Ancestor God no longer had any means to attack Yi Yun.

He could only compete with Yi Yun in devouring the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, but with the three Universe seeds present, Yi Yun's speed was just too terrifying.

The nebulous Primordial Chaos, the Origins energy, the world's laws!

Seeing these constantly fusing with Yi Yun, the Ancestor God reeled in anxiety and anger.

He could no longer permit Yi Yun to continue the devourment or the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao would be under Yi Yun's possession in its entirety.

Upon realizing this, the Ancestor God felt extreme despair!

After all, he had expended immense time and effort to devour the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao. To set up the array, he had spent treasures he had accumulated for hundreds of millions of years!

For this, he had even drained the 84 Spirit Qi wonderlands in the Chaos Heavens. Their recovery would take far more than a few hundred million years.

Once his devourment of the Heavenly Dao failed, the Ancestor God would suffer an incredible loss.

Yet, the Ancestor God had no choice but to give up.

He could not let his efforts empower Yi Yun.

With a deep breath, the Ancestor God roared angrily. He stopped his devourment of the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao!

This was equivalent to him giving up, and rendered all his hard work and preparations for naught!

This was his way of cutting losses!

"Human, I'll dice you up and torture your soul!"

The Ancestor God let out a rapturous roar as the terrifying sound waves emitted out of the array's core and sounded throughout the Chaos Heavens!

The Godly Monarchs, who were waiting anxiously outside, had drastic changes in expression when they heard the roar. They were unsure of what was happening inside the array's core.

Boom!

The void quaked as people retreated. They had all sensed that this battle of epic proportions which determined the fates of everyone was about to begin!

At that moment, in the core of the array, the vortex that the Ancestor God manifested slowly came to a stop as it phased into the Ancestor God's dark gold body.

First was his head, followed by his torso and limbs.

He gave up the devourment of the Heavenly Dao to manifest his true body, his goal was now to destroy Yi Yun.

At that moment, he had paid a terrible price.

Finally, the Ancestor God's full body manifested. He was a dark golden giant nearly ten thousand feet tall. He had cut facial features and his eyes shone like the sun.

He extended his arm and grabbed out at the void, pulling out a battle ax the size of a mountain from a spatial rift.

This battle ax emitted wanton frosty beams that seemed to condense the wailings of countless wraiths. Over the hundred of millions of years, the number of deaths at the Ancestor God's hands were innumerable. The vitalities of the deceased lingered around the battle ax, making it the most terrifying murder weapon in the world!

Chapter 1699: Strength of the Ancestor God

The battle ax cleaved down as immense divine might surged through the nine firmaments, tearing apart the Chaos Heavens' membrane and rushing into the void of the universe. The massive divine strength was like a boundless, raging tidal wave!

At that instant, even the distant stars began to quake. The Chaos Heavens was shaking constantly.

Outside the core of the array, the other Godly Monarchs saw the phantom of a gigantic divine ax. When it came cleaving down, a huge rift tore into the ground out of nowhere. It was thousands of kilometers deep and seemed to tear through the lands of the Chaos Heavens!

Everyone was quivering both in body and mind. The might was at such an unfathomable level that it could split open the Chaos Heavens with one strike. Such a battle was taking place in the Chaos Heavens, but it was not something the Chaos Heavens could withstand. If this continued, it was even possible that the Chaos Heavens would be reduced to smithereens!

Without a doubt, the gigantic ax phantom was the Ancestor God's attack, and withstanding such an attack seemed unimaginable.

"Where's Yi Yun?"

Polar's voice quivered. From his point of view, the original array's core had begun cracking because of the Ancestor God's strike. The array appeared to be on the brink of shattering.

But even so, their perception was still unable to probe deep into the array.

At the core of the array were turbulent blasts of energy that formed a gigantic vortex. It constantly tore the surroundings apart. Even the space around the array was collapsing. Mountains and rivers were all swept into the vortex.

And within the vortex, a black hole could barely be seen, one that suffused Yi Yun's aura. However, there was a huge crack running through the black hole.

That was the mark left behind by the Ancestor God's ax!

The Ancestor God's ax had cleaved right onto the devourment laws Yi Yun had manifested!

As the cracks constantly widened, the black hole shrank in size.

At that moment, the black hole suddenly exploded and was reduced to countless fragments. In a blink of an eye, it vanished within the raging array core.

The Ancestor God's cold eyes observed the core of the array. He could not see Yi Yun, and Yi Yun's aura dissipated with the explosion of the black hole.

Even in the face of death, Yi Yun had not given up his devourment of the Heavenly Dao. In the end, he was vanquished, both in body and laws, with one strike.

However… was Yi Yun really dead?

Ancestor God held his battle ax tight as he surveyed his surroundings. He would absolutely not spare Yi Yun a chance even if Yi Yun only had a sliver of his soul left.

This strike had expended a great deal of the Ancestor God's energy. When he saw the array core in ruins, he could not help but let out an angry bellow.

Although Yi Yun had likely been reduced to dust, all his efforts had been for nothing!

The Ancestor God clenched his fists as he struck the array core repeatedly.

The array core which was already riddled in holes was further destroyed.

The Godly Monarchs outside the array core felt their bodies and minds tremble when they heard the Ancestor God's angry roar.

They watched helplessly as the array core became a spatial ruin formed from wanton forces. It was as though a huge wound had been torn open in the Chaos Heavens' sky.

As the wound constantly worsened, the entire Chaos Heavens would be devoured by its damaged depths.

And beside the massive wound was a giant that slowly stood up.

"Ancestor God…"

The Godly Monarchs outside the array looked at the giant in a daze.

The Ancestor God was still alive, and clearly, no life could exist in that terrifying wound.

Was Yi Yun dead?

At that moment, everyone's hearts plunged into despair.

And it was at that moment that the giant's pair of cold eyes swept towards these trivial lowlifes.

When being swept by this gaze, everyone's hearts stopped beating. Their alarmed souls found it difficult to breathe.

The Ancestor God's gaze had locked onto their souls.

This level of suppression was just too terrifying. Furthermore, they had all openly betrayed the Ancestor God by this point in time.

Under the scrutiny of the Ancestor God, these Godly Monarchs felt a baffling sense of coldness.

If the Ancestor God suddenly attacked, they might very well perish there and then. Even more depressing was that even if they succeeded in fleeing, they were unable to escape the Ancestor God's tracing mark. They would ultimately suffer a worse death.

The air seemed to freeze at that moment as the atmosphere turned as heavy as the Chaos itself. All the Godly Monarchs could only suffer the Ancestor God's suppression in silence.

The Ancestor God stood in midair while holding his gigantic ax. No one knew what he was planning to do.

This suppression that nearly drove people to the brink of madness lasted for quite a while until the Ancestor God finally put away his battle ax.

The Ancestor God looked coldly at everyone. His heart did not suffer any upheavals for he only saw these people as nothing but tools.

He did not directly attack them for he had not completely given up on the Chaos Heavens.

In fact, the Ancestor God's worldly array had enervated most of the Heavenly Dao in the Chaos Heavens' core, but he had ultimately failed to devour it.

Now, after the core's Heavenly Dao was shattered, the Chaos Heavens had been damaged fundamentally even though a portion of the Heavenly Dao had returned to the Chaos Heavens. Its decline could no longer be curbed.

Even if the Ancestor God spent more time and paid a massive price to devour the Heavenly Dao again, the benefits he stood to receive would be far less than what they were previously.

This left him in a dilemma. The Chaos Heavens became useless and bland, but abandoning it would be regretful.

Yet, the Chaos Heavens was a supreme universe in the Multiverse. If he were to abandon the Chaos Heavens, which Heavenly Dao could he devour?

The Ancestor God sat down cross-legged and began slowly recovering his energy.

Meanwhile, a massive divine force came bearing down and enveloping all the Godly Monarchs.

This was the Ancestor God's domain which imprisoned all the Godly Monarchs like a cage.

In fact, the Ancestor God wasn't in the best of states. After his intense battle with Yi Yun, as well as having Yi Yun disrupt his devourment of the Heavenly Dao, the Ancestor God was already injured. The domain he released could naturally be cracked if the Godly Monarchs joined forces.

But at that moment, the Godly Monarchs knew that any attempt at escaping the Ancestor God's domain would incur the Ancestor God's retaliation.

These mighty figures that ruled over the Chaos Heavens knew their fates were in the hands of the Ancestor God.

Of course, not everyone chose to sit idle. Some Godly Monarchs, including Polar, were engaging in voice transmissions in a bid to put up a struggle.

In fact, they also knew that even if they ignited all their blood essence, the threat they posed to the Ancestor God was negligible. However, they still wanted to take the gamble. It wasn't for their dignity as experts, but simply because they had turned weary after all these years. To be made to work akin to slaves, they would rather die in a glorious battle than await a slow death.

Just as the Godly Monarchs were communicating among themselves, someone suddenly discovered that the terrifying wound was changing.

The crack was only full of wanton energy blasts in the beginning, but now, without anyone realizing it, the chaotic flows had turned regular. They amassed towards the center as though something was summoning them.

Rumbling sounds emitted from the crack as a unique sound boomed in the Chaos Heavens.

It was vast and ethereal, the heaviness of history and time in their entirety.

After the Chaos Heavens' response, the rumbling crack grew in intensity and, in a blink of an eye, a black hole appeared in the crack.

The Ancestor God instantly stood up. He could sense a familiar yet alien aura from the crack.

It's Yi Yun? He's still not dead!?

Chapter 1700: Soul

The Ancestor God revealed a look of shock. He had clearly destroyed the laws Yi Yun had manifested! Even though he had considered the possibility of Yi Yun surviving, he had never expected Yi Yun to release such potent auras. It was as though he was never injured.

No one could remain unharmed after receiving his full-force strike in a frontal assault.

Ancestor God found it unbelievable. And at that moment, all the energies, laws, and nebulous Primordial Chaos gathered at a particular spot in the sky. They formed countless tiny points of light, and like birds flocking to a phoenix, they gradually condensed into a human figure, manifesting every inch of his blood, flesh, skin, hair, and even clothes.

This figure was undoubtedly Yi Yun.

Upon seeing this scene, the Ancestor God was astonished. The feeling he had was that Yi Yun's entire body was formed of Origins energy, laws of Origins, and nebulous Primordial Chaos.

It was a body completely formed of energy and laws, with the Primordial Chaos as his body, laws as his soul, and Origins energy as his dantian's Yuan Qi!

As such, Yi Yun's body was a Great Dao in and of itself!

This was the very metamorphosis of life.

It wasn't that the Ancestor God's strike had missed Yi Yun or that Yi Yun was unfazed by his attack; instead, when the gigantic ax struck the black hole, Yi Yun's body, including his soul, had shattered into countess tiny nomological and energy bodies. As such, Ancestor God's damage was minimized.

Not only so, the Ancestor God sensed that there was still an overwhelming energy and nebulous Primordial Chaos emanating out from deep in the rift of the array's core that was gathering towards Yi Yun.

Upon seeing this scene, the Ancestor God's heart sank. He knew very well that with the passage of time, Yi Yun's strength would increase further. His fusion with the Heavenly Dao would continue!

It could be said that every second that passed for the present Yi Yun was equivalent to a thousand years of arduous cultivation for mortal warriors.

The speed of such a terrifying growth chilled his heart.

"So your body has already completely turned into a nomological entity. You are indeed terrifying to force me into such a predicament. However, I will not give you another chance to build your strength."

As the Ancestor God spoke, he slammed the ax into his chest. With a reverberating hum that sounded like thunder, the Ancestor God spat out a mouthful of dark gold blood.

This was the Ancestor God's Divine Blood Origins!

Such divine blood was a lot more powerful than the divine blood Yi Yun had used when refining the Myriad Form Shura Pills since it contained the massive vital forces of the Ancestor God.

The Ancestor God's fresh blood burned the very air around him! Just one drop of this blood was enough to vanquish a mighty figure.

Now, a blob of blood gathered together and collapsed the void.

"I'll use my divine blood as a prison to seal your laws. Let me see how you will nullify this."

The Ancestor God waved his hand as a blob of divine blood transformed into a boundless mist of blood that enveloped Yi Yun. This was the absolute domain of the divine blood. Even if Yi Yun transformed himself into the laws of Origins or nebulous Primordial Chaos, he would remain imprisoned within mist of blood.

The Ancestor God raised his battle ax again!

Billions of wraiths wailed from within the ax with an earth-shattering cry. Even the hundred plus Godly Monarchs around felt like a demonic tune had entered their ears when they heard that. Even their blood flow slowed as they felt an indescribable repression!

As the Ancestor God's previous strike was in the array's core, no one had seen it personally. All they saw were the remnant blasts.

But now, this strike was happening right in front of their eyes!

"Retreat! Everyone, retreat!" a Godly Monarch yelled loudly. Just one look at the Ancestor God's strike made one feel like their soul was being imprisoned. They knew very well that the strike would annihilate everything.

Even if they were Godly Monarchs, they would be swept into the terrifying ax beam if they didn't keep a safe distance. They might even be completely obliterated.

All the Godly Monarchs opened up a gap from the epicenter. Even the patriarchs of the various races were shuddering in fear.

How could such a terrifying attack possibly be endured?

Apart from the Godly Monarchs, the other warriors, be they Heavenly Courts disciples or armies from the other races that rushed over, all of them were stored away by their patriarchs into their mobile abodes or their bodies' internal worlds. A battle at this level would reduce one to ashes immediately if a remnant blast were to brush past them!

The Godly Monarchs had retreated more than fifty kilometers away as they raised their barriers to withstand the explosive energy storms.

Even at this distance, they could still see the Ancestor God's massive body clearly.

"Boom! Boom! Boom!"

The black ax which was enveloped with countless wraiths cleaved down!

At that moment, the world seemed to lose its color. Even the celestial bodies far away were swept up by this strike. Compared to the Ancestor God's overwhelming strike, Yi Yun's body looked like a speck of dust.

It was a battle of disproportion! Yi Yun didn't even draw a weapon as he faced the Ancestor God's attack empty-handed.

Although they were fifty kilometers away, the Godly Monarchs present had excellent eyesight. They were able to see Yi Yun's every move clearly. Even the most minute changes in his expression and energy flow could be detected.

Indeed, a barehanded Yi Yun began taking action. Against the Ancestor God's attack, all he did was raise his hand slightly. But it was this simple motion that left an unforgettable impression on all the Godly Monarchs present.

Beneath Yi Yun's feet, the Chaos Heavens' lands were his foundation. A blackish-red dragon spanning half a million kilometers appeared silently. More than half of its body was buried within the Chaos Heavens' lands, and just its massive dragon head was five thousand kilometers long.

The Godly Monarchs were astounded. With their level of perception, which could extend for five million kilometers, they clearly sensed that Yi Yun's raising of his hand caused the entire Chaos Heavens to stir.

Even the Ancestor God appeared as trivial as a firefly in front of this massive figure.

"This is…"

"This is the Chaos Heavens' dragon veins! The entire Chaos Heavens' soul!"

Universes had life as well. After its birth, it would thrive and wane before being destroyed, just like the stages of human life—birth, aging, illness, and sickness. However, their lives were especially long. With the Chaos Heavens as an example, a lifespan of a hundred billion years was nothing.

Compared to them, humans, Souls, Fey, and all the other thousands of lifeforms were trivial in comparison. No matter what these lifeforms did, it was impossible to garner a reaction from the Universe.

But now, Yi Yun had extracted the Chaos Heavens' soul.

With the Chaos Heavens as a foundation, he had withstood the Ancestor God's strike!

"Boom!"

When the Ancestor God's ax cleaved the humongous dragon soul, the soul paused slightly before hurling straight for the Ancestor God.

The ax beam shattered as the Chaos Heavens trembled violently, creating countless cracks in the lands. Following that, overwhelming aura spewed out from the rifts and gathered towards Yi Yun.

"Begone!"

Yi Yun used his body as a sword as it manifested into a blazing star and slammed heavily into the Ancestor God's chest!

His impregnable body collapsed after being struck by Yi Yun, his ribcage exploding as blood splattered!

The Ancestor God grunted, having lost count of the years it had been since he was inflicted with such grievous wounds.

Yi Yun's body flew backwards. At that moment, he did not need to actively absorb the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao and Origins energy because they would automatically fuse with him. All the liquefied Yuan Qi essence that spewed out from the massive rifts gathered towards Yi Yun as well.

Just standing there allowed Yi Yun to fuse with the Chaos Heavens.

All the energies in the Chaos Heavens were available for Yi Yun's use. The Chaos Heavens' laws were Yi Yun's laws. The Chaos Heavens' lands were Yi Yun's body.

If the Ancestor God wanted to attack Yi Yun, he was basically attacking the entire Chaos Heavens. To kill Yi Yun, he needed to destroy the Chaos Heavens in its entirety. This was literally heaven and man as one!

"You have already fused with the… Chaos Heavens Heavenly Dao?" The heavily injured Ancestor God turned gloomy.

Yi Yun gently raised his hand as countless laws of Origins gathered towards him. A nomological sword coruscating with divine light condensed in his hand.

"The Heavenly Dao's evolution is unending. Creation and Destruction are interchangeable, forming a complete circle. Be it life or a universe, they have formation, existence, disintegration, and emptiness; birth, aging, illness, and death. You wanted to devour the Heavenly Dao, robbing and changing the fate of the universe. You wanted to empower yourself by initiating the deaths of millions; hence, you were destined to be abandoned by the Heavenly Dao.

"It wasn't me who fused with the Chaos Heavens, but it was the Chaos Heavens that chose me."

The reason why Yi Yun could borrow the Chaos Heavens' stellar soul powers to so quickly fuse with the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao was not solely because of the three Universe seeds. On the contrary, it was the Ancestor God's excessive extraction that made the declining Chaos Heavens choose Yi Yun.

The energy that had been robbed by the Ancestor God was injected into Yi Yun's body without any reservation.

As a result of this turn of events, Yi Yun's battle with the Ancestor God experienced a complete reversal!

The present Yi Yun had broken through to the Godly Monarch realm and had fused with the three Universe seeds. Having gathered the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, he was the ultimate lifeform.

Even if the Ancestor God had successfully devoured the Chaos Heavens' Heavenly Dao, it was absolutely impossible for him to have such a perfect, complete fusion like Yi Yun.

"The Chaos Heavens… chose you…" The Ancestor God's expression turned solemn. He never expected that the situation would develop this far.

The Great Dao was heartless, but the Heavenly Dao had made its own choice.

"You perverse acts shall incur the Heavenly Dao's slaying, with me as the executioner!" Yi Yun's voice echoed throughout the entire Chaos Heavens. At that instant, all the Chaos Heavens' energies were amassed in the nomological sword in Yi Yun's hand.

The entire world seemed to be the manifestation of the sword, leaving the Ancestor God with nowhere to hide.

The Ancestor God let out an angry bellow as golden light bloomed from his body as he faced the nomological sword that came slashing down.

The Godly Monarchs and patriarchs could not help but hold their breaths. Their breathing froze as they witnessed this battle of epic proportions.

Boom!

An astounding boom affected the blood and heartbeats of everyone as they resonated in response. The world seemed to let out a wrought up roar and it was none other than the Chaos Heavens' voice.

Radiating divine light, what was a four-foot-long nomological sword extended to dozens of kilometers as it reached straight into the firmaments.

This strike slashed down ruthlessly from Yi Yun's hand.

The Ancestor God roared angrily as he raised the ax to defend!

"Dang!"

In this intense clash, on one side was Yi Yun who had fused with the worldly Great Dao and on the other side was the Ancestor God who was defending with his body.

Even with a Celestial's heaven-defying body, such a stark difference in strength was unbridgeable!

Chapter 1701: Martial Dao Peak

The repeated collisions happened faster and faster as they grew in intensity. Yi Yun's battle with the Ancestor God rent the world asunder.

The Ancestor God's battle ax began showing signs of cracking. Even such a divine armament was unable to withstand Yi Yun's nomological sword.

And as the density of cracks increased, a loud boom was heard as if something within the black ax had been slashed apart. The seal shattered as millions of souls surged out like a tidal wave.

These were the wraiths that Ancestor God had killed and sealed within his battle ax over hundreds of millions of years.

He had used potent forces to bind these wraiths and use their powers for his own. But at that moment in time, with the sealing powers shattered, all the wraiths escaped and charged in one direction—right at the Ancestor God. They gnawed at him, venting all their grievances that had been building up for hundreds of millions of years!

The powers of ghouls stemmed from their grievances, and at this moment, the backlash of billions of souls and their self-destructive rage struck at a critical juncture, right when the Ancestor God was being suppressed by Yi Yun. Even if they failed to injure him, their assault still affected his judgment.

"A murderer will be murdered, a world annihilator will suffer the wrath of the Heavenly Dao. Ancestor God, I will obliterate you today!"

Yi Yun let out a long cry and a massive wheel appeared behind him.

There were all kinds of demon gods on the wheel. It looked like the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence, but it was completely different. It was more like a galactic vortex that had just been born.

Yi Yun's Dao of Major Destruction came from the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch. The demon gods in the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence symbolized destruction, while a considerable portion of Yi Yun's Dao of Creation came from his own insights.

Creation and destruction was the tempo of the universe.

After Yi Yun combined the two together, the 10000 Demon Wheel of Existence he produced would be more aptly called the Wheel of Creation and Destruction. It was equivalent to the universe itself.

The moment the black wheel appeared, it attracted countless bolt of lightning. Each bolt of lightning extended for millions of kilometers as they illuminated the Multiverse rift. Each bolt of lightning was sufficient to blow up stars!

"This is a… Heavenly Tribulation?"

"Did the potency of his strength trigger a punishment from the heavens?"

People were astonished. The Heavenly Tribulation was attracted by Yi Yun's Martial Dao. The scale of a Heavenly Tribulation was no longer limited to the Chaos Heavens, but swept through the massive Multiverse rift.

Compared to a Heavenly Tribulation of this scale, the Fey tribulations and Ghost tribulations that Fey Thearchs or Ghost Thearchs experienced were starkly different and completely trivial. If they were to attempt to transcend such a tribulation, they would be instantly pulverized without leaving anything behind.

"Boom!"

The lightning from the Heavenly Tribulation smote down as the Chaos Heavens trembled in return.

When everyone felt that the Heavenly Tribulation would attack indiscriminately, another shocking scene happened. All the lightning of the Heavenly lightning gathered within Yi Yun's Wheel of Creation and Destruction!

Yi Yun's Martial Dao had triggered the Heavenly Tribulation, but the Heavenly Tribulation was completely at Yi Yun's beck and call.

The Wheel of Creation and Destruction struck down as the Ancestor God with his flailing golden hair charged up with battle ax in hand.

"Ka-cha!"

Divine blood splattered as everyone widened their eyes. This scene shocked everyone down to their very soul.

The Ancestor God's arm had been cleaved off!

The thousand-foot-long dark-golden arm was as heavy as a mountain. The Ancestor God's body could be said to be the most resilient object in the universe, but now, it had been sliced off by Yi Yun's nomological forces!

His arm fell to the ground, the impact cratering the land. This scene was like red-hot metal branding a piece of ice. The ground could not bear the weight of the Ancestor God's arm as it began to melt away.

As immense amount of mud and stone melted, the energies stored within the land began surging towards the Ancestor God's arm.

The Ancestor God grinned nefariously despite having an arm lopped off.

"You are truly impressive to be able to slice off my arm, but that doesn't do a thing to me. The Chaos Heavens cannot withstand the power of my arm. Unless you completely destroy that arm, it will sink deep into the Chaos Heavens' core and independently absorb energy till it develops its strength, to the point of becoming another avatar that can fuse with me! When that happens, I'll have all my powers restored. I would even have my strength enhanced!"

As the Ancestor God spoke, he held the battle ax horizontally across his chest with one arm.

Clearly, if Yi Yun attempted to destroy the Ancestor God's arm, the Ancestor God would launch an attack and not give Yi Yun the chance.

All the Godly Monarchs drew a gasp when they saw this scene. The Ancestor God was just too powerful. How terrifying was Yi Yun's strike that it could slice off the Ancestor God's arm? But even after doing this impressive feat, it did not deal much damage to the Ancestor God.

This defensive and regenerative ability left them in despair.

However, Yi Yun wasn't surprised.

The Ancestor God had cultivated to an extremely high realm. If one were to use astronomical bodies as an analogy, the Ancestor God was like a black hole. He could devour the other astronomical bodies that came close to it. Even a mere arm of his would absorb the Chaos Heavens' nomological powers if it landed in the Chaos Heavens.

Although the Chaos Heavens was massive, its energy was too diluted and unfocused. Only an expert like Yi Yun could bring out the full powers of the Chaos Heavens.

"Your arm is indeed powerful, but it is not your main body after all. Once it left your body, it is no longer as unassailable as before."

With nomological sword in hand, Yi Yun did not take any action. However, his expression was one of utmost confidence.

The Ancestor God sneered and just as he was about to mock Yi Yun, his expression changed.

He lowered his head suddenly and at his feet, the arm which had sank into the ground seemed to enter a boggy marsh and stopped sinking.

The pale golden luster of the arm gradually weakened as its powers rapidly drained!

Following that, from the middle of the arm, around where the elbow was, a black circular halo spread out. Due to the halo, the energy lusters of the arm completed faded away and the arm began to slowly rot.

This scene was as if the passing of billions of years was compressed into an instant. The Ancestor God's arm which had been cultivated to an extremum was rotting!

"How could this be!?"

The Ancestor God felt astounded. His lifespan was already almost equivalent to the more supreme of Great Worlds. Even after his death, his body would remained preserved for all eternity.

But now, there was no more eternity!

In just seconds, the Ancestor God's arm completely rotted away. And at this moment, a dark red bead flew out of his arm, deep red like a leech bloated with his blood.

As one of the three Universe seeds, the Primordial Chaos Demon Bead was the amalgamation of Spirit in the three major laws of Spirit, Qi, and Soul!

So-called "Spirit" referred to flesh and blood. It comprised everything, be it the universe or life's flesh and blood.

When Yi Yun slashed down with his sword, he had embedded the Primordial Chaos Spirit Bead in the Ancestor God's arm. And after the Ancestor God's arm was separated from his main body, it was basically an ownerless object. Just an arm alone was unable to withstand the combined assault of Yi Yun's laws and the Primordial Chaos Demon Bead.

Therefore, the arm had been devoured by the Primordial Chaos Demon Bead!

The essence within had been robbed by the Primordial Chaos Demon Bead and the remaining laws, Origins energy, and remnant lifeblood powers scattered and fused with the Chaos Heavens.

Instantly, the rotting arm rapidly burgeoned in size.

This was because the arm contained too much power. Even if the Primordial Chaos Demon Bead had siphoned off more than 90% of its powers, there was still a lot left.

Without any nomological restraints, the energy was no longer compressed as it naturally spread.

Soon, it reached a length of a thousand feet, increasing in orders of magnitudes without any cessation.

After the arm lost its luster, it turned into the color of dirt. Looking from afar, the Ancestor God's arm had become a huge mountain range!

It was hundreds of thousands of feet tall and hundreds of thousands of kilometers long. This massive mountain range was filled with rich Spirit Qi and was an absolute wonderland!

Such a wonderland would attract countless sects to station themselves here and use such a wonderland to nurture disciples. Not only so, with time, the wonderland would produce many natural treasures and rare beasts. It could even become a marvelous mystic realm.

Hundreds of millions of years later, illustrious Martial Dao heritage could appear here, giving birth to many powerful mighty figures!

Having anticipated this scene, Yi Yun felt wistful. "The Heavenly Dao's evolution is about formation, existence, disintegration, and emptiness. What you took away ultimately needs to be returned. All of this is fated. You… will not be able to destroy the Heavenly Dao!"

Yi Yun finally understood why the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch had not taken away the three Universe seeds when he left the Multiverse he was in. It was not only because of the nomological restraints, since it was possible that the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch could defy the laws and forcefully take away the Universe seeds. Yet, he didn't do so… probably because he understood the reason that the key elements of a Multiverse ultimately belonged to the Multiverse.

A warrior cultivated in martial arts their entire life, living a heaven-defying trajectory as they escaped Samsara. However, they could not bring about the destruction of the world itself or betray their ancestral heritage. The three Universe seeds did not belong to the Dao Originator Celestial Thearch, nor did they belong to Yi Yun. It was no one's, because they were meant to give rise to a brand new Universe.
